  onProviderChange?: (provider: 'INTERNAL_HSM' | 'EXTERNAL_HSM', statusData: any) => void;
}

export const HsmAuthoritySimulatorBar: React.FC<HsmAuthorityBadgeProps> = ({ onProviderChange }) => {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<any>(null);
  const [remoteUrl, setRemoteUrl] = useState<string>('http://127.0.0.1:8001');
  const [switching, setSwitching] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [syncMsg, setSyncMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const fetchStatus = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await api.get('/api/hsm/lmk-key-management/status');
      setStatus(res.data);
      if (res.data?.remote_url) {
        setRemoteUrl(res.data.remote_url);
      }
      if (onProviderChange && res.data?.active_provider) {
        onProviderChange(res.data.active_provider, res.data);
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchStatus();
  }, []);

  const switchMode = async (mode: 'INTERNAL_HSM' | 'EXTERNAL_HSM') => {
    setSwitching(true);
    setSyncMsg(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.post('/api/hsm/lmk-key-management/provider', {
        provider_mode: mode,
        remote_url: remoteUrl.trim(),
      });
      setStatus(res.data);
      sessionStorage.setItem('BAOBAB_HSM_MODE', mode);
      if (mode === 'EXTERNAL_HSM') {
        try {
          const syncRes = await api.post('/api/hsm/lmk-key-management/sync-seeded');
          setSyncMsg(`Synced ${syncRes.data.count || 8} keys from External Soft-HSM`);
        } catch {
          // ignore
        }
      }
      if (onProviderChange) {
        onProviderChange(mode, res.data);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Failed to switch HSM mode:', e);
    } finally {
      setSwitching(false);
    }
  };

  const isExternal = status?.active_provider === 'EXTERNAL_HSM';

  return (
    <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-3.5 mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 font-mono text-xs">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <span
          className={`inline-block w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full ${
            status?.online !== false ? 'bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse' : 'bg-rose-500'
          }`}
        />
        <div>
          <div className="text-slate-400 text-[11px]">ACTIVE CRYPTOGRAPHIC AUTHORITY & WIRE FORMAT INDICATOR</div>
          <div className="font-bold text-white flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 mt-0.5">
            <span>
              HSM Engine:{' '}
              <span className={isExternal ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-sky-400'}>
                {isExternal
                  ? 'EXTERNAL SOFT-HSM (Port 8001 · Thales payShield 10K Wire Format)'
                  : 'INTERNAL SIMULATOR HSM (Local In-Memory Format)'}
              </span>
            </span>
            {status?.lmk_check_value && (
              <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-800 text-amber-300 text-[10px]">
                LMK KCV: {status.lmk_check_value}
              </span>
            )}
            {syncMsg && (
              <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-950 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-700 text-[10px]">
                {syncMsg}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <button
          type="button"
          disabled={switching}
          onClick={() => switchMode('INTERNAL_HSM')}
          className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded font-bold transition ${
            !isExternal
              ? 'bg-sky-600 text-white shadow'
              : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-700'
          }`}
        >
          Internal HSM Format
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"

def patch_host_simulator():
    print("\n=== [2/3] Patching Host Simulator Frontend & Backend ===")
    if not HOST_SIM_ROOT.exists():
        print(f"  [!] Directory not found: {HOST_SIM_ROOT}")
        return

    services_api_path = HOST_SIM_ROOT / "frontend" / "src" / "services" / "api.ts"
    services_api_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    backup_file(services_api_path)
    services_api_path.write_text(FIXED_SERVICES_API_TS, encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"  [+] Updated {services_api_path.relative_to(HOST_SIM_ROOT)} with BAOBAB_AUTH_TOKEN support")

    comp_dir = HOST_SIM_ROOT / "frontend" / "src" / "components"
    comp_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    bar_path = comp_dir / "HsmAuthoritySimulatorBar.tsx"
    bar_path.write_text(HSM_AUTHORITY_BAR_TSX, encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"  [+] Created {bar_path.relative_to(HOST_SIM_ROOT)} indicator component")

    pages_dir = HOST_SIM_ROOT / "frontend" / "src" / "pages"
    if pages_dir.exists():
        for tsx_file in pages_dir.glob("*.tsx"):
            if any(k in tsx_file.name for k in ("Simulator", "Transaction", "Workbench", "Terminal")):
                if tsx_file.name == "KeyCeremonyWorkbenchPage.tsx":
                    continue
                content = tsx_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
                if "HsmAuthoritySimulatorBar" not in content:
                    backup_file(tsx_file)
                    content = "import { HsmAuthoritySimulatorBar } from '../components/HsmAuthoritySimulatorBar';\n" + content
                    content = re.sub(
                        r"(return\s*\(\s*<div[^>]*>)",
                        r"\1\n      <HsmAuthoritySimulatorBar />",
                        content,
                        count=1,
                    )
                    tsx_file.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
                    print(f"  [+] Injected Internal/External HSM Indicator Bar into {tsx_file.name}")

    config_py = HOST_SIM_ROOT / "backend" / "app" / "config.py"
    if config_py.exists():
        backup_file(config_py)
        cfg_text = config_py.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore").replace("\xa0", " ")
        cfg_text = re.sub(
            r'HSM_REMOTE_URL:\s*str\s*=\s*"[^"]*"',
            'HSM_REMOTE_URL: str = "http://127.0.0.1:8001/api/host/command"',
            cfg_text,
        )
        config_py.write_text(cfg_text, encoding="utf-8")
        print("  [+] Cleaned & pointed backend/app/config.py HSM_REMOTE_URL -> http://127.0.0.1:8001/api/host/command")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("==================================================================")
    print(" BAOBAB HOST <-> EXTERNAL SOFT-HSM UNIVERSAL PATCHER")
    print("==================================================================")
    patch_external_soft_hsm()
    patch_host_simulator()
    print("\n[SUCCESS] All patches applied cleanly!")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
fix_tic_decoder.py
Safely appends strict_mask_pan to backend/app/tic_decoder_engine.py
"""

from pathlib import Path

def main():
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    if not (root / "backend").exists() and (root.parent / "backend").exists():
        root = root.parent
    
    target_path = root / "backend" / "app" / "tic_decoder_engine.py"
    if not target_path.exists():
        print(f"Error: Could not find {target_path}")
        return

    print(f"Found target file: {target_path}")
    text = target_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    if "def strict_mask_pan" in text:
        print("✅ strict_mask_pan already exists in tic_decoder_engine.py")
        return

    helper_code = '''

def strict_mask_pan(pan) -> str:
    """Always masks PAN as 123456******1234 by default, even when LOG_RAW_DATA=True."""
    if not pan:
        return "****"
    clean = "".join(ch for ch in str(pan) if ch.isdigit())
    if len(clean) >= 10:
        return f"{clean[:6]}{'*' * (len(clean) - 10)}{clean[-4:]}"
    if "*" in str(pan):
        return str(pan)
    return "****"
'''

    target_path.write_text(text + helper_code, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    print("✨ Successfully added strict_mask_pan to tic_decoder_engine.py!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

const API_BASE = import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || '/api';

export function getToken(): string | null {
  return sessionStorage.getItem('BAOBAB_AUTH_TOKEN');
}

export function setAuthSession(token: string, username: string, hsmMode: string) {
  sessionStorage.setItem('BAOBAB_AUTH_TOKEN', token);
  sessionStorage.setItem('BAOBAB_USER', username);
  sessionStorage.setItem('BAOBAB_HSM_MODE', hsmMode);
}

export function clearAuthSession() {
  sessionStorage.removeItem('BAOBAB_AUTH_TOKEN');
  sessionStorage.removeItem('BAOBAB_USER');
  sessionStorage.removeItem('BAOBAB_HSM_MODE');
}

export async function apiFetch<T = any>(
  endpoint: string,
  options: RequestInit = {}
): Promise<T> {
  const token = getToken();
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    ...(options.headers as Record<string, string>),
  };
  if (token) {
    headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
  }

  const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${endpoint}`, {
    ...options,
    headers,
  });

  if (response.status === 401) {
    clearAuthSession();
    window.location.hash = '#/login';
    throw new Error('Session expired or unauthorized');
  }

  if (!response.ok) {
    let errText = `HTTP ${response.status}`;
    try {
      const errData = await response.json();
      errText = errData.detail || JSON.stringify(errData);
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
    throw new Error(errText);
  }

  return response.json();
}

export const Layout: React.FC<LayoutProps> = ({ children }) => {
  const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState(false);
  const [dark, setDark] = useState(() => document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark'));
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const hsmMode = sessionStorage.getItem('BAOBAB_HSM_MODE') || 'SOFT_HSM_LOCAL';
  const username = sessionStorage.getItem('BAOBAB_USER') || 'admin';

  const toggleDark = () => {
    const next = !dark;
    setDark(next);
    document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark', next);
  };

  const handleLogout = () => {
    clearAuthSession();
    navigate('/login');
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex h-screen overflow-hidden bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-950">
      {/* Dark Navy Sidebar */}
      <aside
        className={`${
          collapsed ? 'w-16' : 'w-64'
        } bg-slate-900 text-slate-200 flex flex-col border-r border-slate-800 transition-all duration-200 select-none`}
      >
        <div className="h-16 flex items-center justify-between px-4 border-b border-slate-800">
          {!collapsed && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <div className="h-3 w-3 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" />
              <div>
                <div className="font-mono font-bold text-sm tracking-wider text-white">BAOBAB HOST</div>
                <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-emerald-400">SWITCH SIMULATOR v1.0</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          <button
            onClick={() => setCollapsed(!collapsed)}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:text-white"
            title="Toggle Sidebar"
          >
            {collapsed ? <ChevronRight size={18} /> : <ChevronLeft size={18} />}
          </button>
        </div>

        <nav className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto py-3 px-2 space-y-1">
          {NAV_ITEMS.map((item) => {
            const Icon = item.icon;
            return (
              <NavLink
                key={item.to}
                to={item.to}
                end={item.to === '/'}
                className={({ isActive }) =>
                  `flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${
                    isActive
                      ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-sm'
                      : 'text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800/80 hover:text-white'
                  }`
                }
                title={collapsed ? item.label : undefined}
              >
                <Icon size={16} className="shrink-0" />
                {!collapsed && <span className="truncate">{item.label}</span>}
              </NavLink>
            );
          })}
        </nav>

        <div className="p-3 border-t border-slate-800 space-y-2">
          {!collapsed && (
            <div className="px-2 py-1.5 rounded bg-slate-950/90 border border-slate-800 text-[11px] font-mono">
              <div className="text-slate-400">HSM ADAPTER MODE:</div>
              <div className="text-emerald-400 font-bold truncate">{hsmMode}</div>
            </div>
          )}
          <button
            onClick={handleLogout}
            className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium bg-rose-950/50 text-rose-300 hover:bg-rose-900/60 border border-rose-800/40"
          >
            <LogOut size={15} />
            {!collapsed && <span>Sign Out ({username})</span>}
          </button>
        </div>
      </aside>

      {/* Main Content Area */}
      <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col overflow-hidden">
        <header className="h-14 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 px-6 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <span className="text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-semibold">
              Compass Plus TW TIC v2.164e
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs font-mono px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20 font-semibold">
              Thales payShield 10K Soft-HSM Connected
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <button
              onClick={toggleDark}
              className="p-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300"
              title="Toggle Light/Dark Mode"
            >
              {dark ? <Sun size={16} /> : <Moon size={16} />}
            </button>
          </div>
        </header>

        <main className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-6">{children}</main>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { History, Search, ArrowRight, Eye, ShieldAlert, CheckCircle2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { apiFetch } from '../api';

export const AuditTrailPage: React.FC = () => {
  const [logs, setLogs] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [entityType, setEntityType] = useState('');
  const [selectedAudit, setSelectedAudit] = useState<any | null>(null);

  const load = async () => {
    try {
      const q = entityType ? `?entity_type=${entityType}` : '';
      const res = await apiFetch(`/audit-trail${q}`);
      setLogs(res);
      if (res.length > 0 && !selectedAudit) setSelectedAudit(res[0]);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, [entityType]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold">Immutable System Audit Trail</h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
            Captures before and after JSON states for every administrative modification across Customers, Accounts, Cards, and Configuration
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <select
            value={entityType}
            onChange={(e) => setEntityType(e.target.value)}
            className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-mono"
          >
            <option value="">ALL ENTITY TYPES</option>
            <option value="CUSTOMER">CUSTOMERS</option>
            <option value="ACCOUNT">ACCOUNTS</option>
            <option value="CARD">CARDS</option>
            <option value="CARD_PROFILE">CARD PROFILES</option>
            <option value="TRANSACTION_CODE">TRANSACTION CODES</option>
            <option value="HSM_KEY">HSM KEYS</option>
            <option value="HOST_PARAMETER">HOST PARAMETERS</option>
            <option value="RESPONSE_CODE">RESPONSE CODES</option>
          </select>
          <button
            onClick={load}
            className="bg-emerald-600 text-white px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold"
          >
            Refresh
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        {/* Left 7 cols: Audit Events Table */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-7 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-left text-xs font-mono">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-400">
                <th className="py-2.5">Time</th>
                <th className="py-2.5">Entity</th>
                <th className="py-2.5">Action</th>
                <th className="py-2.5">Operator</th>
                <th className="py-2.5">Change Summary</th>
                <th className="py-2.5">Inspect</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-200/60 dark:divide-slate-800/60">
              {logs.map((a) => (
                <tr
                  key={a.id}
                  onClick={() => setSelectedAudit(a)}
                  className={`cursor-pointer transition ${selectedAudit?.id === a.id ? 'bg-emerald-500/10' : 'hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/40'}`}
                >
                  <td className="py-2.5 text-slate-400">{new Date(a.created_at).toLocaleTimeString()}</td>
                  <td className="py-2.5 font-bold text-emerald-500">{a.entity_type}</td>
                  <td className="py-2.5">
                    <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold ${
                      a.action === 'CREATE' ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-500' :
                      a.action === 'UPDATE' ? 'bg-sky-500/10 text-sky-400' :
                      'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-500'
                    }`}>
                      {a.action}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td className="py-2.5">{a.performed_by}</td>
                  <td className="py-2.5 font-sans truncate max-w-xs">{a.change_summary}</td>
                  <td className="py-2.5 text-sky-500 hover:underline">
                    <Eye size={14} />
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
              {logs.length === 0 && (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={6} className="py-8 text-center text-slate-400">
                    No audit records logged yet. Edit or delete an entity to generate audit entries.
                  </td>
                </tr>
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>

        {/* Right 5 cols: Diff Inspector */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
            <History size={16} className="text-emerald-500" /> State Diff Inspector
          </h2>
          {selectedAudit ? (
            <div className="space-y-3 text-xs font-mono">
              <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-1">
                <div><span className="text-slate-400">Audit ID:</span> {selectedAudit.id}</div>
                <div><span className="text-slate-400">Target Entity:</span> {selectedAudit.entity_type} ({selectedAudit.entity_id})</div>
                <div><span className="text-slate-400">Timestamp:</span> {new Date(selectedAudit.created_at).toLocaleString()}</div>
                <div><span className="text-slate-400">Action:</span> <span className="font-bold text-emerald-400">{selectedAudit.action}</span> by {selectedAudit.performed_by}</div>
                <div className="text-slate-300 font-sans pt-1 border-t border-slate-800">{selectedAudit.change_summary}</div>
              </div>

              {selectedAudit.before_state && (
                <div>
                  <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-rose-400 font-bold mb-1">State Before Change:</div>
                  <pre className="bg-slate-950 text-rose-300 p-3 rounded-lg max-h-48 overflow-y-auto text-[11px]">
                    {JSON.stringify(selectedAudit.before_state, null, 2)}
                  </pre>
                </div>
              )}

              {selectedAudit.after_state && (
                <div>
                  <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-emerald-400 font-bold mb-1">State After Change:</div>
                  <pre className="bg-slate-950 text-emerald-300 p-3 rounded-lg max-h-48 overflow-y-auto text-[11px]">
                    {JSON.stringify(selectedAudit.after_state, null, 2)}
                  </pre>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="text-xs font-mono text-slate-400 py-12 text-center">
              Select an audit event to inspect the before/after state diff.
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Sliders, ShieldCheck, Code2, Play, Plus, Trash2, CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle, RefreshCw } from 'lucide-react';
import { apiFetch } from '../api';

export const AuthorizerRulesPage: React.FC = () => {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'BUILTIN' | 'BUILDER' | 'CUSTOM'>('CUSTOM');
  const [rules, setRules] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [params, setParams] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [selectedRule, setSelectedRule] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [testExpression, setTestExpression] = useState('trancode == "10" and amount > 50000');
  const [testContext, setTestContext] = useState(
    JSON.stringify({ trancode: "10", amount: 65000, institution: { code: "IFIC" }, card_status: "ACTIVE" }, null, 2)
  );
  const [testResult, setTestResult] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState('');

  // New rule form
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    rule_code: 'RULE_HIGH_VAL',
    name: 'Decline Transactions Over 50,000 BDT',
    description: 'Fraud threshold rule rejecting high single-ticket debit amounts',
    priority: 50,
    rule_mode: 'SCRIPT',
    expression: 'amount > 50000',
    action: 'DECLINE',
    response_code: '61',
    message: 'High value transaction flagged by Host Authorizer Rule',
    stop_on_match: true,
    enabled: true,
  });

  const loadData = async () => {
    try {
      const [rList, pList] = await Promise.all([
        apiFetch('/authorizer-rules'),
        apiFetch('/host-parameters'),
      ]);
      setRules(rList);
      setParams(pList.filter((p: any) => p.parameter_group === 'BAOBAB_AUTH_RULES'));
      if (rList.length > 0 && !selectedRule) setSelectedRule(rList[0]);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, []);

  const handleCreateRule = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      await apiFetch('/authorizer-rules', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify(form),
      });
      setMsg(`Successfully created rule ${form.rule_code}`);
      loadData();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setMsg(`Error: ${err.message}`);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRule = async (id: string) => {
    if (!confirm('Delete this authorizer rule?')) return;
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/authorizer-rules/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
      setMsg('Rule deleted.');
      loadData();
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleTestExpression = async () => {
    try {
      let parsedContext = {};
      try {
        parsedContext = JSON.parse(testContext);
      } catch {
        alert('Invalid JSON in Test Context');
        return;
      }
      const res = await apiFetch('/authorizer-rules/dry-run', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ expression: testExpression, context: parsedContext }),
      });
      setTestResult(res);
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err.message);
    }
  };

  const toggleParam = async (p: any) => {
    const current = p.parameter_value?.enabled ?? p.active;
    const nextVal = { ...p.parameter_value, enabled: !current };
    await apiFetch(`/host-parameters/${p.id}`, {
      method: 'PUT',
      body: JSON.stringify({ parameter_value: nextVal, active: !current }),
    });
    loadData();
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold">Host Authorizer Rules Engine</h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
            Define dynamic pre-auth verification and fraud checks with safe AST expression evaluation (eval/exec-free)
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="text-xs font-mono px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-500 border border-emerald-500/20 font-bold">
            Execution Stage: PRE_CRYPTO
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {msg && (
        <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-400 text-xs font-mono">
          {msg}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tabs */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 pb-2">
        {[
          ['CUSTOM', '1. Custom Expression Rules & Test Bench', Code2],
          ['BUILTIN', '2. Built-in BAOBAB Checks', ShieldCheck],
          ['BUILDER', '3. Visual Condition Builder', Sliders],
        ].map(([k, label, Icon]: any) => (
          <button
            key={k}
            onClick={() => setTab(k)}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-bold transition ${
              tab === k
                ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-sm'
                : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800'
            }`}
          >
            <Icon size={15} />
            <span>{label}</span>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* TAB 1: CUSTOM RULES & TEST BENCH */}
      {tab === 'CUSTOM' && (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
            {/* Rules List (Left 6 cols) */}
            <div className="lg:col-span-6 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4">
              <h2 className="text-sm font-bold flex justify-between items-center">
                <span>Configured Authorizer Rules</span>
                <span className="text-xs font-mono text-slate-400">Total: {rules.length}</span>
              </h2>
              <div className="space-y-2 max-h-80 overflow-y-auto">
                {rules.map((r) => (
                  <div
                    key={r.id}
                    onClick={() => { setSelectedRule(r); setTestExpression(r.expression); }}
                    className={`p-3 rounded-lg border text-xs font-mono cursor-pointer transition ${
                      selectedRule?.id === r.id ? 'border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-500/10' : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                      <span className="font-bold text-emerald-400">{r.rule_code} (Priority {r.priority})</span>
                      <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold ${r.action === 'DECLINE' ? 'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-400' : 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400'}`}>
                        {r.action} (RC {r.response_code})
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-slate-300 font-sans mt-1">{r.name}</div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] text-sky-400 font-mono mt-1 truncate">Expr: {r.expression}</div>
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[10px] text-slate-500 mt-1 pt-1 border-t border-slate-800">
                      <span>Hits: <strong className="text-amber-400">{r.hit_count}</strong></span>
                      <button onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); handleDeleteRule(r.id); }} className="text-rose-500 hover:underline">Delete</button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
                {rules.length === 0 && (
                  <div className="py-12 text-center text-slate-400 text-xs font-mono">
                    No custom rules configured yet. Create one below.
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Create Rule Form */}
              <form onSubmit={handleCreateRule} className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-3 text-xs font-mono">
                <div className="font-bold text-sm">Add New Custom Rule</div>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                  <input
                    value={form.rule_code}
                    onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, rule_code: e.target.value })}
                    placeholder="Rule Code (e.g. RULE_BLOCK_POS)"
                    className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5"
                    required
                  />
                  <input
                    value={form.name}
                    onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, name: e.target.value })}
                    placeholder="Rule Name"
                    className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5"
                    required
                  />
                </div>
                <textarea
                  rows={2}
                  value={form.expression}
                  onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, expression: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="Safe Expression: trancode == '10' and amount > 50000"
                  className="w-full bg-slate-950 text-emerald-300 border border-slate-800 rounded p-2 text-xs font-mono"
                  required
                />
                <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                  <select
                    value={form.action}
                    onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, action: e.target.value })}
                    className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-2 py-1.5"
                  >
                    <option value="DECLINE">DECLINE</option>
                    <option value="APPROVE">APPROVE</option>
                    <option value="FLAG">FLAG</option>
                  </select>
                  <input
                    value={form.response_code}
                    onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, response_code: e.target.value })}
                    placeholder="Response Code (e.g. 61)"
                    maxLength={2}
                    className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-2 py-1.5"
                  />
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    value={form.priority}
                    onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, priority: parseInt(e.target.value) || 100 })}
                    placeholder="Priority (e.g. 50)"
                    className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-2 py-1.5"
                  />
                </div>
                <button type="submit" className="w-full bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white rounded py-2 font-semibold">
                  + Save Authorizer Rule
                </button>
              </form>
            </div>

            {/* Test Bench (Right 6 cols) */}
            <div className="lg:col-span-6 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4">
              <h2 className="text-sm font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
                <Play size={15} className="text-emerald-500" /> Expression Dry-Run Test Bench
              </h2>
              <div className="space-y-3 text-xs font-mono">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">Target Expression</label>
                  <input
                    value={testExpression}
                    onChange={(e) => setTestExpression(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-950 text-emerald-300 border border-slate-800 rounded px-3 py-2"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">Simulation Payload (JSON Context)</label>
                  <textarea
                    rows={6}
                    value={testContext}
                    onChange={(e) => setTestContext(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-950 text-sky-300 border border-slate-800 rounded p-2.5"
                  />
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={handleTestExpression}
                  className="bg-sky-600 hover:bg-sky-500 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-lg font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5"
                >
                  <Play size={13} /> Run AST Dry-Run Evaluation
                </button>

                {testResult && (
                  <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 space-y-1.5 text-xs font-mono">
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-800 pb-1.5">
                      <span className="text-slate-400">Evaluation Result:</span>
                      <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[11px] font-bold ${testResult.matched ? 'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-400' : 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400'}`}>
                        {testResult.matched ? 'MATCHED (TRUE)' : 'NOT MATCHED (FALSE)'}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div><span className="text-slate-400">AST Validation:</span> <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">{testResult.valid ? 'PASSED (Safe AST Whitelist)' : 'SYNTAX ERROR'}</span></div>
                    {testResult.error && <div className="text-rose-400">Error: {testResult.error}</div>}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TAB 2: BUILTIN CHECKS */}
      {tab === 'BUILTIN' && (
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-bold">Core BAOBAB Host Authorization Checks</h2>
          <div className="space-y-2 text-xs font-mono">
            {params.map((p) => {
              const enabled = p.parameter_value?.enabled ?? p.active;
              return (
                <div key={p.id} className="p-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 flex justify-between items-center">
                  <div>
                    <div className="font-bold text-emerald-400">{p.parameter_name}</div>
                    <div className="text-slate-400 font-sans text-[11px]">{p.description}</div>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => toggleParam(p)}
                    className={`px-3 py-1 rounded text-xs font-bold ${enabled ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white' : 'bg-rose-600 text-white'}`}
                  >
                    {enabled ? 'ENABLED' : 'DISABLED'}
                  </button>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TAB 3: VISUAL BUILDER */}
      {tab === 'BUILDER' && (
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-bold">Visual Condition Rule Builder</h2>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
            Generate safe AST expressions visually by selecting parameters and conditions.
          </p>
          <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-3 text-xs font-mono">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-2">
              <select className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5">
                <option value="amount">Transaction Amount (amount)</option>
                <option value="trancode">Transaction Code (trancode)</option>
                <option value="institution.code">Bank Code (institution.code)</option>
                <option value="card_status">Card Status (card_status)</option>
              </select>
              <select className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5">
                <option value=">">Greater than (&gt;)</option>
                <option value="<">Less than (&lt;)</option>
                <option value="==">Equals (==)</option>
                <option value="!=">Not equal (!=)</option>
              </select>
              <input placeholder="Value (e.g. 50000)" className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5" />
            </div>
            <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
              Generated expression: <code className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">amount &gt; 50000</code>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
