import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Landmark, ArrowRightLeft, Clock, CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle, RefreshCw, FileText, Play, Layers, DollarSign } from 'lucide-react';
import { apiFetch } from '../api';

export const ClearingAndSettlementPage: React.FC = () => {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'BATCHES' | 'POSITIONS' | 'RECON' | 'SCENARIOS'>('BATCHES');
  const [recon, setRecon] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [batches, setBatches] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [selectedBatch, setSelectedBatch] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [positions, setPositions] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [cutoverMsg, setCutoverMsg] = useState('');
  const [scenarioResult, setScenarioResult] = useState<any | null>(null);

  const loadData = async () => {
    try {
      const [rData, bData] = await Promise.all([
        apiFetch('/settlement/reconciliation'),
        apiFetch('/settlement/batches'),
      ]);
      setRecon(rData);
      setBatches(bData);
      if (bData.length > 0 && !selectedBatch) {
        inspectBatch(bData[0].id);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, []);

  const inspectBatch = async (batchId: string) => {
    try {
      const data = await apiFetch(`/settlement/batches/${batchId}`);
      setSelectedBatch(data.batch);
      setPositions(data.positions || []);
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleExecuteCutover = async () => {
    setCutoverMsg('');
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch('/settlement/cutover', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ ps_code: 'ITCL' }),
      });
      setCutoverMsg(`Cutover Batch ${res.batch_number} executed: Settled ${res.total_transactions} transactions (${res.total_amount.toLocaleString()} BDT) across ${res.institutions_settled} banks.`);
      loadData();
      inspectBatch(res.batch_id);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setCutoverMsg(`Error: ${err.message}`);
    }
  };

  const handleRunScenarios = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch('/settlement/run-scenarios', { method: 'POST' });
      setScenarioResult(res);
      loadData();
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err.message);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold">Clearing, Daily Settlement & Multilateral Reconciliation</h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
            Dual-balance holds vs ledger clearing, interchange fee calculation, daily cutover batches, and bank settlement positions
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <button
            onClick={handleExecuteCutover}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white text-xs font-semibold shadow"
          >
            <Clock size={14} /> Execute Daily Settlement Cutover
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {cutoverMsg && (
        <div className="p-3.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-400 text-xs font-mono">
          {cutoverMsg}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* KPI Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400">TOTAL APPROVED TXS</div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-emerald-400 mt-1">
            {recon?.total_approved_transactions || 0}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400">TOTAL CLEARED / SETTLED</div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-sky-400 mt-1">
            {recon?.total_settled_transactions || 0}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400">PENDING BATCH CLEARING</div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-amber-400 mt-1">
            {recon?.pending_clearing_transactions || 0}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400">SWITCH RECONCILIATION</div>
          <div className="text-sm font-bold font-mono text-emerald-400 mt-2">
            {recon?.reconciliation_status || 'BALANCED'}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Tabs */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 pb-2">
        {[
          ['BATCHES', '1. Settlement Batches', Clock],
          ['POSITIONS', '2. Bank Net Positions', Landmark],
          ['SCENARIOS', '3. Scenario Test Runner', Play],
        ].map(([k, label, Icon]: any) => (
          <button
            key={k}
            onClick={() => setTab(k)}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-bold transition ${
              tab === k
                ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-sm'
                : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800'
            }`}
          >
            <Icon size={15} />
            <span>{label}</span>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* TAB 1: BATCHES */}
      {tab === 'BATCHES' && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
          <div className="lg:col-span-7 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 overflow-x-auto">
            <h2 className="text-sm font-bold mb-3">Settlement Cutover Batches</h2>
            <table className="w-full text-left text-xs font-mono">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-400">
                  <th className="py-2.5">Batch Number</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">Scheme</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">Cutover Time</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">Transactions</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">Volume (BDT)</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">Fees</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">Status</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-200/60 dark:divide-slate-800/60">
                {batches.map((b) => (
                  <tr
                    key={b.id}
                    onClick={() => inspectBatch(b.id)}
                    className={`cursor-pointer transition ${selectedBatch?.id === b.id ? 'bg-emerald-500/10' : 'hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/50'}`}
                  >
                    <td className="py-2.5 font-bold text-sky-400">{b.batch_number}</td>
                    <td className="py-2.5 text-emerald-400 font-bold">{b.ps_code}</td>
                    <td className="py-2.5 text-slate-400">{new Date(b.cutover_time).toLocaleTimeString()}</td>
                    <td className="py-2.5 font-bold">{b.total_transactions}</td>
                    <td className="py-2.5">{b.total_amount.toLocaleString()}</td>
                    <td className="py-2.5 text-amber-400">{b.total_fees.toLocaleString()}</td>
                    <td className="py-2.5">
                      <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400">
                        {b.status}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
                {batches.length === 0 && (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan={7} className="py-8 text-center text-slate-400">
                      No settlement batches closed yet. Click "Execute Daily Settlement Cutover" to clear current transactions.
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                )}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>

          <div className="lg:col-span-5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4">
            <h2 className="text-sm font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
              <Landmark size={16} className="text-emerald-500" /> Multilateral Net Settlement Positions
            </h2>
            {selectedBatch ? (
              <div className="space-y-3 text-xs font-mono">
                <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 space-y-1">
                  <div>Batch: <span className="text-sky-400 font-bold">{selectedBatch.batch_number}</span></div>
                  <div>Scheme: {selectedBatch.ps_code} Switch · Total Settled: {selectedBatch.total_amount.toLocaleString()} BDT</div>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-2 max-h-72 overflow-y-auto">
                  {positions.map((pos) => {
                    const isCreditor = pos.net_settlement_amount >= 0;
                    return (
                      <div key={pos.id} className="p-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 flex justify-between items-center">
                        <div>
                          <div className="font-bold text-emerald-400">{pos.institution_name} ({pos.institution_code})</div>
                          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
                            Debits: {pos.debit_count} ({pos.debit_volume.toLocaleString()}) · Credits: {pos.credit_count} ({pos.credit_volume.toLocaleString()})
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-amber-400">Net Fee Share: {pos.net_fee_amount.toLocaleString()} BDT</div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-right">
                          <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold ${isCreditor ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400' : 'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-400'}`}>
                            {isCreditor ? 'NET CREDITOR (Receives)' : 'NET DEBTOR (Pays)'}
                          </span>
                          <div className={`text-sm font-bold mt-1 ${isCreditor ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-rose-400'}`}>
                            {pos.net_settlement_amount.toLocaleString()} BDT
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="text-slate-400 text-xs font-mono py-16 text-center">
                Select a batch on the left to inspect its bank-by-bank net clearing positions.
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TAB 2: BANK POSITIONS */}
      {tab === 'POSITIONS' && (
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 overflow-x-auto">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-bold mb-3">Latest Multilateral Clearing Positions (Per Member Bank)</h2>
          <table className="w-full text-left text-xs font-mono">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-400">
                <th className="py-2.5">Bank</th>
                <th className="py-2.5">Debit Volume (Dispensed to Cardholders)</th>
                <th className="py-2.5">Credit Volume (Acquired from Others)</th>
                <th className="py-2.5">Net Fee Amount</th>
                <th className="py-2.5">Net Settlement Position</th>
                <th className="py-2.5">Obligation Status</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-200/60 dark:divide-slate-800/60">
              {positions.map((pos) => {
                const isCreditor = pos.net_settlement_amount >= 0;
                return (
                  <tr key={pos.id}>
                    <td className="py-2.5 font-bold text-emerald-400">{pos.institution_name} ({pos.institution_code})</td>
                    <td className="py-2.5 text-rose-400">{pos.debit_volume.toLocaleString()} BDT</td>
                    <td className="py-2.5 text-emerald-400">{pos.credit_volume.toLocaleString()} BDT</td>
                    <td className="py-2.5 text-amber-400">{pos.net_fee_amount.toLocaleString()} BDT</td>
                    <td className={`py-2.5 font-bold ${isCreditor ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-rose-400'}`}>
                      {pos.net_settlement_amount.toLocaleString()} BDT
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-2.5">
                      <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold ${isCreditor ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400' : 'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-400'}`}>
                        {isCreditor ? 'RECEIVES FROM SWITCH' : 'MUST PAY SWITCH'}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                );
              })}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TAB 3: SCENARIOS */}
      {tab === 'SCENARIOS' && (
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4">
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-sm font-bold">Automated Clearing Regression Test Suite</h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                Dispatches a batch of multi-bank transactions across xBank, yBank, and zBank to test clearing, interchange fee splits, and reconciliation
              </p>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={handleRunScenarios}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold"
            >
              <Play size={14} /> Run Multi-Bank Settlement Batch
            </button>
          </div>

          {scenarioResult && (
            <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 text-xs font-mono space-y-2">
              <div className="text-emerald-400 font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <CheckCircle2 size={16} /> Batch Scenario Execution Completed
              </div>
              <div>Dispatched: <strong className="text-white">{scenarioResult.transactions_generated} transactions</strong></div>
              <div>Approved: <strong className="text-emerald-400">{scenarioResult.approved_count}</strong> · Declined: <strong className="text-rose-400">{scenarioResult.declined_count}</strong></div>
              <div className="text-slate-400 pt-1 border-t border-slate-800">
                Transactions generated across multiple banks. Now click "Execute Daily Settlement Cutover" above to clear them.
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  Search,
  User,
  CreditCard,
  Landmark,
  Trash2,
  Link as LinkIcon,
  Unlink,
  RefreshCw,
  Edit3,
  KeyRound,
  Plus,
  CheckCircle2,
  ShieldAlert,
  ArrowRightLeft,
  Loader2,
  X,
  ChevronRight,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { apiFetch } from '../api';

type SearchMode = 'all' | 'customer' | 'pan' | 'account';

const MODE_TABS: { id: SearchMode; label: string; icon: React.ReactNode; hint: string }[] = [
  { id: 'all', label: 'All', icon: <Search size={14} />, hint: 'CIF, name, PAN or account' },
  { id: 'customer', label: 'Customer', icon: <User size={14} />, hint: 'Customer number / name / mobile' },
  { id: 'pan', label: 'PAN / Card', icon: <CreditCard size={14} />, hint: 'Full or partial PAN' },
  { id: 'account', label: 'Account', icon: <Landmark size={14} />, hint: 'Account number' },
];

export const CustomerDataMaintenancePage: React.FC = () => {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<SearchMode>('all');
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [customers, setCustomers] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [allAccounts, setAllAccounts] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [allCustomers, setAllCustomers] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [selectedCustId, setSelectedCustId] = useState<string>('');
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [stats, setStats] = useState({ total_customers: 0, total_cards: 0, total_accounts: 0 });

  // Modals
  const [editAccountModal, setEditAccountModal] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [pinModalCard, setPinModalCard] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [newPin, setNewPin] = useState('1234');
  const [linkModalCard, setLinkModalCard] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [targetAccountId, setTargetAccountId] = useState('');
  const [linkRole, setLinkRole] = useState('SECONDARY');
  const [reassignModalCard, setReassignModalCard] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [reassignCustId, setReassignCustId] = useState('');

  const loadWorkspace = useCallback(
    async (query: string = searchTerm, activeMode: SearchMode = mode) => {
      setLoading(true);
      setError('');
      try {
        const params = new URLSearchParams();
        if (query.trim()) params.set('q', query.trim());
        params.set('mode', activeMode);
        const res = await apiFetch(`/maintenance/search?${params.toString()}`);
        const custList = res.customers || [];
        setCustomers(custList);
        setAllAccounts(res.all_accounts || []);
        setAllCustomers(res.all_customers || []);
        setStats({
          total_customers: res.total_customers ?? custList.length,
          total_cards: res.total_cards ?? 0,
          total_accounts: res.total_accounts ?? 0,
        });
        if (custList.length > 0) {
          const still = custList.find((c: any) => c.id === selectedCustId);
          setSelectedCustId(still ? still.id : custList[0].id);
        } else {
          setSelectedCustId('');
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err.message || 'Search failed');
        setCustomers([]);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    },
    [searchTerm, mode, selectedCustId]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    loadWorkspace('', 'all');
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const selectedCust = useMemo(
    () => customers.find((c) => c.id === selectedCustId) || null,
    [customers, selectedCustId]
  );

  const handleSearchSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    loadWorkspace(searchTerm, mode);
  };

  const switchMode = (m: SearchMode) => {
    setMode(m);
    loadWorkspace(searchTerm, m);
  };

  const flash = (text: string, isError = false) => {
    if (isError) {
      setError(text);
      setMsg('');
    } else {
      setMsg(text);
      setError('');
    }
  };

  // ---------- Account balance edit ----------
  const handleSaveAccountEdit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!editAccountModal) return;
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/accounts/${editAccountModal.id}`, {
        method: 'PUT',
        body: JSON.stringify({
          account_type: editAccountModal.account_type,
          available_balance: Number(editAccountModal.available_balance),
          ledger_balance: Number(editAccountModal.ledger_balance),
          overdraft_limit: Number(editAccountModal.overdraft_limit || 0),
          account_status: editAccountModal.account_status,
        }),
      });
      flash(
        `Account ${editAccountModal.account_number} updated — Available ${Number(
          editAccountModal.available_balance
        ).toLocaleString()} ${editAccountModal.currency}`
      );
      setEditAccountModal(null);
      await loadWorkspace(searchTerm, mode);
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message || 'Update failed', true);
    }
  };

  // ---------- Delete account ----------
  const handleDeleteAccount = async (acct: any) => {
    if (!confirm(`Delete account ${acct.account_number}? Cards will be detached.`)) return;
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/accounts/${acct.id}?force=true`, { method: 'DELETE' });
      flash(`Account ${acct.account_number} deleted`);
      await loadWorkspace(searchTerm, mode);
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  // ---------- Link / Unlink / Promote ----------
  const handleLinkAccount = async () => {
    if (!linkModalCard || !targetAccountId) return;
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/cards/${linkModalCard.id}/accounts`, {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({
          account_id: targetAccountId,
          account_role: linkRole,
          priority: (linkModalCard.card_accounts?.length || 0) + 1,
        }),
      });
      flash(`Linked account to ${linkModalCard.masked_pan} as ${linkRole}`);
      setLinkModalCard(null);
      await loadWorkspace(searchTerm, mode);
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  const handleUnlink = async (linkId: string, acctNum: string, maskedPan: string) => {
    if (!confirm(`Unlink ${acctNum} from ${maskedPan}?`)) return;
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/cards/accounts/${linkId}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
      flash(`Unlinked ${acctNum}`);
      await loadWorkspace(searchTerm, mode);
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  const handleSetPrimary = async (linkId: string, acctNum: string) => {
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/cards/accounts/${linkId}`, {
        method: 'PUT',
        body: JSON.stringify({ account_role: 'PRIMARY', priority: 1 }),
      });
      flash(`${acctNum} is now PRIMARY`);
      await loadWorkspace(searchTerm, mode);
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  // ---------- PIN change ----------
  const handleChangePin = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!pinModalCard) return;
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch(`/cards/${pinModalCard.id}/pin`, {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ new_pin: newPin }),
      });
      flash(`PIN updated for ${pinModalCard.masked_pan} — new PVV/Offset: ${res.new_pvv || 'OK'}`);
      setPinModalCard(null);
      setNewPin('1234');
      await loadWorkspace(searchTerm, mode);
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  // ---------- Reassign card to another customer ----------
  const handleReassignCustomer = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!reassignModalCard || !reassignCustId) return;
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch(`/cards/${reassignModalCard.id}/reassign-customer`, {
        method: 'PUT',
        body: JSON.stringify({ customer_id: reassignCustId }),
      });
      flash(
        `Card ${reassignModalCard.masked_pan} moved to customer ${res.new_customer_number}`
      );
      setReassignModalCard(null);
      setReassignCustId('');
      await loadWorkspace(searchTerm, mode);
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  // ---------- Delete card ----------
  const handleDeleteCard = async (card: any) => {
    if (!confirm(`Delete card ${card.masked_pan}?`)) return;
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/cards/${card.id}?force=true`, { method: 'DELETE' });
      flash(`Card ${card.masked_pan} deleted`);
      await loadWorkspace(searchTerm, mode);
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  // ---------- Update customer basics ----------
  const handleUpdateCustomer = async (fields: Record<string, any>) => {
    if (!selectedCust) return;
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/customers/${selectedCust.id}`, {
        method: 'PUT',
        body: JSON.stringify(fields),
      });
      flash('Customer updated');
      await loadWorkspace(searchTerm, mode);
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2">
            <ShieldAlert className="text-emerald-500" size={22} />
            Customer Data Maintenance 360
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1 max-w-2xl">
            Search by Customer, PAN or Account. Inspect relationships, edit balances, re-link
            accounts, change PIN, reassign cards, and delete entities — all in one modern workspace.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] font-mono">
          <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-sky-500/10 text-sky-400 border border-sky-500/20">
            {stats.total_customers} customers
          </span>
          <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20">
            {stats.total_cards} cards
          </span>
          <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/20">
            {stats.total_accounts} accounts
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Alerts */}
      {msg && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 p-3 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-400 text-xs font-mono">
          <CheckCircle2 size={16} /> {msg}
          <button onClick={() => setMsg('')} className="ml-auto opacity-60 hover:opacity-100">
            <X size={14} />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
      {error && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 p-3 rounded-xl bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-500/30 text-rose-400 text-xs font-mono">
          <ShieldAlert size={16} /> {error}
          <button onClick={() => setError('')} className="ml-auto opacity-60 hover:opacity-100">
            <X size={14} />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Search mode tabs + bar */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-sm space-y-3">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
          {MODE_TABS.map((t) => (
            <button
              key={t.id}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => switchMode(t.id)}
              className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-all ${
                mode === t.id
                  ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-md shadow-emerald-600/25'
                  : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700'
              }`}
            >
              {t.icon}
              {t.label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleSearchSubmit} className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-[240px]">
            <Search size={15} className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />
            <input
              value={searchTerm}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={MODE_TABS.find((t) => t.id === mode)?.hint || 'Search…'}
              className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 text-sm font-mono focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/40 focus:border-emerald-500 outline-none"
            />
          </div>
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={loading}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 disabled:opacity-50 text-white px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold shadow-md shadow-emerald-600/20"
          >
            {loading ? <Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin" /> : <Search size={14} />}
            Search
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setSearchTerm('');
              loadWorkspace('', mode);
            }}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 text-xs font-medium hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800"
          >
            <RefreshCw size={14} /> Reset
          </button>
        </form>
      </div>

      {/* Main split layout */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-5 min-h-[520px]">
        {/* Left: customer list */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-4 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col">
          <div className="px-4 py-3 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">
              Matched Customers
            </span>
            <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-emerald-500">{customers.length}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto max-h-[640px]">
            {loading && customers.length === 0 && (
              <div className="p-8 text-center text-slate-400 text-xs">
                <Loader2 className="animate-spin mx-auto mb-2" size={20} /> Searching…
              </div>
            )}
            {!loading && customers.length === 0 && (
              <div className="p-8 text-center text-slate-400 text-xs">
                No customers matched. Try a different mode or term.
              </div>
            )}
            {customers.map((c) => {
              const active = c.id === selectedCustId;
              return (
                <button
                  key={c.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSelectedCustId(c.id)}
                  className={`w-full text-left px-4 py-3 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/80 transition-colors ${
                    active
                      ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 border-l-2 border-l-emerald-500'
                      : 'hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/50 border-l-2 border-l-transparent'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                    <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-emerald-500">
                      {c.customer_number}
                    </span>
                    <span
                      className={`text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-bold ${
                        c.customer_status === 'ACTIVE'
                          ? 'bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400'
                          : 'bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-400'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {c.customer_status}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-sm font-medium mt-0.5 truncate">
                    {c.first_name} {c.last_name}
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
                    <span className="text-sky-400">{c.institution_code || '—'}</span>
                    <span>·</span>
                    <span>{(c.cards || []).length} cards</span>
                    <span>·</span>
                    <span>{(c.accounts || []).length} accts</span>
                  </div>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right: detail workspace */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-8 space-y-4">
          {!selectedCust ? (
            <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-16 text-center text-slate-400 text-sm">
              Select a customer from the left list or search by PAN / Account above.
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              {/* Customer header card */}
              <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-5">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
                  <div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <User size={18} className="text-emerald-500" />
                      <h2 className="text-lg font-bold">
                        {selectedCust.first_name} {selectedCust.last_name}
                      </h2>
                      <span className="font-mono text-xs text-emerald-500 bg-emerald-500/10 px-2 py-0.5 rounded">
                        {selectedCust.customer_number}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="mt-2 grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3 text-xs font-mono text-slate-400">
                      <div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide">Bank</div>
                        <div className="text-sky-400 font-bold">
                          {selectedCust.institution_code || '—'}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide">Mobile</div>
                        <div className="text-slate-200">{selectedCust.mobile_number || '—'}</div>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide">Risk</div>
                        <div>{selectedCust.risk_category || 'NORMAL'}</div>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide">Status</div>
                        <div
                          className={
                            selectedCust.customer_status === 'ACTIVE'
                              ? 'text-emerald-400 font-bold'
                              : 'text-rose-400 font-bold'
                          }
                        >
                          {selectedCust.customer_status}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() =>
                        handleUpdateCustomer({
                          customer_status:
                            selectedCust.customer_status === 'ACTIVE' ? 'BLOCKED' : 'ACTIVE',
                        })
                      }
                      className="text-xs px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800"
                    >
                      {selectedCust.customer_status === 'ACTIVE' ? 'Block' : 'Activate'}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Accounts section */}
              <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden">
                <div className="px-5 py-3 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Landmark size={16} className="text-amber-500" />
                  <h3 className="text-sm font-bold">Accounts</h3>
                  <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400 ml-auto">
                    {(selectedCust.accounts || []).length}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800">
                  {(selectedCust.accounts || []).length === 0 && (
                    <div className="p-6 text-xs text-slate-400 text-center">No accounts</div>
                  )}
                  {(selectedCust.accounts || []).map((a: any) => (
                    <div
                      key={a.id}
                      className="px-5 py-3.5 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 hover:bg-slate-50/50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/30"
                    >
                      <div>
                        <div className="font-mono text-sm font-bold text-emerald-500">
                          {a.account_number}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-mono mt-0.5">
                          {a.account_type} · {a.account_status} · OD {Number(a.overdraft_limit || 0).toLocaleString()}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-right">
                        <div className="text-sm font-bold font-mono">
                          {Number(a.available_balance).toLocaleString()}{' '}
                          <span className="text-slate-400 text-xs">{a.currency}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
                          Ledger {Number(a.ledger_balance).toLocaleString()}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setEditAccountModal({ ...a })}
                          className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-emerald-600/10 text-emerald-400 hover:bg-emerald-600/20"
                        >
                          <Edit3 size={12} /> Balance
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleDeleteAccount(a)}
                          className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-rose-600/10 text-rose-400 hover:bg-rose-600/20"
                        >
                          <Trash2 size={12} />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Cards section */}
              <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden">
                <div className="px-5 py-3 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <CreditCard size={16} className="text-sky-500" />
                  <h3 className="text-sm font-bold">Cards</h3>
                  <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400 ml-auto">
                    {(selectedCust.cards || []).length}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="p-4 space-y-4">
                  {(selectedCust.cards || []).length === 0 && (
                    <div className="p-4 text-xs text-slate-400 text-center">No cards</div>
                  )}
                  {(selectedCust.cards || []).map((card: any) => (
                    <div
                      key={card.id}
                      className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-950/50 p-4 space-y-3"
                    >
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
                        <div>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <span className="font-mono text-base font-bold text-sky-400">
                              {card.masked_pan}
                            </span>
                            <span
                              className={`text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-bold ${
                                card.card_status === 'ACTIVE'
                                  ? 'bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400'
                                  : 'bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-400'
                              }`}
                            >
                              {card.card_status}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-mono mt-1">
                            Ref {card.test_pan_reference} · {card.cardholder_name} · Exp{' '}
                            {String(card.expiry_month).padStart(2, '0')}/{card.expiry_year} ·{' '}
                            {card.card_product}
                          </div>
                          {card.pin_profile && (
                            <div className="text-[11px] text-amber-400/90 font-mono mt-1">
                              {card.pin_profile.verification_method} · PVV/Offset{' '}
                              {card.pin_profile.pin_offset_reference} · CVV{' '}
                              {card.pin_profile.cvv_reference || '—'}
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => {
                              setPinModalCard(card);
                              setNewPin('1234');
                            }}
                            className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-violet-600/10 text-violet-400 hover:bg-violet-600/20"
                          >
                            <KeyRound size={12} /> PIN
                          </button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => {
                              setLinkModalCard(card);
                              setTargetAccountId(allAccounts[0]?.id || '');
                              setLinkRole('SECONDARY');
                            }}
                            className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-sky-600/10 text-sky-400 hover:bg-sky-600/20"
                          >
                            <LinkIcon size={12} /> Link Acct
                          </button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => {
                              setReassignModalCard(card);
                              setReassignCustId(allCustomers[0]?.id || '');
                            }}
                            className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-amber-600/10 text-amber-400 hover:bg-amber-600/20"
                          >
                            <ArrowRightLeft size={12} /> Reassign
                          </button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleDeleteCard(card)}
                            className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-rose-600/10 text-rose-400 hover:bg-rose-600/20"
                          >
                            <Trash2 size={12} />
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* Linked accounts */}
                      <div className="space-y-1.5">
                        <div className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500 font-bold">
                          Linked Accounts
                        </div>
                        {(card.card_accounts || []).length === 0 && (
                          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 italic">No linked accounts</div>
                        )}
                        {(card.card_accounts || []).map((lnk: any) => (
                          <div
                            key={lnk.id}
                            className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-xs font-mono"
                          >
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                              <ChevronRight size={12} className="text-slate-500" />
                              <span className="font-bold text-emerald-500">{lnk.account_number}</span>
                              <span className="text-slate-400">{lnk.account_type}</span>
                              <span
                                className={`text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-bold ${
                                  lnk.account_role === 'PRIMARY'
                                    ? 'bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400'
                                    : 'bg-slate-500/15 text-slate-400'
                                }`}
                              >
                                {lnk.account_role}
                              </span>
                              <span className="text-slate-400">
                                Avl {Number(lnk.available_balance).toLocaleString()} {lnk.currency}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex gap-1.5">
                              {lnk.account_role !== 'PRIMARY' && (
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  onClick={() => handleSetPrimary(lnk.id, lnk.account_number)}
                                  className="text-[10px] text-emerald-400 hover:underline"
                                >
                                  Make Primary
                                </button>
                              )}
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() =>
                                  handleUnlink(lnk.id, lnk.account_number, card.masked_pan)
                                }
                                className="text-[10px] text-rose-400 hover:underline flex items-center gap-0.5"
                              >
                                <Unlink size={10} /> Unlink
                              </button>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ========== MODALS ========== */}

      {/* Edit Account Balance */}
      {editAccountModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <form
            onSubmit={handleSaveAccountEdit}
            className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-6 w-full max-w-md space-y-4 shadow-2xl"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <h2 className="text-sm font-bold font-mono text-emerald-400">
                Edit Account {editAccountModal.account_number}
              </h2>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setEditAccountModal(null)}>
                <X size={16} className="text-slate-400" />
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-xs font-mono">
              <label className="space-y-1">
                <span className="text-slate-400">Available Balance</span>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  step="0.01"
                  value={editAccountModal.available_balance}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setEditAccountModal({
                      ...editAccountModal,
                      available_balance: e.target.value,
                    })
                  }
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2"
                />
              </label>
              <label className="space-y-1">
                <span className="text-slate-400">Ledger Balance</span>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  step="0.01"
                  value={editAccountModal.ledger_balance}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setEditAccountModal({
                      ...editAccountModal,
                      ledger_balance: e.target.value,
                    })
                  }
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2"
                />
              </label>
              <label className="space-y-1">
                <span className="text-slate-400">Overdraft Limit</span>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  step="0.01"
                  value={editAccountModal.overdraft_limit || 0}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setEditAccountModal({
                      ...editAccountModal,
                      overdraft_limit: e.target.value,
                    })
                  }
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2"
                />
              </label>
              <label className="space-y-1">
                <span className="text-slate-400">Status</span>
                <select
                  value={editAccountModal.account_status}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setEditAccountModal({
                      ...editAccountModal,
                      account_status: e.target.value,
                    })
                  }
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2"
                >
                  <option value="ACTIVE">ACTIVE</option>
                  <option value="BLOCKED">BLOCKED</option>
                  <option value="CLOSED">CLOSED</option>
                </select>
              </label>
              <label className="space-y-1 col-span-2">
                <span className="text-slate-400">Account Type</span>
                <select
                  value={editAccountModal.account_type}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setEditAccountModal({
                      ...editAccountModal,
                      account_type: e.target.value,
                    })
                  }
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2"
                >
                  <option value="SAVINGS">SAVINGS</option>
                  <option value="CURRENT">CURRENT</option>
                  <option value="CREDIT">CREDIT</option>
                </select>
              </label>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setEditAccountModal(null)}
                className="px-4 py-2 text-xs rounded-lg"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white px-5 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold"
              >
                Save Balances
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Change PIN */}
      {pinModalCard && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <form
            onSubmit={handleChangePin}
            className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-6 w-full max-w-sm space-y-4 shadow-2xl"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <h2 className="text-sm font-bold">Change PIN — {pinModalCard.masked_pan}</h2>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setPinModalCard(null)}>
                <X size={16} className="text-slate-400" />
              </button>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
              New clear PIN will recalculate Visa PVV / IBM offset via Soft-HSM.
            </p>
            <input
              type="password"
              inputMode="numeric"
              pattern="[0-9]*"
              minLength={4}
              maxLength={12}
              value={newPin}
              onChange={(e) => setNewPin(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2.5 font-mono text-center text-lg tracking-widest"
              required
            />
            <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setPinModalCard(null)} className="px-4 py-2 text-xs">
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="bg-violet-600 hover:bg-violet-500 text-white px-5 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold"
              >
                Update PIN
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Link Account */}
      {linkModalCard && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-6 w-full max-w-md space-y-4 shadow-2xl">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <h2 className="text-sm font-bold">Link Account → {linkModalCard.masked_pan}</h2>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setLinkModalCard(null)}>
                <X size={16} className="text-slate-400" />
              </button>
            </div>
            <select
              value={targetAccountId}
              onChange={(e) => setTargetAccountId(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs font-mono"
            >
              {allAccounts.map((a) => (
                <option key={a.id} value={a.id}>
                  {a.account_number} ({a.account_type}) — {a.customer_name} —{' '}
                  {Number(a.available_balance).toLocaleString()} {a.currency}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
            <select
              value={linkRole}
              onChange={(e) => setLinkRole(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs font-mono"
            >
              <option value="PRIMARY">PRIMARY</option>
              <option value="SECONDARY">SECONDARY</option>
            </select>
            <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setLinkModalCard(null)} className="px-4 py-2 text-xs">
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleLinkAccount}
                className="bg-sky-600 hover:bg-sky-500 text-white px-5 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1"
              >
                <Plus size={14} /> Link Account
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Reassign Customer */}
      {reassignModalCard && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <form
            onSubmit={handleReassignCustomer}
            className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-6 w-full max-w-md space-y-4 shadow-2xl"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <h2 className="text-sm font-bold">
                Reassign Card {reassignModalCard.masked_pan}
              </h2>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setReassignModalCard(null)}>
                <X size={16} className="text-slate-400" />
              </button>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
              Move this card to a different customer CIF. Linked accounts stay with the card.
            </p>
            <select
              value={reassignCustId}
              onChange={(e) => setReassignCustId(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs font-mono"
              required
            >
              {allCustomers.map((c) => (
                <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>
                  {c.customer_number} — {c.name}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
            <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setReassignModalCard(null)}
                className="px-4 py-2 text-xs"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-500 text-white px-5 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1"
              >
                <ArrowRightLeft size={14} /> Reassign Customer
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { apiFetch } from '../api';

// ============================================================================
// PAGE 7: CONFIGURABLE TRANSACTION CODES (Code 10, 20, 30, 40 & Custom)
// ============================================================================
export const TransactionCodesPage: React.FC = () => {
  const [codes, setCodes] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [savedMsg, setSavedMsg] = useState('');

  const load = async () => {
    const list = await apiFetch('/transaction-codes');
    setCodes(list);
    if (!selected && list.length > 0) setSelected(list[0]);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, []);

  const handleSave = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!selected) return;
    await apiFetch('/transaction-codes', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify(selected),
    });
    setSavedMsg(`Saved configuration for Transaction Code ${selected.transaction_code}`);
    load();
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-xl font-bold">Configurable Transaction Codes (Codes 10, 20, 30, 40 & Custom)</h1>
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
          Define what each transaction code means, which MTI/processing code it uses, and which HSM & host checks execute
        </p>
      </div>

      {savedMsg && (
        <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-500 text-xs font-mono">
          {savedMsg}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-4 space-y-2">
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-2">
            <h2 className="text-sm font-bold">Defined Codes</h2>
            <button
              onClick={() =>
                setSelected({
                  transaction_code: '50',
                  transaction_name: 'New Configurable Transaction',
                  description: 'Custom operator-defined rule set',
                  transaction_category: 'FINANCIAL',
                  processing_code: '0500000',
                  default_mti: '0200',
                  financial_flag: true,
                  balance_inquiry_flag: false,
                  debit_flag: true,
                  credit_flag: false,
                  reversal_allowed: true,
                  pin_required: true,
                  cvv_required: false,
                  pvv_required: true,
                  emv_required: false,
                  mac_required: false,
                  account_check_required: true,
                  card_check_required: true,
                  limit_check_required: true,
                  active: true,
                })
              }
              className="text-xs bg-emerald-600 text-white px-2.5 py-1 rounded font-semibold"
            >
              + New Code
            </button>
          </div>
          {codes.map((c) => (
            <button
              key={c.id}
              onClick={() => setSelected(c)}
              className={`w-full text-left p-3 rounded-lg border transition ${
                selected?.transaction_code === c.transaction_code
                  ? 'border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-500/10'
                  : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/50'
              }`}
            >
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center font-mono text-xs font-bold">
                <span className="text-emerald-500">CODE {c.transaction_code}</span>
                <span>MTI {c.default_mti}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="text-xs font-medium mt-1">{c.transaction_name}</div>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        {selected && (
          <form
            onSubmit={handleSave}
            className="lg:col-span-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-6 space-y-4"
          >
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-mono text-slate-400 mb-1">Transaction Code</label>
                <input
                  value={selected.transaction_code}
                  onChange={(e) => setSelected({ ...selected, transaction_code: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs font-mono"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="md:col-span-2">
                <label className="block text-xs font-mono text-slate-400 mb-1">Transaction Name (Operator Defined)</label>
                <input
                  value={selected.transaction_name}
                  onChange={(e) => setSelected({ ...selected, transaction_name: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-mono text-slate-400 mb-1">Default MTI</label>
                <input
                  value={selected.default_mti}
                  onChange={(e) => setSelected({ ...selected, default_mti: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs font-mono"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-mono text-slate-400 mb-1">Processing Code (7-char TIC F3)</label>
                <input
                  value={selected.processing_code}
                  onChange={(e) => setSelected({ ...selected, processing_code: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs font-mono"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-mono text-slate-400 mb-1">Category</label>
                <input
                  value={selected.transaction_category}
                  onChange={(e) => setSelected({ ...selected, transaction_category: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs font-mono"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
              <div className="text-xs font-mono uppercase text-slate-400 mb-2">
                Authorization & HSM Verification Flags
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3 text-xs font-mono">
                {[
                  ['financial_flag', 'Financial Posting'],
                  ['debit_flag', 'Debit Account'],
                  ['credit_flag', 'Credit Account'],
                  ['balance_inquiry_flag', 'Balance Inquiry'],
                  ['reversal_allowed', 'Reversal Allowed'],
                  ['pin_required', 'HSM PIN Check'],
                  ['pvv_required', 'HSM PVV Check'],
                  ['cvv_required', 'HSM CVV Check'],
                  ['emv_required', 'HSM EMV ARQC'],
                  ['mac_required', 'HSM MAC Check'],
                  ['card_check_required', 'Card Status/Exp'],
                  ['account_check_required', 'Account Status'],
                  ['limit_check_required', 'Card/Acct Limits'],
                  ['active', 'Code Active'],
                ].map(([key, label]) => (
                  <label key={key} className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={Boolean(selected[key])}
                      onChange={(e) => setSelected({ ...selected, [key]: e.target.checked })}
                      className="rounded border-slate-600 text-emerald-600"
                    />
                    <span>{label}</span>
                  </label>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              type="submit"
              className="bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-semibold px-5 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs"
            >
              Save Transaction Code Rules
            </button>
          </form>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

// ============================================================================
// PAGE 14: HOST CONFIGURATION (BAOBAB Parameters)
// ============================================================================
export const HostConfigurationPage: React.FC = () => {
  const [params, setParams] = useState<any[]>([]);

  const load = async () => setParams(await apiFetch('/host-parameters'));
  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, []);

  const toggleParam = async (p: any) => {
    const currentEnabled = p.parameter_value?.enabled ?? true;
    const updatedValue = { ...p.parameter_value, enabled: !currentEnabled };
    await apiFetch(`/host-parameters/${p.id}`, {
      method: 'PUT',
      body: JSON.stringify({ parameter_value: updatedValue, active: !currentEnabled }),
    });
    load();
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-xl font-bold">BAOBAB-Inspired Host Authorization Configuration</h1>
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
          Enable or disable central authorization engine rules (`AUTHORIZEACCTBALANCESTRANS`, `CHECKCARDLIMITS`, `CHECKACCT2CARDLIMITS`)
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full text-left text-xs font-mono">
          <thead>
            <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-400">
              <th className="py-2.5">Group</th>
              <th className="py-2.5">Parameter Name</th>
              <th className="py-2.5">Value / Order</th>
              <th className="py-2.5">Description</th>
              <th className="py-2.5">Status</th>
              <th className="py-2.5">Action</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-200/60 dark:divide-slate-800/60">
            {params.map((p) => {
              const isEnabled = p.parameter_value?.enabled ?? p.active;
              return (
                <tr key={p.id}>
                  <td className="py-2.5 text-slate-400">{p.parameter_group}</td>
                  <td className="py-2.5 font-bold text-emerald-500">{p.parameter_name}</td>
                  <td className="py-2.5">{JSON.stringify(p.parameter_value)}</td>
                  <td className="py-2.5 font-sans">{p.description}</td>
                  <td className="py-2.5">
                    <span
                      className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold ${
                        isEnabled ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-500' : 'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-500'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {isEnabled ? 'ENABLED' : 'DISABLED'}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td className="py-2.5">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => toggleParam(p)}
                      className="text-sky-500 hover:underline text-[11px]"
                    >
                      Toggle Rule
                    </button>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              );
            })}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

// PAGE 15: RESPONSE CODE MANAGEMENT
// ============================================================================
export const ResponseCodesPage: React.FC = () => {
  const [codes, setCodes] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    response_code: '',
    response_description: '',
    response_category: 'DECLINE',
    approved_flag: false,
  });

  const load = async () => setCodes(await apiFetch('/response-codes'));
  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, []);

  const handleSave = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    await apiFetch('/response-codes', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(form) });
    setForm({ response_code: '', response_description: '', response_category: 'DECLINE', approved_flag: false });
    load();
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-xl font-bold">Response Code Mapping</h1>
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">Manage TIC DE39 response codes and approval flags</p>
      </div>

      <form
        onSubmit={handleSave}
        className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-5 gap-3"
      >
        <input
          value={form.response_code}
          onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, response_code: e.target.value })}
          placeholder="2-Char Code (e.g. 59)"
          maxLength={2}
          className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs font-mono"
          required
        />
        <input
          value={form.response_description}
          onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, response_description: e.target.value })}
          placeholder="Description"
          className="md:col-span-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs"
          required
        />
        <select
          value={form.response_category}
          onChange={(e) =>
            setForm({
              ...form,
              response_category: e.target.value,
              approved_flag: e.target.value === 'APPROVAL',
            })
          }
          className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs font-mono"
        >
          <option value="DECLINE">DECLINE</option>
          <option value="APPROVAL">APPROVAL</option>
          <option value="ERROR">ERROR</option>
        </select>
        <button
          type="submit"
          className="bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold"
        >
          + Upsert Code
        </button>
      </form>

      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full text-left text-xs font-mono">
          <thead>
            <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-400">
              <th className="py-2">DE39 Code</th>
              <th className="py-2">TIC F39 (5-Char)</th>
              <th className="py-2">Description</th>
              <th className="py-2">Category</th>
              <th className="py-2">Approved Flag</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-200/60 dark:divide-slate-800/60">
            {codes.map((c) => (
              <tr key={c.id}>
                <td className="py-2 font-bold text-emerald-500">{c.response_code}</td>
                <td className="py-2 text-slate-400">000{c.response_code}</td>
                <td className="py-2 font-sans">{c.response_description}</td>
                <td className="py-2">{c.response_category}</td>
                <td className="py-2">{c.approved_flag ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE'}</td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export const HostKeyManagementPage: React.FC = () => {
  const [keys, setKeys] = useState<any[]>([]);
// [PATCH step02_02:hsm_key_inst_state]
  const [institutions, setInstitutions] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    key_name: '',
    key_type: 'ZPK',
    key_usage: 'PIN_ENCRYPTION',
    key_identifier: `KEY_${Math.floor(100 + Math.random() * 900)}`,
    kvc: 'A1B2C3',
    algorithm: '3DES_2KEY',
    key_length: 128,
    hsm_key_reference: 'LMK_PROTECTED_SLOT_REF',
    key_status: 'ACTIVE',
// [PATCH step02_02:hsm_key_inst_form_field]
    institution_id: '',
  });

// [PATCH step02_02:hsm_key_load_inst]
  const load = async () => {
    const [kList, iList] = await Promise.all([apiFetch('/hsm/keys'), apiFetch('/institutions')]);
    setKeys(kList);
    setInstitutions(iList);
    if (!form.institution_id && iList.length > 0) {
      setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, institution_id: iList[0].id }));
    }
  };
  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, []);

  const handleRegister = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    await apiFetch('/hsm/keys', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(form) });
    load();
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-xl font-bold">Host Cryptographic Key Management</h1>
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
          Register key references and KVC metadata for ZMK, ZPK, TMK, AWK, IWK, PVK, CVK, TAK, and MK-AC (clear keys remain inside the Soft-HSM boundary)

      </div>

      <form
        onSubmit={handleRegister}
        className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-6 gap-3"
      >
        <input
          value={form.key_identifier}
          onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, key_identifier: e.target.value })}
          placeholder="Key Identifier"
          className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs font-mono"
          required
        />
        <input
          value={form.key_name}
          onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, key_name: e.target.value })}
          placeholder="Key Name / Description"
          className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs"
          required
        />
        <select
          value={form.key_type}
          onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, key_type: e.target.value })}
          className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs font-mono"
        >
          {['ZMK', 'TMK', 'ZPK', 'AWK', 'IWK', 'PVK', 'CVK', 'TAK', 'MK-AC'].map((t) => (
            <option key={t} value={t}>
              {t}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
// [PATCH step02_02:hsm_key_inst_dropdown]
        <select
          value={form.institution_id}
          onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, institution_id: e.target.value })}
          className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs font-mono"
        >
          <option value="">System Key (ITCL Switch)</option>
          {institutions.map((i) => (
            <option key={i.id} value={i.id}>{i.institution_code} — {i.short_name || i.name}</option>

        <input

          required
        />
        <input

          placeholder="Protected HSM Slot / LMK Cryptogram Ref"
          className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs font-mono"

        />
        <button

          + Register Key Ref

      </form>

      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full text-left text-xs font-mono">

              <th className="py-2.5">Name</th>
// [PATCH step02_02:hsm_key_table_inst_th]
              <th className="py-2.5">Owning Bank / Switch</th>
