import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { api } from '../services/api';

interface KeyRecord {
  id: string;
  key_identifier: string;
  key_name: string;
  key_type: string;
  thales_key_type_code: string;
  key_usage: string;
  key_scheme: string;
  key_version: number;
  key_status: string;
  kvc: string;
  algorithm: string;
  key_length: number;
  provider_type: 'INTERNAL_HSM' | 'EXTERNAL_HSM';
  lmk_id: string;
  lmk_check_value: string | null;
  encrypted_key_block: string;
  masked_key_block: string;
  institution_code?: string;
  created_at?: string;
}

export const KeyCeremonyWorkbenchPage: React.FC = () => {
  const [lmkStatus, setLmkStatus] = useState<any>(null);
  const [auditReport, setAuditReport] = useState<any>(null);
  const [keys, setKeys] = useState<KeyRecord[]>([]);
  const [providerFilter, setProviderFilter] = useState<string>('ACTIVE_PROVIDER');
  const [remoteUrlInput, setRemoteUrlInput] = useState<string>('http://127.0.0.1:8001');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [banner, setBanner] = useState<{ type: 'ok' | 'err' | 'warn'; msg: string } | null>(null);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'inventory' | 'a0_generate' | 'a6_import' | 'a8_export' | 'audit'>('inventory');

  // A0 Key Generation Form State
  const [a0Alias, setA0Alias] = useState('ZPK_EXT_ISS_01');
  const [a0Name, setA0Name] = useState('External Interchange ZPK');
  const [a0Type, setA0Type] = useState('ZPK');
  const [a0Scheme, setA0Scheme] = useState('U');
  const [a0Mode, setA0Mode] = useState('0');
  const [a0ZmkAlias, setA0ZmkAlias] = useState('ZMK_MAIN');
  const [a0Result, setA0Result] = useState<any>(null);

  // A6 Key Import Form State
  const [a6Alias, setA6Alias] = useState('ZPK_PARTNER_IMP_01');
  const [a6Name, setA6Name] = useState('Imported Partner ZPK');
  const [a6Type, setA6Type] = useState('ZPK');
  const [a6ZmkAlias, setA6ZmkAlias] = useState('ZMK_MAIN');
  const [a6EncKey, setA6EncKey] = useState('');
  const [a6Scheme, setA6Scheme] = useState('U');
  const [a6Result, setA6Result] = useState<any>(null);

  // A8 Key Export Form State
  const [a8KeyAlias, setA8KeyAlias] = useState('AWK_ATM_01');
  const [a8ZmkAlias, setA8ZmkAlias] = useState('ZMK_MAIN');
  const [a8Scheme, setA8Scheme] = useState('U');
  const [a8Result, setA8Result] = useState<any>(null);

  const loadAll = async (filterOverride?: string) => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const statusRes = await api.get('/api/hsm/lmk-key-management/status');
      setLmkStatus(statusRes.data);
      if (statusRes.data?.remote_url) {
        setRemoteUrlInput(statusRes.data.remote_url);
      }
      const effFilter = filterOverride || providerFilter;
      const qParam = effFilter === 'ACTIVE_PROVIDER' ? statusRes.data.active_provider : effFilter;
      const keysRes = await api.get(`/api/hsm/lmk-key-management/keys?provider_type=${qParam}&include_superseded=true`);
      setKeys(keysRes.data.keys || []);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setBanner({ type: 'err', msg: e?.response?.data?.detail || e.message || 'Failed to load HSM key status' });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadAll();
  }, []);

  const handleSwitchProvider = async (mode: 'INTERNAL_HSM' | 'EXTERNAL_HSM') => {
    setBanner(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.post('/api/hsm/lmk-key-management/provider', {
        provider_mode: mode,
        remote_url: remoteUrlInput.trim(),
      });
      setLmkStatus(res.data);
      setBanner({
        type: res.data.online ? 'ok' : 'warn',
        msg: `Switched Cryptographic Authority to ${res.data.active_provider} (LMK KCV: ${res.data.lmk_check_value})`,
      });
      await loadAll(mode);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setBanner({ type: 'err', msg: e?.response?.data?.detail || 'Provider switch failed' });
    }
  };

  const handleSyncExternalKeys = async () => {
    setBanner(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.post('/api/hsm/lmk-key-management/sync-seeded');
      setBanner({
        type: 'ok',
        msg: `Synchronized & BU-verified ${res.data.count} LMK-encrypted keys from External Soft-HSM (Domain ${res.data.lmk_check_value})`,
      });
      await loadAll('EXTERNAL_HSM');
    } catch (e: any) {
      setBanner({ type: 'err', msg: e?.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to sync keys from External Soft-HSM' });
    }
  };

  const handleGenerateA0 = async () => {
    setBanner(null);
    setA0Result(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.post('/api/hsm/lmk-key-management/generate', {
        key_identifier: a0Alias,
        key_name: a0Name,
        key_type: a0Type,
        key_scheme: a0Scheme,
        mode: a0Mode,
        export_zmk_key_identifier: a0Mode === '1' ? a0ZmkAlias : undefined,
      });
      setA0Result(res.data);
      setBanner({
        type: 'ok',
        msg: `Soft-HSM Command A0 (A100) succeeded. Stored LMK key block for '${res.data.key.key_identifier}' (KCV: ${res.data.key.kvc})`,
      });
      await loadAll();
    } catch (e: any) {
      setBanner({ type: 'err', msg: e?.response?.data?.detail || 'Soft-HSM A0 key generation failed' });
    }
  };

  const handleImportA6 = async () => {
    setBanner(null);
    setA6Result(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.post('/api/hsm/lmk-key-management/import', {
        key_identifier: a6Alias,
        key_name: a6Name,
        key_type: a6Type,
        zmk_key_identifier: a6ZmkAlias,
        encrypted_key_under_zmk: a6EncKey,
        key_scheme_lmk: a6Scheme,
      });
      setA6Result(res.data);
      setBanner({
        type: 'ok',
        msg: `Soft-HSM Command A6 (A700) succeeded. Imported '${res.data.key.key_identifier}' under LMK (KCV: ${res.data.key.kvc})`,
      });
      await loadAll();
    } catch (e: any) {
      setBanner({ type: 'err', msg: e?.response?.data?.detail || 'Soft-HSM A6 key import failed' });
    }
  };

  const handleExportA8 = async () => {
    setBanner(null);
    setA8Result(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.post('/api/hsm/lmk-key-management/export', {
        key_identifier: a8KeyAlias,
        zmk_key_identifier: a8ZmkAlias,
        export_scheme: a8Scheme,
      });
      setA8Result(res.data);
      setBanner({
        type: 'ok',
        msg: `Soft-HSM Command A8 (A900) succeeded. Exported '${a8KeyAlias}' under '${a8ZmkAlias}' (KCV: ${res.data.kcv})`,
      });
    } catch (e: any) {
      setBanner({ type: 'err', msg: e?.response?.data?.detail || 'Soft-HSM A8 key export failed' });
    }
  };

  const handleVerifyBu = async (alias: string) => {
    setBanner(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.post(`/api/hsm/lmk-key-management/verify-kcv/${alias}`);
      setBanner({
        type: res.data.kcv_matched ? 'ok' : 'warn',
        msg: `Soft-HSM BU (BV00) check for '${alias}': Calculated KCV ${res.data.calculated_kvc} (Stored: ${res.data.stored_kvc}) | Raw: ${res.data.raw_response}`,
      });
    } catch (e: any) {
      setBanner({ type: 'err', msg: e?.response?.data?.detail || `BU check failed for ${alias}` });
    }
  };

  const handleRotateKey = async (alias: string) => {
    setBanner(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.post('/api/hsm/lmk-key-management/rotate', { key_identifier: alias });
      setBanner({
        type: 'ok',
        msg: `Rotated '${alias}' via Soft-HSM A0: v${res.data.previous_version} to v${res.data.new_version} (New KCV: ${res.data.key.kvc})`,
      });
      await loadAll();
    } catch (e: any) {
      setBanner({ type: 'err', msg: e?.response?.data?.detail || `Rotation failed for ${alias}` });
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteKey = async (id: string, alias: string) => {
    setBanner(null);
    try {
      await api.delete(`/api/hsm/keys/${id}?force=true`);
      setBanner({ type: 'ok', msg: `Deleted key record '${alias}' from Host inventory` });
      await loadAll();
    } catch (e: any) {
      setBanner({ type: 'err', msg: e?.response?.data?.detail || 'Delete failed' });
    }
  };

  const loadAuditDeliverable = async () => {
    setActiveTab('audit');
    try {
      const res = await api.get('/api/hsm/lmk-key-management/audit-report');
      setAuditReport(res.data);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setBanner({ type: 'err', msg: 'Failed to load audit report' });
    }
  };

  const isExternal = lmkStatus?.active_provider === 'EXTERNAL_HSM';

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header & Active Cryptographic Authority Banner */}
      <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-between items-center gap-4">
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-white font-mono">
              LMK-Centric Key Management & Cryptographic Ownership
            </h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1">
              Thales payShield 10K LMK Domain Isolation · Zero Clear Key Storage · Live A0 / A6 / A8 / BU / NC Execution
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              onClick={() => handleSwitchProvider('INTERNAL_HSM')}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-xs font-mono font-bold transition ${
                !isExternal ? 'bg-sky-600 text-white' : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-700'
              }`}
            >
              Internal Simulator HSM
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => handleSwitchProvider('EXTERNAL_HSM')}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-xs font-mono font-bold transition ${
                isExternal ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white' : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-700'
              }`}
            >
              External Soft-HSM Authority
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* LMK Domain Status Grid */}
        {lmkStatus && (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-5 gap-3 pt-2 border-t border-slate-800 text-xs font-mono">
            <div className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 p-3 rounded">
              <div className="text-slate-400">Active Authority</div>
              <div className={`font-bold mt-1 ${isExternal ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-sky-400'}`}>
                {lmkStatus.active_provider} ({lmkStatus.online ? 'ONLINE' : 'OFFLINE'})
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 p-3 rounded">
              <div className="text-slate-400">LMK Domain Check Value (NC)</div>
              <div className="font-bold text-amber-400 mt-1">
                Slot %{lmkStatus.lmk_id || '00'} · {lmkStatus.lmk_check_value}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 p-3 rounded">
              <div className="text-slate-400">HSM State & Firmware</div>
              <div className="font-bold text-slate-200 mt-1">
                {lmkStatus.hsm_state} ({lmkStatus.firmware})
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 p-3 rounded md:col-span-2">
              <div className="text-slate-400 mb-1">External Soft-HSM Endpoint & Seeded LMK Sync</div>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <input
                  value={remoteUrlInput}
                  onChange={(e) => setRemoteUrlInput(e.target.value)}
                  className="flex-1 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-emerald-300 text-xs"
                  placeholder="http://127.0.0.1:8001"
                />
                <button
                  onClick={handleSyncExternalKeys}
                  className="bg-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-600 px-3 py-1 rounded text-white font-bold whitespace-nowrap"
                >
                  Sync LMK Keys
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {lmkStatus?.persistence_audit?.ephemeral_risk && (
          <div className="bg-amber-950/50 border border-amber-700/60 rounded p-2.5 text-xs font-mono text-amber-200">
            <strong>LMK Persistence Notice:</strong> {lmkStatus.persistence_audit.ephemeral_risk}
          </div>
        )}

        {banner && (
          <div
            className={`p-3 rounded text-xs font-mono border ${
              banner.type === 'ok'
                ? 'bg-emerald-950/70 border-emerald-700 text-emerald-200'
                : banner.type === 'warn'
                ? 'bg-amber-950/70 border-amber-700 text-amber-200'
                : 'bg-rose-950/70 border-rose-700 text-rose-200'
            }`}
          >
            {banner.msg}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Navigation Tabs */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 border-b border-slate-800 pb-2 font-mono text-xs">
        {[
          { id: 'inventory', label: '1. Key Inventory & LMK Domains' },
          { id: 'a0_generate', label: '2. Generate Key (Soft-HSM A0)' },
          { id: 'a6_import', label: '3. Import Key (Soft-HSM A6)' },
          { id: 'a8_export', label: '4. Export / Translate Key (Soft-HSM A8)' },
          { id: 'audit', label: '5. Mandatory LMK Audit Deliverable (Part G)' },

            onClick={() => (t.id === 'audit' ? loadAuditDeliverable() : setActiveTab(t.id as any))}

          </button>

      </div>

      {activeTab === 'inventory' && (

          <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-between items-center gap-3">

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  ShieldCheck,
  Users,
  CreditCard,
  Landmark,
  Activity,
  CheckCircle2,
  XCircle,
  RotateCcw,
  TerminalSquare,
  Cpu,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  BarChart,
  Bar,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
  Tooltip,
  ResponsiveContainer,
  PieChart,
  Pie,
  Cell,
} from 'recharts';
import { apiFetch, setAuthSession } from '../api';

export const LoginPage: React.FC = () => {
  const [username, setUsername] = useState('admin');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('AdminPassword123!');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError('');
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch('/auth/login', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ username, password }),
      });
      setAuthSession(res.access_token, res.username, res.hsm_mode);
      navigate('/');
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || 'Authentication failed');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      <div className="max-w-md w-full bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-8 shadow-2xl space-y-6">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-400">
            <ShieldCheck size={28} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">BAOBAB Private Host</h1>
            <p className="text-xs font-mono text-slate-400">Single-User Payment Switch & HSM Simulator</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {error && (
          <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-rose-950/80 border border-rose-800 text-rose-300 text-xs font-mono">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-mono uppercase text-slate-400 mb-1">Operator Username</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={username}
              onChange={(e) => setUsername(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm text-white font-mono focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500"
              required
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-mono uppercase text-slate-400 mb-1">Operator Password</label>
            <input
              type="password"
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm text-white font-mono focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500"
              required
            />
          </div>
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={loading}
            className="w-full bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-semibold py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm transition shadow-lg"
          >
            {loading ? 'Authenticating...' : 'Sign In to Host Console'}
          </button>
        </form>

        <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-800 text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400 space-y-1">
          <div>Default Local Credentials:</div>
          <div className="text-emerald-400">User: admin | Pass: AdminPassword123!</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export const DashboardPage: React.FC = () => {
  const [data, setData] = useState<any>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const loadSummary = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch('/dashboard/summary');
      setData(res);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadSummary();
  }, []);

  if (loading || !data) {
    return <div className="text-sm font-mono text-slate-500">Loading Host Switch Telemetry...</div>;
  }

  const m = data.metrics;
  const pieData = [
    { name: 'Approved', value: m.approved_transactions || 0, color: '#10b981' },
    { name: 'Declined', value: m.declined_transactions || 0, color: '#f43f5e' },
    { name: 'Reversed', value: m.reversed_transactions || 0, color: '#f59e0b' },
  ];

  const barData = (data.recent_transactions || []).slice(0, 6).map((t: any) => ({
    stan: `STAN ${t.stan}`,
    amount: t.amount,
  }));

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">Banking Host Executive Dashboard</h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            Real-time authorization telemetry, ledger activity, and Soft-HSM operations
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Link
            to="/simulator"
            className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold shadow-sm"
          >
            <TerminalSquare size={15} /> Launch Transaction Simulator
          </Link>
          <Link
            to="/hsm-workbench"
            className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold"
          >
            <Cpu size={15} /> Open HSM Workbench
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* KPI Cards */}

type Fields = Record<string, string>;
type Flags = Record<string, boolean>;
type TabKey = 'fields' | 'paste' | 'time' | 'cases';
type SplitMode = 'auto' | 'separate' | 'join';

interface NextIds {
  has_history: boolean;
  last_stan: string | null;
  last_rrn: string | null;
  next_stan: string;
  next_rrn: string;
  last_transaction: any;

const STORAGE_KEY = 'BAOBAB_SIMULATOR_STATE_V2';
const MANDATORY_FIELDS = ['2', '3', '4', '11', '37', '41', '49'];
const SAMPLE_ISO =
  '02007220000008008000164567890123450001010000000000100000100001000020526001050';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Date & time helpers (DE7 is GMT, the other time fields are local time)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const pad = (n: number, w = 2) => String(n).padStart(w, '0');
const fmtGmt = (d: Date) =>
  pad(d.getUTCMonth() + 1) + pad(d.getUTCDate()) + pad(d.getUTCHours()) + pad(d.getUTCMinutes()) + pad(d.getUTCSeconds());
const fmtLocalTime = (d: Date) => pad(d.getHours()) + pad(d.getMinutes()) + pad(d.getSeconds());
const fmtLocalDate = (d: Date) => pad(d.getMonth() + 1) + pad(d.getDate());
const toLocalInput = (d: Date) =>
  `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}T${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(d.getMinutes())}:${pad(d.getSeconds())}`;

const TIME_META: Record<string, { label: string; hint: string; make: (d: Date) => string }> = {
  '7': { label: 'GMT transmission time', hint: 'MMDDhhmmss in GMT', make: fmtGmt },
  '12': { label: 'Local transaction time', hint: 'hhmmss, local time', make: fmtLocalTime },
  '13': { label: 'Local transaction date', hint: 'MMDD, local date', make: fmtLocalDate },
  '15': { label: 'Settlement date', hint: 'MMDD, local date', make: fmtLocalDate },
  '16': { label: 'Currency conversion date', hint: 'MMDD, local date', make: fmtLocalDate },
  '17': { label: 'Capture date', hint: 'MMDD, local date', make: fmtLocalDate },
};
const TIME_KEYS = Object.keys(TIME_META);
const CORE_TIME_KEYS = ['7', '12', '13'];

const buildDefaultFields = (ids?: { stan: string; rrn: string } | null): Fields => {
  const now = new Date();
  return {
    '2': '4567890123450001',
    '3': '0100000',
    '4': '000000250000',
    '7': fmtGmt(now),
    '11': ids?.stan || '100001',
    '12': fmtLocalTime(now),
    '13': fmtLocalDate(now),
    '14': '2812',
    '18': '5411',
    '22': '051',
    '25': '000',
    '32': '123456',
    '37': ids?.rrn || '000020526001',
    '41': 'ATM00001',
    '49': '050',
  };
};

const allEnabled = (f: Fields): Flags => {
  const out: Flags = {};
  Object.keys(f).forEach((k) => (out[k] = true));
  return out;
};

const isDigits = (s?: string | null) => !!s && /^\d+$/.test(s);
// True when the value already used (or is behind) the last value stored in the database.
const isStale = (current?: string, last?: string | null) => {
  if (!current || !last) return false;
  if (isDigits(current) && isDigits(last)) return Number(current) <= Number(last);
  return current === last;
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Raw message helpers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const splitMessages = (text: string, mode: SplitMode): string[] => {
  const lines = text
    .replace(/^\uFEFF/, '')
    .split(/\r?\n/)
    .map((l) => l.replace(/[\r\n]+$/, ''))
    .filter((l) => l.trim() !== '');
  if (!lines.length) return [];
  const extract = (l: string) => {
    const i = l.indexOf('A4M');
    return i > 0 ? l.slice(i) : l;
  };
  const looksLikeMessage = (l: string) => /A4M/.test(l) || /^\s*\d{4}[0-9A-Fa-f]{16}/.test(l);
  let effective = mode;
  if (mode === 'auto') {
    effective = lines.length > 1 && lines.every(looksLikeMessage) ? 'separate' : 'join';
  }
  return effective === 'separate' ? lines.map(extract) : [extract(lines.join(''))];
};

const decodeFileBytes = (buf: ArrayBuffer): string => {
  const latin = new TextDecoder('windows-1252').decode(buf);
  let utf8: string | null = null;
  try {
    utf8 = new TextDecoder('utf-8', { fatal: true }).decode(buf);
  } catch {
    // not valid UTF-8, so the file is a single-byte (Latin-1 / Windows-1252) file
    return latin;
  }
  // TIC separators (chr 221 and chr 179) are single bytes in a Latin-1 file, and the pair
  // 0xDD 0xB3 also happens to be valid UTF-8. A TIC message only contains characters up to
  // U+00FF, so a wider character together with those bytes means the file is Latin-1.
  const hasWideChar = Array.from(utf8).some((ch) => ch.charCodeAt(0) > 0xff);
  if (hasWideChar && /[\u00DD\u00B3]/.test(latin)) return latin;
  return utf8;
};

export const TransactionSimulatorPage: React.FC = () => {
  // ---- core simulator state -------------------------------------------------
  const [catalog, setCatalog] = useState<any>(null);
  const [txCode, setTxCode] = useState('10');
  const [mti, setMti] = useState('0200');

  const [enabledFields, setEnabledFields] = useState<Flags>(() => allEnabled(buildDefaultFields()));
  const [newFieldNum, setNewFieldNum] = useState('55');
  const [rawTic, setRawTic] = useState('');
  const [compactTic, setCompactTic] = useState('');
  const [decodedView, setDecodedView] = useState<any>(null);
  const [validationErrors, setValidationErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [txResponse, setTxResponse] = useState<any>(null);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  // ---- workbench state ------------------------------------------------------
  const [hydrated, setHydrated] = useState(false);
  const [sessionRestored, setSessionRestored] = useState(false);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<TabKey>('fields');
  const [nextIds, setNextIds] = useState<NextIds | null>(null);
  const [autoAdvance, setAutoAdvance] = useState(true);
  const [flashField, setFlashField] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [toast, setToast] = useState<{ kind: 'ok' | 'err' | 'info'; text: string } | null>(null);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  // ---- paste / file state ---------------------------------------------------
  const [pasteText, setPasteText] = useState('');
  const [pasteMode, setPasteMode] = useState<SplitMode>('auto');
  const [pasteIndex, setPasteIndex] = useState(0);
  const [pasteAuto, setPasteAuto] = useState(true);
  const [pasteOpts, setPasteOpts] = useState<LoadOpts>({ ids: false, time: false });
  const [pasteError, setPasteError] = useState('');
  const [pasteInfo, setPasteInfo] = useState<any>(null);
  const [pasteFileName, setPasteFileName] = useState('');
  const [dragOver, setDragOver] = useState(false);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  // ---- time tab state -------------------------------------------------------
  const [clock, setClock] = useState<Date>(new Date());
  const [pickedTime, setPickedTime] = useState(toLocalInput(new Date()));

  // ---- saved cases state ----------------------------------------------------
  const [savedCases, setSavedCases] = useState<SavedCase[]>([]);
  const [caseOpts, setCaseOpts] = useState<LoadOpts>({ ids: true, time: false });
  const [caseFilter, setCaseFilter] = useState('');
  const [currentCaseId, setCurrentCaseId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [currentCaseName, setCurrentCaseName] = useState('');
  const [saveOpen, setSaveOpen] = useState(false);
  const [saveName, setSaveName] = useState('');
  const [saveDesc, setSaveDesc] = useState('');
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const pasteMessages = useMemo(() => splitMessages(pasteText, pasteMode), [pasteText, pasteMode]);
  const pasteLineCount = useMemo(
    () => pasteText.split(/\r?\n/).filter((l) => l.trim() !== '').length,
    [pasteText]
  );

  const notify = (kind: 'ok' | 'err' | 'info', text: string) => setToast({ kind, text });

  // ==========================================================================
  // Start-up: catalog, last STAN/RRN from the database, last session / last case
  // ==========================================================================
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    (async () => {
      apiFetch('/simulator/catalog')
        .then((c) => !cancelled && setCatalog(c))
        .catch(console.error);

      let ids: NextIds | null = null;
      let cases: SavedCase[] = [];
      try {
        ids = await apiFetch('/simulator-workbench/next-ids');
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Could not read last STAN/RRN from database', e);
      }
      try {
        cases = await apiFetch('/simulator-workbench/cases');
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Could not read saved simulator cases', e);
      }
      if (cancelled) return;
      setNextIds(ids);
      setSavedCases(cases);

      let stored: any = null;
      try {
        const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        if (raw) stored = JSON.parse(raw);
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Could not restore simulator state', e);
      }

      let f: Fields | null = null;
      if (stored && stored.fields && Object.keys(stored.fields).length) {
        f = { ...stored.fields };
        setEnabledFields(stored.enabledFields || allEnabled(f));
        if (stored.txCode) setTxCode(stored.txCode);
        if (stored.mti) setMti(stored.mti);
        if (typeof stored.clearPinHelper === 'string') setClearPinHelper(stored.clearPinHelper);
        if (stored.rawTic) setRawTic(stored.rawTic);
        if (stored.compactTic) setCompactTic(stored.compactTic);
        if (stored.txResponse) setTxResponse(stored.txResponse);
        if (typeof stored.autoAdvance === 'boolean') setAutoAdvance(stored.autoAdvance);
        if (stored.pasteOpts) setPasteOpts(stored.pasteOpts);
        if (stored.caseOpts) setCaseOpts(stored.caseOpts);
        if (stored.currentCaseId) setCurrentCaseId(stored.currentCaseId);
        if (stored.currentCaseName) setCurrentCaseName(stored.currentCaseName);
        if (stored.activeTab) setActiveTab(stored.activeTab);
        setSessionRestored(true);
      } else if (cases.length) {
        const latest = cases[0];
        f = { ...latest.fields };
        setEnabledFields(latest.enabled_fields && Object.keys(latest.enabled_fields).length ? latest.enabled_fields : allEnabled(f));
        setTxCode(latest.transaction_code || '10');
        setMti(latest.mti || '0200');
        setClearPinHelper(latest.clear_pin_helper || '');
        setCurrentCaseId(latest.id);
        setCurrentCaseName(latest.name);
        setSessionRestored(true);
      } else {
        f = buildDefaultFields(ids ? { stan: ids.next_stan, rrn: ids.next_rrn } : null);
        setEnabledFields(allEnabled(f));
      }

      // Never start with a STAN / RRN the database has already used
      if (ids && ids.has_history && f) {
        if ('11' in f && isStale(f['11'], ids.last_stan)) f['11'] = ids.next_stan;
        if ('37' in f && isStale(f['37'], ids.last_rrn)) f['37'] = ids.next_rrn;
      }
      if (f) setFields(f);
      setHydrated(true);
    })();
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

  // Persist the working state so the simulator re-opens exactly where it was left
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!hydrated) return;
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(
        STORAGE_KEY,
        JSON.stringify({
          fields,
          enabledFields,
          txCode,
          mti,
          clearPinHelper,
          rawTic,
          compactTic,
          txResponse,
          autoAdvance,
          pasteOpts,
          caseOpts,
          currentCaseId,
          currentCaseName,
          activeTab,
        })
      );
    } catch (e) {
      /* storage may be full or blocked */
    }
  }, [
    hydrated, fields, enabledFields, txCode, mti, clearPinHelper, rawTic, compactTic,
    txResponse, autoAdvance, pasteOpts, caseOpts, currentCaseId, currentCaseName, activeTab,
  ]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!toast) return;
    const t = window.setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3800);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(t);
  }, [toast]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeTab !== 'time') return;
    setClock(new Date());
    const t = window.setInterval(() => setClock(new Date()), 1000);
    return () => window.clearInterval(t);
  }, [activeTab]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!flashField) return;
    const t = window.setTimeout(() => setFlashField(null), 1400);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(t);
  }, [flashField]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (pasteIndex > 0 && pasteIndex >= pasteMessages.length) setPasteIndex(0);
  }, [pasteMessages, pasteIndex]);

  // ==========================================================================
  // Helpers
  // ==========================================================================
  const getActiveFields = () => {
    const out: Fields = {};
    Object.entries(fields).forEach(([k, v]) => {
      if (enabledFields[k] !== false && v !== '') out[k] = v;
    });
    return out;
  };

  const fetchNextIds = async (): Promise<NextIds | null> => {
    try {
      const ids: NextIds = await apiFetch('/simulator-workbench/next-ids');
      setNextIds(ids);
      return ids;
    } catch (e) {
      return null;
    }
  };

  const reloadCases = async () => {
    try {
      const cases: SavedCase[] = await apiFetch('/simulator-workbench/cases');
      setSavedCases(cases);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn(e);
    }
  };

  const useDatabaseIds = async () => {
    const ids = await fetchNextIds();
    if (!ids) {
      notify('err', 'Could not read the last STAN and RRN from the database.');
      return;
    }
    setFields((prev) => ({ ...prev, '11': ids.next_stan, '37': ids.next_rrn }));
    setEnabledFields((prev) => ({ ...prev, '11': true, '37': true }));
    notify('ok', `STAN ${ids.next_stan} and RRN ${ids.next_rrn} are ready to use.`);
  };

  const bumpStanAndRrn = () => {
    const nextStan = String((parseInt(fields['11'] || '100000', 10) + 1) % 1000000).padStart(6, '0');
    const nextRrn = String(parseInt(fields['37'] || '20526000', 10) + 1).padStart(12, '0');
    setFields({ ...fields, '11': nextStan, '37': nextRrn });
  };

  const setTimeNow = (keys: string[], date: Date = new Date()) => {
    setFields((prev) => {
      const next = { ...prev };
      keys.forEach((k) => (next[k] = TIME_META[k].make(date)));
      return next;
    });
    setEnabledFields((prev) => {
      const next = { ...prev };
      keys.forEach((k) => (next[k] = true));
      return next;
    });
  };

  const setAllTimeNow = (date: Date = new Date()) => {
    const keys = [...CORE_TIME_KEYS, ...['15', '16', '17'].filter((k) => k in fields)];
    setTimeNow(keys, date);
  };

  const applyPickedTime = () => {
    const d = new Date(pickedTime);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) {
      notify('err', 'Pick a valid date and time first.');
      return;
    }
    setAllTimeNow(d);
    notify('ok', 'Time fields updated from the selected date and time.');
  };

  const addFieldToEditor = (num?: string) => {
    const n = num || newFieldNum;
    if (!n) return;
    setFields((prev) => (n in prev ? prev : { ...prev, [n]: '' }));
    setEnabledFields((prev) => ({ ...prev, [n]: true }));
    setActiveTab('fields');
    setFlashField(n);
    window.setTimeout(() => {
      document.getElementById(`de-row-${n}`)?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center', behavior: 'smooth' });
    }, 60);
  };

  const removeField = (n: string) => {
    setFields((prev) => {
      const next = { ...prev };
      delete next[n];
      return next;
    });
    setEnabledFields((prev) => {
      const next = { ...prev };
      delete next[n];
      return next;
    });
  };

  const jumpToField = (n: number) => {
    const key = String(n);
    if (key in fields) {
      setFlashField(key);
      document.getElementById(`de-row-${key}`)?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center', behavior: 'smooth' });
    } else if (catalog?.field_definitions?.some((d: any) => String(d.field_number) === key)) {
      addFieldToEditor(key);
    }
  };

  // Loads a message / case into the editor, optionally refreshing STAN, RRN and time
  const loadIntoEditor = async (
    data: { mti: string; txCode?: string | null; fields: Fields; enabled?: Flags; pin?: string },
    opts: LoadOpts
  ) => {
    const f: Fields = {};
    Object.entries(data.fields || {}).forEach(([k, v]) => (f[String(k)] = String(v ?? '')));
    const en: Flags =
      data.enabled && Object.keys(data.enabled).length ? { ...data.enabled } : allEnabled(f);
    Object.keys(f).forEach((k) => {
      if (!(k in en)) en[k] = true;
    });

    if (opts.ids) {
      const ids = await fetchNextIds();
      if (ids) {
        if ('11' in f) f['11'] = ids.next_stan;
        if ('37' in f) f['37'] = ids.next_rrn;
      }
    }
    if (opts.time) {
      const now = new Date();
      TIME_KEYS.forEach((k) => {
        if (k in f) f[k] = TIME_META[k].make(now);
      });
    }

    setFields(f);
    setEnabledFields(en);
    if (data.mti) setMti(data.mti);
    if (data.txCode) setTxCode(String(data.txCode));
    if (data.pin !== undefined) setClearPinHelper(data.pin);
    setValidationErrors({});
    setTxResponse(null);
    setCompactTic('');
    setDecodedView(null);
    setRawTic('');
  };

  // ==========================================================================
  // Raw message: paste, file, parse
  // ==========================================================================
  const parseMessage = async (message: string) => {
    setPasteError('');
    setPasteInfo(null);
    if (!message.trim()) {
      setPasteError('Paste a raw message or load a file first.');
      return;
    }
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch('/simulator/parse-raw', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ raw_message: message }),
      });
      if (!res.valid) {
        setPasteError(res.error || 'The message could not be parsed.');
        return;
      }
      await loadIntoEditor(
        { mti: res.mti, txCode: res.derived_transaction_code, fields: res.fields || {} },
        pasteOpts
      );
      setRawTic(message);
      if (res.detailed_fields) setDecodedView({ detailed_fields: res.detailed_fields });
      const keys = Object.keys(res.fields || {}).sort((a, b) => Number(a) - Number(b));
      setPasteInfo({ format: res.format, mti: res.mti, keys, warnings: res.warnings || [] });
      setSessionRestored(false);
      setCurrentCaseId(null);
      setCurrentCaseName('');
      setActiveTab('fields');
      notify('ok', `Loaded ${keys.length} fields from the ${res.format === 'TIC_V2164E' ? 'TIC' : 'ISO 8583'} message.`);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setPasteError(err.message || 'The message could not be parsed.');
    }
  };

  const handlePaste = (e: React.ClipboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
    if (!pasteAuto) return;
    const text = e.clipboardData.getData('text');
    if (!text.trim()) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    setPasteText(text);
    setPasteFileName('');
    setPasteIndex(0);
    const msgs = splitMessages(text, pasteMode);
    if (msgs.length) parseMessage(msgs[0]);
  };

  const readFile = async (file: File) => {
    try {
      const text = decodeFileBytes(await file.arrayBuffer());
      setPasteText(text);
      setPasteFileName(file.name);
      setPasteIndex(0);
      setPasteError('');
      setPasteInfo(null);
      const msgs = splitMessages(text, pasteMode);
      if (!msgs.length) {
        setPasteError('The file is empty.');
        return;
      }
      if (pasteAuto) await parseMessage(msgs[0]);
      else notify('info', `Loaded ${file.name}. Press Parse and load fields to continue.`);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setPasteError(err.message || 'The file could not be read.');
    }
  };

  const onFilePicked = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (file) readFile(file);
    e.target.value = '';
  };

  const onDrop = (e: React.DragEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setDragOver(false);
    const file = e.dataTransfer.files?.[0];
    if (file) readFile(file);
  };

  // ==========================================================================
  // Build, decode, submit
  // ==========================================================================
  const handleBuildAndValidate = async () => {
    setValidationErrors({});
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch('/simulator/build', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ mti, fields: getActiveFields() }),
      });
      if (!res.valid) {
        setValidationErrors(res.errors || {});
        notify('err', `${Object.keys(res.errors || {}).length} field(s) need attention.`);
      } else {
        setRawTic(res.raw_tic_message);
        setCompactTic(res.compact_tic);
        setDecodedView(res.decoded);
        notify('ok', 'Message built and validated.');
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      notify('err', e.message);
    }
  };

  const handleDecodeRaw = async () => {
    if (!rawTic.trim()) return;
    try {
      const dec = await apiFetch('/simulator/decode', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ raw_tic_message: rawTic }),
      });
      setDecodedView(dec);
      if (dec.valid && dec.raw_fields) {
        setMti(dec.mti || '0200');
        setFields(dec.raw_fields);
        setEnabledFields(allEnabled(dec.raw_fields));
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      notify('err', e.message);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmitTransaction = async () => {
    setSubmitting(true);
    setValidationErrors({});
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch('/simulator/submit', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({
          transaction_code: txCode,
          mti,
          fields: getActiveFields(),
          test_clear_pin_helper: clearPinHelper || undefined,
          source_channel: 'SIMULATOR',
        }),
      });
      setTxResponse(res);
      setRawTic(res.sanitized_request_tic || rawTic);
      setCompactTic(res.compact_response_tic || '');
      if (autoAdvance) {
        const ids = await fetchNextIds();
        if (ids) {
          setFields((prev) => {
            const next = { ...prev };
            if ('11' in next) next['11'] = ids.next_stan;
            if ('37' in next) next['37'] = ids.next_rrn;
            return next;
          });
        }
      } else {
        fetchNextIds();
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      notify('err', e.message);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const resetToDefaults = async () => {
    try {
      localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    } catch (e) {
      /* ignore */
    }
    const ids = await fetchNextIds();
    const f = buildDefaultFields(ids ? { stan: ids.next_stan, rrn: ids.next_rrn } : null);
    setTxCode('10');
    setMti('0200');
    setClearPinHelper('1234');
    setFields(f);
    setEnabledFields(allEnabled(f));
    setTxResponse(null);
    setRawTic('');
    setCompactTic('');
    setDecodedView(null);
    setValidationErrors({});
    setSessionRestored(false);
    setCurrentCaseId(null);
    setCurrentCaseName('');
    notify('info', 'Simulator reset. STAN and RRN continue from the database.');
  };

  const copyRaw = async () => {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(rawTic);
      setCopied(true);
      window.setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1400);
    } catch (e) {
      notify('err', 'Copy failed. Select the text and copy it manually.');
    }
  };

  // ==========================================================================
  // Saved cases
  // ==========================================================================
  const openSaveDialog = () => {
    setSaveName(currentCaseName || '');
    setSaveDesc(savedCases.find((c) => c.id === currentCaseId)?.description || '');
    setSaveOpen(true);
  };

  const casePayload = (name: string, description: string, overwrite = false) => ({
    name: name.trim(),
    description: description.trim(),
    mti,
    transaction_code: txCode,
    clear_pin_helper: clearPinHelper || '',
    fields,
    enabled_fields: enabledFields,
    overwrite,
  });

  const saveCase = async (asNew: boolean) => {
    const name = saveName.trim();
    if (!name) {
      notify('err', 'Give the case a name first.');
      return;
    }
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      let saved: SavedCase;
      if (!asNew && currentCaseId) {
        saved = await apiFetch(`/simulator-workbench/cases/${currentCaseId}`, {
          method: 'PUT',
          body: JSON.stringify(casePayload(name, saveDesc)),
        });
      } else {
        try {
          saved = await apiFetch('/simulator-workbench/cases', {
            method: 'POST',
            body: JSON.stringify(casePayload(name, saveDesc)),
          });
        } catch (err: any) {
          if (!/already exists/i.test(err.message || '')) throw err;
          if (!window.confirm(`A case named "${name}" already exists. Replace it?`)) {
            setSaving(false);
            return;
          }
          saved = await apiFetch('/simulator-workbench/cases', {
            method: 'POST',
            body: JSON.stringify(casePayload(name, saveDesc, true)),
          });
        }
      }
      setCurrentCaseId(saved.id);
      setCurrentCaseName(saved.name);
      setSaveOpen(false);
      await reloadCases();
      notify('ok', `Saved case "${saved.name}".`);
    } catch (e: any) {
      notify('err', e.message || 'The case could not be saved.');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const loadCase = async (c: SavedCase) => {
    await loadIntoEditor(
      {
        mti: c.mti,
        txCode: c.transaction_code,
        fields: c.fields,
        enabled: c.enabled_fields,
        pin: c.clear_pin_helper || '',
      },
      caseOpts
    );
    setCurrentCaseId(c.id);
    setCurrentCaseName(c.name);
    setSessionRestored(false);
    setActiveTab('fields');
    notify('ok', `Loaded case "${c.name}".`);
  };

  const deleteCase = async (c: SavedCase) => {
    if (!window.confirm(`Delete the saved case "${c.name}"?`)) return;
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/simulator-workbench/cases/${c.id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
      if (currentCaseId === c.id) {
        setCurrentCaseId(null);
        setCurrentCaseName('');
      }
      await reloadCases();
      notify('info', `Deleted "${c.name}".`);
    } catch (e: any) {
      notify('err', e.message);
    }
  };

  const filteredCases = savedCases.filter((c) => {
    const q = caseFilter.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return true;
    return c.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || (c.description || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
  });

  // ==========================================================================
  // Render helpers
  // ==========================================================================
  const fieldDefs: any[] = catalog?.field_definitions || [];
  const defFor = (n: string | number) => fieldDefs.find((d: any) => String(d.field_number) === String(n));

  const bitmapCell = (n: number) => {
    const key = String(n);
    const def = defFor(n);
    const present = key in fields;
    let cls = 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-900/70 cursor-default';
    if (present && enabledFields[key] === false) cls = 'bg-slate-400 dark:bg-slate-600 cursor-pointer';
    else if (present && fields[key] === '') cls = 'bg-amber-400 cursor-pointer';
    else if (present) cls = 'bg-emerald-500 cursor-pointer';
    else if (def) cls = 'bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-emerald-300 dark:hover:bg-emerald-800 cursor-pointer';
    return (
      <button
        key={n}
        type="button"
        onClick={() => jumpToField(n)}
        title={`DE${n}${def ? ' ' + def.name : ' (not defined)'}${present ? '' : def ? ' - click to add' : ''}`}
        aria-label={`DE${n}`}
        className={`h-3.5 rounded-[3px] transition-colors ${cls}`}
      />
    );
  };

  const tabs: { key: TabKey; label: string; icon: React.ReactNode; badge?: string }[] = [
    { key: 'fields', label: 'Field editor', icon: <ListChecks size={14} />, badge: String(Object.keys(fields).length) },
    { key: 'paste', label: 'Paste or load message', icon: <ClipboardPaste size={14} /> },
    { key: 'time', label: 'Date and time', icon: <Clock size={14} /> },
    { key: 'cases', label: 'Saved cases', icon: <Bookmark size={14} />, badge: savedCases.length ? String(savedCases.length) : undefined },
  ];

  const optionRow = (
    opts: LoadOpts,
    set: (o: LoadOpts) => void,
    idsLabel: string,
    timeLabel: string
  ) => (
    <div className="space-y-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 p-3">
      <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 cursor-pointer">
        <input
          type="checkbox"
          checked={opts.ids}
          onChange={(e) => set({ ...opts, ids: e.target.checked })}
          className="accent-emerald-600"
        />
        {idsLabel}
      </label>
      <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 cursor-pointer">
        <input
          type="checkbox"
          checked={opts.time}
          onChange={(e) => set({ ...opts, time: e.target.checked })}
          className="accent-emerald-600"
        />
        {timeLabel}
      </label>
    </div>
  );

  // ==========================================================================
  // Render
  // ==========================================================================
  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      <HsmAuthoritySimulatorBar />

                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setCurrentCaseId(null);
                      setCurrentCaseName('');
                    }}
                    className="rounded-full hover:bg-white/20 p-0.5"

                    aria-label="Detach from saved case"
                  >
                    <X size={10} />
                  </button>
                </span>

            </div>
          </div>

            </button>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setActiveTab('cases')} className={btnHero}>
              <FolderOpen size={14} /> Open case
            </button>
            <button type="button" onClick={resetToDefaults} className={btnHero} title="Reset the simulator to default values">
              <RotateCcw size={14} /> Reset
            </button>
            <button type="button" onClick={bumpStanAndRrn} className={btnHero} title="Add 1 to STAN and RRN">
              <Plus size={14} /> STAN and RRN
            </button>

              type="button"

                        setTxCode(nextCode);

                          setMti(found.default_mti);
                          setFields({ ...fields, '3': found.processing_code });

                      <option value="0200">0200 Financial request</option>
                      <option value="0210">0210 Financial response</option>
                      <option value="0220">0220 Financial advice</option>
                      <option value="0400">0400 Reversal request</option>
                      <option value="0410">0410 Reversal response</option>
                      <option value="0420">0420 Reversal advice</option>
                      <option value="0430">0430 Reversal advice response</option>
                      <option value="0800">0800 Network management</option>
                      <option value="0810">0810 Network management response</option>
                      {!['0100','0110','0200','0210','0220','0400','0410','0420','0430','0800','0810'].includes(mti) && (
                        <option value={mti}>{mti}</option>
                      )}
                    </select>
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label className={labelCls}>Synthetic card</label>
                    <select
                      value={fields['2'] || ''}
                      onChange={(e) => setFields({ ...fields, '2': e.target.value })}
                      className={inputCls}
                    >

                        <option value={fields['2']}>Custom PAN from the message</option>
                      )}
                      {(catalog?.test_cards || []).map((c: any) => (
                        <option key={c.id} value={c.test_pan_reference}>
                          {c.masked_pan} ({c.card_status})
                        </option>
                      ))}
                    </select>
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label className={labelCls}>Server PIN helper (packs DE52)</label>

                      type="password"
                      value={clearPinHelper}

                {/* Bitmap strip */}
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/70 dark:bg-slate-950/50 p-3">

                      const isMandatory = MANDATORY_FIELDS.includes(fnum);
                      const timeMeta = TIME_META[fnum];
                      const value = fields[fnum] ?? '';
                      const fixed = def && def.length_type === 'FIXED' ? def.fixed_length : null;
                      const off = enabledFields[fnum] === false;
                      return (

                            {def && (
                              <span className="rounded bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] text-slate-500">

                                {def.fixed_length ? ` ${def.fixed_length}` : ''}
                              </span>
                            )}
                            <input
                              value={value}
                              onChange={(e) => setFields({ ...fields, [fnum]: e.target.value })}
                              disabled={off}
                              className={`${inputCls} !w-auto min-w-[10rem] flex-1`}
                            />
                            {fixed ? (
                              <span className={`w-12 text-right font-mono text-[10px] ${value.length > fixed ? 'text-rose-500' : 'text-slate-400'}`}>

                              </span>

                                type="button"

                            {!isMandatory && (
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => removeField(fnum)}

                                title={`Remove DE${fnum}`}
                                aria-label={`Remove DE${fnum}`}

                                <Trash2 size={13} />
                              </button>
                            )}

                              <AlertTriangle size={12} /> {err}

            {/* =================== TAB: PASTE / LOAD =================== */}
            {activeTab === 'paste' && (

                  />
                  <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                      <input
                        ref={fileInputRef}
                        type="file"
                        className="hidden"
                        accept=".txt,.log,.iso,.tic,.msg,.dat,.hex,text/plain"
                        onChange={onFilePicked}
                      />

                        <FileUp size={14} /> Load from file
                      </button>

                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                          setPasteText(SAMPLE_ISO);
                          setPasteFileName('');

                        }}

                        Insert a sample ISO 8583 message

                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                          setPasteText('');
                          setPasteFileName('');
                          setPasteError('');
                          setPasteInfo(null);
                          setPasteIndex(0);
                        }}
                        className={btnGhost}
                        disabled={!pasteText}
                      >
                        <X size={14} /> Clear
                      </button>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => parseMessage(pasteMessages[Math.min(pasteIndex, Math.max(0, pasteMessages.length - 1))] || '')}
                        className={btnPrimary}
                      >
                        <Zap size={14} /> Parse and load fields
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
                  <div className="space-y-3">
                    <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 cursor-pointer">
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        checked={pasteAuto}
                        onChange={(e) => setPasteAuto(e.target.checked)}

                      />
                      Load the fields as soon as I paste or open a file
                    </label>
                    {pasteLineCount > 1 && (
                      <div>

                            setPasteMode(e.target.value as SplitMode);
                            setPasteIndex(0);
                          }}
                          className={inputCls}
                        >
                          <option value="auto">Detect automatically</option>
                          <option value="separate">Each line is its own message</option>
                          <option value="join">All lines form one message</option>
