                      </div>
                    )}
                    {pasteMessages.length > 1 && (
                      <div>
                        <label className={labelCls}>{pasteMessages.length} messages found. Choose one to load.</label>
                        <select
                          value={pasteIndex}
                          onChange={(e) => {
                            const i = Number(e.target.value);
                            setPasteIndex(i);
                            parseMessage(pasteMessages[i]);
                          }}
                          className={inputCls}
                        >
                          {pasteMessages.map((m, i) => (
                            <option key={i} value={i}>
                              Message {i + 1}: {m.slice(0, 34)}
                              {m.length > 34 ? '...' : ''}
                            </option>
                          ))}
                        </select>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  {optionRow(
                    pasteOpts,
                    setPasteOpts,
                    'Replace STAN and RRN with the next free values from the database',
                    'Set the time fields in the message to the current time'
                  )}
                </div>

                {pasteError && (
                  <div className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-xl border border-rose-400/40 bg-rose-500/10 p-3 text-xs text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-300">
                    <AlertTriangle size={14} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
                    <div>
                      <div className="font-semibold">The message was not loaded</div>
                      <div className="mt-0.5">{pasteError}</div>
                      <div className="mt-1 text-rose-500/80">
                        Check that the message starts with A4M (TIC) or a 4-digit MTI (ISO 8583) and that it is not cut off.
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}

                {pasteInfo && (
                  <div className="space-y-2 rounded-xl border border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-500/5 p-3">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs">
                      <span className="font-semibold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
                        {pasteInfo.keys.length} fields loaded
                      </span>
                      <span className="rounded bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px]">
                        {pasteInfo.format === 'TIC_V2164E' ? 'TIC v2.164e' : 'ISO 8583:1987'}
                      </span>
                      <span className="rounded bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px]">
                        MTI {pasteInfo.mti}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                      {pasteInfo.keys.map((k: string) => (
                        <button
                          key={k}
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => {
                            setActiveTab('fields');
                            window.setTimeout(() => jumpToField(Number(k)), 80);
                          }}
                          className="rounded bg-emerald-500/15 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 hover:bg-emerald-500/30"
                          title={defFor(k)?.name}
                        >
                          DE{k}
                        </button>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                    {pasteInfo.warnings.length > 0 && (
                      <ul className="list-disc space-y-0.5 pl-5 text-[11px] text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">
                        {pasteInfo.warnings.map((w: string, i: number) => (
                          <li key={i}>{w}</li>
                        ))}
                      </ul>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* =================== TAB: DATE AND TIME =================== */}
            {activeTab === 'time' && (
              <div className="space-y-4">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/50 p-4">
                  <div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">Local time on this computer</div>
                    <div className="font-mono text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
                      {pad(clock.getHours())}:{pad(clock.getMinutes())}:{pad(clock.getSeconds())}
                      <span className="ml-3 text-sm font-medium text-slate-500">
                        {clock.getFullYear()}-{pad(clock.getMonth() + 1)}-{pad(clock.getDate())}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="mt-0.5 font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                      GMT {pad(clock.getUTCHours())}:{pad(clock.getUTCMinutes())}:{pad(clock.getUTCSeconds())}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => { setAllTimeNow(); notify('ok', 'All time fields set to the current time.'); }} className={btnPrimary}>
                    <Clock size={14} /> Set all time fields to now
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-2">
                  <div className="min-w-[14rem] flex-1">
                    <label className={labelCls}>Use a specific date and time instead</label>
                    <input
                      type="datetime-local"
                      step={1}
                      value={pickedTime}
                      onChange={(e) => setPickedTime(e.target.value)}
                      className={inputCls}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => setPickedTime(toLocalInput(new Date()))} className={btnGhost}>
                    Use current
                  </button>
                  <button type="button" onClick={applyPickedTime} className={btnGhost}>
                    Apply to time fields
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-2">
                  {TIME_KEYS.map((k) => {
                    const meta = TIME_META[k];
                    const present = k in fields;
                    const off = enabledFields[k] === false;
                    return (
                      <div
                        key={k}
                        className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/60 dark:bg-slate-950/40 p-2.5 text-xs"
                      >
                        <span className="w-12 font-mono font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">DE{k}</span>
                        <div className="w-48">
                          <div className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">{meta.label}</div>
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">{meta.hint}</div>
                        </div>
                        {present ? (
                          <input
                            value={fields[k]}
                            onChange={(e) => setFields({ ...fields, [k]: e.target.value })}
                            disabled={off}
                            className={`${inputCls} !w-auto min-w-[8rem] flex-1`}
                          />
                        ) : (
                          <span className="min-w-[8rem] flex-1 text-[11px] text-slate-400">Not in the message yet</span>
                        )}
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setTimeNow([k])}
                          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border border-emerald-500/40 bg-emerald-500/10 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 hover:bg-emerald-500/20 transition"
                        >
                          <Clock size={11} /> {present ? 'Now' : 'Add and set to now'}
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
                <p className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-slate-500">
                  DE7 uses GMT. DE12, DE13, DE15, DE16 and DE17 use the local time of this computer. DE14 is the card
                  expiry date and is never changed here.
                </p>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* =================== TAB: SAVED CASES =================== */}
            {activeTab === 'cases' && (
              <div className="space-y-4">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <div className="relative min-w-[14rem] flex-1">
                    <Search size={14} className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />
                    <input
                      value={caseFilter}
                      onChange={(e) => setCaseFilter(e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="Search saved cases"
                      className={`${inputCls} !pl-8`}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <button type="button" onClick={openSaveDialog} className={btnPrimary}>
                    <Save size={14} /> Save current as case
                  </button>
                </div>

                {optionRow(
                  caseOpts,
                  setCaseOpts,
                  'Use the next free STAN and RRN from the database when I open a case',
                  'Set the time fields to the current time when I open a case'
                )}

                {filteredCases.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 p-8 text-center text-xs text-slate-500">
                    {savedCases.length === 0
                      ? 'No saved cases yet. Set up a transaction, then press Save case to keep it.'
                      : 'No saved case matches your search.'}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="max-h-[460px] space-y-2 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                    {filteredCases.map((c) => (
                      <div
                        key={c.id}
                        className={`flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border p-3 text-xs ${
                          c.id === currentCaseId
                            ? 'border-emerald-500/60 bg-emerald-500/5'
                            : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/60 dark:bg-slate-950/40'
                        }`}
                      >
                        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                            <span className="truncate text-sm font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">{c.name}</span>
                            <span className="rounded bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px]">MTI {c.mti}</span>
                            {c.transaction_code && (
                              <span className="rounded bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px]">Code {c.transaction_code}</span>
                            )}
                            <span className="rounded bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px]">{c.field_count} fields</span>
                          </div>
                          {c.description && <div className="mt-1 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">{c.description}</div>}
                          <div className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                            Saved {c.updated_at ? new Date(c.updated_at).toLocaleString() : ''}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <button type="button" onClick={() => loadCase(c)} className={btnGhost}>
                            <FolderOpen size={13} /> Open
                          </button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => deleteCase(c)}
                            className="rounded-lg p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:bg-rose-500/10 hover:text-rose-500 transition"
                            title="Delete this case"
                            aria-label={`Delete ${c.name}`}
                          >
                            <Trash2 size={14} />
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* ------------------------------ Right column ------------------------------ */}
        <div className="space-y-5 lg:col-span-5">
          {/* Raw message */}
          <div className={`${cardCls} space-y-3 p-5`}>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <h2 className="text-sm font-bold">Wire message</h2>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <button type="button" onClick={handleDecodeRaw} className={btnGhost}>
                  Decode into fields
                </button>
                <button type="button" onClick={copyRaw} className={btnGhost} title="Copy the raw message" aria-label="Copy the raw message">
                  {copied ? <Check size={13} className="text-emerald-500" /> : <Copy size={13} />}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
            <textarea
              rows={4}
              value={rawTic}
              onChange={(e) => setRawTic(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Build and validate to generate the TIC message, or paste one here and decode it."
              spellCheck={false}
              className="w-full resize-y rounded-lg border border-slate-800 bg-slate-950 p-3 font-mono text-xs text-emerald-300 placeholder:text-slate-600 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/40"
            />
            {compactTic && (
              <div>
                <div className="mb-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  Compact TIC format (Ý and ³ delimiters)
                </div>
                <div className="break-all rounded-lg border border-slate-800 bg-slate-950 p-2.5 font-mono text-[11px] text-amber-300">
                  {compactTic}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Host outcome */}
          {txResponse && (
            <div className={`${cardCls} space-y-4 p-5`}>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 pb-3">
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <div className="truncate font-mono text-xs text-slate-400">{txResponse.transaction_reference}</div>
                  <div className="mt-0.5 font-mono text-base font-bold">
                    RC {txResponse.response_code} ({txResponse.response_tic_f39}): {txResponse.response_message}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <span
                  className={`shrink-0 rounded-full px-3 py-1 font-mono text-xs font-bold ${
                    txResponse.authorization_status === 'APPROVED'
                      ? 'border border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-500'
                      : 'border border-rose-500/30 bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-500'
                  }`}
                >
                  {txResponse.authorization_status}
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 font-mono text-xs">
                <div className="rounded-lg bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 p-2">
                  <span className="text-slate-400">Response MTI:</span> {txResponse.response_mti}
                </div>
                <div className="rounded-lg bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 p-2">
                  <span className="text-slate-400">Switch and route:</span>{' '}
                  <span className="font-bold text-emerald-500">{txResponse.ps_code || 'ITCL'}</span> ({txResponse.is_on_us ? 'ON-US' : 'OFF-US'})
                </div>
                <div className="col-span-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 p-2">
                  <span className="text-slate-400">New balance:</span>{' '}
                  {txResponse.account_balance_after !== null && txResponse.account_balance_after !== undefined
                    ? `${txResponse.account_balance_after.toLocaleString()} ${txResponse.currency}`
                    : 'Unchanged'}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <div className="mb-2 text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  Host execution trace ({txResponse.checks?.length || 0} steps)
                </div>
                <div className="max-h-64 space-y-1.5 overflow-y-auto">
                  {(txResponse.checks || []).map((c: any) => (
                    <div
                      key={c.check_order}
                      className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200/60 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 p-2 font-mono text-xs"
                    >
                      <div>
                        <span className="mr-1.5 font-bold text-slate-400">#{c.check_order}</span>
                        <span className="font-bold">{c.check_name}:</span>{' '}
                        <span className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-300">{c.message}</span>
                      </div>
                      <span
                        className={`shrink-0 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${
                          c.check_status === 'PASSED' ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-500' : 'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-500'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {c.check_status} (RC {c.response_code})
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Decoded view */}
          {decodedView && (
            <div className={`${cardCls} space-y-2 p-5`}>
              <h3 className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Decoded TIC v2.164e structure</h3>
              <pre className="max-h-60 overflow-auto rounded-lg bg-slate-950 p-3 font-mono text-[11px] text-sky-300">
                {JSON.stringify(decodedView.detailed_fields || decodedView, null, 2)}
              </pre>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */}
      {/* Save dialog                                                          */}
      {/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */}
      {saveOpen && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/60 p-4"
          onClick={() => !saving && setSaveOpen(false)}
          role="dialog"
          aria-modal="true"
          aria-label="Save case"
        >
          <div
            className="w-full max-w-md space-y-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-6 shadow-2xl"
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <h2 className="text-sm font-bold">Save case</h2>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setSaveOpen(false)} className="rounded p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-white" aria-label="Close">
                <X size={16} />
              </button>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className={labelCls}>Case name</label>
              <input
                autoFocus
                value={saveName}
                onChange={(e) => setSaveName(e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && saveCase(!currentCaseId)}
                placeholder="ATM withdrawal with wrong PIN"
                className={inputCls}
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className={labelCls}>Notes (optional)</label>
              <textarea
                rows={3}
                value={saveDesc}
                onChange={(e) => setSaveDesc(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="What this case checks"
                className={inputCls}
              />
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
              Saves the message type, transaction code, PIN helper, every field and which fields are switched on or off.
            </p>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-2">
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setSaveOpen(false)} className={btnGhost} disabled={saving}>
                Cancel
              </button>
              {currentCaseId && (
                <button type="button" onClick={() => saveCase(true)} className={btnGhost} disabled={saving}>
                  Save as new case
                </button>
              )}
              <button type="button" onClick={() => saveCase(!currentCaseId)} className={btnPrimary} disabled={saving}>
                <Save size={14} /> {saving ? 'Saving...' : currentCaseId ? 'Update case' : 'Save case'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Toast */}
      {toast && (
        <div
          role="status"
          className={`fixed bottom-5 right-5 z-50 flex max-w-sm items-start gap-2 rounded-xl border px-4 py-3 text-xs font-medium shadow-xl ${
            toast.kind === 'ok'
              ? 'border-emerald-500/40 bg-emerald-950 text-emerald-200'
              : toast.kind === 'err'
              ? 'border-rose-500/40 bg-rose-950 text-rose-200'
              : 'border-slate-600 bg-slate-900 text-slate-200'
          }`}
        >
          {toast.kind === 'ok' ? <Check size={14} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" /> : toast.kind === 'err' ? <AlertTriangle size={14} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" /> : <Zap size={14} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />}
          <span>{toast.text}</span>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

// ============================================================================
// PAGE 9: TRANSACTION JOURNAL
// ============================================================================
export const TransactionJournalPage: React.FC = () => {
  const [txs, setTxs] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [stan, setStan] = useState('');
  const [rrn, setRrn] = useState('');
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('');
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [totalPages, setTotalPages] = useState(1);
  const [totalTxs, setTotalTxs] = useState(0);

  const load = async (p: number = page) => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams({ page: String(p), page_size: '25' });
    if (stan) params.set('stan', stan);
    if (rrn) params.set('rrn', rrn);
    if (status) params.set('status', status);
    const res = await apiFetch(`/transactions?${params.toString()}`);
    const items = Array.isArray(res) ? res : (res.items || []);
    setTxs(items);
    setTotalTxs(Array.isArray(res) ? items.length : (res.total ?? items.length));
    setTotalPages(Array.isArray(res) ? 1 : (res.total_pages || 1));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load(page);
  }, [page]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold">Host Transaction Journal</h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
            Complete immutable audit log of all processed authorizations, financial postings, and reversals
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <input
            value={stan}
            onChange={(e) => setStan(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Filter STAN..."
            className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-mono"
          />
          <input
            value={rrn}
            onChange={(e) => setRrn(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Filter RRN..."
            className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-mono"
          />
          <select
            value={status}
            onChange={(e) => setStatus(e.target.value)}
            className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-mono"
          >
            <option value="">ALL OUTCOMES</option>
            <option value="APPROVED">APPROVED</option>
            <option value="DECLINED">DECLINED</option>
          </select>
          <button
            onClick={() => { setPage(1); load(1); }}
            className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-emerald-600 text-white px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold"
          >
            <Search size={14} /> Search
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full text-left text-xs font-mono">
          <thead>
            <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-400">
              <th className="py-2.5">Reference</th>
              <th className="py-2.5">MTI / Code</th>
// [PATCH step02_02:journal_table_route_th]
              <th className="py-2.5">Switch / Route</th>
              <th className="py-2.5">STAN / RRN</th>
              <th className="py-2.5">Masked PAN</th>
              <th className="py-2.5">Amount</th>
              <th className="py-2.5">RC</th>
              <th className="py-2.5">Outcome</th>
              <th className="py-2.5">Timestamp</th>
              <th className="py-2.5">Inspect</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-200/60 dark:divide-slate-800/60">
            {txs.map((t) => (
              <tr key={t.id}>
                <td className="py-2.5 font-bold text-sky-500">{t.transaction_reference}</td>
                <td className="py-2.5">
                  {t.mti} (Code {t.transaction_code || 'N/A'})
                </td>
// [PATCH step02_02:journal_table_route_td]
                <td className="py-2.5">
                  <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">{t.ps_code || "ITCL"}</span>
                  <span className={`ml-1.5 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold ${t.is_on_us ? "bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400" : "bg-sky-500/10 text-sky-400"}`}>
                    {t.is_on_us ? "ON-US" : "OFF-US"}
                  </span>
                </td>
                <td className="py-2.5">
                  {t.stan} / {t.rrn}
                </td>
                <td className="py-2.5">{t.masked_pan}</td>
                <td className="py-2.5 font-bold">
                  {t.transaction_amount.toLocaleString()} {t.currency}
                </td>
                <td className="py-2.5 font-bold">{t.response_code}</td>
                <td className="py-2.5">
                  <span
                    className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold ${
                      t.authorization_status === 'APPROVED'
                        ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-500'
                        : 'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-500'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {t.authorization_status} ({t.transaction_status})
                  </span>
                </td>
                <td className="py-2.5">{new Date(t.created_at).toLocaleTimeString()}</td>
                <td className="py-2.5">
                  <Link
                    to={`/transactions/${t.id}`}
                    className="text-emerald-500 hover:underline font-bold"
                  >
                    Details ➔
                  </Link>
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
// [PATCH step05:journal_pagination_bar_fixed]
        </table>
      </div>

      <div className="flex justify-between items-center bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-3 text-xs font-mono">
        <div className="text-slate-400">Total Journal Records: <strong className="text-emerald-500">{totalTxs}</strong></div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <button disabled={page <= 1} onClick={() => setPage(page - 1)} className="px-3 py-1 rounded border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 disabled:opacity-40">Previous</button>
          <span>Page {page} of {totalPages}</span>
          <button disabled={page >= totalPages} onClick={() => setPage(page + 1)} className="px-3 py-1 rounded border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 disabled:opacity-40">Next</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

// ============================================================================
// PAGE 10: TRANSACTION DETAILS
// ============================================================================
export const TransactionDetailsPage: React.FC = () => {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const [detail, setDetail] = useState<any>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (id) apiFetch(`/transactions/${id}`).then(setDetail).catch(console.error);
  }, [id]);

  if (!detail) {
    return <div className="text-xs font-mono text-slate-400">Loading transaction trace...</div>;
  }

  const tx = detail.transaction;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <Link
            to="/transactions"
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-mono text-emerald-500 hover:underline mb-1"
          >
            <ArrowLeft size={14} /> Back to Transaction Journal
          </Link>
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold font-mono">{tx.transaction_reference}</h1>
        </div>
        <span
          className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-mono font-bold ${
            tx.authorization_status === 'APPROVED'
              ? 'bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-500'
              : 'bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-500'
          }`}
        >
          {tx.authorization_status} — RC {tx.response_code} ({tx.response_message})
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-6 gap-3 text-xs font-mono">
        {[
          ['MTI', tx.mti],
          ['Processing Code', tx.processing_code],
          ['STAN', tx.stan],
          ['RRN', tx.rrn],
          ['Masked PAN', tx.masked_pan],
          ['Amount', `${tx.transaction_amount.toLocaleString()} ${tx.currency}`],
// [PATCH step02_02:tx_details_bank_cards]
          ['Switch System', `${tx.ps_code || 'ITCL'} (${tx.is_on_us ? 'ON-US' : 'OFF-US'})`],
          ['Issuing Bank', tx.issuer_code || 'XBANK'],
          ['Acquiring Bank', tx.acquirer_code || 'XBANK'],
        ].map(([k, v]) => (
          <div
            key={k}
            className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-3"
          >
            <div className="text-slate-400 text-[10px]">{k}</div>
            <div className="font-bold mt-1">{v}</div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Step-by-Step Checks */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5">
        <h2 className="text-sm font-bold mb-3">Authorization Checks Executed</h2>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {detail.checks.map((c: any) => (
            <div
              key={c.check_order}
              className="flex justify-between items-center p-2.5 rounded bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 text-xs font-mono"
            >
              <div>
                <span className="text-slate-400 mr-2">Step {c.check_order}:</span>
                <span className="font-bold">{c.check_name}</span> — {c.message}
              </div>
              <span
                className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold ${
                  c.check_status === 'PASSED'
                    ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-500'
                    : 'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-500'
                }`}
              >
                {c.check_status} ({c.duration_ms} ms)
              </span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Sanitized Wire Messages */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-3">
        <h2 className="text-sm font-bold">Sanitized TIC Request & Response Messages</h2>
        {detail.messages.map((m: any, i: number) => (
          <div key={i} className="p-3 rounded bg-slate-950 text-xs font-mono space-y-1">
            <div className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">
              [{m.message_type} — MTI {m.mti}]
            </div>
            <div className="text-slate-200 break-all">{m.sanitized_message}</div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

function findStoredJwtToken(): string {
  const candidateKeys = [
    'baobab_auth_token',
    'baobab_token',
    'host_token',
    'auth_token',
    'token',
    'access_token',
    'jwt',
  ];
  for (const k of candidateKeys) {
    const v = localStorage.getItem(k) || sessionStorage.getItem(k);
    if (v && v.trim()) {
      const clean = v.trim().replace(/^"|"$/g, '');
      if (clean.startsWith('eyJ')) return clean;
    }
  }
  // Scan all localStorage & sessionStorage entries for any JWT or JSON containing access_token
  for (const store of [localStorage, sessionStorage]) {
    for (let i = 0; i < store.length; i++) {
      const key = store.key(i);
      if (!key) continue;
      const raw = store.getItem(key) || '';
      const trimmed = raw.trim().replace(/^"|"$/g, '');
      if (trimmed.startsWith('eyJ') && trimmed.split('.').length === 3) {
        return trimmed;
      }
      if (trimmed.startsWith('{')) {
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(trimmed);
          const tok = parsed?.access_token || parsed?.token || parsed?.state?.token;
          if (typeof tok === 'string' && tok.startsWith('eyJ')) {
            return tok;
          }
        } catch {
          // ignore
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return '';
}

function getAuthHeaders(): Record<string, string> {
  const token = findStoredJwtToken();
  return token
    ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
    : { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
}

let autoLoginPromise: Promise<string | null> | null = null;

async function ensureSimulatorToken(): Promise<string | null> {
  if (autoLoginPromise) return autoLoginPromise;
  autoLoginPromise = (async () => {
    try {
      const resp = await window.fetch('/api/auth/login', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ username: 'admin', password: 'AdminPassword123!' }),
      });
      if (!resp.ok) return null;
      const data = await resp.json();
      if (data?.access_token) {
        localStorage.setItem('baobab_token', data.access_token);
        localStorage.setItem('token', data.access_token);
        localStorage.setItem('access_token', data.access_token);
        return data.access_token as string;
      }
      return null;
    } catch {
      return null;
    } finally {
      autoLoginPromise = null;
    }
  })();
  return autoLoginPromise;
}

async function apiFetch(input: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<Response> {
  const headers = new Headers(init?.headers || {});
  const existingToken = findStoredJwtToken();
  if (existingToken && !headers.has('Authorization')) {
    headers.set('Authorization', `Bearer ${existingToken}`);
  }
  if (!headers.has('Content-Type') && init?.body) {
    headers.set('Content-Type', 'application/json');
  }

  let resp = await window.fetch(input, { ...init, headers });
  if (resp.status === 401) {
    const freshToken = await ensureSimulatorToken();
    if (freshToken) {
      headers.set('Authorization', `Bearer ${freshToken}`);
      resp = await window.fetch(input, { ...init, headers });
    }
  }
  return resp;
}

function StatusBadge({ status }: { status: string }) {
  const s = (status || '').toUpperCase();
  if (s === 'APPROVED') {
    return (
      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-semibold bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30">
        <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3" /> APPROVED
      </span>
    );
  }
  if (s === 'REVERSED') {
    return (
      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-semibold bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30">
        <RotateCcw className="w-3 h-3" /> REVERSED
      </span>
    );
  }
  if (s === 'PENDING') {
    return (
      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-semibold bg-sky-500/15 text-sky-400 border border-sky-500/30">
        <Clock className="w-3 h-3" /> PENDING
      </span>
    );
  }
  return (
    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-semibold bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-400 border border-rose-500/30">
      <XCircle className="w-3 h-3" /> {s || 'DECLINED'}
    </span>
  );
}

export const TransactionLogViewerPage: React.FC = () => {
  // Data state
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<TxLogRow[]>([]);
  const [summary, setSummary] = useState<TxSummaryMetrics>({
    total_transactions: 0,
    approved_transactions: 0,
    declined_transactions: 0,
    reversed_transactions: 0,
    pending_transactions: 0,
    approval_rate: 0,
    approved_volume: 0,
  });
  const [total, setTotal] = useState<number>(0);
  const [page, setPage] = useState<number>(1);
  const [pageSize, setPageSize] = useState<number>(25);
  const [totalPages, setTotalPages] = useState<number>(1);
  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState<string>('created_at');
  const [sortDir, setSortDir] = useState<'asc' | 'desc'>('desc');

  // Loading & Error
  const [initialLoading, setInitialLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [lastUpdated, setLastUpdated] = useState<string>('—');

  // Auto-refresh timer state
  const [autoRefresh, setAutoRefresh] = useState<boolean>(() => {
    try {
      const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY_REFRESH) || '{}');
      return saved.autoRefresh ?? true;
    } catch {
      return true;
    }
  });
  const [ isPaused, setIsPaused ] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [refreshIntervalSec, setRefreshIntervalSec] = useState<number>(() => {
    try {
      const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY_REFRESH) || '{}');
      return Number(saved.intervalSec) || 5;
    } catch {
      return 5;
    }
  });
  const [customIntervalInput, setCustomIntervalInput] = useState<string>('');
  const [showCustomInterval, setShowCustomInterval] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [countdown, setCountdown] = useState<number>(refreshIntervalSec);

  // Filters state (draft vs applied)
  const [draftFilters, setDraftFilters] = useState<FilterState>(EMPTY_FILTERS);
  const [appliedFilters, setAppliedFilters] = useState<FilterState>(EMPTY_FILTERS);
  const [showAdvancedFilters, setShowAdvancedFilters] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Column customization state
  const [visibleColumns, setVisibleColumns] = useState<string[]>(() => {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY_COLS);
      if (raw) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) return parsed;
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
    return DEFAULT_VISIBLE_KEYS;
  });
  const [showColModal, setShowColModal] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [draftColumns, setDraftColumns] = useState<string[]>(visibleColumns);

  // Selected Transaction for Detail Modal/Drawer
  const [selectedTxId, setSelectedTxId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [activeDetailTab, setActiveDetailTab] = useState<
    'GENERAL' | 'AUTHORIZATION' | 'ISO_DETAILS' | 'CRYPTO' | 'TRACE' | 'RELATED'
  >('GENERAL');

  // Concurrency & cleanup refs
  const inFlightRef = useRef<boolean>(false);
  const abortControllerRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  // Persist auto-refresh settings
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(
        STORAGE_KEY_REFRESH,
        JSON.stringify({ autoRefresh, intervalSec: refreshIntervalSec })
      );
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  }, [autoRefresh, refreshIntervalSec]);

  // Load saved column preferences from backend on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;
    apiFetch('/api/transaction-logs/preferences/columns', { headers: getAuthHeaders() })
      .then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null))
      .then((data) => {
        if (mounted && data && Array.isArray(data.columns) && data.columns.length > 0) {
          // Only overwrite if user hasn't customized locally yet
          if (!localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY_COLS)) {
            setVisibleColumns(data.columns);
            setDraftColumns(data.columns);
          }
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {});
    return () => {
      mounted = false;
    };
  }, []);

  // Build query string from appliedFilters, page, pageSize, sortBy, sortDir
  const buildQueryParams = useCallback(
    (overridePage?: number) => {
      const params = new URLSearchParams();
      params.set('page', String(overridePage ?? page));
      params.set('page_size', String(pageSize));
      params.set('sort_by', sortBy);
      params.set('sort_dir', sortDir);
      Object.entries(appliedFilters).forEach(([k, v]) => {
        if (v !== undefined && v !== null && String(v).trim() !== '') {
          params.set(k, String(v).trim());
        }
      });
      return params.toString();
    },
    [appliedFilters, page, pageSize, sortBy, sortDir]
  );

  // Core fetch function (non-overlapping, preserves scroll and selection)
  const fetchTransactions = useCallback(
    async (isBackgroundRefresh = false, overridePage?: number) => {
      if (inFlightRef.current) {
        return; // Prevent overlapping refresh requests
      }
      inFlightRef.current = true;
      if (!isBackgroundRefresh) {
        setRefreshing(true);
      } else {
        setRefreshing(true);
      }

      const controller = new AbortController();
      abortControllerRef.current = controller;

      try {
        const qs = buildQueryParams(overridePage);
        const resp = await apiFetch(`/api/transaction-logs?${qs}`, {
          headers: getAuthHeaders(),
          signal: controller.signal,
        });
        if (!resp.ok) {
          const errBody = await resp.json().catch(() => ({}));
          throw new Error(errBody.detail || `Database query failed (HTTP ${resp.status})`);
        }
        const data = await resp.json();
        setRows(Array.isArray(data.items) ? data.items : []);
        setTotal(Number(data.total ?? 0));
        setTotalPages(Number(data.total_pages ?? 1));
        if (data.summary) {
          setSummary(data.summary);
        }
        setLastUpdated(new Date().toLocaleTimeString());
        setErrorMsg(null);
      } catch (err: any) {
        if (err?.name !== 'AbortError') {
          setErrorMsg(err?.message || 'Unable to retrieve transaction logs from database.');
        }
      } finally {
        inFlightRef.current = false;
        setInitialLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      }
    },
    [buildQueryParams]
  );

  // 1.1 Automatic initial loading & whenever appliedFilters / page / pageSize / sort change
  useEffect(() => {
    fetchTransactions(false);
    setCountdown(refreshIntervalSec);
  }, [fetchTransactions, refreshIntervalSec]);

  // Cleanup any in-flight request when leaving the page
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (abortControllerRef.current) {
        abortControllerRef.current.abort();
      }
    };
  }, []);

  // 1.2 Automatic refresh countdown timer
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!autoRefresh || isPaused) {
      return;
    }
    const timer = window.setInterval(() => {
      setCountdown((prev) => {
        if (prev <= 1) {
          if (!inFlightRef.current) {
            fetchTransactions(true);
          }
          return refreshIntervalSec;
        }
        return prev - 1;
      });
    }, 1000);

    return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
  }, [autoRefresh, isPaused, refreshIntervalSec, fetchTransactions]);

  // Handlers
  const handleManualRefresh = () => {
    setCountdown(refreshIntervalSec);
    fetchTransactions(false);
  };

  const handleApplyFilters = (e?: React.FormEvent) => {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();
    setPage(1);
    setAppliedFilters({ ...draftFilters });
  };

  const handleClearFilters = () => {
    setDraftFilters(EMPTY_FILTERS);
    setAppliedFilters(EMPTY_FILTERS);
    setPage(1);
  };

  const handleSort = (col: ColumnDef) => {
    if (!col.sortable || !col.sortKey) return;
    if (sortBy === col.sortKey) {
      setSortDir((d) => (d === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc'));
    } else {
      setSortBy(col.sortKey);
      setSortDir('desc');
    }
  };

  const handleExportCsv = async () => {
    try {
      const qs = buildQueryParams(1);
      const resp = await apiFetch(`/api/transaction-logs/export?${qs}`, {
        headers: getAuthHeaders(),
      });
      if (!resp.ok) throw new Error('Failed to export CSV');
      const blob = await resp.blob();
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `baobab_transactions_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 19).replace(/[:T]/g, '_')}.csv`;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      a.remove();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err?.message || 'CSV Export failed');
    }
  };

  const handleSaveColumns = async () => {
    if (draftColumns.length === 0) {
      alert('Please select at least one column.');
      return;
    }
    setVisibleColumns(draftColumns);
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY_COLS, JSON.stringify(draftColumns));
    setShowColModal(false);
    try {
      await apiFetch('/api/transaction-logs/preferences/columns', {
        method: 'PUT',
        headers: getAuthHeaders(),
        body: JSON.stringify({ columns: draftColumns }),
      });
    } catch {
      // localStorage already saved
    }
  };

  const activeColumns = useMemo(
    () => ALL_COLUMNS.filter((c) => visibleColumns.includes(c.key)),
    [visibleColumns]
  );

  const activeFilterCount = useMemo(
    () => Object.values(appliedFilters).filter((v) => String(v).trim() !== '').length,
    [appliedFilters]
  );

  const startRecord = total === 0 ? 0 : (page - 1) * pageSize + 1;
  const endRecord = Math.min(total, page * pageSize);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4 text-slate-100">
      <HsmAuthoritySimulatorBar />
      {/* HEADER BAR */}
      <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between gap-3 bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-4 shadow-lg">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-indigo-500/15 border border-indigo-500/30 text-indigo-400">
              <Activity className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-lg font-bold tracking-tight text-white">
                TRANSACTION LOG VIEWER
              </h1>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                Real-Time Host Switch Transaction Monitoring, TIC v2.164e ISO Inspector &amp; Pipeline Trace Investigator
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* AUTO-REFRESH CONTROL BAR */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5 bg-slate-950/80 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 pr-2 border-r border-slate-800">
            <span className="text-slate-400">Last Updated:</span>
            <span className="font-mono font-semibold text-emerald-400">{lastUpdated}</span>
            {refreshing && (
              <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-400 animate-spin ml-1" title="Querying database..." />
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 pr-2 border-r border-slate-800">
            <span className="text-slate-400">Auto Refresh:</span>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setAutoRefresh((v) => !v);
                setIsPaused(false);
                setCountdown(refreshIntervalSec);
              }}
              className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-bold transition ${
                autoRefresh
                  ? 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40'
                  : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 border border-slate-700'
              }`}
            >
              {autoRefresh ? 'ON' : 'OFF'}
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 pr-2 border-r border-slate-800">
            <span className="text-slate-400">Interval:</span>
            <select
              value={showCustomInterval ? 'CUSTOM' : String(refreshIntervalSec)}
              onChange={(e) => {
                const val = e.target.value;
                if (val === 'CUSTOM') {
                  setShowCustomInterval(true);
                  setCustomIntervalInput(String(refreshIntervalSec));
                } else {
                  setShowCustomInterval(false);
                  const sec = Number(val);
                  setRefreshIntervalSec(sec);
                  setCountdown(sec);
                }
              }}
              className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded px-2 py-0.5 text-slate-200 font-mono focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500"
            >
              {[2, 5, 10, 15, 30, 60].map((s) => (
                <option key={s} value={String(s)}>
                  {s}s
                </option>
              ))}
              <option value="CUSTOM">Custom...</option>
            </select>

            {showCustomInterval && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min={1}
                  max={300}
                  value={customIntervalInput}
                  onChange={(e) => setCustomIntervalInput(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-14 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-slate-200"
                  placeholder="Sec"
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    const parsed = Math.max(1, Math.min(300, Number(customIntervalInput) || 5));
                    setRefreshIntervalSec(parsed);
                    setCountdown(parsed);
                  }}
                  className="px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white rounded font-medium"
                >
                  Set
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {autoRefresh && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 pr-2 border-r border-slate-800">
              <span className="text-slate-400">Next Refresh In:</span>
              <span
                className={`font-mono font-bold px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded ${
                  isPaused ? 'text-amber-400 bg-amber-500/10' : 'text-indigo-300 bg-indigo-500/15'
                }`}
              >
                {isPaused ? 'PAUSED' : `${String(countdown).padStart(2, '0')}s`}
              </span>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleManualRefresh}
              disabled={refreshing}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:opacity-50 text-white font-medium transition"
            >
              <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${refreshing ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
              Refresh Now
            </button>

            {autoRefresh && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsPaused((p) => !p)}
                className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border font-medium transition ${
                  isPaused
                    ? 'bg-emerald-600/20 border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-300 hover:bg-emerald-600/30'
                    : 'bg-amber-500/15 border-amber-500/30 text-amber-300 hover:bg-amber-500/25'
                }`}
              >
                {isPaused ? (
                  <>
                    <Play className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Resume
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Pause className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Pause
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ERROR BANNER */}
      {errorMsg && (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between bg-rose-950/70 border border-rose-500/40 text-rose-200 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-xs">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-400 shrink-0" />
            <span>{errorMsg}</span>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleManualRefresh}
            className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-500 text-white rounded font-semibold"
          >
            Retry Query
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 2.1 SUMMARY CARDS */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-3">
        <div className="bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-3">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">
            Total Transactions
          </div>
          <div className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-white">
            {summary.total_transactions.toLocaleString()}
          </div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">Matching active filter context</div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-slate-900/90 border border-emerald-500/25 rounded-xl p-3">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-400">
            Approved
          </div>
          <div className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-emerald-400">
            {summary.approved_transactions.toLocaleString()}
          </div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5 font-mono">
            Vol: {summary.approved_volume.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-slate-900/90 border border-rose-500/25 rounded-xl p-3">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-rose-400">
            Declined
          </div>
          <div className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-rose-400">
            {summary.declined_transactions.toLocaleString()}
          </div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">Host / HSM / Rule declines</div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-slate-900/90 border border-amber-500/25 rounded-xl p-3">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-amber-400">
            Reversed
          </div>
          <div className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-amber-400">
            {summary.reversed_transactions.toLocaleString()}
          </div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">MTI 0400 / 0420 reversals</div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-slate-900/90 border border-sky-500/25 rounded-xl p-3">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-sky-400">
            Pending
          </div>
          <div className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-sky-400">
            {summary.pending_transactions.toLocaleString()}
          </div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">In-flight / awaiting advice</div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-slate-900/90 border border-indigo-500/25 rounded-xl p-3">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-400">
            Approval Rate
          </div>
          <div className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-indigo-300">
            {summary.approval_rate.toFixed(1)}%
          </div>
          <div className="w-full bg-slate-800 h-1.5 rounded-full mt-2 overflow-hidden">
            <div
              className="bg-indigo-500 h-full rounded-full transition-all"
              style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, Math.max(0, summary.approval_rate))}%` }}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 2.2 SERVER-SIDE TRANSACTION FILTERS */}
      <form
        onSubmit={handleApplyFilters}
        className="bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-3.5 space-y-3"
      >
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-300">
            <Filter className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-400" />
            <span>SERVER-SIDE TRANSACTION FILTERS</span>
            {activeFilterCount > 0 && (
              <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-500/30">
                {activeFilterCount} Active
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setShowAdvancedFilters((s) => !s)}
              className="text-xs text-indigo-400 hover:text-indigo-300 font-medium"
            >
              {showAdvancedFilters ? 'Hide Extended Filters ▲' : 'Show All 20 Filters ▼'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Primary Filter Row */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-2.5 text-xs">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-1">Txn ID / Reference</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={draftFilters.transaction_id}
              onChange={(e) => setDraftFilters({ ...draftFilters, transaction_id: e.target.value })}
              placeholder="TX-... or UUID"
              className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-slate-200 font-mono focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-none"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-1">RRN (F37)</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={draftFilters.rrn}
              onChange={(e) => setDraftFilters({ ...draftFilters, rrn: e.target.value })}
              placeholder="e.g. 000020526001"
              className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-slate-200 font-mono focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-none"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-1">STAN (F11)</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={draftFilters.stan}
              onChange={(e) => setDraftFilters({ ...draftFilters, stan: e.target.value })}
              placeholder="e.g. 100001"
              className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-slate-200 font-mono focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-none"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-1">PAN (Full or Last 4)</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={draftFilters.pan}
              onChange={(e) => setDraftFilters({ ...draftFilters, pan: e.target.value })}
              placeholder="456789... or 0001"
              className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-slate-200 font-mono focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-none"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-1">Status</label>
            <select
              value={draftFilters.status}
              onChange={(e) => setDraftFilters({ ...draftFilters, status: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-slate-200 focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-none"
            >
              <option value="">All Statuses</option>
              <option value="APPROVED">APPROVED</option>
              <option value="DECLINED">DECLINED</option>
              <option value="REVERSED">REVERSED</option>
              <option value="PENDING">PENDING</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-1">Response Code (F39)</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={draftFilters.response_code}
              onChange={(e) => setDraftFilters({ ...draftFilters, response_code: e.target.value })}
              placeholder="00, 05, 51, 55, 61..."
              className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-slate-200 font-mono focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-none"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Extended 20-Filter Grid */}
        {showAdvancedFilters && (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-2.5 pt-2 border-t border-slate-800/80 text-xs">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-1">MTI</label>
              <select
                value={draftFilters.mti}
                onChange={(e) => setDraftFilters({ ...draftFilters, mti: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-slate-200 font-mono"
              >
                <option value="">All MTIs</option>
                <option value="0100">0100 (Auth Req)</option>
                <option value="0200">0200 (Financial Req)</option>
                <option value="0220">0220 (Clearing Advice)</option>
                <option value="0400">0400 (Reversal Req)</option>
                <option value="0420">0420 (Reversal Advice)</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-1">Processing System</label>
              <select
                value={draftFilters.ps_code}
                onChange={(e) => setDraftFilters({ ...draftFilters, ps_code: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-slate-200"
              >
                <option value="">All Switches</option>
                <option value="ITCL">ITCL (QCash)</option>
                <option value="VISA">VISA</option>
                <option value="MASTERCARD">MASTERCARD</option>
                <option value="NPSB">NPSB</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-1">Issuer Bank</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={draftFilters.issuer}
                onChange={(e) => setDraftFilters({ ...draftFilters, issuer: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="XBANK, YBANK, ZBANK..."
                className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-slate-200"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-1">Acquirer Bank / ID</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={draftFilters.acquirer}
                onChange={(e) => setDraftFilters({ ...draftFilters, acquirer: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="XBANK or 123456"
                className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-slate-200"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-1">Transaction Type / Code</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={draftFilters.transaction_type}
                onChange={(e) => setDraftFilters({ ...draftFilters, transaction_type: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="Withdrawal, Purchase, 10..."
                className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-slate-200"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-1">Account Number</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={draftFilters.account_number}
                onChange={(e) => setDraftFilters({ ...draftFilters, account_number: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="ACCT-..."
                className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-slate-200 font-mono"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-1">Customer Name / CIF</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={draftFilters.customer}
                onChange={(e) => setDraftFilters({ ...draftFilters, customer: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="CIF or Customer Name"
                className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-slate-200"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-1">Terminal ID (F41)</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={draftFilters.terminal_id}
                onChange={(e) => setDraftFilters({ ...draftFilters, terminal_id: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="ATM00001 / POS00002"
                className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-slate-200 font-mono"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-1">Terminal Name / Owner</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={draftFilters.terminal_name}
                onChange={(e) => setDraftFilters({ ...draftFilters, terminal_name: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="Owner or Location"
                className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-slate-200"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-1">Merchant ID / Name</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={draftFilters.merchant_id}
                onChange={(e) => setDraftFilters({ ...draftFilters, merchant_id: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="Merchant ID"
                className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-slate-200 font-mono"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-1">MCC (F18)</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={draftFilters.mcc}
                onChange={(e) => setDraftFilters({ ...draftFilters, mcc: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="6011, 5411..."
                className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-slate-200 font-mono"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-1">Correlation ID</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={draftFilters.correlation_id}
                onChange={(e) => setDraftFilters({ ...draftFilters, correlation_id: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="CORR-..."
                className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-slate-200 font-mono"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-1">Currency (F49)</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={draftFilters.currency}
                onChange={(e) => setDraftFilters({ ...draftFilters, currency: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="BDT, USD..."
                className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-slate-200 font-mono"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-1">Amount From</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                step="0.01"
                value={draftFilters.amount_from}
                onChange={(e) => setDraftFilters({ ...draftFilters, amount_from: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="Min Amount"
                className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-slate-200 font-mono"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-1">Amount To</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                step="0.01"
                value={draftFilters.amount_to}
                onChange={(e) => setDraftFilters({ ...draftFilters, amount_to: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="Max Amount"
                className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-slate-200 font-mono"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-1">Date From</label>
              <input
                type="date"
                value={draftFilters.date_from}
                onChange={(e) => setDraftFilters({ ...draftFilters, date_from: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-slate-200 font-mono"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-1">Date To</label>
              <input
                type="date"
                value={draftFilters.date_to}
                onChange={(e) => setDraftFilters({ ...draftFilters, date_to: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-slate-200 font-mono"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Filter Action Buttons */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-1">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleClearFilters}
            className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 text-xs font-medium transition"
          >
            Clear Filters
          </button>
          <button
            type="submit"
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white text-xs font-semibold transition shadow"
          >
            <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            Apply Filters
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>

      {/* 2.3 MAIN TRANSACTION TABLE CONTAINER */}
      <div className="bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-lg">
        {/* Table Toolbar */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 px-4 py-3 border-b border-slate-800 bg-slate-950/50">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-300">
              Transaction Log Stream
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">
              (Double-click any row or click Investigate for full 6-tab switch forensics)
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setDraftColumns(visibleColumns);
                setShowColModal(true);
              }}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 text-xs font-medium border border-slate-700 transition"
            >
              <SlidersHorizontal className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-400" />
              Columns ({visibleColumns.length}/{ALL_COLUMNS.length})
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleExportCsv}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded bg-emerald-600/20 hover:bg-emerald-600/30 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/30 text-xs font-medium transition"
            >
              <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              Export CSV
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Table */}
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
            <thead>
              <tr className="bg-slate-950/90 border-b border-slate-800 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">
                {activeColumns.map((col) => {
                  const isSorted = col.sortable && col.sortKey === sortBy;
                  return (
                    <th
                      key={col.key}
                      onClick={() => handleSort(col)}
                      className={`py-2.5 px-3 whitespace-nowrap select-none ${
                        col.sortable ? 'cursor-pointer hover:text-white' : ''
                      } ${
                        col.align === 'right'
                          ? 'text-right'
                          : col.align === 'center'
                          ? 'text-center'
                          : 'text-left'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div
                        className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 ${
                          col.align === 'right' ? 'justify-end' : col.align === 'center' ? 'justify-center' : ''
                        }`}
                      >
                        <span>{col.label}</span>
                        {col.sortable && (
                          <span>
                            {isSorted ? (
                              sortDir === 'asc' ? (
                                <ArrowUp className="w-3 h-3 text-indigo-400" />
                              ) : (
                                <ArrowDown className="w-3 h-3 text-indigo-400" />
                              )
                            ) : (
                              <ArrowUpDown className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-600" />
                            )}
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </th>
                  );
                })}
                <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right whitespace-nowrap">Action</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-800/70 font-mono">
              {initialLoading ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={activeColumns.length + 1} className="py-12 text-center text-slate-400 font-sans">
                    <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 text-indigo-400 animate-spin mx-auto mb-2" />
                    Loading latest transactions from BAOBAB host database...
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={activeColumns.length + 1} className="py-12 text-center text-slate-400 font-sans">
                    No transaction records match the active filter criteria.
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                rows.map((row) => {
                  const isSelected = selectedTxId === row.id;
                  return (
                    <tr
                      key={row.id}
                      onDoubleClick={() => {
                        setSelectedTxId(row.id);
                        setActiveDetailTab('GENERAL');
                      }}
                      className={`transition cursor-pointer ${
                        isSelected
                          ? 'bg-indigo-950/60 hover:bg-indigo-950/80'
                          : 'hover:bg-slate-800/60'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {activeColumns.map((col) => {
                        const val = (row as any)[col.key];
                        if (col.key === 'status') {
                          return (
                            <td key={col.key} className="py-2 px-3 text-center whitespace-nowrap font-sans">
                              <StatusBadge status={row.status} />
                            </td>
                          );
                        }
                        if (col.key === 'amount') {
                          return (
                            <td key={col.key} className="py-2 px-3 text-right whitespace-nowrap font-semibold text-white">
                              {Number(row.amount || 0).toLocaleString(undefined, {
                                minimumFractionDigits: 2,
                                maximumFractionDigits: 2,
                              })}
                            </td>
                          );
                        }
                        if (col.key === 'response_code') {
                          const isOk = row.response_code === '00';
                          return (
                            <td key={col.key} className="py-2 px-3 text-center whitespace-nowrap">
                              <span
                                className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[11px] font-bold ${
                                  isOk
                                    ? 'bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-300'
                                    : 'bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-300'
                                }`}
                              >
                                {row.response_code}
                              </span>
                            </td>
                          );
                        }
                        if (col.key === 'mti') {
