#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
build_release.py — Final Validation, Syntax Checker, and Clean ZIP Release Builder
Run from project root: python scripts/build_release.py
"""

import os
import py_compile
import shutil
import sys
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

ROOT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

REQUIRED_SEVEN_MODULES = [
    "backend/app/database.py",
    "backend/app/models.py",
    "backend/app/schemas.py",
    "backend/app/api_routes.py",
    "backend/app/host_engine.py",
    "backend/app/hsm_adapter.py",
    "backend/app/iso_tic.py",
]

REQUIRED_OTHER_FILES = [
    "backend/app/main.py",
    "backend/app/config.py",
    "backend/app/security.py",
    "backend/app/logging_service.py",
    "backend/app/seed_data.py",
    "backend/requirements.txt",
    "frontend/package.json",
    "frontend/src/App.tsx",
    "frontend/src/pages/SimulatorAndJournal.tsx",
    "frontend/src/pages/HsmAndMonitorPages.tsx",
    "README.md",
]

EXCLUDE_DIRS = {".venv", "venv", "node_modules", "__pycache__", ".git", "release", "dist"}
EXCLUDE_FILES = {".env", "baobab_host.db"}


def main() -> int:
    print("=" * 72)
    print("  BAOBAB HOST SIMULATOR — RELEASE VALIDATOR & ZIP BUILDER")
    print("=" * 72)

    missing = []
    for rel in REQUIRED_SEVEN_MODULES + REQUIRED_OTHER_FILES:
        if not (ROOT_DIR / rel).exists():
            missing.append(rel)

    if missing:
        print("[ERROR] Missing required files:")
        for m in missing:
            print(f"  - {m}")
        return 1

    print("[OK] All 7 core Python modules and frontend files are present.")

    # Syntax check all Python files
    syntax_errors = []
    for py_file in (ROOT_DIR / "backend").rglob("*.py"):
        try:
            py_compile.compile(str(py_file), doraise=True)
        except py_compile.PyCompileError as exc:
            syntax_errors.append(str(exc))

    if syntax_errors:
        print("[ERROR] Python syntax errors detected:")
        for err in syntax_errors:
            print(err)
        return 1

    print("[OK] All Python backend files passed syntax verification.")

    release_dir = ROOT_DIR / "release" / "baobab-host-simulator"
    if release_dir.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(release_dir)
    release_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    copied_count = 0
    for item in ROOT_DIR.rglob("*"):
        rel = item.relative_to(ROOT_DIR)
        if any(part in EXCLUDE_DIRS for part in rel.parts):
            continue
        if item.name in EXCLUDE_FILES or item.suffix == ".zip":
            continue
        target = release_dir / rel
        if item.is_dir():
            target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        else:
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copy2(item, target)
            copied_count += 1

    zip_path = ROOT_DIR / "baobab-host-simulator-release.zip"
    with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
        for file_path in release_dir.rglob("*"):
            if file_path.is_file():
                arcname = file_path.relative_to(release_dir.parent)
                zf.write(file_path, arcname)

    print(f"[OK] Copied {copied_count} clean source files into {release_dir}")
    print(f"[OK] Created deployable ZIP archive: {zip_path}")
    print("=" * 72)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
run_local.py — Convenience launcher to start the FastAPI Backend on http://127.0.0.1:8000
Run from project root: python scripts/run_local.py
"""

import os
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
BACKEND_DIR = ROOT_DIR / "backend"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    os.chdir(BACKEND_DIR)
    print("Starting BAOBAB Private Host Simulator Backend on http://127.0.0.1:8000 ...")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""tools/fix_final_bugs.py - final bug fixes. Run from project root. Supports --dry-run."""
import datetime, shutil, sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(r"E:\HOST_VSCODE\host-simulator")
DRY = "--dry-run" in sys.argv
BACKUP = ROOT / "_backups" / ("final_fix_" + datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S"))
failed = []


def load(rel):
    p = ROOT / rel
    raw = p.read_bytes().decode("utf-8-sig")
    return p, raw.replace("\r\n", "\n"), ("\r\n" if "\r\n" in raw else "\n")


def store(rel, p, text, eol):
    if DRY:
        return
    dest = BACKUP / rel
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(p, dest)
    p.write_bytes(text.replace("\n", eol).encode("utf-8"))


def fix(rel, old, new, many=False):
    p, text, eol = load(rel)
    if old not in text:
        if new in text:
            print("[SKIP] already applied:", rel)
        else:
            print("[FAIL] anchor not found:", rel, "|", old[:60].replace("\n", " "))
            failed.append(rel)
        return
    if not many and text.count(old) != 1:
        print("[FAIL] anchor not unique:", rel)
        failed.append(rel)
        return
    store(rel, p, text.replace(old, new), eol)
    print(("[DRY] " if DRY else "[OK]  ") + rel)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
install_transaction_log_viewer_v1.py
Part 1 of 3 — Database Schema Extensions, TIC v2.164e Decoder Engine Integration,
Host Engine Trace & Metadata Capture, and Non-Destructive Historical Backfill.
"""

import argparse
import os
import py_compile
import shutil
import sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path


def detect_project_root(explicit_root: str | None = None) -> Path:
    if explicit_root:
        root = Path(explicit_root).resolve()
    else:
        root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
        if not (root / "backend").exists() and (root.parent / "backend").exists():
            root = root.parent
    required = [
        root / "backend" / "app" / "models.py",
        root / "backend" / "app" / "host_engine.py",
        root / "backend" / "app" / "main.py",
        root / "frontend" / "src",
    ]
    for req in required:
        if not req.exists():
            raise RuntimeError(f"Project structure check failed: missing {req}")
    return root


class SafeInstaller:
    def __init__(self, root: Path, dry_run: bool = False):
        self.root = root
        self.dry_run = dry_run
        ts = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
        self.backup_dir = root / "_backups" / f"tx_log_viewer_v1_{ts}"
        self.modified_files: list[str] = []
        self.created_files: list[str] = []

    def backup_file(self, path: Path) -> None:
        if not path.exists() or self.dry_run:
            return
        rel = path.relative_to(self.root)
        dest = self.backup_dir / rel
        dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(path, dest)

    def write_file(self, rel_path: str, content: str) -> None:
        target = self.root / rel_path
        existed = target.exists()
        if existed:
            old = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            if old == content:
                print(f"  [=] Unchanged: {rel_path}")
                return
            self.backup_file(target)
        if not self.dry_run:
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
        if existed:
            self.modified_files.append(rel_path)
            print(f"  [M] Updated:   {rel_path}")
        else:
            self.created_files.append(rel_path)
            print(f"  [+] Created:   {rel_path}")

    def patch_file(self, rel_path: str, marker: str, anchor: str, replacement: str) -> None:
        target = self.root / rel_path
        if not target.exists():
            raise RuntimeError(f"Target file not found: {rel_path}")
        text = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        if marker in text:
            print(f"  [=] Patch already applied ({marker}): {rel_path}")
            return
        if anchor not in text:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Expected anchor not found in {rel_path} for marker {marker}")
        new_text = text.replace(anchor, replacement, 1)
        self.backup_file(target)
        if not self.dry_run:
            target.write_text(new_text, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
        self.modified_files.append(rel_path)
        print(f"  [P] Patched ({marker}): {rel_path}")

    def validate_python_files(self, rel_paths: list[str]) -> None:
        if self.dry_run:
            return
        for rel in rel_paths:
            p = self.root / rel
            if p.exists() and p.suffix == ".py":
                py_compile.compile(str(p), doraise=True)
                print(f"  [OK] Syntax verified: {rel}")

SEP = chr(221)   # Ý
SSEP = chr(179)  # ³


def _unescape(s: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"\\x([0-9a-fA-F]{2})", lambda m: chr(int(m.group(1), 16)), s)


def _decode_bitmap(hex_str: str) -> Tuple[List[int], str]:
    bits = bin(int(hex_str, 16))[2:].zfill(len(hex_str) * 4)
    return [i + 1 for i, b in enumerate(bits) if b == "1"], bits


def _read_bitmap(msg: str, pos: int) -> Tuple[List[int], str, Optional[str], str, int]:
    ph = msg[pos : pos + 16]
    pos += 16
    if bin(int(ph, 16))[2:].zfill(64)[0] == "1":
        sh = msg[pos : pos + 16]
        pos += 16
        fh = ph + sh
    else:
        sh = None
        fh = ph
    fields, bits = _decode_bitmap(fh)
    # Field 1 is secondary bitmap indicator, never returned as a regular data field
    fields = [f for f in fields if f != 1]
    return fields, ph, sh, bits, pos


def _read_field(msg: str, pos: int, fnum: int) -> Tuple[str, int]:
    if fnum not in FIELD_DEFS:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported TIC field number: F{fnum}")
    _, _, lt, fl = FIELD_DEFS[fnum]
    if lt == "FIXED":
        if pos + fl > len(msg):
            raise ValueError(f"Field F{fnum} truncated (expected {fl} chars, got {len(msg) - pos})")
        return msg[pos : pos + fl], pos + fl
    if lt == "LVAR":
        l = int(msg[pos : pos + 1]); pos += 1; return msg[pos : pos + l], pos + l
    if lt == "LLVAR":
        l = int(msg[pos : pos + 2]); pos += 2; return msg[pos : pos + l], pos + l
    if lt == "LLLVAR":
        l = int(msg[pos : pos + 3]); pos += 3; return msg[pos : pos + l], pos + l
    if lt == "LLLLLVAR":
        l = int(msg[pos : pos + 5]); pos += 5; return msg[pos : pos + l], pos + l
    if lt == "PLLLLLVAR":
        l = int(msg[pos + 1 : pos + 5]) if msg[pos : pos + 1] == "0" else int(msg[pos : pos + 5])
        pos += 5
        return msg[pos : pos + l], pos + l
    raise ValueError(f"Unhandled length type {lt}")


def _pf3(v: str):
    tc = v[0:3]; fa = v[3:5]; ta = v[5:7]
    detail = {
        "F3.1 Transaction Code":  f"{tc} — {TRAN_CODES.get(tc, 'Configurable / Custom')}",
        "F3.2 From Account Type": f"{fa} — {ACCT_TYPES.get(fa, 'Unknown')}",
        "F3.3 To Account Type":   f"{ta} — {ACCT_TYPES.get(ta, 'Unknown')}",
    }
    return detail, {"F3.1": tc, "F3.2": fa, "F3.3": ta}


def _pf22(v: str):
    ce = v[0:2]; pc = v[2:3] if len(v) >= 3 else "?"
    detail = {
        "F22.1 Card Entry Mode": f"{ce} — {POS_ENTRY_MODES.get(ce, 'Unknown')}",
        "F22.2 PIN Capability":  f"{pc} — {PIN_CAP.get(pc, 'Unknown')}",
    }
    return detail, {"F22": v}


def _pf25(v: str):
    code = v.strip().lstrip("0") or "0"
    return {"F25.1 POS Condition": f"{v} — {POS_CONDITION_CODES.get(code, 'Unknown')}"}, {"F25": v}

def _pf39(v: str):
    if len(v) == 5:
        retain = v[2]; rc = v[3:5]
        detail = {
            "F39.1 Retain Card Indicator": f"{retain} — {RETAIN_CARD.get(retain, 'Unknown')}",
            "F39.2 Response Code":         f"{rc} — {RESPONSE_CODES.get(rc, 'Unknown')}",
        }
        return detail, {"F39": v}
    rc = v.strip()[:2]
    return {"F39 Response Code": f"{rc} — {RESPONSE_CODES.get(rc, 'Unknown')}"}, {"F39": v}


def _pf43(v: str):
    subs = [
        ("F43.1", 30), ("F43.2", 30), ("F43.3", 3), ("F43.4", 3), ("F43.5", 30),
        ("F43.6", 30), ("F43.7", 30), ("F43.8", 3), ("F43.9", 8), ("F43.10", 10),
        ("F43.11", 4), ("F43.12", 25), ("F43.13", 3), ("F43.14", 9), ("F43.15", 4),
    ]
    labels = [
        "Terminal Owner", "Terminal City", "Terminal State", "Terminal Country",
        "Terminal Address", "Terminal Branch", "Terminal Region", "Terminal Class",
        "Terminal Date", "Terminal PS Name", "Terminal FI Name",
        "Terminal Retailer Name", "Terminal County", "Terminal ZIP Code",
        "Terminal Time Offset",
    ]
    detail = {}; compact = {}; ptr = 0
    for (key, w), label in zip(subs, labels):
        chunk = v[ptr : ptr + w]
        stripped = chunk.strip()
        if key == "F43.8" and stripped:
            detail[f"{key} {label}"] = f"{stripped} — {TERM_CLASS.get(stripped.zfill(3), 'Unknown')}"
        elif stripped:
            detail[f"{key} {label}"] = stripped
        compact[key] = chunk
        ptr += w
    if not detail:
        detail["Terminal Name/Location"] = v.strip()
    return detail, compact

def _parse_uamp(raw: str) -> Dict[str, str]:
    text = raw.replace(chr(13), "")
    parts = text.split(chr(16))
    result: Dict[str, str] = {}
    for p in parts:
        p = p.strip(chr(19)).strip()
        if "=" in p:
            k, v = p.split("=", 1)
            k_clean = k.strip()
            v_clean = v.strip()
            if k_clean in ("NP", "RPK"):
                v_clean = "***MASKED_SECRET***"
            elif k_clean in ("P2", "ExtPAN") and v_clean:
                v_clean = mask_pan(v_clean)
            result[k_clean] = v_clean
        elif p:
            result[p] = ""
    return result


def _apply_names(d: Dict[str, str], nm: Dict[str, str]) -> Dict[str, str]:
    return {f"{k} ({nm[k]})" if k in nm else k: v for k, v in d.items()}


def _uamp_compact(raw: str) -> str:
    d = _parse_uamp(raw)
    return "".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in d.items())


def _build_compact(mti: str, header: Dict[str, str], fields_compact: List[Tuple[int, str, Any]]) -> str:
    short_mti = mti[1:] if len(mti) == 4 else mti
    parts = [f"{short_mti}:", f"H1){header['H1']}{SEP}H2){header['H2']}{SEP}H3){header['H3']}{SEP}"]
    for fnum, raw, compact in fields_compact:
        if isinstance(compact, dict) and len(compact) > 1:
            sub_parts = [f"{k}){v}" for k, v in compact.items()]
            parts.append(SSEP.join(sub_parts) + SSEP + SEP)
        elif isinstance(compact, dict) and len(compact) == 1:
            k, v = next(iter(compact.items()))
            parts.append(f"{k}){v}{SEP}")
        else:
            parts.append(f"F{fnum}){raw}{SEP}")
    return "".join(parts)


def mask_sensitive_wire_string(raw_msg: str) -> str:
    """Mask PAN and PIN blocks in raw TIC or ISO wire strings before returning to UI."""
    if not raw_msg:
        return ""
    out = re.sub(
        r"(A4M\d{5}\d{4}[0-9A-Fa-f]{16,32})(\d{2})(\d{12,19})",
        lambda m: f"{m.group(1)}{m.group(2)}{mask_pan(m.group(3))}",
        raw_msg,
    )
    out = re.sub(
        r"(F2\))(\d{12,19})",
        lambda m: f"{m.group(1)}{mask_pan(m.group(2))}",
        out,
    )
    out = re.sub(r"(F52\))[0-9A-Fa-f]{16}", r"\1****************", out)
    out = re.sub(r"(F35\))[^Ý]+", r"\1***MASKED_TRACK2***", out)
    out = re.sub(r"(F45\))[^Ý]+", r"\1***MASKED_TRACK1***", out)
    return out


def decode_full_tic_or_iso_message(raw_msg: str, allow_full_pan: bool = False) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Master decoder entry point reusing `tic_decoder.py` logic for TIC/TCI v2.164e
    and falling back to `iso_standard_codec.py` if an ISO 8583:1987 message is supplied.
    Always returns ascending numeric field order, flat rows for UI tables, subfields,
    warnings, errors, and masked sensitive fields.
    """
    if not raw_msg or not raw_msg.strip():
        return {
            "valid": False,
            "format": "EMPTY",
            "header": {},
            "mti": "",
            "mti_description": "",
            "primary_bitmap": "",
            "secondary_bitmap": None,
            "fields_present": [],
            "parsed_fields": [],
            "flat_rows": [],
            "warnings": [],
            "parse_errors": {"message": "Empty message content"},
            "compact_tic": "",
            "sanitized_raw": "",
        }

    msg = _unescape(raw_msg.replace("\n", "").replace("\r", "").strip())
    a4m_idx = msg.find("A4M")

    # Standard ISO 8583:1987 fallback if not TIC
    if a4m_idx == -1:
        iso_res = decode_iso8583_1987(msg)
        if not iso_res.get("valid"):
            return {
                "valid": False,
                "format": "UNKNOWN",
                "header": {},
                "mti": iso_res.get("mti", ""),
                "mti_description": "Unknown / Invalid Format",
                "primary_bitmap": "",
                "secondary_bitmap": None,
                "fields_present": [],
                "parsed_fields": [],
                "flat_rows": [],
                "warnings": iso_res.get("warnings", []),
                "parse_errors": {"format": iso_res.get("error", "Missing A4M header")},
                "compact_tic": "",
                "sanitized_raw": mask_sensitive_wire_string(msg),
            }
        bmap = iso_res.get("bitmap", {})
        raw_f = iso_res.get("raw_fields", {})
        parsed_fields = []
        flat_rows = []
        for fnum in sorted(int(k) for k in raw_f.keys() if str(k).isdigit()):
            if fnum == 1:
                continue
            val = raw_f[str(fnum)]
            fname, dtype, ltype, flen = ISO8583_FIELDS.get(fnum, ("Unknown", "ANS", "LLVAR", None))
            if fnum == 2:
                safe_val = val if allow_full_pan else mask_pan(val)
            elif fnum in (35, 45, 52, 53, 63):
                safe_val = f"***MASKED_F{fnum}***"
            else:
                safe_val = val
            parsed_fields.append({
                "field_number": fnum,
                "field_tag": f"F{fnum}",
                "field_name": fname,
                "data_type": dtype,
                "length_type": ltype,
                "raw_value": safe_val,
                "display_value": safe_val,
                "subfields": [{"key": "value", "value": safe_val}],
            })
            flat_rows.append({
                "field_number": fnum,
                "field_tag": f"F{fnum}",
                "field_name": fname,
                "subfield_key": fname,
                "value": safe_val,
            })
        mti_val = iso_res["mti"]
        return {
            "valid": True,
            "format": "ISO8583_1987",
            "header": {"Protocol": "ISO 8583:1987"},
            "mti": mti_val,
            "mti_description": MTI_NAMES.get(mti_val, "ISO 8583 Message"),
            "primary_bitmap": bmap.get("primary_hex", ""),
            "secondary_bitmap": bmap.get("secondary_hex"),
            "fields_present": sorted(f for f in bmap.get("fields_present", []) if f != 1),
            "parsed_fields": parsed_fields,
            "flat_rows": flat_rows,
            "warnings": iso_res.get("warnings", []),
            "parse_errors": {},
            "compact_tic": "",
            "sanitized_raw": mask_sensitive_wire_string(msg),
        }

    if a4m_idx > 0:
        msg = msg[a4m_idx:]

    if len(msg) < 28:
        return {
            "valid": False,
            "format": "TIC_V2164E",
            "header": {},
            "mti": "",
            "mti_description": "",
            "primary_bitmap": "",
            "secondary_bitmap": None,
            "fields_present": [],
            "parsed_fields": [],
            "flat_rows": [],
            "warnings": [],
            "parse_errors": {"header": "TIC/TCI message is too short (< 28 chars)"},
            "compact_tic": "",
            "sanitized_raw": mask_sensitive_wire_string(msg),
        }

    h1, h2, h3 = msg[0:3], msg[3:5], msg[5:8]
    header_info = {
        "H1 Start Indicator": h1,
        "H2 Protocol Version": h2,
        "H3 Reject Status": h3,
    }
    header_for_compact = {"H1": h1, "H2": h2, "H3": h3}
    warnings: List[str] = []

    if h1 != "A4M":
        warnings.append(f"Unexpected start indicator: '{h1}' (expected 'A4M')")
    if h3 != "000":
        rmap = {"001": "Not a TIC/TCI message", "197": "Invalid MAC"}
        warnings.append(f"Reject H3={h3}: {rmap.get(h3, 'Bad field #' + h3)}")

    pos = 8
    mti = msg[pos : pos + 4]
    pos += 4
    if mti.startswith("9"):
        orig = "0" + mti[1:]
        mti_name = f"REJECT of {MTI_NAMES.get(orig, 'Unknown')} ({orig})"
        warnings.append(f"Reject message (MTI={mti})")
    else:
        mti_name = MTI_NAMES.get(mti, "Unknown MTI")

    try:
        present, ph, sh, _, pos = _read_bitmap(msg, pos)
    except Exception as exc:
        return {
            "valid": False,
            "format": "TIC_V2164E",
            "header": header_info,
            "mti": mti,
            "mti_description": mti_name,
            "primary_bitmap": "",
            "secondary_bitmap": None,
            "fields_present": [],
            "parsed_fields": [],
            "flat_rows": [],
            "warnings": warnings,
            "parse_errors": {"bitmap": str(exc)},
            "compact_tic": "",
            "sanitized_raw": mask_sensitive_wire_string(msg),
        }

    parsed_fields: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    flat_rows: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    parse_errors: Dict[str, str] = {}
    compact_fields: List[Tuple[int, str, Any]] = []

    # Strictly ascending numeric order, never treating Field 1 as a data field
    for fnum in sorted(f for f in present if f != 1):
        try:
            raw_val, pos = _read_field(msg, pos, fnum)
            fname, dtype, ltype, _ = FIELD_DEFS.get(fnum, ("Unknown", "ANS", "LLVAR", None))

            detail: Dict[str, Any] = {}
            compact: Any = None
            safe_raw = raw_val

            if fnum == 2:
                safe_raw = raw_val if allow_full_pan else mask_pan(raw_val)
                detail = {
                    "PAN": safe_raw,
                    "BIN (First 6)": raw_val[:6] if len(raw_val) >= 6 else raw_val,
                    "Length": str(len(raw_val)),
                }
                compact = {"F2": safe_raw}
            elif fnum == 3:
                if len(raw_val) >= 7:
                    detail, compact = _pf3(raw_val)
                else:
                    detail = {"Processing Code": raw_val}
                    compact = {"F3": raw_val}
            elif fnum in (4, 5, 6, 54):
                amt_fmt = f"{int(raw_val)/100:,.2f}" if raw_val.isdigit() else raw_val
                detail = {"Raw Minor Units": raw_val, "Formatted Amount": amt_fmt}
                compact = {f"F{fnum}": raw_val}
            elif fnum == 22:
                detail, compact = _pf22(raw_val)
            elif fnum == 25:
                detail, compact = _pf25(raw_val)
            elif fnum == 28:
                detail, compact = _pf28(raw_val)
            elif fnum in (35, 45):
                safe_raw = f"***MASKED_TRACK_{'2' if fnum == 35 else '1'}_DATA***"
                detail = {"Track Data": safe_raw}
                compact = {f"F{fnum}": safe_raw}
            elif fnum == 39:
                detail, compact = _pf39(raw_val)
            elif fnum == 43:
                detail, compact = _pf43(raw_val)
            elif fnum == 44:
                detail, compact = _pf44(raw_val)
            elif fnum == 48:
                detail, compact = _pf48(raw_val)
            elif fnum in (52, 53, 63):
                safe_raw = f"***MASKED_{fname.upper().replace(' ', '_')}***"
                detail = {fname: safe_raw}
                compact = {f"F{fnum}": "****************"}
            elif fnum == 61:
                detail, compact = _pf61(raw_val)
            elif fnum == 70:
                code = raw_val.strip().lstrip("0") or "0"
                detail = {"F70 Network Mgmt Code": f"{raw_val.strip()} — {NETWORK_MGMT_CODES.get(code, 'Unknown')}"}
                compact = {"F70": raw_val.strip()}
            elif fnum == 95:
                detail, compact = _pf95(raw_val)
            elif fnum == 104:
                net = raw_val.strip()
                detail = {"Host Network ID": f"{net} — {HOST_NET_IDS.get(net, 'Other')}"}
                compact = {"F104": net}
            elif fnum == 105:
                detail, compact = _pf105(raw_val)
            elif fnum == 106:
                detail, compact = _pf106(raw_val)
            elif fnum == 121:
                safe_raw = raw_val[:3] + "***" + raw_val[6:] if len(raw_val) >= 6 else "***"
                detail, compact = _pf121(raw_val)
            elif fnum == 122:
                safe_raw = "***" + raw_val[3:]
                detail, compact = _pf122(raw_val)
            elif fnum == 123:
                uamp = _parse_uamp(raw_val)
                detail = _apply_names(uamp, UAMP_F123_NAMES)
                compact = {"F123": _uamp_compact(raw_val)}
            elif fnum == 124:
                uamp = _parse_uamp(raw_val)
                detail = _apply_names(uamp, UAMP_F124_NAMES)
                compact = {"F124": _uamp_compact(raw_val)}
            elif fnum == 125:
                uamp = _parse_uamp(raw_val)
                detail = _apply_names(uamp, UAMP_F125_NAMES)
                compact = {"F125": _uamp_compact(raw_val)}
            elif fnum == 126:
                detail, compact = _pf126(raw_val)
            else:
                detail = {fname: raw_val.strip()}
                compact = {f"F{fnum}": raw_val}

            sub_list = [{"key": k, "value": str(v)} for k, v in detail.items() if v is not None and str(v) != ""]
            if not sub_list:
                sub_list = [{"key": fname, "value": safe_raw.strip()}]

            summary_val = (
                " | ".join(f"{s['key']}: {s['value']}" for s in sub_list)
                if len(sub_list) > 1
                else sub_list[0]["value"]
            )

            parsed_fields.append({
                "field_number": fnum,
                "field_tag": f"F{fnum}",
                "field_name": fname,
                "data_type": dtype,
                "length_type": ltype,
                "raw_value": safe_raw,
                "display_value": summary_val,
                "subfields": sub_list,
            })

            for idx, s in enumerate(sub_list):
                flat_rows.append({
                    "field_number": fnum,
                    "field_tag": f"F{fnum}" if idx == 0 else "",
                    "field_name": fname if idx == 0 else "",
                    "subfield_key": s["key"],
                    "value": s["value"],
                })

            compact_fields.append((fnum, safe_raw, compact))
        except Exception as exc:
            parse_errors[f"F{fnum}"] = str(exc)
            warnings.append(f"Error reading F{fnum}: {exc}")
            break

    remaining = msg[pos:]
    if remaining:
        warnings.append(f"{len(remaining)} unparsed trailing character(s)")

    compact_line = _build_compact(mti, header_for_compact, compact_fields)
    return {
        "valid": len(parse_errors) == 0,
        "format": "TIC_V2164E",
        "header": header_info,
        "mti": mti,
        "mti_description": mti_name,
        "primary_bitmap": ph,
        "secondary_bitmap": sh if sh else None,
        "fields_present": sorted(f for f in present if f != 1),
        "parsed_fields": parsed_fields,
        "flat_rows": flat_rows,
        "warnings": warnings,
        "parse_errors": parse_errors,
        "compact_tic": compact_line,
        "sanitized_raw": mask_sensitive_wire_string(msg),
    }


def extract_metadata_from_tic(raw_msg: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Extracts structured transaction columns from a raw TIC message for DB persistence & backfill."""
    dec = decode_full_tic_or_iso_message(raw_msg, allow_full_pan=False)
    fmap = {f["field_number"]: f for f in dec.get("parsed_fields", [])}

    def _raw(fnum: int) -> Optional[str]:
        return fmap[fnum]["raw_value"].strip() if fnum in fmap and fmap[fnum].get("raw_value") else None

    f43_subs = {s["key"]: s["value"] for s in fmap.get(43, {}).get("subfields", [])}
    term_owner = next((v for k, v in f43_subs.items() if "F43.1 " in k), None)
    term_city = next((v for k, v in f43_subs.items() if "F43.2 " in k), None)
    term_addr = next((v for k, v in f43_subs.items() if "F43.5 " in k), None)
    merch_name = next((v for k, v in f43_subs.items() if "F43.12" in k), None) or term_owner

    f3_raw = _raw(3) or ""
    tc_prefix = f3_raw[:3] if len(f3_raw) >= 3 else ""
    tx_type_name = TRAN_CODES.get(tc_prefix)

    return {
        "mcc": _raw(18),
        "pos_entry_mode": _raw(22),
        "pos_condition_code": _raw(25),
        "acquirer_id": _raw(32),
        "forwarding_id": _raw(33),
        "approval_code": _raw(38),
        "terminal_id": _raw(41),
        "terminal_owner": term_owner,
        "terminal_name": term_addr or term_city or _raw(41),
        "merchant_name": merch_name,
        "source_account": _raw(102),
        "destination_account": _raw(103),
        "transaction_type_name": tx_type_name,
    }


def compare_request_and_response(req_raw: Optional[str], resp_raw: Optional[str]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Builds a side-by-side comparison of Request vs Response ISO/TIC fields in ascending numeric order."""
    req_dec = decode_full_tic_or_iso_message(req_raw or "") if req_raw else {"parsed_fields": []}
    resp_dec = decode_full_tic_or_iso_message(resp_raw or "") if resp_raw else {"parsed_fields": []}

    req_map = {f["field_number"]: f for f in req_dec.get("parsed_fields", [])}
    resp_map = {f["field_number"]: f for f in resp_dec.get("parsed_fields", [])}

    all_fnums = sorted(set(req_map.keys()) | set(resp_map.keys()))
    comparison: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    for fnum in all_fnums:
        if fnum == 1:
            continue
        rf = req_map.get(fnum)
        spf = resp_map.get(fnum)
        fname = (rf or spf or {}).get("field_name") or FIELD_DEFS.get(fnum, ("Unknown",))[0]
        req_val = rf["display_value"] if rf else None
        resp_val = spf["display_value"] if spf else None
        comparison.append({
            "field_number": fnum,
            "field_tag": f"F{fnum}",
            "field_name": fname,
            "in_request": rf is not None,
            "in_response": spf is not None,
            "request_value": req_val,
            "response_value": resp_val,
            "differs": (req_val or "") != (resp_val or ""),
        })
    return comparison


def export_decoded_message_excel_bytes(decoded: Dict[str, Any], rrn: str = "TX") -> Optional[bytes]:
    """Generates an in-memory `.xlsx` report using the styling from `tic_decoder.py`."""
    if not HAS_OPENPYXL:
        return None
    wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
    ts = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC")

    C_NAVY = "1B2A4A"
    C_TEAL = "0D6E6E"
    C_STEEL = "2E5F8A"
    C_ICE = "E8F4FD"
    C_LTGRAY = "F5F5F5"
    C_GOLD = "D4AF37"
    C_BORDER = "B0BEC5"

    def _fill(c): return PatternFill("solid", fgColor=c)
    def _font(b=False, c="000000", s=10, it=False): return Font(bold=b, color=c, size=s, italic=it, name="Calibri")
    def _border(st="thin", c=C_BORDER):
        sd = Side(style=st, color=c)
        return Border(left=sd, right=sd, top=sd, bottom=sd)
    def _align(h="left", v="center", w=False): return Alignment(horizontal=h, vertical=v, wrap_text=w)

    ws1 = wb.active
    ws1.title = "Summary"
    ws1.column_dimensions["A"].width = 28
    ws1.column_dimensions["B"].width = 65

    c = ws1.cell(row=1, column=1, value="TIC / TCI ISO 8583 · Decoded Message Report")
    c.fill = _fill(C_NAVY); c.font = _font(True, "FFFFFF", 13); c.alignment = _align("center")
    ws1.merge_cells("A1:B1")

    c2 = ws1.cell(row=2, column=1, value=f"Reference (RRN): {rrn} | Generated: {ts}")
    c2.fill = _fill(C_NAVY); c2.font = _font(False, "D0D0D0", 10, True); c2.alignment = _align("center")
    ws1.merge_cells("A2:B2")

    overview = [
        ("Format", decoded.get("format", "TIC_V2164E")),
        ("MTI", f"{decoded.get('mti', '')} — {decoded.get('mti_description', '')}"),
        ("Primary Bitmap", decoded.get("primary_bitmap", "")),
        ("Secondary Bitmap", decoded.get("secondary_bitmap") or "— not present"),
        ("Fields Present", str(decoded.get("fields_present", []))),
    ]
    for k, v in (decoded.get("header") or {}).items():
        overview.append((k, str(v)))

    r = 4
    for idx, (k, v) in enumerate(overview):
        bg = C_ICE if idx % 2 == 0 else C_LTGRAY
        ca = ws1.cell(row=r, column=1, value=k)
        cb = ws1.cell(row=r, column=2, value=v)
        ca.fill = _fill(bg); ca.font = _font(True); ca.border = _border()
        cb.fill = _fill(bg); cb.font = _font(False); cb.border = _border()
        r += 1

    r += 1
    ct = ws1.cell(row=r, column=1, value="COMPACT TIC-FORMAT OUTPUT")
    ct.fill = _fill(C_TEAL); ct.font = _font(True, "FFFFFF", 11)
    ws1.merge_cells(start_row=r, start_column=1, end_row=r, end_column=2)
    r += 1
    cc = ws1.cell(row=r, column=1, value=decoded.get("compact_tic", ""))
    cc.fill = _fill("FFF8E1"); cc.font = _font(False, "5D4037", 9, True)
    cc.alignment = _align("left", "center", True); cc.border = _border("medium", C_GOLD)
    ws1.merge_cells(start_row=r, start_column=1, end_row=r, end_column=2)

    ws2 = wb.create_sheet("Fields Detail")
    ws2.column_dimensions["A"].width = 10
    ws2.column_dimensions["B"].width = 34
    ws2.column_dimensions["C"].width = 38
    ws2.column_dimensions["D"].width = 55

    headers = ["Field", "Field Name", "Subfield / Key", "Value"]
    for ci, h in enumerate(headers, 1):
        hc = ws2.cell(row=1, column=ci, value=h)
        hc.fill = _fill(C_STEEL); hc.font = _font(True, "FFFFFF", 10); hc.alignment = _align("center")

    for idx, row_item in enumerate(decoded.get("flat_rows", []), start=2):
        bg = C_ICE if idx % 2 == 0 else C_LTGRAY
        ws2.cell(row=idx, column=1, value=row_item["field_tag"]).fill = _fill(bg)
        ws2.cell(row=idx, column=2, value=row_item["field_name"]).fill = _fill(bg)
        ws2.cell(row=idx, column=3, value=row_item["subfield_key"]).fill = _fill(bg)
        ws2.cell(row=idx, column=4, value=row_item["value"]).fill = _fill(bg)

    buf = io.BytesIO()
    wb.save(buf)
    return buf.getvalue()
'''

    he_tx_replacement = '''            completed_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
        )

        tic_meta = extract_metadata_from_tic(raw_request_msg)
        f3_code = (fields.get("3", "0100000") or "0100000")[:3]

        tx.source_account = account.account_number if account else (fields.get("102") or tic_meta.get("source_account"))
        tx.destination_account = fields.get("103") or tic_meta.get("destination_account")
        tx.transaction_type_name = TRAN_CODES.get(f3_code) or ("Acquirer Reversal" if mti.startswith("04") else f"Tran Code {tx_code or f3_code}")
        tx.processing_duration_ms = max(1, int((time.perf_counter() - getattr(self, "pipeline_t0", time.perf_counter())) * 1000))
        failed_chk = next((c for c in self.checks_log if c["check_status"] == "FAILED"), None)
        tx.decline_reason = failed_chk["message"] if (not approved and failed_chk) else (None if approved else resp_desc)

        self.db.add(tx)
        self.db.flush()

        # Persist structured TransactionTraceEvent records for actual executed stages
        trace_order = 1
        self.db.add(TransactionTraceEvent(
            transaction_id=tx.id,
            correlation_id=tx.correlation_id,
            event_order=trace_order,
            event_code="TRANSACTION_RECEIVED",
            event_category="INGRESS",
            event_name="TRANSACTION RECEIVED",
            event_status="PASSED",
            response_code="00",
            duration_ms=1,
            message=f"Incoming {mti} transaction {tx_ref} received via {source_channel} (STAN {tx.stan}, RRN {tx.rrn}).",
        ))
        for chk in self.checks_log:
            trace_order += 1
            cname_up = chk["check_name"].upper()
            cat = "VALIDATION"
            if "MESSAGE" in cname_up:
                cat = "PARSING"
            elif "ROUTING" in cname_up or "NETWORK" in cname_up:
                cat = "ROUTING"
            elif "HSM" in cname_up or "PIN" in cname_up or "CVV" in cname_up or "EMV" in cname_up or "MAC" in cname_up:
                cat = "HSM_CRYPTO"
            elif "LIMIT" in cname_up:
                cat = "LIMITS"
            elif "RULE" in cname_up:
                cat = "RISK_RULE"
            elif "BALANCE" in cname_up or "DECISION" in cname_up:
                cat = "AUTHORIZATION"
            elif "LEDGER" in cname_up:
                cat = "LEDGER"
            self.db.add(TransactionTraceEvent(
                transaction_id=tx.id,
                correlation_id=tx.correlation_id,
                event_order=trace_order,
                event_code=cname_up.replace(" ", "_")[:50],
                event_category=cat,
                event_name=chk["check_name"].upper(),
                event_status=chk["check_status"],
                response_code=chk["response_code"],
                duration_ms=chk["duration_ms"],
                message=chk["message"],
            ))
        trace_order += 1
        self.db.add(TransactionTraceEvent(
            transaction_id=tx.id,
            correlation_id=tx.correlation_id,
            event_order=trace_order,
            event_code="RESPONSE_GENERATION",
            event_category="EGRESS",
            event_name="RESPONSE GENERATION",
            event_status="PASSED",
            response_code=response_code,
            duration_ms=1,
            message=f"ISO 8583 / TIC {resp_mti} response generated (F39=000{response_code}, Approval={tx.approval_code}).",
        ))
        trace_order += 1
        self.db.add(TransactionTraceEvent(
            transaction_id=tx.id,
            correlation_id=tx.correlation_id,
            event_order=trace_order,
            event_code="TRANSACTION_COMPLETED",
            event_category="COMPLETION",
            event_name="TRANSACTION COMPLETED",
            event_status=tx.authorization_status,
            response_code=response_code,
            duration_ms=tx.processing_duration_ms,
            message=f"Final response delivered ({tx.authorization_status} — RC {response_code}: {resp_desc}).",
        ))
'''
    installer.patch_file(
        "backend/app/host_engine.py",
        "[PATCH tx_log_viewer_v1:populate_tx_metadata_and_trace]",
        he_tx_anchor,
        he_tx_replacement,
    )

    installer.validate_python_files([
        "backend/app/tic_decoder_engine.py",
        "backend/app/models.py",
        "backend/app/host_engine.py",
    ])


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Install Transaction Log Viewer Part 1 (Models, TIC Decoder, Trace Capture)")
    parser.add_argument("--project-root", default=None, help="Explicit path to project root")
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="Validate without modifying files")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    root = detect_project_root(args.project_root)
    print(f"=== BAOBAB Transaction Log Viewer Installer v1 ===\nProject Root: {root}\nDry Run: {args.dry_run}")
    installer = SafeInstaller(root, dry_run=args.dry_run)
    apply_v1(installer)

    # Run schema sync on existing DB if not dry_run
    if not args.dry_run:
        sys.path.insert(0, str(root / "backend"))
        from app.database import init_db
        init_db()
        print("  [OK] Database additive columns & TransactionTraceEvent table synchronized.")

    print("\n--- Summary (Installer v1) ---")
    print(f"Created files  ({len(installer.created_files)}): {installer.created_files}")
    print(f"Modified files ({len(installer.modified_files)}): {installer.modified_files}")
    if not args.dry_run and installer.modified_files:
        print(f"Backups stored in: {installer.backup_dir}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
install_transaction_log_viewer_v2.py
Part 2 of 3 — FastAPI Transaction Log Viewer Router, Server-Side Filtering/Sorting/Pagination,
Summary Statistics, Lazy-Loaded Investigation Endpoints, Trace Export, and Pytest Suite.
"""

import argparse
import py_compile
import shutil
import sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path


def detect_project_root(explicit_root: str | None = None) -> Path:
    if explicit_root:
        root = Path(explicit_root).resolve()
    else:
        root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
        if not (root / "backend").exists() and (root.parent / "backend").exists():
            root = root.parent
    if not (root / "backend" / "app" / "tic_decoder_engine.py").exists():
        raise RuntimeError("Please run install_transaction_log_viewer_v1.py first.")
    return root


class SafeInstaller:
    def __init__(self, root: Path, dry_run: bool = False):
        self.root = root
        self.dry_run = dry_run
        ts = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
        self.backup_dir = root / "_backups" / f"tx_log_viewer_v2_{ts}"
        self.modified_files: list[str] = []
        self.created_files: list[str] = []

    def backup_file(self, path: Path) -> None:
        if not path.exists() or self.dry_run:
            return
        rel = path.relative_to(self.root)
        dest = self.backup_dir / rel
        dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(path, dest)

    def write_file(self, rel_path: str, content: str) -> None:
        target = self.root / rel_path
        existed = target.exists()
        if existed:
            old = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            if old == content:
                print(f"  [=] Unchanged: {rel_path}")
                return
            self.backup_file(target)
        if not self.dry_run:
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
        if existed:
            self.modified_files.append(rel_path)
            print(f"  [M] Updated:   {rel_path}")
        else:
            self.created_files.append(rel_path)
            print(f"  [+] Created:   {rel_path}")

    def patch_file(self, rel_path: str, marker: str, anchor: str, replacement: str) -> None:
        target = self.root / rel_path
        if not target.exists():
            raise RuntimeError(f"Target file not found: {rel_path}")
        text = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        if marker in text:
            print(f"  [=] Patch already applied ({marker}): {rel_path}")
            return
        if anchor not in text:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Expected anchor not found in {rel_path} for marker {marker}")
        new_text = text.replace(anchor, replacement, 1)
        self.backup_file(target)
        if not self.dry_run:
            target.write_text(new_text, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
        self.modified_files.append(rel_path)
        print(f"  [P] Patched ({marker}): {rel_path}")

    def validate_python_files(self, rel_paths: list[str]) -> None:
        if self.dry_run:
            return
        for rel in rel_paths:
            p = self.root / rel
            if p.exists() and p.suffix == ".py":
                py_compile.compile(str(p), doraise=True)
                print(f"  [OK] Syntax verified: {rel}")

def _short_inst_code(inst: Optional[Institution], default: str = "ITCL") -> str:
    if not inst:
        return default
    raw = (inst.short_name or inst.institution_code or default).strip()
    for sep in (" - ", " — ", " – ", "/"):
        if sep in raw:
            return raw.split(sep)[0].strip().upper()
    return raw.upper()


def _resolve_display_status(tx: Transaction) -> str:
    if (tx.transaction_status or "").upper() == "REVERSED":
        return "REVERSED"
    if (tx.transaction_status or "").upper() == "PENDING":
        return "PENDING"
    return (tx.authorization_status or "DECLINED").upper()


def backfill_historical_transaction_metadata(db: Session) -> None:
    """
    Safe, idempotent startup backfill so any pre-existing transactions created before
    the Transaction Log Viewer upgrade have populated metadata columns (approval_code,
    mcc, terminal_owner, transaction_type_name, etc.) from their stored TIC messages.
    """
    missing_txs = (
        db.query(Transaction)
        .filter(Transaction.transaction_type_name.is_(None))
        .limit(500)
        .all()
    )
    if not missing_txs:
        return

    for tx in missing_txs:
        f3_prefix = (tx.processing_code or "0100000")[:3]
        tx.transaction_type_name = TRAN_CODES.get(f3_prefix) or (
            "Acquirer Reversal" if (tx.mti or "").startswith("04") else f"Code {tx.transaction_code or f3_prefix}"
        )
        tx.correlation_id = tx.correlation_id or tx.transaction_reference

        msgs = db.query(TransactionMessage).filter(TransactionMessage.transaction_id == tx.id).all()
        req_m = next((m for m in msgs if m.message_type == "REQUEST"), None)
        resp_m = next((m for m in msgs if m.message_type == "RESPONSE"), None)

        if req_m and req_m.sanitized_message:
            meta = extract_metadata_from_tic(req_m.sanitized_message)
            tx.mcc = tx.mcc or meta.get("mcc") or "6011"
            tx.pos_entry_mode = tx.pos_entry_mode or meta.get("pos_entry_mode") or "051"
            tx.pos_condition_code = tx.pos_condition_code or meta.get("pos_condition_code") or "000"
            tx.acquirer_id = tx.acquirer_id or meta.get("acquirer_id") or tx.merchant_id or "123456"
            tx.forwarding_id = tx.forwarding_id or meta.get("forwarding_id")
            tx.terminal_name = tx.terminal_name or meta.get("terminal_name") or tx.terminal_id
            tx.terminal_owner = tx.terminal_owner or meta.get("terminal_owner") or "ITCL Member Bank"
            tx.merchant_name = tx.merchant_name or meta.get("merchant_name") or tx.merchant_id
            tx.source_account = tx.source_account or meta.get("source_account")
            tx.destination_account = tx.destination_account or meta.get("destination_account")

        if resp_m and resp_m.sanitized_message:
            resp_meta = extract_metadata_from_tic(resp_m.sanitized_message)
            tx.approval_code = tx.approval_code or resp_meta.get("approval_code")
        if not tx.approval_code:
            tx.approval_code = tx.rrn[-6:] if (tx.authorization_status == "APPROVED" and tx.rrn) else "000000"

        if not tx.source_account and tx.account_id:
            acct = db.query(Account).filter(Account.id == tx.account_id).first()
            if acct:
                tx.source_account = acct.account_number

        checks = db.query(TransactionCheck).filter(TransactionCheck.transaction_id == tx.id).all()
        dur_sum = sum(c.duration_ms or 1 for c in checks)
        tx.processing_duration_ms = max(2, dur_sum)
        if tx.authorization_status != "APPROVED":
            failed = next((c for c in checks if c.check_status == "FAILED"), None)
            tx.decline_reason = failed.message if failed else tx.response_message

    db.commit()


def _apply_transaction_filters(
    query,
    db: Session,
    transaction_id: Optional[str] = None,
    rrn: Optional[str] = None,
    stan: Optional[str] = None,
    pan: Optional[str] = None,
    account_number: Optional[str] = None,
    customer: Optional[str] = None,
    terminal_id: Optional[str] = None,
    terminal_name: Optional[str] = None,
    merchant_id: Optional[str] = None,
    merchant_name: Optional[str] = None,
    mcc: Optional[str] = None,
    issuer: Optional[str] = None,
    acquirer: Optional[str] = None,
    ps_code: Optional[str] = None,
    mti: Optional[str] = None,
    response_code: Optional[str] = None,
    status: Optional[str] = None,
    transaction_type: Optional[str] = None,
    currency: Optional[str] = None,
    amount_from: Optional[float] = None,
    amount_to: Optional[float] = None,
    date_from: Optional[str] = None,
    date_to: Optional[str] = None,
    correlation_id: Optional[str] = None,
):
    if transaction_id:
        t_clean = transaction_id.strip()
        term = f"%{t_clean}%"
        query = query.filter(
            or_(
                Transaction.id.ilike(term),
                Transaction.transaction_reference.ilike(term),
                Transaction.correlation_id.ilike(term),
            )
        )
    if correlation_id:
        c_term = f"%{correlation_id.strip()}%"
        query = query.filter(
            or_(
                Transaction.correlation_id.ilike(c_term),
                Transaction.transaction_reference.ilike(c_term),
            )
        )
    if rrn:
        query = query.filter(Transaction.rrn.ilike(f"%{rrn.strip()}%"))
    if stan:
        query = query.filter(Transaction.stan.ilike(f"%{stan.strip()}%"))
    if pan:
        p_clean = pan.strip()
        p_term = f"%{p_clean}%"
        matching_card_ids = [
            c.id for c in db.query(Card.id).filter(
                or_(Card.test_pan_reference.ilike(p_term), Card.masked_pan.ilike(p_term))
            ).all()
        ]
        if matching_card_ids:
            query = query.filter(
                or_(Transaction.masked_pan.ilike(p_term), Transaction.card_id.in_(matching_card_ids))
            )
        else:
            query = query.filter(Transaction.masked_pan.ilike(p_term))
    if account_number:
        a_term = f"%{account_number.strip()}%"
        acct_ids = [a.id for a in db.query(Account.id).filter(Account.account_number.ilike(a_term)).all()]
        query = query.filter(
            or_(
                Transaction.source_account.ilike(a_term),
                Transaction.destination_account.ilike(a_term),
                Transaction.account_id.in_(acct_ids) if acct_ids else False,
            )
        )
    if customer:
        c_term = f"%{customer.strip()}%"
        cust_ids = [
            c.id for c in db.query(Customer.id).filter(
                or_(
                    Customer.customer_number.ilike(c_term),
                    Customer.first_name.ilike(c_term),
                    Customer.last_name.ilike(c_term),
                )
            ).all()
        ]
        query = query.filter(Transaction.customer_id.in_(cust_ids) if cust_ids else Transaction.customer_id == "__NONE__")
    if terminal_id:
        query = query.filter(Transaction.terminal_id.ilike(f"%{terminal_id.strip()}%"))
    if terminal_name:
        tn = f"%{terminal_name.strip()}%"
        query = query.filter(or_(Transaction.terminal_name.ilike(tn), Transaction.terminal_owner.ilike(tn)))
    if merchant_id:
        query = query.filter(Transaction.merchant_id.ilike(f"%{merchant_id.strip()}%"))
    if merchant_name:
        query = query.filter(Transaction.merchant_name.ilike(f"%{merchant_name.strip()}%"))
    if mcc:
        query = query.filter(Transaction.mcc.ilike(f"%{mcc.strip()}%"))
    if issuer:
        iss_term = f"%{issuer.strip()}%"
        iss_ids = [
            i.id for i in db.query(Institution.id).filter(
                or_(
                    Institution.id == issuer.strip(),
                    Institution.institution_code.ilike(iss_term),
                    Institution.short_name.ilike(iss_term),
                    Institution.name.ilike(iss_term),
                )
            ).all()
        ]
        query = query.filter(Transaction.issuer_institution_id.in_(iss_ids) if iss_ids else Transaction.issuer_institution_id == "__NONE__")
    if acquirer:
        acq_term = f"%{acquirer.strip()}%"
        acq_ids = [
            i.id for i in db.query(Institution.id).filter(
                or_(
                    Institution.id == acquirer.strip(),
                    Institution.institution_code.ilike(acq_term),
                    Institution.short_name.ilike(acq_term),
                    Institution.name.ilike(acq_term),
                    Institution.acquirer_id.ilike(acq_term),
                )
            ).all()
        ]
        query = query.filter(
            or_(
                Transaction.acquirer_institution_id.in_(acq_ids) if acq_ids else False,
                Transaction.acquirer_id.ilike(acq_term),
            )
        )
    if ps_code:
        query = query.filter(Transaction.ps_code == ps_code.strip().upper())
    if mti:
        query = query.filter(Transaction.mti == mti.strip())
    if response_code:
        query = query.filter(Transaction.response_code == response_code.strip())
    if status:
        st_up = status.strip().upper()
        if st_up == "REVERSED":
            query = query.filter(Transaction.transaction_status == "REVERSED")
        elif st_up == "PENDING":
            query = query.filter(Transaction.transaction_status == "PENDING")
        elif st_up == "APPROVED":
            query = query.filter(Transaction.authorization_status == "APPROVED", Transaction.transaction_status != "REVERSED")
        elif st_up == "DECLINED":
            query = query.filter(Transaction.authorization_status == "DECLINED")
    if transaction_type:
        tt = f"%{transaction_type.strip()}%"
        query = query.filter(
            or_(
                Transaction.transaction_type_name.ilike(tt),
                Transaction.transaction_code == transaction_type.strip(),
                Transaction.processing_code.ilike(tt),
            )
        )
    if currency:
        query = query.filter(Transaction.currency == currency.strip().upper())
    if amount_from is not None:
        query = query.filter(Transaction.transaction_amount >= Decimal(str(amount_from)))
    if amount_to is not None:
        query = query.filter(Transaction.transaction_amount <= Decimal(str(amount_to)))
    if date_from:
        try:
            dt_from = datetime.fromisoformat(date_from.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
            query = query.filter(Transaction.created_at >= dt_from)
        except Exception:
            pass
    if date_to:
        try:
            raw_to = date_to.strip()
            if len(raw_to) == 10:
                dt_to = datetime.fromisoformat(raw_to + "T23:59:59+00:00")
            else:
                dt_to = datetime.fromisoformat(raw_to.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
            query = query.filter(Transaction.created_at <= dt_to)
        except Exception:
            pass
    return query


def _serialize_tx_list_row(tx: Transaction) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    created_dt = tx.created_at or datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    iss_code = _short_inst_code(tx.issuer_institution, "XBANK")
    acq_code = _short_inst_code(tx.acquirer_institution, "XBANK")
    f3_prefix = (tx.processing_code or "0100000")[:3]
    tx_type = tx.transaction_type_name or TRAN_CODES.get(f3_prefix) or (
        "Acquirer Reversal" if (tx.mti or "").startswith("04") else f"Code {tx.transaction_code or f3_prefix}"
    )
    return {
        "id": tx.id,
        "transaction_reference": tx.transaction_reference,
        "correlation_id": tx.correlation_id or tx.transaction_reference,
        "date": created_dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
        "time": created_dt.strftime("%H:%M:%S.%f")[:-3],
        "created_at": created_dt.isoformat(),
        "mti": tx.mti,
        "processing_code": tx.processing_code,
        "transaction_code": tx.transaction_code,
        "transaction_type": tx_type,
        "mcc": tx.mcc or "6011",
        "terminal_id": tx.terminal_id or "TERM0001",
        "terminal_name": tx.terminal_name or tx.terminal_id or "ATM Terminal",
        "terminal_owner": tx.terminal_owner or acq_code,
        "merchant_id": tx.merchant_id or "123456",
        "merchant_name": tx.merchant_name or f"{acq_code} Merchant",
        "issuer_code": iss_code,
        "issuer_name": tx.issuer_institution.name if tx.issuer_institution else iss_code,
        "acquirer_code": acq_code,
        "acquirer_name": tx.acquirer_institution.name if tx.acquirer_institution else acq_code,
        "ps_code": tx.ps_code or "ITCL",
        "is_on_us": bool(tx.is_on_us),
        "masked_pan": tx.masked_pan or "****",
        "source_account": tx.source_account,
        "amount": float(tx.transaction_amount or 0),
        "billing_amount": float(tx.billing_amount or tx.transaction_amount or 0),
        "currency": tx.currency or "BDT",
        "response_code": tx.response_code,
        "response_description": tx.response_message,
        "approval_code": tx.approval_code or ("000000" if tx.response_code != "00" else (tx.rrn[-6:] if tx.rrn else "AUTH00")),
        "rrn": tx.rrn,
        "stan": tx.stan,
        "status": _resolve_display_status(tx),
        "authorization_status": tx.authorization_status,
        "transaction_status": tx.transaction_status,
        "processing_duration_ms": tx.processing_duration_ms or 2,
        "source_channel": tx.source_channel,
    }


def _ compute_summary_from_query(filtered_query) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    total = filtered_query.count()
    approved = filtered_query.filter(
        Transaction.authorization_status == "APPROVED",
        Transaction.transaction_status != "REVERSED",
    ).count()
    declined = filtered_query.filter(Transaction.authorization_status == "DECLINED").count()
    reversed_cnt = filtered_query.filter(Transaction.transaction_status == "REVERSED").count()
    pending_cnt = filtered_query.filter(Transaction.transaction_status == "PENDING").count()
    total_approved_ever = approved + reversed_cnt
    rate = round((total_approved_ever / total) * 100, 1) if total > 0 else 0.0
    vol = (
        filtered_query.filter(Transaction.authorization_status == "APPROVED")
        .with_entities(func.sum(Transaction.transaction_amount))
        .scalar()
        or Decimal("0.00")
    )
    return {
        "total_transactions": total,
        "approved_transactions": approved,
        "declined_transactions": declined,
        "reversed_transactions": reversed_cnt,
        "pending_transactions": pending_cnt,
        "approval_rate": rate,
        "approved_volume": float(vol),
    }

    issuer: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    acquirer: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    ps_code: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    mti: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    response_code: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    status: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    transaction_type: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    currency: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    amount_from: Optional[float] = Query(None),
    amount_to: Optional[float] = Query(None),
    date_from: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    date_to: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    sort_by: str = Query("created_at"),
    sort_dir: str = Query("desc"),
    page: int = Query(1, ge=1),
    page_size: int = Query(25, ge=1, le=200),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    _: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    """
    Lightweight, server-side paginated transaction log list.
    Never loads raw ISO messages per row, preventing N+1 queries and keeping auto-refresh fast.
    """
    base_q = db.query(Transaction).options(
        joinedload(Transaction.issuer_institution),
        joinedload(Transaction.acquirer_institution),
    )
    filtered_q = _apply_transaction_filters(
        base_q, db,
        transaction_id=transaction_id, correlation_id=correlation_id, rrn=rrn, stan=stan,
        pan=pan, account_number=account_number, customer=customer, terminal_id=terminal_id,
        terminal_name=terminal_name, merchant_id=merchant_id, merchant_name=merchant_name,
        mcc=mcc, issuer=issuer, acquirer=acquirer, ps_code=ps_code, mti=mti,
        response_code=response_code, status=status, transaction_type=transaction_type,
        currency=currency, amount_from=amount_from, amount_to=amount_to,
        date_from=date_from, date_to=date_to,
    )

    summary = _compute_summary_from_query(
        _apply_transaction_filters(
            db.query(Transaction), db,
            transaction_id=transaction_id, correlation_id=correlation_id, rrn=rrn, stan=stan,
            pan=pan, account_number=account_number, customer=customer, terminal_id=terminal_id,
            terminal_name=terminal_name, merchant_id=merchant_id, merchant_name=merchant_name,
            mcc=mcc, issuer=issuer, acquirer=acquirer, ps_code=ps_code, mti=mti,
            response_code=response_code, status=status, transaction_type=transaction_type,
            currency=currency, amount_from=amount_from, amount_to=amount_to,
            date_from=date_from, date_to=date_to,
        )
    )

    sort_col_map = {
        "created_at": Transaction.created_at,
        "transaction_reference": Transaction.transaction_reference,
        "amount": Transaction.transaction_amount,
        "mti": Transaction.mti,
        "rrn": Transaction.rrn,
        "stan": Transaction.stan,
        "response_code": Transaction.response_code,
        "status": Transaction.authorization_status,
    }
    sort_col = sort_col_map.get(sort_by, Transaction.created_at)
    order_expr = asc(sort_col) if sort_dir.lower() == "asc" else desc(sort_col)

    total = summary["total_transactions"]
    total_pages = max(1, (total + page_size - 1) // page_size)
    safe_page = min(page, total_pages)

    rows = (
        filtered_q.order_by(order_expr)
        .offset((safe_page - 1) * page_size)
        .limit(page_size)
        .all()
    )

    return {
        "items": [_serialize_tx_list_row(t) for t in rows],
        "total": total,
        "page": safe_page,
        "page_size": page_size,
        "total_pages": total_pages,
        "summary": summary,
        "server_timestamp": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    }

    rrn: Optional[str] = Query(None),
