@router.get("/export")
def export_transaction_logs_csv(
    transaction_id: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    rrn: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    stan: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    pan: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    issuer: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    acquirer: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    ps_code: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    mti: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    response_code: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    status: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    transaction_type: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    currency: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    amount_from: Optional[float] = Query(None),
    amount_to: Optional[float] = Query(None),
    date_from: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    date_to: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    _: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    base_q = db.query(Transaction).options(
        joinedload(Transaction.issuer_institution),
        joinedload(Transaction.acquirer_institution),
    )
    filtered_q = _apply_transaction_filters(
        base_q, db,
        transaction_id=transaction_id, rrn=rrn, stan=stan, pan=pan,
        issuer=issuer, acquirer=acquirer, ps_code=ps_code, mti=mti,
        response_code=response_code, status=status, transaction_type=transaction_type,
        currency=currency, amount_from=amount_from, amount_to=amount_to,
        date_from=date_from, date_to=date_to,
    )
    rows = filtered_q.order_by(Transaction.created_at.desc()).limit(2000).all()

    output = io.StringIO()
    writer = csv.writer(output)
    writer.writerow([
        "Txn Reference", "Date", "Time", "MTI", "Transaction Type", "Processing System",
        "Issuer", "Acquirer", "Masked PAN", "Source Account", "Amount", "Currency",
        "Response Code", "Response Description", "Approval Code", "RRN", "STAN",
        "Terminal ID", "Terminal Owner", "MCC", "Status", "Duration (ms)"
    ])
    for t in rows:
        s = _serialize_tx_list_row(t)
        writer.writerow([
            s["transaction_reference"], s["date"], s["time"], s["mti"], s["transaction_type"],
            s["ps_code"], s["issuer_code"], s["acquirer_code"], s["masked_pan"],
            s["source_account"] or "", f"{s['amount']:.2f}", s["currency"],
            s["response_code"], s["response_description"], s["approval_code"],
            s["rrn"], s["stan"], s["terminal_id"], s["terminal_owner"], s["mcc"],
            s["status"], s["processing_duration_ms"],
        ])

    csv_bytes = output.getvalue().encode("utf-8-sig")
    fname = f"baobab_transaction_logs_{datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}.csv"
    return Response(
        content=csv_bytes,
        media_type="text/csv",
        headers={"Content-Disposition": f'attachment; filename="{fname}"'},
    )


def _get_tx_or_404(db: Session, transaction_id: str) -> Transaction:
    tx = (
        db.query(Transaction)
        .options(
            joinedload(Transaction.issuer_institution),
            joinedload(Transaction.acquirer_institution),
        )
        .filter(
            or_(
                Transaction.id == transaction_id,
                Transaction.transaction_reference == transaction_id,
            )
        )
        .first()
    )
    if not tx:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"Transaction '{transaction_id}' not found")
    return tx


@router.get("/{transaction_id}")
def get_transaction_general_detail(
    transaction_id: str,
    reveal_pan: bool = Query(False, description="Explicit simulator-only full PAN reveal"),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    _: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    """TAB 1 — GENERAL: Complete Transaction, Card, Account, Merchant/Terminal, Financial & Network Reference info."""
    tx = _get_tx_or_404(db, transaction_id)
    card = db.query(Card).filter(Card.id == tx.card_id).first() if tx.card_id else None
    cust = db.query(Customer).filter(Customer.id == tx.customer_id).first() if tx.customer_id else None
    acct = db.query(Account).filter(Account.id == tx.account_id).first() if tx.account_id else None

    # Decode request message for any additional terminal/location attributes
    req_msg = (
        db.query(TransactionMessage)
        .filter(TransactionMessage.transaction_id == tx.id, TransactionMessage.message_type == "REQUEST")
        .first()
    )
    f43_location = None
    if req_msg and req_msg.sanitized_message:
        dec = decode_full_tic_or_iso_message(req_msg.sanitized_message)
        for pf in dec.get("parsed_fields", []):
            if pf["field_number"] == 43:
                f43_location = pf["display_value"]

    allow_full = bool(reveal_pan and getattr(settings, "LOG_RAW_DATA", True))
    pan_display = (card.test_pan_reference if (allow_full and card) else tx.masked_pan) or "****"
    bin_prefix = (card.test_pan_reference[:6] if card and card.test_pan_reference else (tx.masked_pan[:6] if tx.masked_pan else "N/A"))

    row_summary = _serialize_tx_list_row(tx)
    return {
        "summary": row_summary,
        "transaction_info": {
            "transaction_id": tx.id,
            "transaction_reference": tx.transaction_reference,
            "transaction_date": row_summary["date"],
            "transaction_time": row_summary["time"],
            "transaction_type": row_summary["transaction_type"],
            "mti": tx.mti,
            "processing_code": tx.processing_code,
            "transaction_code": tx.transaction_code,
            "processing_system": tx.ps_code or "ITCL",
            "transaction_status": row_summary["status"],
            "authorization_status": tx.authorization_status,
            "transaction_channel": tx.source_channel,
            "source_application": "BAOBAB Host Switch Engine",
            "correlation_id": tx.correlation_id or tx.transaction_reference,
            "is_on_us": tx.is_on_us,
        },
        "card_info": {
            "pan": pan_display,
            "masked_pan": tx.masked_pan,
            "full_pan_available": bool(card and getattr(settings, "LOG_RAW_DATA", True)),
            "card_type": card.card_type if card else "N/A",
            "card_product": card.card_product if card else "N/A",
            "bin": bin_prefix,
            "expiry_date": f"{card.expiry_month:02d}/{card.expiry_year}" if card else "••/••••",
            "card_status": card.card_status if card else "N/A",
            "cardholder_name": card.cardholder_name if card else None,
            "customer_name": f"{cust.first_name} {cust.last_name or ''}".strip() if cust else None,
            "customer_id": cust.customer_number if cust else None,
        },
        "account_info": {
            "source_account": acct.account_number if acct else tx.source_account,
            "destination_account": tx.destination_account,
            "account_type": acct.account_type if acct else None,
            "account_currency": acct.currency if acct else tx.currency,
            "account_status": acct.account_status if acct else None,
            "branch_code": acct.branch_code if acct else None,
        },
        "merchant_terminal_info": {
            "merchant_id": tx.merchant_id,
            "merchant_name": row_summary["merchant_name"],
            "mcc": row_summary["mcc"],
            "pos_entry_mode": tx.pos_entry_mode or "051",
            "pos_condition_code": tx.pos_condition_code or "000",
            "terminal_id": tx.terminal_id,
            "terminal_name": row_summary["terminal_name"],
            "terminal_owner": row_summary["terminal_owner"],
            "terminal_location": f43_location or row_summary["terminal_name"],
            "acquirer": f"{row_summary['acquirer_code']} — {row_summary['acquirer_name']}",
            "issuer": f"{row_summary['issuer_code']} — {row_summary['issuer_name']}",
        },
        "financial_info": {
            "transaction_amount": float(tx.transaction_amount or 0),
            "billing_amount": float(tx.billing_amount or tx.transaction_amount or 0),
            "transaction_currency": tx.currency,
            "billing_currency": acct.currency if acct else tx.currency,
            "exchange_rate": "1.000000",
            "fee": 0.0,
        },
        "network_reference_info": {
            "rrn": tx.rrn,
            "stan": tx.stan,
            "approval_code": row_summary["approval_code"],
            "acquirer_reference": tx.acquirer_id or (tx.acquirer_institution.acquirer_id if tx.acquirer_institution else "123456"),
            "forwarding_reference": tx.forwarding_id,
            "network_transaction_reference": tx.transaction_reference,
        },
    }


@router.get("/{transaction_id}/authorization")
def get_transaction_authorization_detail(
    transaction_id: str,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    _: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    """TAB 2 — AUTHORIZER RESPONSE: Explains why the transaction was approved or declined using actual checks & ledger."""
    tx = _get_tx_or_404(db, transaction_id)
    checks = (
        db.query(TransactionCheck)
        .filter(TransactionCheck.transaction_id == tx.id)
        .order_by(TransactionCheck.check_order.asc())
        .all()
    )
    ledger = (
        db.query(AccountLedger)
        .filter(AccountLedger.transaction_id == tx.id)
        .order_by(AccountLedger.created_at.asc())
        .all()
    )
    card = db.query(Card).filter(Card.id == tx.card_id).first() if tx.card_id else None
    acct = db.query(Account).filter(Account.id == tx.account_id).first() if tx.account_id else None
    card_lim = db.query(CardLimit).filter(CardLimit.card_id == card.id).first() if card else None
    acct_lim = db.query(AccountLimit).filter(AccountLimit.account_id == acct.id).first() if acct else None

    failed_check = next((c for c in checks if c.check_status == "FAILED"), None)
    rule_checks = [c for c in checks if "Rule" in c.check_name or "Permissions" in c.check_name]
    limit_checks = [c for c in checks if "Limit" in c.check_name]
    bin_checks = [c for c in checks if "Routing" in c.check_name or "BIN" in c.check_name or "Lookup" in c.check_name]
    card_status_chk = next((c for c in checks if "Card Status" in c.check_name), None)
    acct_status_chk = next((c for c in checks if "Account Status" in c.check_name), None)
    bal_chk = next((c for c in checks if "Balance Authorization" in c.check_name), None)

    recorded_balance_before = float(ledger[0].balance_before) if ledger else None
    recorded_balance_after = float(ledger[-1].balance_after) if ledger else (float(acct.available_balance) if acct else None)

    total_dur = sum(c.duration_ms or 1 for c in checks) or tx.processing_duration_ms or 1

    return {
        "authorization_status": tx.authorization_status,
        "transaction_status": tx.transaction_status,
        "display_status": _resolve_display_status(tx),
        "response_code": tx.response_code,
        "response_tic_f39": f"000{tx.response_code}",
        "response_description": tx.response_message,
        "decline_reason": (
            failed_check.message
            if failed_check
            else (tx.decline_reason if tx.authorization_status != "APPROVED" else "None — All authorization checks passed")
        ),
        "failed_stage": failed_check.check_name if failed_check else None,
        "authorization_decision": (
            f"APPROVED (Auth Code {tx.approval_code or '000000'})"
            if tx.authorization_status == "APPROVED"
            else f"DECLINED at stage '{failed_check.check_name if failed_check else 'Host Validation'}' (RC {tx.response_code})"
        ),
        "applicable_rules": [
            {"name": c.check_name, "status": c.check_status, "rc": c.response_code, "message": c.message}
            for c in rule_checks
        ],
        "card_status_at_auth": (
            card_status_chk.message if card_status_chk else (card.card_status if card else "Not evaluated")
        ),
        "account_status_at_auth": (
            acct_status_chk.message if acct_status_chk else (acct.account_status if acct else "Not evaluated")
        ),
        "balance_snapshot": {
            "balance_check_message": bal_chk.message if bal_chk else None,
            "balance_before": recorded_balance_before,
            "balance_after": recorded_balance_after,
            "currency": tx.currency,
        },
        "limits_evaluation": {
            "card_per_tx_limit": float(card_lim.transaction_limit) if card_lim else None,
            "card_daily_limit": float(card_lim.daily_limit) if card_lim else None,
            "account_per_tx_limit": float(acct_lim.per_transaction_limit) if acct_lim else None,
            "account_daily_limit": float(acct_lim.daily_limit) if acct_lim else None,
            "limit_validation_result": (
                " | ".join(f"{c.check_name}: {c.status if hasattr(c, 'status') else c.check_status} ({c.message})" for c in limit_checks)
                if limit_checks
                else "Not required / Not reached"
            ),
        },
        "validation_results": {
            "terminal_validation": f"Terminal {tx.terminal_id or 'TERM0001'} accepted",
            "bin_validation": (
                " | ".join(f"{c.check_name}: {c.check_status} ({c.message})" for c in bin_checks)
                if bin_checks
                else f"On-Us {tx.ps_code} routing validated"
            ),
            "processing_system_validation": f"Switch {tx.ps_code or 'ITCL'} ({'On-Us' if tx.is_on_us else 'Off-Us'})",
        },
        "timestamps": {
            "authorization_timestamp": tx.created_at.isoformat() if tx.created_at else None,
            "response_timestamp": (tx.completed_at or tx.created_at).isoformat() if (tx.completed_at or tx.created_at) else None,
            "processing_duration_ms": total_dur,
        },
        "checks": [
            {
                "check_order": c.check_order,
                "check_name": c.check_name,
                "check_status": c.check_status,
                "response_code": c.response_code,
                "message": c.message,
                "duration_ms": c.duration_ms,
                "timestamp": c.created_at.isoformat() if c.created_at else None,
            }
            for c in checks
        ],
        "ledger_entries": [
            {
                "id": l.id,
                "entry_type": l.entry_type,
                "amount": float(l.amount),
                "currency": l.currency,
                "balance_before": float(l.balance_before),
                "balance_after": float(l.balance_after),
                "description": l.description,
                "posting_status": l.posting_status,
                "created_at": l.created_at.isoformat() if l.created_at else None,
            }
            for l in ledger
        ],
    }


@router.get("/{transaction_id}/messages")
def get_transaction_iso_messages(
    transaction_id: str,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    _: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    """TAB 3 — ISO DETAILS: Returns all stored messages for the transaction, decoded with `tic_decoder.py` + side-by-side diff."""
    tx = _get_tx_or_404(db, transaction_id)
    msgs = (
        db.query(TransactionMessage)
        .filter(TransactionMessage.transaction_id == tx.id)
        .order_by(TransactionMessage.created_at.asc())
        .all()
    )

    req_raw = None
    resp_raw = None
    out_msgs = []
    for m in msgs:
        if m.message_type == "REQUEST" and not req_raw:
            req_raw = m.sanitized_message
        elif m.message_type == "RESPONSE" and not resp_raw:
            resp_raw = m.sanitized_message

        decoded = decode_full_tic_or_iso_message(m.sanitized_message, allow_full_pan=False)
        out_msgs.append({
            "id": m.id,
            "transaction_id": tx.id,
            "direction": m.message_type,
            "mti": m.mti,
            "message_format": m.message_format,
            "timestamp": m.created_at.isoformat() if m.created_at else tx.created_at.isoformat(),
            "raw_message": mask_sensitive_wire_string(m.sanitized_message),
            "decoded": decoded,
        })

    comparison = compare_request_and_response(req_raw, resp_raw)
    return {
        "transaction_id": tx.id,
        "transaction_reference": tx.transaction_reference,
        "rrn": tx.rrn,
        "stan": tx.stan,
        "messages": out_msgs,
        "comparison": comparison,
    }


@router.get("/{transaction_id}/messages/{message_id}/parsed")
def get_single_parsed_iso_message(
    transaction_id: str,
    message_id: str,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    _: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    tx = _get_tx_or_404(db, transaction_id)
    msg = (
        db.query(TransactionMessage)
        .filter(TransactionMessage.id == message_id, TransactionMessage.transaction_id == tx.id)
        .first()
    )
    if not msg:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Transaction message not found")
    decoded = decode_full_tic_or_iso_message(msg.sanitized_message, allow_full_pan=False)
    return {
        "id": msg.id,
        "direction": msg.message_type,
        "mti": msg.mti,
        "message_format": msg.message_format,
        "timestamp": msg.created_at.isoformat() if msg.created_at else None,
        "raw_message": mask_sensitive_wire_string(msg.sanitized_message),
        "decoded": decoded,
    }


@router.get("/{transaction_id}/messages/{message_id}/export-excel")
def export_parsed_message_excel(
    transaction_id: str,
    message_id: str,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    _: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    tx = _get_tx_or_404(db, transaction_id)
    msg = (
        db.query(TransactionMessage)
        .filter(TransactionMessage.id == message_id, TransactionMessage.transaction_id == tx.id)
        .first()
    )
    if not msg:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Transaction message not found")
    decoded = decode_full_tic_or_iso_message(msg.sanitized_message, allow_full_pan=False)
    xlsx_bytes = export_decoded_message_excel_bytes(decoded, rrn=f"{tx.rrn}_{msg.mti}")
    if not xlsx_bytes:
        # CSV fallback if openpyxl is unavailable
        buf = io.StringIO()
        writer = csv.writer(buf)
        writer.writerow(["Field", "Field Name", "Subfield / Key", "Value"])
        for row in decoded.get("flat_rows", []):
            writer.writerow([row["field_tag"], row["field_name"], row["subfield_key"], row["value"]])
        return Response(
            content=buf.getvalue().encode("utf-8-sig"),
            media_type="text/csv",
            headers={"Content-Disposition": f'attachment; filename="{tx.rrn}_{msg.mti}_decoded.csv"'},
        )
    return Response(
        content=xlsx_bytes,
        media_type="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
        headers={"Content-Disposition": f'attachment; filename="{tx.rrn}_{msg.mti}_decoded.xlsx"'},
    )


def _mask_crypto_dict(d: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    if not d:
        return {}
    out: Dict[str, Any] = {}
    for k, v in d.items():
        kl = k.lower()
        if any(s in kl for s in ("pin_block", "clear_key", "clear_pin", "cvv", "track", "pvv", "offset", "secret")):
            if kl in ("pvv_matched", "cvv_matched", "arqc_verified", "mac_matched", "destination_pin_block_generated"):
                out[k] = v
            else:
                out[k] = "***MASKED_SENSITIVE***"
        else:
            out[k] = v
    return out


@router.get("/{transaction_id}/crypto")
def get_transaction_crypto_detail(
    transaction_id: str,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    _: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    """TAB 4 — KEYS & CRYPTO: Returns sanitized HSM operations, key references (never clear key material), and audit refs."""
    tx = _get_tx_or_404(db, transaction_id)
    hsm_ops = (
        db.query(HsmOperation)
        .filter(HsmOperation.transaction_id == tx.id)
        .order_by(HsmOperation.created_at.asc())
        .all()
    )

    operations_out = []
    for op in hsm_ops:
        key_rec = db.query(HsmKeyReference).filter(HsmKeyReference.id == op.key_reference_id).first() if op.key_reference_id else None
        audit_rec = db.query(HsmAuditLog).filter(HsmAuditLog.operation_id == op.id).first()
        op_up = op.operation_type.upper()
        op_category = "CRYPTO_OPERATION"
        if "PVV" in op_up or "PIN_VERIFY" in op_up:
            op_category = "PIN Verification (Visa PVV / IBM 3624)"
        elif "TRANSLATE" in op_up:
            op_category = "PIN Block Translation (AWK -> IWK)"
        elif "CVV" in op_up:
            op_category = "CVV / CVV2 Verification"
        elif "ARQC" in op_up or "EMV" in op_up:
            op_category = "EMV ARQC Verification & ARPC Generation"
        elif "MAC" in op_up:
            op_category = "Retail MAC ISO 9797-1 Alg 3"

        operations_out.append({
            "operation_id": op.id,
            "hsm_provider": "Thales payShield 10K Soft-HSM",
            "hsm_connection": f"{settings.HSM_MODE} (Host LMK Slot Table)",
            "hsm_operation": op.operation_type,
            "operation_category": op_category,
            "request_reference": op.request_reference,
            "audit_reference": audit_rec.audit_reference if audit_rec else None,
            "key_type": key_rec.key_type if key_rec else "SLOT_KEY",
            "key_alias": key_rec.key_identifier if key_rec else "DEFAULT_SLOT",
            "key_name": key_rec.key_name if key_rec else "Internal HSM Operational Key",
            "key_version": "v1 (Active)",
            "key_scheme": key_rec.algorithm if key_rec else "3DES_2KEY (Variant LMK)",
            "key_usage": key_rec.key_usage if key_rec else "OPERATIONAL",
            "kvc": key_rec.kvc if key_rec else "N/A",
            "hsm_key_reference": key_rec.hsm_key_reference if key_rec else "LMK_PROTECTED",
            "cryptographic_result": op.response_status,
            "hsm_response_code": op.error_code,
            "hsm_processing_status": "COMPLETED" if op.error_code == "00" else "DECLINED_OR_ERROR",
            "request_timestamp": op.created_at.isoformat() if op.created_at else None,
            "response_timestamp": op.created_at.isoformat() if op.created_at else None,
            "duration_ms": op.duration_ms,
            "sanitized_request": _mask_crypto_dict(op.sanitized_request),
            "sanitized_response": _mask_crypto_dict(op.sanitized_response),
        })

    return {
        "transaction_id": tx.id,
        "transaction_reference": tx.transaction_reference,
        "hsm_provider": "Thales payShield 10K Soft-HSM",
        "hsm_mode": settings.HSM_MODE,
        "operations_count": len(operations_out),
        "operations": operations_out,
    }


def _build_or_load_trace_events(db: Session, tx: Transaction, persist_if_missing: bool = False) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Retrieves actual recorded TransactionTraceEvent records for `tx`.
    If `tx` was created before `TransactionTraceEvent` existed, reconstructs the trace strictly
    from the transaction's actual persisted `TransactionCheck`, `HsmOperation`, and `AccountLedger`
    rows — NEVER re-executing authorization, HSM, or ledger processing, and NEVER fabricating stages
    that did not run.
    """
    stored_events = (
        db.query(TransactionTraceEvent)
        .filter(TransactionTraceEvent.transaction_id == tx.id)
        .order_by(TransactionTraceEvent.event_order.asc())
        .all()
    )
    if stored_events:
        return [
            {
                "event_id": ev.id,
                "transaction_id": ev.transaction_id,
                "correlation_id": ev.correlation_id or tx.transaction_reference,
                "event_order": ev.event_order,
                "event_code": ev.event_code,
                "event_category": ev.event_category,
                "event_name": ev.event_name,
                "event_status": ev.event_status,
                "response_code": ev.response_code,
                "duration_ms": ev.duration_ms,
                "message": ev.message,
                "event_timestamp": ev.event_timestamp.isoformat() if ev.event_timestamp else tx.created_at.isoformat(),
            }
            for ev in stored_events
        ]

    # Reconstruct strictly from actual persisted TransactionCheck rows
    checks = (
        db.query(TransactionCheck)
        .filter(TransactionCheck.transaction_id == tx.id)
        .order_by(TransactionCheck.check_order.asc())
        .all()
    )
    base_ts = tx.created_at or datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    elapsed_ms = 0
    reconstructed: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []

    def _add_ev(order: int, code: str, cat: str, name: str, status: str, rc: str, dur: int, msg: str):
        nonlocal elapsed_ms
        ev_ts = base_ts + timedelta(milliseconds=elapsed_ms)
        elapsed_ms += max(1, dur)
        reconstructed.append({
            "event_id": f"TRC-{tx.id[:8]}-{order:02d}",
            "transaction_id": tx.id,
            "correlation_id": tx.correlation_id or tx.transaction_reference,
            "event_order": order,
            "event_code": code,
            "event_category": cat,
            "event_name": name,
            "event_status": status,
            "response_code": rc,
            "duration_ms": max(1, dur),
            "message": msg,
            "event_timestamp": ev_ts.isoformat(),
        })

    order_idx = 1
    _add_ev(
        order_idx,
        "TRANSACTION_RECEIVED",
        "INGRESS",
        "TRANSACTION RECEIVED",
        "PASSED",
        "00",
        1,
        f"Incoming MTI {tx.mti} transaction {tx.transaction_reference} received from {tx.source_channel}.",
    )

    for c in checks:
        order_idx += 1
        cname_up = c.check_name.upper()
        cat = "VALIDATION"
        if "MESSAGE" in cname_up:
            cat = "PARSING"
        elif "ROUTING" in cname_up or "NETWORK" in cname_up:
            cat = "ROUTING"
        elif "HSM" in cname_up or "PIN" in cname_up or "CVV" in cname_up or "EMV" in cname_up or "MAC" in cname_up:
            cat = "HSM_CRYPTO"
        elif "LIMIT" in cname_up:
            cat = "LIMITS"
        elif "RULE" in cname_up:
            cat = "RISK_RULE"
        elif "BALANCE" in cname_up or "DECISION" in cname_up:
            cat = "AUTHORIZATION"
        elif "LEDGER" in cname_up:
            cat = "LEDGER"

        _add_ev(
            order_idx,
            cname_up.replace(" ", "_")[:50],
            cat,
            cname_up,
            c.check_status,
            c.response_code,
            c.duration_ms or 1,
            c.message,
        )

    order_idx += 1
    _add_ev(
        order_idx,
        "RESPONSE_GENERATION",
        "EGRESS",
        "RESPONSE GENERATION",
        "PASSED",
        tx.response_code,
        1,
        f"ISO 8583 / TIC response generated (RC={tx.response_code}: {tx.response_message}).",
    )
    order_idx += 1
    _add_ev(
        order_idx,
        "TRANSACTION_COMPLETED",
        "COMPLETION",
        "TRANSACTION COMPLETED",
        _resolve_display_status(tx),
        tx.response_code,
        1,
        f"Final response delivered ({_resolve_display_status(tx)}).",
    )

    if persist_if_missing:
        for item in reconstructed:
            db.add(
                TransactionTraceEvent(
                    transaction_id=tx.id,
                    correlation_id=item["correlation_id"],
                    event_order=item["event_order"],
                    event_code=item["event_code"],
                    event_category=item["event_category"],
                    event_name=item["event_name"],
                    event_status=item["event_status"],
                    response_code=item["response_code"],
                    duration_ms=item["duration_ms"],
                    message=item["message"],
                    event_timestamp=datetime.fromisoformat(item["event_timestamp"]),
                )
            )
        db.commit()

    return reconstructed


def _format_switch_trace_text(tx: Transaction, events: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> str:
    total_ms = sum(e.get("duration_ms", 1) for e in events)
    final_status = _resolve_display_status(tx)
    lines = [
        "=" * 60,
        "TRANSACTION PROCESSING TRACE",
        "=" * 60,
        "",
        f"Transaction ID : {tx.transaction_reference}",
        f"Internal UUID  : {tx.id}",
        f"Correlation ID : {tx.correlation_id or tx.transaction_reference}",
        f"MTI            : {tx.mti}",
        f"STAN           : {tx.stan}",
        f"RRN            : {tx.rrn}",
        f"Masked PAN     : {tx.masked_pan}",
        f"Amount         : {tx.transaction_amount:.2f} {tx.currency}",
        f"Switch / Route : {tx.ps_code} ({'ON-US' if tx.is_on_us else 'OFF-US'})",
        "",
    ]
    for ev in events:
        try:
            dt = datetime.fromisoformat(ev["event_timestamp"].replace("Z", "+00:00"))
            ts_str = dt.strftime("%H:%M:%S.%f")[:-3]
        except Exception:
            ts_str = ev["event_timestamp"]
        lines.append("-" * 60)
        lines.append(f"{ts_str} | {ev['event_name']} [{ev['event_status']}] ({ev['duration_ms']} ms)")
        lines.append("-" * 60)
        lines.append(f"{ev['message']}")
        lines.append("")

    lines.extend([
        "=" * 60,
        f"FINAL STATUS: {final_status} (RC {tx.response_code} — {tx.response_message})",
        f"TOTAL PROCESSING TIME: {total_ms} MS",
        "=" * 60,
    ])
    return "\n".join(lines)


@router.get("/{transaction_id}/trace")
def get_transaction_trace(
    transaction_id: str,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    _: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    """TAB 5 — PROCESSING TRACE (Read-only retrieval of recorded trace events)."""
    tx = _get_tx_or_404(db, transaction_id)
    events = _build_or_load_trace_events(db, tx, persist_if_missing=False)
    formatted_text = _format_switch_trace_text(tx, events)
    total_ms = sum(e.get("duration_ms", 1) for e in events)
    return {
        "transaction_id": tx.id,
        "transaction_reference": tx.transaction_reference,
        "correlation_id": tx.correlation_id or tx.transaction_reference,
        "mti": tx.mti,
        "stan": tx.stan,
        "rrn": tx.rrn,
        "final_status": _resolve_display_status(tx),
        "response_code": tx.response_code,
        "response_message": tx.response_message,
        "total_duration_ms": total_ms,
        "events": events,
        "formatted_trace": formatted_text,
    }


@router.post("/{transaction_id}/trace/generate")
def generate_or_load_transaction_trace(
    transaction_id: str,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    _: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    """
    Explicit [ Generate / Load Transaction Trace ] button action.
    Loads actual recorded events (and persists reconstructed events from TransactionCheck if legacy),
    NEVER re-executing authorization, HSM, or ledger posting.
    """
    tx = _get_tx_or_404(db, transaction_id)
    events = _build_or_load_trace_events(db, tx, persist_if_missing=True)
    formatted_text = _format_switch_trace_text(tx, events)
    total_ms = sum(e.get("duration_ms", 1) for e in events)
    return {
        "transaction_id": tx.id,
        "transaction_reference": tx.transaction_reference,
        "correlation_id": tx.correlation_id or tx.transaction_reference,
        "mti": tx.mti,
        "stan": tx.stan,
        "rrn": tx.rrn,
        "final_status": _resolve_display_status(tx),
        "response_code": tx.response_code,
        "response_message": tx.response_message,
        "total_duration_ms": total_ms,
        "events": events,
        "formatted_trace": formatted_text,
    }


@router.get("/{transaction_id}/trace/export")
def export_transaction_trace_txt(
    transaction_id: str,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    _: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    tx = _get_tx_or_404(db, transaction_id)
    events = _build_or_load_trace_events(db, tx, persist_if_missing=False)
    formatted_text = _format_switch_trace_text(tx, events)
    fname = f"trace_{tx.transaction_reference}_{tx.rrn}.txt"
    return Response(
        content=formatted_text.encode("utf-8"),
        media_type="text/plain; charset=utf-8",
        headers={"Content-Disposition": f'attachment; filename="{fname}"'},
    )


@router.get("/{transaction_id}/related")
def get_related_transactions(
    transaction_id: str,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    _: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    """
    TAB 6 — RELATED TRANSACTIONS:
    Links Original Authorizations, Reversals (0400/0420), Financial Advices (0220),
    and Duplicate Transmissions using reliable keys (original_transaction_id, TransactionReversal,
    RRN, STAN+RRN, and Correlation ID) — never linking by equal amount alone.
    """
    tx = _get_tx_or_404(db, transaction_id)
    related_map: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}

    def _register(rel_tx: Optional[Transaction], relationship_type: str, link_basis: str):
        if not rel_tx or rel_tx.id == tx.id:
            return
        if rel_tx.id not in related_map:
            row = _serialize_tx_list_row(rel_tx)
            row["relationship_type"] = relationship_type
            row["link_basis"] = link_basis
            related_map[rel_tx.id] = row

    # 1. Explicit original_transaction_id parent
    if tx.original_transaction_id:
        orig = db.query(Transaction).filter(Transaction.id == tx.original_transaction_id).first()
        _register(orig, "ORIGINAL_AUTHORIZATION", "Explicit original_transaction_id FK")

    # 2. Explicit child transactions pointing to this transaction as original
    children = db.query(Transaction).filter(Transaction.original_transaction_id == tx.id).all()
    for ch in children:
        rel_label = "REVERSAL" if (ch.mti or "").startswith("04") else "LINKED_FOLLOW_UP"
        _register(ch, rel_label, "Explicit original_transaction_id FK")

    # 3. TransactionReversal table links
    rev_links = (
        db.query(TransactionReversal)
        .filter(
            or_(
                TransactionReversal.original_transaction_id == tx.id,
                TransactionReversal.reversal_transaction_id == tx.id,
            )
        )
        .all()
    )
    for rl in rev_links:
        if rl.original_transaction_id != tx.id:
            o_tx = db.query(Transaction).filter(Transaction.id == rl.original_transaction_id).first()
            _register(o_tx, "ORIGINAL_AUTHORIZATION", f"Reversal Registry (RRN {rl.original_rrn})")
        if rl.reversal_transaction_id != tx.id:
            r_tx = db.query(Transaction).filter(Transaction.id == rl.reversal_transaction_id).first()
            _register(r_tx, "REVERSAL", f"Reversal Registry ({rl.reversal_reason})")

    # 4. Same RRN (Advices 0220, Reversals 0400/0420, Duplicate Transmissions RC 94)
    if tx.rrn:
        same_rrn = db.query(Transaction).filter(Transaction.rrn == tx.rrn, Transaction.id != tx.id).all()
        for sr in same_rrn:
            if sr.response_code == "94":
                r_type = "DUPLICATE_TRANSMISSION"
                basis = f"Identical STAN {sr.stan} / RRN {sr.rrn} (RC 94)"
            elif (sr.mti or "").startswith("04"):
                r_type = "REVERSAL"
                basis = f"Matching RRN {sr.rrn}"
            elif sr.mti == "0220":
                r_type = "CLEARING_ADVICE_0220"
                basis = f"Matching RRN {sr.rrn}"
            elif sr.mti in ("0100", "0200"):
                r_type = "ORIGINAL_AUTHORIZATION"
                basis = f"Matching RRN {sr.rrn}"
            else:
                r_type = "RELATED_BY_RRN"
                basis = f"Matching RRN {sr.rrn}"
            _register(sr, r_type, basis)

    # 5. Same Correlation ID (if shared across multi-leg switch operations)
    if tx.correlation_id:
        same_corr = (
            db.query(Transaction)
            .filter(Transaction.correlation_id == tx.correlation_id, Transaction.id != tx.id)
            .all()
        )
        for sc in same_corr:
            _register(sc, "CORRELATED_LEG", f"Correlation ID {tx.correlation_id}")

    related_list = sorted(related_map.values(), key=lambda x: x["created_at"])
    return {
        "transaction_id": tx.id,
        "transaction_reference": tx.transaction_reference,
        "rrn": tx.rrn,
        "stan": tx.stan,
        "related_count": len(related_list),
        "related_transactions": related_list,
    }


@router.get("/{transaction_id}/package")
def download_investigation_package(
    transaction_id: str,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    """Downloads a complete, sanitized JSON investigation dossier for support teams."""
    general = get_transaction_general_detail(transaction_id, reveal_pan=False, db=db, _=current_user)
    auth = get_transaction_authorization_detail(transaction_id, db=db, _=current_user)
    iso = get_transaction_iso_messages(transaction_id, db=db, _=current_user)
    crypto = get_transaction_crypto_detail(transaction_id, db=db, _=current_user)
    trace = get_transaction_trace(transaction_id, db=db, _=current_user)
    related = get_related_transactions(transaction_id, db=db, _=current_user)

    dossier = {
        "package_metadata": {
            "generated_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            "generated_by": current_user,
            "application": settings.APP_NAME,
            "security_policy": "PCI-DSS Sanitized (PAN Masked, PIN/CVV/Keys Redacted)",
        },
        "general": general,
        "authorizer_response": auth,
        "iso_messages_and_comparison": iso,
        "keys_and_crypto": crypto,
        "processing_trace": trace,
        "related_transactions": related,
    }
    ref = general["summary"]["transaction_reference"]
    content = json.dumps(dossier, indent=2, default=str).encode("utf-8")
    return Response(
        content=content,
        media_type="application/json",
        headers={"Content-Disposition": f'attachment; filename="investigation_{ref}.json"'},
    )
'''

def _auth_headers():

    # 5. Authorizer Response Tab

    fnums = [f["field_number"] for f in req_decoded["parsed_fields"]]
    assert fnums == sorted(fnums)
    assert 1 not in fnums
    # Verify PIN block F52 is strictly masked
    f52_entry = next((f for f in req_decoded["parsed_fields"] if f["field_number"] == 52), None)

    # 7. Keys & Crypto Tab (no clear keys or PIN blocks exposed)

    bal_before_trace = client.get(f"/api/transaction-logs/{tx1_id}/authorization", headers=headers).json()["balance_snapshot"]["balance_after"]
    trace_resp = client.post(f"/api/transaction-logs/{tx1_id}/trace/generate", headers=headers)

    assert len(trace_data["events"]) >= 5
    bal_after_trace = client.get(f"/api/transaction-logs/{tx1_id}/authorization", headers=headers).json()["balance_snapshot"]["balance_after"]
    assert bal_before_trace == bal_after_trace

    # 9. Reversal & Related Transactions Tab
    rev_submit = client.post(
        "/api/simulator/submit",
        headers=headers,

def apply_v2(installer: SafeInstaller) -> None:
    # 1. Write transaction_logs_router.py
    installer.write_file(
        "backend/app/routers/transaction_logs_router.py",
        TRANSACTION_LOGS_ROUTER_PY.replace("def _ compute_summary_from_query", "def _compute_summary_from_query"),
    )

    # 2. Wire router and startup backfill into backend/app/main.py
    main_import_anchor = "from app.routers.institutions_router import router as institutions_router\n"
    main_import_replacement = (
        "from app.routers.institutions_router import router as institutions_router\n"
        "# [PATCH tx_log_viewer_v2:main_router_import]\n"
        "from app.routers.transaction_logs_router import (\n"
        "    router as transaction_logs_router,\n"
        "    backfill_historical_transaction_metadata,\n"
        ")\n"
    )
    installer.patch_file(
        "backend/app/main.py",
        "[PATCH tx_log_viewer_v2:main_router_import]",
        main_import_anchor,
        main_import_replacement,
    )

    main_seed_anchor = "        seed_initial_data(db)\n"
    main_seed_replacement = (
        "        seed_initial_data(db)\n"
        "# [PATCH tx_log_viewer_v2:main_startup_backfill]\n"
        "        backfill_historical_transaction_metadata(db)\n"
    )
    installer.patch_file(
        "backend/app/main.py",
        "[PATCH tx_log_viewer_v2:main_startup_backfill]",
        main_seed_anchor,
        main_seed_replacement,
    )

    main_include_anchor = "app.include_router(institutions_router)\n"
    main_include_replacement = (
        "app.include_router(institutions_router)\n"
        "# [PATCH tx_log_viewer_v2:main_include_router]\n"
        "app.include_router(transaction_logs_router)\n"
    )
    installer.patch_file(
        "backend/app/main.py",
        "[PATCH tx_log_viewer_v2:main_include_router]",
        main_include_anchor,
        main_include_replacement,
    )

    # 3. Write automated pytest suite
    installer.write_file("backend/tests/test_transaction_log_viewer.py", PYTEST_SUITE_PY)

    installer.validate_python_files([
        "backend/app/routers/transaction_logs_router.py",
        "backend/app/main.py",
        "backend/tests/test_transaction_log_viewer.py",
    ])


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Install Transaction Log Viewer Part 2 (FastAPI Router & Tests)")
    parser.add_argument("--project-root", default=None, help="Explicit path to project root")
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="Validate without modifying files")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    root = detect_project_root(args.project_root)
    print(f"=== BAOBAB Transaction Log Viewer Installer v2 ===\nProject Root: {root}\nDry Run: {args.dry_run}")
    installer = SafeInstaller(root, dry_run=args.dry_run)
    apply_v2(installer)

    if not args.dry_run:
        sys.path.insert(0, str(root / "backend"))
        from app.database import SessionLocal
        from app.routers.transaction_logs_router import backfill_historical_transaction_metadata
        db = SessionLocal()
        try:
            backfill_historical_transaction_metadata(db)
            print("  [OK] Historical transactions backfilled with TIC metadata.")
        finally:
            db.close()

    print("\n--- Summary (Installer v2) ---")
    print(f"Created files  ({len(installer.created_files)}): {installer.created_files}")
    print(f"Modified files ({len(installer.modified_files)}): {installer.modified_files}")
    if not args.dry_run and installer.modified_files:
        print(f"Backups stored in: {installer.backup_dir}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
install_transaction_log_viewer_v3.py
Part 3 of 3 — Database Performance Indexes, Column Preference Persistence API,
Complete React/TypeScript Transaction Log Viewer Page (Auto-Load, Configurable
Auto-Refresh Timer, 20 Server-Side Filters, Column Customizer, 6 Investigation Tabs),
Sidebar/Router Integration, and End-to-End Validation.

import argparse
import os
import py_compile
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path


def detect_project_root(explicit_root: str | None = None) -> Path:
    if explicit_root:
        root = Path(explicit_root).resolve()
    else:
        root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
        if not (root / "backend").exists() and (root.parent / "backend").exists():
            root = root.parent
    required = [
        root / "backend" / "app" / "tic_decoder_engine.py",
        root / "backend" / "app" / "routers" / "transaction_logs_router.py",
        root / "frontend" / "src" / "App.tsx",
        root / "frontend" / "src" / "components" / "Layout.tsx",
    ]
    for req in required:
        if not req.exists():
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Prerequisite check failed: missing {req}.\n"
                "Please ensure install_transaction_log_viewer_v1.py and "
                "install_transaction_log_viewer_v2.py have been executed first."
            )
    return root


class SafeInstaller:
    def __init__(self, root: Path, dry_run: bool = False):
        self.root = root
        self.dry_run = dry_run
        ts = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
        self.backup_dir = root / "_backups" / f"tx_log_viewer_v3_{ts}"
        self.modified_files: list[str] = []
        self.created_files: list[str] = []

    def backup_file(self, path: Path) -> None:
        if not path.exists() or self.dry_run:
            return
        rel = path.relative_to(self.root)
        dest = self.backup_dir / rel
        dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(path, dest)

    def write_file(self, rel_path: str, content: str) -> None:
        target = self.root / rel_path
        existed = target.exists()
        if existed:
            old = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            if old == content:
                print(f"  [=] Unchanged: {rel_path}")
                return
            self.backup_file(target)
        if not self.dry_run:
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
        if existed:
            self.modified_files.append(rel_path)
            print(f"  [M] Updated:   {rel_path}")
        else:
            self.created_files.append(rel_path)
            print(f"  [+] Created:   {rel_path}")

    def patch_file(self, rel_path: str, marker: str, anchor: str, replacement: str) -> None:
        target = self.root / rel_path
        if not target.exists():
            raise RuntimeError(f"Target file not found: {rel_path}")
        text = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        if marker in text:
            print(f"  [=] Patch already applied ({marker}): {rel_path}")
            return
        if anchor not in text:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Expected anchor not found in {rel_path} for marker {marker}")
        new_text = text.replace(anchor, replacement, 1)
        self.backup_file(target)
        if not self.dry_run:
            target.write_text(new_text, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
        self.modified_files.append(rel_path)
        print(f"  [P] Patched ({marker}): {rel_path}")

    def validate_python_files(self, rel_paths: list[str]) -> None:
        if self.dry_run:
            return
        for rel in rel_paths:
            p = self.root / rel
            if p.exists() and p.suffix == ".py":
                py_compile.compile(str(p), doraise=True)
                print(f"  [OK] Python syntax verified: {rel}")

DATABASE_INDEXES_PY = r'''"""
database_indexes_tx_logs.py — Safe Additive Performance Indexes for Transaction Log Viewer
Creates composite and single-column indexes if they do not already exist.
Never drops or alters existing data.
"""

from sqlalchemy import text
from sqlalchemy.engine import Engine

INDEX_STATEMENTS = [
    "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_tx_logs_created_at_desc ON transactions (created_at DESC)",
    "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_tx_logs_auth_tx_status ON transactions (authorization_status, transaction_status)",
    "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_tx_logs_rrn_stan ON transactions (rrn, stan)",
    "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_tx_logs_correlation_id ON transactions (correlation_id)",
    "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_tx_logs_masked_pan ON transactions (masked_pan)",
    "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_tx_logs_ps_code_mti_rc ON transactions (ps_code, mti, response_code)",
    "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_tx_logs_issuer_acquirer ON transactions (issuer_institution_id, acquirer_institution_id)",
    "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_tx_logs_terminal_merchant ON transactions (terminal_id, merchant_id)",
    "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_tx_logs_source_account ON transactions (source_account)",
    "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_tx_trace_tx_id_order ON transaction_trace_events (transaction_id, event_order)",
]


def ensure_transaction_log_indexes(engine: Engine) -> None:
    with engine.begin() as conn:
        for stmt in INDEX_STATEMENTS:
            try:
                conn.execute(text(stmt))
            except Exception:
                pass
'''

ROUTER_PREFS_EXTENSION_PY = r'''

# [PATCH tx_log_viewer_v3:column_preferences_and_incremental_poll]
DEFAULT_TX_LOG_COLUMNS = [
    "transaction_reference",
    "date",
    "time",
    "mti",
    "transaction_type",
    "mcc",
    "terminal_id",
    "terminal_name",
    "terminal_owner",
    "issuer_code",
    "acquirer_code",
    "ps_code",
    "masked_pan",

    "currency",
    "response_code",
    "response_description",
    "approval_code",
    "rrn",
    "stan",
    "status",
]


@router.get("/preferences/columns")
def get_user_column_preferences(
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    from app.models import HostParameter
    param_name = f"TX_LOG_VIEWER_COLUMNS_{current_user.upper()}"
    param = (
        db.query(HostParameter)
        .filter(
            HostParameter.parameter_group == "UI_PREFERENCES",
            HostParameter.parameter_name == param_name,
        )
        .first()
    )
    if param and isinstance(param.parameter_value, dict) and "columns" in param.parameter_value:
        return {"columns": param.parameter_value["columns"], "default_columns": DEFAULT_TX_LOG_COLUMNS}
    return {"columns": DEFAULT_TX_LOG_COLUMNS, "default_columns": DEFAULT_TX_LOG_COLUMNS}


@router.put("/preferences/columns")
def save_user_column_preferences(
    payload: Dict[str, Any],
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    from app.models import HostParameter
    cols = payload.get("columns")
    if not isinstance(cols, list) or len(cols) == 0:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="At least one column must be selected")
    param_name = f"TX_LOG_VIEWER_COLUMNS_{current_user.upper()}"
    param = (
        db.query(HostParameter)
        .filter(
            HostParameter.parameter_group == "UI_PREFERENCES",
            HostParameter.parameter_name == param_name,
        )
        .first()
    )
    if param:
        param.parameter_value = {"columns": cols, "updated_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}
    else:
        param = HostParameter(
            parameter_group="UI_PREFERENCES",
            parameter_name=param_name,
            parameter_value={"columns": cols, "updated_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()},
            description=f"Saved Transaction Log Viewer column preferences for {current_user}",
            active=True,
        )
        db.add(param)
    db.commit()
    return {"status": "saved", "columns": cols}
'''

function getAuthHeaders(): Record<string, string> {
  const token =
    localStorage.getItem('baobab_token') ||
    localStorage.getItem('token') ||
    localStorage.getItem('access_token') ||
    sessionStorage.getItem('token') ||
    '';
  return token
    ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
    : { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
}

function StatusBadge({ status }: { status: string }) {
  const s = (status || '').toUpperCase();
  if (s === 'APPROVED') {
    return (
      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-semibold bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30">
        <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3" /> APPROVED
      </span>
    );
  }
  if (s === 'REVERSED') {
    return (
      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-semibold bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30">
        <RotateCcw className="w-3 h-3" /> REVERSED
      </span>
    );
  }
  if (s === 'PENDING') {
    return (
      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-semibold bg-sky-500/15 text-sky-400 border border-sky-500/30">
        <Clock className="w-3 h-3" /> PENDING
      </span>
    );
  }
  return (
    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-semibold bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-400 border border-rose-500/30">
      <XCircle className="w-3 h-3" /> {s || 'DECLINED'}
    </span>
  );
}

export const TransactionLogViewerPage: React.FC = () => {
  // Data state
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<TxLogRow[]>([]);
  const [summary, setSummary] = useState<TxSummaryMetrics>({
    total_transactions: 0,
    approved_transactions: 0,
    declined_transactions: 0,
    reversed_transactions: 0,
    pending_transactions: 0,
    approval_rate: 0,
    approved_volume: 0,
  });
  const [total, setTotal] = useState<number>(0);
  const [page, setPage] = useState<number>(1);
  const [pageSize, setPageSize] = useState<number>(25);
  const [totalPages, setTotalPages] = useState<number>(1);
  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState<string>('created_at');
  const [sortDir, setSortDir] = useState<'asc' | 'desc'>('desc');

  // Loading & Error
  const [initialLoading, setInitialLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [lastUpdated, setLastUpdated] = useState<string>('—');

  // Auto-refresh timer state
  const [autoRefresh, setAutoRefresh] = useState<boolean>(() => {
    try {
      const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY_REFRESH) || '{}');
      return saved.autoRefresh ?? true;
    } catch {
      return true;
    }
  });
  const [ isPaused, setIsPaused ] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [refreshIntervalSec, setRefreshIntervalSec] = useState<number>(() => {
    try {
      const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY_REFRESH) || '{}');
      return Number(saved.intervalSec) || 5;
    } catch {
      return 5;
    }
  });
  const [customIntervalInput, setCustomIntervalInput] = useState<string>('');
  const [showCustomInterval, setShowCustomInterval] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [countdown, setCountdown] = useState<number>(refreshIntervalSec);

  // Filters state (draft vs applied)
  const [draftFilters, setDraftFilters] = useState<FilterState>(EMPTY_FILTERS);
  const [appliedFilters, setAppliedFilters] = useState<FilterState>(EMPTY_FILTERS);
  const [showAdvancedFilters, setShowAdvancedFilters] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Column customization state
  const [visibleColumns, setVisibleColumns] = useState<string[]>(() => {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY_COLS);
      if (raw) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) return parsed;
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
    return DEFAULT_VISIBLE_KEYS;
  });
  const [showColModal, setShowColModal] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [draftColumns, setDraftColumns] = useState<string[]>(visibleColumns);

  // Selected Transaction for Detail Modal/Drawer
  const [selectedTxId, setSelectedTxId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [activeDetailTab, setActiveDetailTab] = useState<
    'GENERAL' | 'AUTHORIZATION' | 'ISO_DETAILS' | 'CRYPTO' | 'TRACE' | 'RELATED'
  >('GENERAL');

  // Concurrency & cleanup refs
  const inFlightRef = useRef<boolean>(false);
  const abortControllerRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  // Persist auto-refresh settings
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(
        STORAGE_KEY_REFRESH,
        JSON.stringify({ autoRefresh, intervalSec: refreshIntervalSec })
      );
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  }, [autoRefresh, refreshIntervalSec]);

  // Load saved column preferences from backend on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;
    fetch('/api/transaction-logs/preferences/columns', { headers: getAuthHeaders() })
      .then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null))
      .then((data) => {
        if (mounted && data && Array.isArray(data.columns) && data.columns.length > 0) {
          // Only overwrite if user hasn't customized locally yet
          if (!localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY_COLS)) {
            setVisibleColumns(data.columns);
            setDraftColumns(data.columns);
          }
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {});
    return () => {
      mounted = false;
    };
  }, []);

  // Build query string from appliedFilters, page, pageSize, sortBy, sortDir
  const buildQueryParams = useCallback(
    (overridePage?: number) => {
      const params = new URLSearchParams();
      params.set('page', String(overridePage ?? page));
      params.set('page_size', String(pageSize));
      params.set('sort_by', sortBy);
      params.set('sort_dir', sortDir);
      Object.entries(appliedFilters).forEach(([k, v]) => {
        if (v !== undefined && v !== null && String(v).trim() !== '') {
          params.set(k, String(v).trim());
        }
      });
      return params.toString();
    },
    [appliedFilters, page, pageSize, sortBy, sortDir]
  );

  // Core fetch function (non-overlapping, preserves scroll and selection)
  const fetchTransactions = useCallback(
    async (isBackgroundRefresh = false, overridePage?: number) => {
      if (inFlightRef.current) {
        return; // Prevent overlapping refresh requests
      }
      inFlightRef.current = true;
      if (!isBackgroundRefresh) {
        setRefreshing(true);
      } else {
        setRefreshing(true);
      }

      const controller = new AbortController();
      abortControllerRef.current = controller;

      try {
        const qs = buildQueryParams(overridePage);
        const resp = await fetch(`/api/transaction-logs?${qs}`, {
          headers: getAuthHeaders(),
          signal: controller.signal,
        });
        if (!resp.ok) {
          const errBody = await resp.json().catch(() => ({}));
          throw new Error(errBody.detail || `Database query failed (HTTP ${resp.status})`);
        }
        const data = await resp.json();
        setRows(Array.isArray(data.items) ? data.items : []);
        setTotal(Number(data.total ?? 0));
        setTotalPages(Number(data.total_pages ?? 1));
        if (data.summary) {
          setSummary(data.summary);
        }
        setLastUpdated(new Date().toLocaleTimeString());
        setErrorMsg(null);
      } catch (err: any) {
        if (err?.name !== 'AbortError') {
          setErrorMsg(err?.message || 'Unable to retrieve transaction logs from database.');
        }
      } finally {
        inFlightRef.current = false;
        setInitialLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      }
    },
    [buildQueryParams]
  );

  // 1.1 Automatic initial loading & whenever appliedFilters / page / pageSize / sort change
  useEffect(() => {
    fetchTransactions(false);
    setCountdown(refreshIntervalSec);
  }, [fetchTransactions, refreshIntervalSec]);

  // Cleanup any in-flight request when leaving the page
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (abortControllerRef.current) {
        abortControllerRef.current.abort();
      }
    };
  }, []);

  // 1.2 Automatic refresh countdown timer
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!autoRefresh || isPaused) {
      return;
    }
    const timer = window.setInterval(() => {
      setCountdown((prev) => {
        if (prev <= 1) {
          if (!inFlightRef.current) {
            fetchTransactions(true);
          }
          return refreshIntervalSec;
        }
        return prev - 1;
      });
    }, 1000);

    return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
  }, [autoRefresh, isPaused, refreshIntervalSec, fetchTransactions]);

  // Handlers
  const handleManualRefresh = () => {
    setCountdown(refreshIntervalSec);
    fetchTransactions(false);
  };

  const handleApplyFilters = (e?: React.FormEvent) => {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();
    setPage(1);
    setAppliedFilters({ ...draftFilters });
  };

  const handleClearFilters = () => {
    setDraftFilters(EMPTY_FILTERS);
    setAppliedFilters(EMPTY_FILTERS);
    setPage(1);
  };

  const handleSort = (col: ColumnDef) => {
    if (!col.sortable || !col.sortKey) return;
    if (sortBy === col.sortKey) {
      setSortDir((d) => (d === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc'));
    } else {
      setSortBy(col.sortKey);
      setSortDir('desc');
    }
  };

  const handleExportCsv = async () => {
    try {
      const qs = buildQueryParams(1);
      const resp = await fetch(`/api/transaction-logs/export?${qs}`, {
        headers: getAuthHeaders(),
      });
      if (!resp.ok) throw new Error('Failed to export CSV');
      const blob = await resp.blob();
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `baobab_transactions_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 19).replace(/[:T]/g, '_')}.csv`;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      a.remove();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err?.message || 'CSV Export failed');
    }
  };

  const handleSaveColumns = async () => {
    if (draftColumns.length === 0) {
      alert('Please select at least one column.');
      return;
    }
    setVisibleColumns(draftColumns);
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY_COLS, JSON.stringify(draftColumns));
    setShowColModal(false);
    try {
      await fetch('/api/transaction-logs/preferences/columns', {
        method: 'PUT',
        headers: getAuthHeaders(),
        body: JSON.stringify({ columns: draftColumns }),
      });
    } catch {
      // localStorage already saved
    }
  };

  const activeColumns = useMemo(
    () => ALL_COLUMNS.filter((c) => visibleColumns.includes(c.key)),
    [visibleColumns]
  );

  const activeFilterCount = useMemo(
    () => Object.values(appliedFilters).filter((v) => String(v).trim() !== '').length,
    [appliedFilters]
  );

  const startRecord = total === 0 ? 0 : (page - 1) * pageSize + 1;
  const endRecord = Math.min(total, page * pageSize);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4 text-slate-100">
      {/* HEADER BAR */}
      <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between gap-3 bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-4 shadow-lg">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-indigo-500/15 border border-indigo-500/30 text-indigo-400">
              <Activity className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-lg font-bold tracking-tight text-white">
                TRANSACTION LOG VIEWER
              </h1>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                Real-Time Host Switch Transaction Monitoring, TIC v2.164e ISO Inspector &amp; Pipeline Trace Investigator
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* AUTO-REFRESH CONTROL BAR */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5 bg-slate-950/80 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 pr-2 border-r border-slate-800">
            <span className="text-slate-400">Last Updated:</span>
            <span className="font-mono font-semibold text-emerald-400">{lastUpdated}</span>
            {refreshing && (
              <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-400 animate-spin ml-1" title="Querying database..." />
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 pr-2 border-r border-slate-800">
            <span className="text-slate-400">Auto Refresh:</span>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setAutoRefresh((v) => !v);
                setIsPaused(false);
                setCountdown(refreshIntervalSec);
              }}
              className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-bold transition ${
                autoRefresh
                  ? 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40'
                  : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 border border-slate-700'
              }`}
            >
              {autoRefresh ? 'ON' : 'OFF'}
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 pr-2 border-r border-slate-800">
            <span className="text-slate-400">Interval:</span>
            <select
              value={showCustomInterval ? 'CUSTOM' : String(refreshIntervalSec)}
              onChange={(e) => {
                const val = e.target.value;
                if (val === 'CUSTOM') {
                  setShowCustomInterval(true);
                  setCustomIntervalInput(String(refreshIntervalSec));
                } else {
                  setShowCustomInterval(false);
                  const sec = Number(val);
                  setRefreshIntervalSec(sec);
                  setCountdown(sec);
                }
              }}
              className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded px-2 py-0.5 text-slate-200 font-mono focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500"
            >
              {[2, 5, 10, 15, 30, 60].map((s) => (
                <option key={s} value={String(s)}>
                  {s}s
                </option>
              ))}
              <option value="CUSTOM">Custom...</option>
            </select>

            {showCustomInterval && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min={1}
                  max={300}
                  value={customIntervalInput}
                  onChange={(e) => setCustomIntervalInput(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-14 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-slate-200"
                  placeholder="Sec"
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    const parsed = Math.max(1, Math.min(300, Number(customIntervalInput) || 5));
                    setRefreshIntervalSec(parsed);
                    setCountdown(parsed);
                  }}
                  className="px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white rounded font-medium"
                >
                  Set
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {autoRefresh && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 pr-2 border-r border-slate-800">
              <span className="text-slate-400">Next Refresh In:</span>
              <span
                className={`font-mono font-bold px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded ${
                  isPaused ? 'text-amber-400 bg-amber-500/10' : 'text-indigo-300 bg-indigo-500/15'
                }`}
              >
                {isPaused ? 'PAUSED' : `${String(countdown).padStart(2, '0')}s`}
              </span>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleManualRefresh}
              disabled={refreshing}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:opacity-50 text-white font-medium transition"
            >
              <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${refreshing ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
              Refresh Now
            </button>

            {autoRefresh && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsPaused((p) => !p)}
                className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border font-medium transition ${
                  isPaused
                    ? 'bg-emerald-600/20 border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-300 hover:bg-emerald-600/30'
                    : 'bg-amber-500/15 border-amber-500/30 text-amber-300 hover:bg-amber-500/25'
                }`}
              >
                {isPaused ? (
                  <>
                    <Play className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Resume
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Pause className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Pause
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ERROR BANNER */}
      {errorMsg && (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between bg-rose-950/70 border border-rose-500/40 text-rose-200 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-xs">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-400 shrink-0" />
            <span>{errorMsg}</span>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleManualRefresh}
            className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-500 text-white rounded font-semibold"
          >
            Retry Query
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 2.1 SUMMARY CARDS */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-3">
        <div className="bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-3">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">
            Total Transactions
          </div>
          <div className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-white">
            {summary.total_transactions.toLocaleString()}
          </div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">Matching active filter context</div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-slate-900/90 border border-emerald-500/25 rounded-xl p-3">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-400">
            Approved
          </div>
          <div className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-emerald-400">
            {summary.approved_transactions.toLocaleString()}
          </div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5 font-mono">
            Vol: {summary.approved_volume.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-slate-900/90 border border-rose-500/25 rounded-xl p-3">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-rose-400">
            Declined
          </div>
          <div className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-rose-400">
            {summary.declined_transactions.toLocaleString()}
          </div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">Host / HSM / Rule declines</div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-slate-900/90 border border-amber-500/25 rounded-xl p-3">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-amber-400">
            Reversed
          </div>
          <div className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-amber-400">
            {summary.reversed_transactions.toLocaleString()}
          </div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">MTI 0400 / 0420 reversals</div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-slate-900/90 border border-sky-500/25 rounded-xl p-3">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-sky-400">
            Pending
          </div>
          <div className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-sky-400">
            {summary.pending_transactions.toLocaleString()}
          </div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">In-flight / awaiting advice</div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-slate-900/90 border border-indigo-500/25 rounded-xl p-3">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-400">
            Approval Rate
          </div>
          <div className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-indigo-300">
            {summary.approval_rate.toFixed(1)}%
          </div>
          <div className="w-full bg-slate-800 h-1.5 rounded-full mt-2 overflow-hidden">
            <div
              className="bg-indigo-500 h-full rounded-full transition-all"
              style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, Math.max(0, summary.approval_rate))}%` }}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 2.2 SERVER-SIDE TRANSACTION FILTERS */}
      <form
        onSubmit={handleApplyFilters}
        className="bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-3.5 space-y-3"
      >
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-300">
            <Filter className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-400" />
            <span>SERVER-SIDE TRANSACTION FILTERS</span>
            {activeFilterCount > 0 && (
              <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-500/30">
                {activeFilterCount} Active
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setShowAdvancedFilters((s) => !s)}
              className="text-xs text-indigo-400 hover:text-indigo-300 font-medium"
            >
              {showAdvancedFilters ? 'Hide Extended Filters ▲' : 'Show All 20 Filters ▼'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Primary Filter Row */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-2.5 text-xs">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-1">Txn ID / Reference</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={draftFilters.transaction_id}
              onChange={(e) => setDraftFilters({ ...draftFilters, transaction_id: e.target.value })}
              placeholder="TX-... or UUID"
              className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-slate-200 font-mono focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-none"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-1">RRN (F37)</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={draftFilters.rrn}
              onChange={(e) => setDraftFilters({ ...draftFilters, rrn: e.target.value })}
              placeholder="e.g. 000020526001"
              className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-slate-200 font-mono focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-none"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-1">STAN (F11)</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={draftFilters.stan}
              onChange={(e) => setDraftFilters({ ...draftFilters, stan: e.target.value })}
              placeholder="e.g. 100001"
              className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-slate-200 font-mono focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-none"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-1">PAN (Full or Last 4)</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={draftFilters.pan}
              onChange={(e) => setDraftFilters({ ...draftFilters, pan: e.target.value })}
              placeholder="456789... or 0001"
              className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-slate-200 font-mono focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-none"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-1">Status</label>
            <select
              value={draftFilters.status}
              onChange={(e) => setDraftFilters({ ...draftFilters, status: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-slate-200 focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-none"
            >
              <option value="">All Statuses</option>
              <option value="APPROVED">APPROVED</option>
              <option value="DECLINED">DECLINED</option>
              <option value="REVERSED">REVERSED</option>
              <option value="PENDING">PENDING</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-1">Response Code (F39)</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={draftFilters.response_code}
              onChange={(e) => setDraftFilters({ ...draftFilters, response_code: e.target.value })}
              placeholder="00, 05, 51, 55, 61..."
              className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-slate-200 font-mono focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-none"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Extended 20-Filter Grid */}
        {showAdvancedFilters && (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-2.5 pt-2 border-t border-slate-800/80 text-xs">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-1">MTI</label>
              <select
                value={draftFilters.mti}
                onChange={(e) => setDraftFilters({ ...draftFilters, mti: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-slate-200 font-mono"
              >
                <option value="">All MTIs</option>
                <option value="0100">0100 (Auth Req)</option>
                <option value="0200">0200 (Financial Req)</option>
                <option value="0220">0220 (Clearing Advice)</option>
                <option value="0400">0400 (Reversal Req)</option>
                <option value="0420">0420 (Reversal Advice)</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-1">Processing System</label>
              <select
                value={draftFilters.ps_code}
                onChange={(e) => setDraftFilters({ ...draftFilters, ps_code: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-slate-200"
              >
                <option value="">All Switches</option>
                <option value="ITCL">ITCL (QCash)</option>
                <option value="VISA">VISA</option>
                <option value="MASTERCARD">MASTERCARD</option>
                <option value="NPSB">NPSB</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-1">Issuer Bank</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={draftFilters.issuer}
                onChange={(e) => setDraftFilters({ ...draftFilters, issuer: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="XBANK, YBANK, ZBANK..."
                className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-slate-200"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-1">Acquirer Bank / ID</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={draftFilters.acquirer}
                onChange={(e) => setDraftFilters({ ...draftFilters, acquirer: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="XBANK or 123456"
                className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-slate-200"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-1">Transaction Type / Code</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={draftFilters.transaction_type}
                onChange={(e) => setDraftFilters({ ...draftFilters, transaction_type: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="Withdrawal, Purchase, 10..."
