@router.post("/bin-ranges", response_model=BinRangeOut)
def create_bin_range(payload: BinRangeCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: str = Depends(get_current_user)):
    prefix = payload.bin_prefix.strip()
    existing = db.query(BinRange).filter(BinRange.bin_prefix == prefix).first()
    if existing:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"BIN prefix '{prefix}' already exists")

    inst = db.query(Institution).filter(Institution.id == payload.institution_id).first()
    if not inst:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Institution not found")

    ps_id = payload.processing_system_id or inst.processing_system_id

    bin_low = payload.bin_low or f"{prefix}".ljust(19, "0")
    bin_high = payload.bin_high or f"{prefix}".ljust(19, "9")

    b = BinRange(
        bin_prefix=prefix,
        bin_low=bin_low,
        bin_high=bin_high,
        pan_length=payload.pan_length,
        institution_id=payload.institution_id,
        processing_system_id=ps_id,
        card_type=payload.card_type,
        card_product=payload.card_product,
        scheme=payload.scheme,
        country_code=payload.country_code,
        currency=payload.currency,
        is_on_us=payload.is_on_us,
        status=payload.status,
    )
    db.add(b)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(b)
    return _serialize_bin(b)

def update_bin_range(bin_id: str, payload: BinRangeUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: str = Depends(get_current_user)):

@router.get("/bin-ranges/lookup/{pan}")
def lookup_bin_for_pan(pan: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: str = Depends(get_current_user)):
    clean_pan = "".join(ch for ch in pan if ch.isdigit())
    if len(clean_pan) < 6:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="PAN is too short for BIN lookup (minimum 6 digits)")

    # Check 6, 8, 10, 12 digit prefixes
    matched = None
    for length in (12, 10, 8, 6):
        if len(clean_pan) >= length:
            prefix = clean_pan[:length]
            matched = db.query(BinRange).filter(BinRange.bin_prefix == prefix).first()
            if matched:
                break

    if not matched:
        # Fallback to general range check
        all_bins = db.query(BinRange).all()
        for b in all_bins:
            if b.bin_low and b.bin_high:
                if b.bin_low.ljust(19, '0') <= clean_pan.ljust(19, '0') <= b.bin_high.ljust(19, '9'):
                    matched = b
                    break

    if not matched:
        return {"found": False, "pan_masked": pan[:6] + "*" * (len(pan) - 10) + pan[-4:] if len(pan) >= 10 else "****", "message": "No matching BIN range found. Defaulting to On-Us ITCL switch."}

    return {
        "found": True,
        "bin_prefix": matched.bin_prefix,
        "institution": {
            "id": matched.institution.id,
            "code": matched.institution.institution_code,
            "name": matched.institution.name,
            "acquirer_id": matched.institution.acquirer_id,
        },
        "processing_system": {
            "id": matched.processing_system.id,
            "code": matched.processing_system.ps_code,
            "name": matched.processing_system.name,
        },
        "card_product": matched.card_product,
        "scheme": matched.scheme,
        "is_on_us": matched.is_on_us,
    }
'''

def main() -> int:
    args = parse_installer_args("Step 01_02: FastAPI Router for Processing Systems, Institutions & BINs + Tests")
    session = PatcherSession(
        step_id="step01_02",
        title="Implement Institutions & Processing Systems API Router and Pytest Suite",
        dry_run=args.dry_run,
    )

    # 1. Write backend/app/routers/institutions_router.py
    session.write_file("backend/app/routers/institutions_router.py", INSTITUTIONS_ROUTER_CODE)

    # 2. Write backend/tests/test_step01_institutions.py
    session.write_file("backend/tests/test_step01_institutions.py", TEST_INSTITUTIONS_CODE)

    # 3. Patch backend/app/main.py to include institutions_router
    session.patch_file(
        "backend/app/main.py",
        [
            {
                "marker": "step01_02:include_institutions_router",
                "action": "insert_after",
                "anchor": "from app.api_routes import router",
                "text": "from app.routers.institutions_router import router as institutions_router",
            },
            {
                "marker": "step01_02:app_include_router_inst",
                "action": "insert_after",
                "anchor": "app.include_router(router)",
                "text": "app.include_router(institutions_router)",
            },
        ],
    )

    session.record_progress(
        completed=[
            "Created `backend/app/routers/institutions_router.py` with endpoints for processing systems, institutions, multi-network links, and BIN range prefix lookups.",
            "Wired `institutions_router` into `backend/app/main.py`.",
            "Created automated test suite `backend/tests/test_step01_institutions.py`.",
        ],
        remaining=[
            "Step 1 Script 3 of 3 (`tools/install_step01_03.py`): Create React UI page `InstitutionsAndBinsPage.tsx` and wire navigation in `App.tsx` and `Layout.tsx`.",
        ],
        modified_files=[
            "backend/app/routers/institutions_router.py",
            "backend/app/main.py",
            "backend/tests/test_step01_institutions.py",
        ],
    )

    session.record_contracts(
        section_title="Step 1.2 — Processing Systems & Institutions API Contracts",
        contract_items=[
            "**GET /api/processing-systems**: Returns all active processing switches.",
            "**POST /api/processing-systems**: Registers a new processing system.",
            "**GET /api/institutions**: Returns all member banks with their primary processing system code.",
            "**POST /api/institutions**: Creates a new bank (defaults to **ITCL** if `processing_system_id` is omitted).",
            "**GET /api/institutions/{inst_id}/networks**: Lists secondary network participations.",
            "**POST /api/institutions/{inst_id}/networks**: Links a bank to VISA, Mastercard, or NPSB.",
            "**GET /api/bin-ranges**: Lists BIN prefixes.",
            "**GET /api/bin-ranges/lookup/{pan}**: Resolves a PAN to its issuing bank and processing system.",
        ],
    )

    return session.finish()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

import { Landmark, Cpu, Network, CreditCard, Plus, Trash2, Search, CheckCircle2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { apiFetch } from '../api';

export const InstitutionsAndBinsPage: React.FC = () => {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'INST' | 'PS' | 'NET' | 'BINS'>('INST');
  const [institutions, setInstitutions] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [processingSystems, setProcessingSystems] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [networks, setNetworks] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [bins, setBins] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [lookupPan, setLookupPan] = useState('4567890123450001');
  const [lookupResult, setLookupResult] = useState<any>(null);
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState('');

  // Forms state
  const [instForm, setInstForm] = useState({
    institution_code: 'IFIC',
    name: 'IFIC Bank PLC',
    short_name: 'IFIC',
    acquirer_id: '554433',
    forwarding_id: '554433',
    role: 'BOTH',
    ps_code: 'ITCL',
    country_code: '050',
    currency: 'BDT',
    settlement_account_number: 'SETL-IFIC-001',
  });

  const [binForm, setBinForm] = useState({
    bin_prefix: '456795',
    institution_id: '',
    card_type: 'DEBIT',
    card_product: 'VISA_DEBIT_GOLD',
    scheme: 'ITCL',
    is_on_us: true,
  });

  const loadAll = async () => {
    try {
      const [iList, psList, bList] = await Promise.all([
        apiFetch('/institutions'),
        apiFetch('/processing-systems'),
        apiFetch('/bin-ranges'),
      ]);
      setInstitutions(iList);
      setProcessingSystems(psList);
      setBins(bList);
      if (iList.length > 0 && !binForm.institution_id) {
        setBinForm((f) => ({ ...f, institution_id: iList[0].id }));
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadAll();
  }, []);

  const handleCreateInstitution = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      await apiFetch('/institutions', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify(instForm),
      });
      setMsg(`Successfully registered institution ${instForm.institution_code} under ITCL switch.`);
      loadAll();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setMsg(`Error: ${err.message}`);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateBin = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      await apiFetch('/bin-ranges', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify(binForm),
      });
      setMsg(`Successfully added BIN range prefix ${binForm.bin_prefix}`);
      loadAll();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setMsg(`Error: ${err.message}`);
    }
  };

  const handleLookupPan = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch(`/bin-ranges/lookup/${lookupPan}`);
      setLookupResult(res);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setLookupResult({ found: false, message: err.message });
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteInstitution = async (id: string) => {
    if (!confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this institution?')) return;
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/institutions/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
      setMsg('Institution deleted successfully.');
      loadAll();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setMsg(`Cannot delete: ${err.message}`);
    }

              <input

                onChange={(e) => setInstForm({ ...instForm, institution_code: e.target.value })}

                className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-3 py-2 text-xs font-mono"

def main() -> int:
    args = parse_installer_args("Step 01_03: React Institutions and BIN Manager Page UI + Routing & Navigation")
    session = PatcherSession(
        step_id="step01_03",
        title="Implement Institutions & BINs React Workbench UI and Navigation",
        dry_run=args.dry_run,
    )

    # 1. Write frontend/src/pages/InstitutionsAndBinsPage.tsx
    session.write_file("frontend/src/pages/InstitutionsAndBinsPage.tsx", INSTITUTIONS_PAGE_CODE)

    # 2. Patch frontend/src/App.tsx to add /institutions route
    session.patch_file(
        "frontend/src/App.tsx",
        [
            {
                "marker": "step01_03:app_import_institutions",
                "action": "insert_after",
                "anchor": "import {\n  CustomersPage,\n  CardsPage,\n  AccountsPage,\n  CardLimitsPage,\n  AccountLimitsPage,\n} from './pages/BankingEntities';",
                "text": "import { InstitutionsAndBinsPage } from './pages/InstitutionsAndBinsPage';",
            },
            {
                "marker": "step01_03:app_route_institutions",
                "action": "insert_after",
                "anchor": "        <Route\n          path=\"/accounts\"\n          element={\n            <ProtectedRoute>\n              <AccountsPage />\n            </ProtectedRoute>\n          }\n        />",
                "text": (
                    "        <Route\n"
                    "          path=\"/institutions\"\n          element={\n"
                    "            <ProtectedRoute>\n"
                    "              <InstitutionsAndBinsPage />\n"
                    "            </ProtectedRoute>\n"
                    "          }\n"
                    "        />"
                ),
            },
        ],
    )

    # 3. Patch frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx to add navigation item under CORE BANKING
    session.patch_file(
        "frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx",
        [
            {
                "marker": "step01_03:layout_nav_institutions",
                "action": "insert_after",
                "anchor": "  { to: '/accounts', label: '4. Accounts & Ledger', icon: Landmark, group: 'CORE BANKING' },",

def test_entities_have_institution_links(db_session):
    xbank = db_session.query(Institution).filter(Institution.institution_code == "XBANK").first()
    assert xbank is not None

    cust = db_session.query(Customer).first()
    assert cust.institution_id == xbank.id

    acct = db_session.query(Account).first()
    assert acct.institution_id == xbank.id

    card = db_session.query(Card).first()
    assert card.institution_id == xbank.id


def test_transaction_records_institution_and_ps_code(db_session):
    proc = HostTransactionProcessor(db_session)
    res = proc.process_transaction({
        "transaction_code": "10",
        "mti": "0200",
        "test_clear_pin_helper": "1234",
        "fields": {
            "2": "4567890123450001",
            "3": "0100000",
            "4": "000000150000",
            "11": "300001",
            "32": "123456",  # XBANK acquirer ID
            "37": "000095000001",
            "41": "ATM01",
            "49": "BDT",
        },
    })
    assert res["response_code"] == "00"

    tx = db_session.query(Transaction).filter(Transaction.id == res["transaction_id"]).first()
    assert tx is not None
    assert tx.ps_code == "ITCL"
    assert tx.is_on_us is True
    assert tx.issuer_institution_id is not None
    assert tx.acquirer_institution_id is not None
    assert tx.issuer_institution_id == tx.acquirer_institution_id


def test_api_creates_card_with_institution(client, db_session):
    ybank = db_session.query(Institution).filter(Institution.institution_code == "YBANK").first()
    cust = db_session.query(Customer).first()
    acct = db_session.query(Account).first()

    payload = {

        "test_pan_reference": "5123450123459999",
        "cardholder_name": "YBANK TEST HOLDER",
        "expiry_month": 12,
        "expiry_year": 2028,
        "linked_account_id": acct.id,
        "institution_id": ybank.id,
    }
    res = client.post("/api/cards", json=payload)
    assert res.status_code == 200
    data = res.json()
    assert data["institution_id"] == ybank.id
    assert data["institution_code"] == "YBANK"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
INSTALLER: tools/install_step03_01.py
STEP 3 — Full CRUD and Audit Trail — Script 1 of 3
Adds:
  1. AuditTrail ORM model in backend/app/models.py
  2. Pydantic v2 schemas for CustomerUpdate, AccountUpdate, CardUpdate, AuditTrailOut in backend/app/schemas.py
  3. backend/app/audit_service.py for capturing before/after state diffs
  4. PUT and DELETE endpoints with 409 Conflict protection for Customers, Accounts, Cards
  5. GET /api/audit-trail endpoint in backend/app/api_routes.py
  6. Automated Pytest test suite in backend/tests/test_step03_crud_and_audit.py
"""

from pathlib import Path
import sys

BASE_DIR = Path(r"E:\HOST_VSCODE\host-simulator").resolve()
sys.path.insert(0, str(BASE_DIR))

from tools.patcher import PatcherSession, parse_installer_args

AUDIT_SERVICE_CODE = '''"""
audit_service.py — Entity Snapshot and Audit Trail Logger
Captures before/after JSON states and diff summaries for regulatory audit compliance.
"""

from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from app.models import AuditTrail


def serialize_entity(entity: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Serialize a SQLAlchemy declarative model into a clean JSON-serializable dict."""
    if entity is None:
        return {}
    out: Dict[str, Any] = {}
    for col in entity.__table__.columns:
        val = getattr(entity, col.name, None)
        if hasattr(val, "isoformat"):
            out[col.name] = val.isoformat()
        elif hasattr(val, "__float__"):
            out[col.name] = float(val)
        else:
            out[col.name] = val
    return out


def record_audit(
    db: Session,
    entity_type: str,
    entity_id: str,
    action: str,
    performed_by: str = "admin",
    before_state: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    after_state: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    change_summary: Optional[str] = None,
) -> AuditTrail:
    """Record an immutable audit trail entry."""
    entry = AuditTrail(
        entity_type=entity_type.upper(),
        entity_id=str(entity_id),
        action=action.upper(),
        performed_by=performed_by,
        before_state=before_state,
        after_state=after_state,
        change_summary=change_summary,
    )
    db.add(entry)
    db.flush()
    return entry
'''

def test_customer_update_creates_audit_entry(client, db_session):
    cust = db_session.query(Customer).first()
    assert cust is not None

    update_payload = {
        "first_name": "Tariq Updated",
        "email": "tariq.new@example.test",
        "risk_category": "VIP"
    }
    res = client.put(f"/api/customers/{cust.id}", json=update_payload)
    assert res.status_code == 200
    data = res.json()
    assert data["first_name"] == "Tariq Updated"
    assert data["risk_category"] == "VIP"

    audit = (
        db_session.query(AuditTrail)
        .filter(AuditTrail.entity_type == "CUSTOMER", AuditTrail.entity_id == cust.id)
        .order_by(AuditTrail.created_at.desc())
        .first()
    )
    assert audit is not None
    assert audit.action == "UPDATE"
    assert audit.before_state["first_name"] == "Tariq"
    assert audit.after_state["first_name"] == "Tariq Updated"


def test_delete_customer_with_linked_accounts_fails_409(client, db_session):
    cust = db_session.query(Customer).filter(Customer.accounts.any()).first()
    assert cust is not None

    # Normal delete without force must return 409 Conflict
    res = client.delete(f"/api/customers/{cust.id}")
    assert res.status_code == 409
    assert "active accounts" in res.json()["detail"].lower()


def test_card_update_and_audit(client, db_session):
    card = db_session.query(Card).first()
    assert card is not None

    payload = {
        "cardholder_name": "NEW CARDHOLDER NAME",
        "expiry_month": 11,
        "expiry_year": 2029,
        "card_status": "BLOCKED"
    }
    res = client.put(f"/api/cards/{card.id}", json=payload)
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["cardholder_name"] == "NEW CARDHOLDER NAME"
    assert res.json()["card_status"] == "BLOCKED"

    audit = (
        db_session.query(AuditTrail)
        .filter(AuditTrail.entity_type == "CARD", AuditTrail.entity_id == card.id)
        .order_by(AuditTrail.created_at.desc())
        .first()
    )
    assert audit is not None
    assert audit.action == "UPDATE"
    assert audit.after_state["card_status"] == "BLOCKED"


def test_query_audit_trail_endpoint(client, db_session):
    res = client.get("/api/audit-trail")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert isinstance(res.json(), list)

def test_card_profile_crud_and_conflict_check(client, db_session):
    # 1. Create a custom profile
    payload = {
        "profile_code": "PROF_CUSTOM_01",
        "profile_name": "Custom Student Debit Profile",
        "card_product": "VISA_STUDENT",
        "domestic_enabled": True,
        "international_enabled": False,
        "ecommerce_enabled": False,
        "contactless_enabled": True,
        "cash_enabled": True
    }
    create_res = client.post("/api/card-profiles", json=payload)
    assert create_res.status_code == 200
    prof_id = create_res.json()["id"]

    # 2. Update the profile
    update_res = client.put(f"/api/card-profiles/{prof_id}", json={"ecommerce_enabled": True})
    assert update_res.status_code == 200
    assert update_res.json()["ecommerce_enabled"] is True

    # 3. Check audit trail
    audit = db_session.query(AuditTrail).filter(
        AuditTrail.entity_type == "CARD_PROFILE",
        AuditTrail.entity_id == prof_id,
        AuditTrail.action == "UPDATE"
    ).first()
    assert audit is not None
    assert audit.after_state["ecommerce_enabled"] is True

    # 4. Deleting a profile referenced by cards must return 409
    std_prof = db_session.query(CardProfile).filter(CardProfile.profile_code == "PROF_DOM_STD").first()
    del_conflict = client.delete(f"/api/card-profiles/{std_prof.id}")
    assert del_conflict.status_code == 409

    # 5. Deleting unreferenced custom profile succeeds
    del_ok = client.delete(f"/api/card-profiles/{prof_id}")
    assert del_ok.status_code == 200

def main() -> int:
    args = parse_installer_args("Step 03_02: CRUD and Audit Trail for Config & Cryptographic Resources")
    session = PatcherSession(
        step_id="step03_02",

        dry_run=args.dry_run,
    )

    # 1. Patch backend/app/schemas.py to add CardProfile schemas, HsmKeyReferenceUpdate, and ResponseCodeUpdate

        "backend/app/schemas.py",
        [

                    "    transaction_permissions: Dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)\n"

                    "    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)\n\n\n"
                    "class HsmKeyReferenceUpdate(BaseModel):\n"

    # 2. Patch backend/app/api_routes.py to add card profile CRUD, key updates, and parameter/code deletions

                "text": (
                    "# --- CARD PROFILES CRUD ---\n\n"
                    "@router.get('/card-profiles', response_model=List[CardProfileOut])\n"

                    "    return db.query(CardProfile).order_by(CardProfile.profile_code.asc()).all()\n\n\n"
                    "@router.post('/card-profiles', response_model=CardProfileOut)\n"
                    "def create_card_profile(payload: CardProfileCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user)):\n"
                    "    p_code = payload.profile_code.upper().strip()\n"

                    "                 change_summary=f'Created card profile {prof.profile_code}')\n"
                    "    db.commit()\n"
                    "    db.refresh(prof)\n"
                    "    return prof\n\n\n"

                    "    prof = db.query(CardProfile).filter(CardProfile.id == profile_id).first()\n"
                    "    if not prof:\n"
                    "        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail='Card profile not found')\n"
                    "    before = serialize_entity(prof)\n"
                    "    for k, v in payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True).items():\n"
                    "        setattr(prof, k, v)\n"
                    "    after = serialize_entity(prof)\n"
                    "    record_audit(db, 'CARD_PROFILE', prof.id, 'UPDATE', performed_by=current_user, before_state=before, after_state=after,\n"
                    "                 change_summary=f'Updated card profile {prof.profile_code}')\n"
                    "    db.commit()\n"
                    "    db.refresh(prof)\n"
                    "    return prof\n\n\n"
                    "@router.delete('/card-profiles/{profile_id}')\n"
                    "def delete_card_profile(profile_id: str, force: bool = Query(False), db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user)):\n"
                    "    prof = db.query(CardProfile).filter(CardProfile.id == profile_id).first()\n"
                    "    if not prof:\n"
                    "        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail='Card profile not found')\n"
                    "    has_cards = db.query(Card).filter(Card.card_profile_id == prof.id).first() is not None\n"
                    "    if has_cards and not force:\n"
                    "        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=f'Cannot delete card profile {prof.profile_code} assigned to active cards. Reassign cards first or use ?force=true')\n"
                    "    before = serialize_entity(prof)\n"
                    "    db.delete(prof)\n"
                    "    record_audit(db, 'CARD_PROFILE', profile_id, 'DELETE', performed_by=current_user, before_state=before,\n"
                    "                 change_summary=f'Deleted card profile {prof.profile_code} (Force: {force})')\n"

AUDIT_PAGE_CODE = '''import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

  const [entityType, setEntityType] = useState('');
  const [selectedAudit, setSelectedAudit] = useState<any | null>(null);

  const load = async () => {
    try {
      const q = entityType ? `?entity_type=${entityType}` : '';
      const res = await apiFetch(`/audit-trail${q}`);
      setLogs(res);
      if (res.length > 0 && !selectedAudit) setSelectedAudit(res[0]);

      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, [entityType]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">

          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <select
            value={entityType}

def test_link_multiple_accounts_to_card(client, db_session):
    card = db_session.query(Card).first()
    cust = card.customer

    # Create a secondary CURRENT account for the customer
    sec_acct = Account(
        account_number="2002009999",
        customer_id=cust.id,
        account_type="CURRENT",
        currency="BDT",
        available_balance=Decimal("50000.00"),
        ledger_balance=Decimal("50000.00"),
        account_status="ACTIVE",
        institution_id=card.institution_id,
    )
    db_session.add(sec_acct)
    db_session.commit()

    # Link secondary account to card via API
    payload = {
        "account_id": sec_acct.id,
        "account_role": "SECONDARY",
        "priority": 2,
    }
    res = client.post(f"/api/cards/{card.id}/accounts", json=payload)
    assert res.status_code == 200
    data = res.json()
    assert data["account_number"] == "2002009999"
    assert data["account_role"] == "SECONDARY"
    assert data["priority"] == 2

    # Query card accounts
    get_res = client.get(f"/api/cards/{card.id}/accounts")
    assert get_res.status_code == 200
    links = get_res.json()
    assert len(links) >= 2


def test_de3_account_selection_savings_vs_current(db_session):
    proc = HostTransactionProcessor(db_session)
    card = db_session.query(Card).filter(Card.test_pan_reference == "4567890123450001").first()

    # Seeded primary account is SAVINGS (balance: 150,000.00)
    primary_acct = db_session.query(Account).filter(Account.id == card.linked_account_id).first()
    assert primary_acct.account_type == "SAVINGS"

    # Add a CURRENT account with 20,000.00 balance
    curr_acct = Account(
        account_number="2002008888",
        customer_id=card.customer_id,
        account_type="CURRENT",
        currency="BDT",
        available_balance=Decimal("20000.00"),
        ledger_balance=Decimal("20000.00"),
        account_status="ACTIVE",
        institution_id=card.institution_id,
    )
    db_session.add(curr_acct)
    db_session.flush()

    # Link CURRENT account to the card
    db_session.add(
        CardAccount(
            card_id=card.id,
            account_id=curr_acct.id,
            account_role="SECONDARY",
            currency="BDT",
            priority=2,
            status="ACTIVE",
        )
    )
    db_session.commit()

    # Transaction 1: DE3 = 0100100 (digits 3-4 = 01 -> Current/Checking account requested)
    res_curr = proc.process_transaction({
        "transaction_code": "10",
        "mti": "0200",
        "test_clear_pin_helper": "1234",
        "fields": {
            "2": card.test_pan_reference,
            "3": "0100100",  # 010 (tran code) + 01 (From Checking) + 00 (To Unspecified)
            "4": "000000050000",  # 500.00 BDT
            "11": "400001",
            "37": "000099000001",
            "41": "ATM01",
            "49": "BDT",
        },
    })
    assert res_curr["response_code"] == "00"
    tx_curr = db_session.query(Transaction).filter(Transaction.id == res_curr["transaction_id"]).first()
    assert tx_curr.account_id == curr_acct.id

    # Transaction 2: DE3 = 0101100 (digits 3-4 = 11 -> Savings account requested)
    res_sav = proc.process_transaction({
        "transaction_code": "10",
        "mti": "0200",
        "test_clear_pin_helper": "1234",
        "fields": {
            "2": card.test_pan_reference,
            "3": "0101100",  # 010 (tran code) + 11 (From Savings) + 00 (To Unspecified)
            "4": "000000050000",  # 500.00 BDT
            "11": "400002",
            "37": "000099000002",
            "41": "ATM01",
            "49": "BDT",
        },
    })
    assert res_sav["response_code"] == "00"
    tx_sav = db_session.query(Transaction).filter(Transaction.id == res_sav["transaction_id"]).first()
    assert tx_sav.account_id == primary_acct.id
'''


def main() -> int:
    args = parse_installer_args("Step 04: Complete Card and Account Multi-Linking")
    session = PatcherSession(
        step_id="step04",
        title="Implement Complete Multi-Account Card Linking & DE3 Account Selection Engine",
        dry_run=args.dry_run,
    )

    # 1. Patch backend/app/schemas.py to add CardAccount schemas
    session.patch_file(
        "backend/app/schemas.py",
        [
            {
                "marker": "step04:schemas_card_account_links",
                "action": "append",
                "text": (
                    "\n# ==============================================================================\n"
                    "# STEP 4 SCHEMAS: CARD & ACCOUNT MULTI-LINKING\n"
                    "# ==============================================================================\n\n"
                    "class CardAccountLinkCreate(BaseModel):\n"
                    "    account_id: str\n"
                    '    account_role: str = "SECONDARY"  # PRIMARY, SECONDARY\n'
                    "    priority: int = 2\n"
                    '    status: str = "ACTIVE"\n\n\n'
                    "class CardAccountLinkUpdate(BaseModel):\n"
                    "    account_role: Optional[str] = None\n"
                    "    priority: Optional[int] = None\n"
                    "    status: Optional[str] = None\n\n\n"
                    "class CardAccountLinkOut(BaseModel):\n"
                    "    id: str\n"
                    "    card_id: str\n"
                    "    account_id: str\n"
                    "    account_number: Optional[str] = None\n"
                    "    account_type: Optional[str] = None\n"
                    "    currency: str\n"
                    "    available_balance: Optional[float] = None\n"
                    "    account_role: str\n"
                    "    priority: int\n"
                    "    status: str\n"
                    "    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)\n"
                ),
            }
        ],
    )

    # 2. Patch backend/app/api_routes.py to add endpoints for card accounts
    session.patch_file(
        "backend/app/api_routes.py",
        [
            {
                "marker": "step04:api_routes_schema_imports",
                "action": "insert_after",
                "anchor": "    CardUpdate,",
                "text": (
                    "    CardAccountLinkCreate,\n"
                    "    CardAccountLinkOut,\n"
                    "    CardAccountLinkUpdate,"
                ),
            },
            {
                "marker": "step04:api_card_account_endpoints",
                "action": "insert_before",
                "anchor": "# ==============================================================================\n# 3. TRANSACTION CODES, HOST CONFIGURATION & RESPONSE CODES",
                "text": (
                    "# --- CARD & ACCOUNT MULTI-LINKING (STEP 4) ---\n\n"
                    "@router.get('/cards/{card_id}/accounts', response_model=List[CardAccountLinkOut])\n"
                    "def list_card_accounts(card_id: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: str = Depends(get_current_user)):\n"
                    "    card = db.query(Card).filter(Card.id == card_id).first()\n"
                    "    if not card:\n"
                    "        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail='Card not found')\n"
                    "    links = db.query(CardAccount).filter(CardAccount.card_id == card.id).order_by(CardAccount.priority.asc()).all()\n"
                    "    out = []\n"
                    "    for l in links:\n"
                    "        acct = l.account\n"
                    "        out.append({\n"
                    "            'id': l.id,\n"
                    "            'card_id': l.card_id,\n"
                    "            'account_id': l.account_id,\n"
                    "            'account_number': acct.account_number if acct else None,\n"
                    "            'account_type': acct.account_type if acct else None,\n"
                    "            'currency': l.currency,\n"
                    "            'available_balance': float(acct.available_balance) if acct else 0.0,\n"
                    "            'account_role': l.account_role,\n"
                    "            'priority': l.priority,\n"
                    "            'status': l.status,\n"
                    "        })\n"
                    "    return out\n\n\n"
                    "@router.post('/cards/{card_id}/accounts', response_model=CardAccountLinkOut)\n"
                    "def link_account_to_card(card_id: str, payload: CardAccountLinkCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user)):\n"
                    "    card = db.query(Card).filter(Card.id == card_id).first()\n"
                    "    if not card:\n"
                    "        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail='Card not found')\n"
                    "    acct = db.query(Account).filter(Account.id == payload.account_id).first()\n"
                    "    if not acct:\n"
                    "        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail='Account not found')\n"
                    "    existing = db.query(CardAccount).filter(CardAccount.card_id == card.id, CardAccount.account_id == acct.id).first()\n"
                    "    if existing:\n"
                    "        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail='Account is already linked to this card')\n\n"
                    "    if payload.account_role == 'PRIMARY':\n"
                    "        db.query(CardAccount).filter(CardAccount.card_id == card.id).update({'account_role': 'SECONDARY'}, synchronize_session=False)\n"
                    "        card.linked_account_id = acct.id\n\n"
                    "    link = CardAccount(\n"
                    "        card_id=card.id,\n"
                    "        account_id=acct.id,\n"
                    "        account_role=payload.account_role,\n"
                    "        currency=acct.currency,\n"
                    "        priority=payload.priority,\n"
                    "        status=payload.status,\n"
                    "    )\n"
                    "    db.add(link)\n"
                    "    db.flush()\n"
                    "    record_audit(db, 'CARD_ACCOUNT', link.id, 'CREATE', performed_by=current_user,\n"
                    "                 after_state=serialize_entity(link),\n"
                    "                 change_summary=f'Linked account {acct.account_number} to card {card.masked_pan} as {payload.account_role}')\n"
                    "    db.commit()\n"
                    "    db.refresh(link)\n"
                    "    return {\n"
                    "        'id': link.id,\n"
                    "        'card_id': link.card_id,\n"
                    "        'account_id': link.account_id,\n"
                    "        'account_number': acct.account_number,\n"
                    "        'account_type': acct.account_type,\n"
                    "        'currency': link.currency,\n"
                    "        'available_balance': float(acct.available_balance),\n"
                    "        'account_role': link.account_role,\n"
                    "        'priority': link.priority,\n"
                    "        'status': link.status,\n"
                    "    }\n\n\n"
                    "@router.put('/cards/accounts/{link_id}', response_model=CardAccountLinkOut)\n"
                    "def update_card_account_link(link_id: str, payload: CardAccountLinkUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user)):\n"
                    "    link = db.query(CardAccount).filter(CardAccount.id == link_id).first()\n"
                    "    if not link:\n"
                    "        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail='Card account link not found')\n"
                    "    before = serialize_entity(link)\n"
                    "    if payload.account_role == 'PRIMARY':\n"
                    "        db.query(CardAccount).filter(CardAccount.card_id == link.card_id).update({'account_role': 'SECONDARY'}, synchronize_session=False)\n"
                    "        card = db.query(Card).filter(Card.id == link.card_id).first()\n"
                    "        if card:\n"
                    "            card.linked_account_id = link.account_id\n\n"
                    "    for k, v in payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True).items():\n"
                    "        setattr(link, k, v)\n"
                    "    after = serialize_entity(link)\n"
                    "    record_audit(db, 'CARD_ACCOUNT', link.id, 'UPDATE', performed_by=current_user, before_state=before, after_state=after,\n"
                    "                 change_summary=f'Updated card account link {link.id}')\n"
                    "    db.commit()\n"
                    "    db.refresh(link)\n"
                    "    acct = link.account\n"
                    "    return {\n"
                    "        'id': link.id,\n"
                    "        'card_id': link.card_id,\n"
                    "        'account_id': link.account_id,\n"
                    "        'account_number': acct.account_number if acct else None,\n"
                    "        'account_type': acct.account_type if acct else None,\n"
                    "        'currency': link.currency,\n"
                    "        'available_balance': float(acct.available_balance) if acct else 0.0,\n"
                    "        'account_role': link.account_role,\n"
                    "        'priority': link.priority,\n"
                    "        'status': link.status,\n"
                    "    }\n\n\n"
                    "@router.delete('/cards/accounts/{link_id}')\n"
                    "def unlink_account_from_card(link_id: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user)):\n"
                    "    link = db.query(CardAccount).filter(CardAccount.id == link_id).first()\n"
                    "    if not link:\n"
                    "        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail='Card account link not found')\n"
                    "    remaining = db.query(CardAccount).filter(CardAccount.card_id == link.card_id).count()\n"
                    "    if remaining <= 1:\n"
                    "        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail='Cannot unlink the only account from a card. A card must have at least one linked account.')\n"
                    "    before = serialize_entity(link)\n"
                    "    db.delete(link)\n"
                    "    record_audit(db, 'CARD_ACCOUNT', link_id, 'DELETE', performed_by=current_user, before_state=before,\n"
                    "                 change_summary=f'Unlinked account {link.account_id} from card {link.card_id}')\n"
                    "    db.commit()\n"
                    "    return {'status': 'deleted', 'link_id': link_id}\n\n"
                ),
            },
        ],
    )

    # 3. Patch backend/app/host_engine.py to select target account using DE3 digits 3-4
    session.patch_file(
        "backend/app/host_engine.py",
        [
            {
                "marker": "step04:host_engine_de3_account_selection",
                "action": "replace",
                "anchor": (

                "text": (
                    "        # Step 4: Multi-Account Resolution via DE3 Processing Code (Digits 3-4 = From Account Type)\n"
                    "        # 01 = Checking / Current, 11 = Savings, 31 = Credit, 00 = Default Primary\n"
                    "        from_acct_type = proc_code[3:5] if len(proc_code) >= 5 else '00'\n"
                    "        acct_type_target = None\n"
                    "        if from_acct_type in ('01', '02', '20'):\n"
                    "            acct_type_target = 'CURRENT'\n"
                    "        elif from_acct_type in ('10', '11'):\n"
                    "            acct_type_target = 'SAVINGS'\n"
                    "        elif from_acct_type in ('30', '31'):\n"
                    "            acct_type_target = 'CREDIT'\n\n"
                    "        active_card_accts = (\n"
                    "            self.db.query(CardAccount)\n"
                    "            .filter(CardAccount.card_id == card.id, CardAccount.status == 'ACTIVE')\n"
                    "            .order_by(CardAccount.priority.asc())\n"
                    "            .all()\n"
                    "        )\n\n"
                    "        selected_card_acct = None\n"
                    "        if acct_type_target and active_card_accts:\n"
                    "            for ca in active_card_accts:\n"
                    "                if ca.account and ca.account.account_type == acct_type_target:\n"
                    "                    selected_card_acct = ca\n"
                    "                    break\n\n"
                    "        if not selected_card_acct and active_card_accts:\n"
                    "            selected_card_acct = active_card_accts[0]\n\n"
                    "        account_id = selected_card_acct.account_id if selected_card_acct else card.linked_account_id"
                ),
            }

    )

    # 4. Patch frontend/src/pages/BankingEntities.tsx to add Multi-Account Modal in CardsPage
    session.patch_file(

  3. Interactive search toolbars and pagination controls in BankingEntities.tsx & SimulatorAndJournal.tsx

def test_customer_pagination_and_search(client, db_session):
    # Test search by partial name
    res = client.get("/api/customers?q=Tariq&page=1&page_size=10")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    data = res.json()
    assert "items" in data
    assert data["total"] >= 1
    assert any("Tariq" in c["first_name"] for c in data["items"])


def test_card_search_by_partial_pan_and_status(client, db_session):
    # Test search by partial PAN digits "0003" (which is seeded as BLOCKED)
    res = client.get("/api/cards?pan=0003&status=BLOCKED")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    data = res.json()
    assert "items" in data
    assert data["total"] == 1
    assert data["items"][0]["card_status"] == "BLOCKED"

def main() -> int:
    args = parse_installer_args("Step 05: Advanced Search and Pagination")
    session = PatcherSession(
        step_id="step05",
        title="Add Advanced Search, Filtering, and Server-Side Pagination Across All Entities",
        dry_run=args.dry_run,
    )

    # 1. Patch backend/app/schemas.py to add generic pagination schema
    session.patch_file(
        "backend/app/schemas.py",
        [
            {
                "marker": "step05:schema_paginated_response",
                "action": "append",
                "text": (
                    "\n# ==============================================================================\n"
                    "# STEP 5 SCHEMAS: PAGINATED RESPONSE ENVELOPE\n"
                    "# ==============================================================================\n\n"
                    "from typing import Generic, TypeVar\n\n"
                    "T = TypeVar('T')\n\n"
                    "class PaginatedResponse(BaseModel, Generic[T]):\n"
                    "    items: List[T]\n"
                    "    total: int\n"
                    "    page: int\n"
                    "    page_size: int\n"
                    "    total_pages: int\n"
                ),
            }
        ],
    )

    # 2. Patch backend/app/api_routes.py to support advanced search & pagination on /customers, /accounts, /cards, /transactions
    session.patch_file(
        "backend/app/api_routes.py",
        [
            {
                "marker": "step05:api_routes_import_paginated",
                "action": "insert_after",
                "anchor": "from app.schemas import (",
                "text": "    PaginatedResponse,",
            },
            # Upgrade GET /customers with query filters and pagination
            {
                "marker": "step05:api_customers_paginated",
                "action": "replace",
                "anchor": (
                    "@router.get(\"/customers\", response_model=List[CustomerOut])\n"
                    "def list_customers(db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: str = Depends(get_current_user)):\n"
                    "    return db.query(Customer).order_by(Customer.created_at.desc()).all()"
                ),
                "text": (
                    "@router.get('/customers', response_model=PaginatedResponse[CustomerOut])\n"
                    "def list_customers(\n"
                    "    q: Optional[str] = Query(None, description='Search by customer number, name, email, or mobile'),\n"
                    "    institution_id: Optional[str] = Query(None),\n"
                    "    status: Optional[str] = Query(None),\n"
                    "    page: int = Query(1, ge=1),\n"
                    "    page_size: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100),\n"
                    "    db: Session = Depends(get_db),\n"
                    "    _: str = Depends(get_current_user),\n"
                    "):\n"
                    "    query = db.query(Customer)\n"
                    "    if q:\n"
                    "        term = f'%{q.strip()}%'\n"
                    "        query = query.filter(\n"
                    "            (Customer.customer_number.ilike(term)) |\n"
                    "            (Customer.first_name.ilike(term)) |\n"
                    "            (Customer.last_name.ilike(term)) |\n"
                    "            (Customer.email.ilike(term)) |\n"
                    "            (Customer.mobile_number.ilike(term))\n"
                    "        )\n"
                    "    if institution_id:\n"
                    "        query = query.filter(Customer.institution_id == institution_id)\n"
                    "    if status:\n"
                    "        query = query.filter(Customer.customer_status == status.upper())\n\n"
                    "    total = query.count()\n"
                    "    items = query.order_by(Customer.created_at.desc()).offset((page - 1) * page_size).limit(page_size).all()\n"
                    "    total_pages = max(1, (total + page_size - 1) // page_size)\n"
                    "    return PaginatedResponse(\n"
                    "        items=items,\n"
                    "        total=total,\n"
                    "        page=page,\n"
                    "        page_size=page_size,\n"
                    "        total_pages=total_pages,\n"
                    "    )"
                ),
            },
            # Upgrade GET /accounts with query filters and pagination
            {
                "marker": "step05:api_accounts_paginated",
                "action": "replace",
                "anchor": (
                    "@router.get(\"/accounts\")\n"
                    "def list_accounts(db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: str = Depends(get_current_user)):\n"
                    "    accounts = db.query(Account).order_by(Account.created_at.desc()).all()\n"
                    "    out = []\n"
                    "    for a in accounts:\n"
                    "        lim = db.query(AccountLimit).filter(AccountLimit.account_id == a.id).first()\n"
                    "        out.append({\n"
                    "            \"id\": a.id,\n"
                    "            \"account_number\": a.account_number,\n"
                    "            \"customer_id\": a.customer_id,\n"
                    "            \"customer_name\": f\"{a.customer.first_name} {a.customer.last_name or ''}\".strip() if a.customer else \"\",\n"
                    "            \"account_type\": a.account_type,\n"
                    "            \"currency\": a.currency,\n"
                    "            \"available_balance\": float(a.available_balance),\n"
                    "            \"ledger_balance\": float(a.ledger_balance),\n"
                    "            \"overdraft_limit\": float(a.overdraft_limit),\n"
                    "            \"account_status\": a.account_status,\n"
                    "            \"branch_code\": a.branch_code,\n"
                    "            \"institution_id\": a.institution_id,\n"
                    "            \"institution_code\": a.institution.institution_code if a.institution else None,\n"
                    "            \"institution_name\": a.institution.name if a.institution else None,\n"
                    "            \"limits\": {\n"
                    "                \"id\": lim.id,\n"
                    "                \"per_transaction_limit\": float(lim.per_transaction_limit),\n"
                    "                \"daily_limit\": float(lim.daily_limit),\n"
                    "                \"weekly_limit\": float(lim.weekly_limit),\n"
                    "                \"monthly_limit\": float(lim.monthly_limit),\n"
                    "                \"daily_used\": float(lim.daily_used),\n"

  2. Pydantic v2 schemas in backend/app/schemas.py

  4. frontend/src/pages/CardCryptoLabPage.tsx
  5. Route registration in App.tsx and Layout.tsx
  6. Automated Pytest test suite in backend/tests/test_step06_card_crypto.py
"""

from pathlib import Path
import sys

BASE_DIR = Path(r"E:\HOST_VSCODE\host-simulator").resolve()
sys.path.insert(0, str(BASE_DIR))

CARD_CRYPTO_SERVICE_CODE = '''"""
card_crypto_service.py — Card Issuing, Luhn Validation, and Cryptographic Calculations
Interfaces with SoftHsmCryptoCore for Visa PVV, IBM 3624, CVV, and ISO PIN Blocks.
"""

import random
import re
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
from app.hsm_adapter import SoftHsmCryptoCore


def validate_luhn(pan: str) -> bool:
    """Validate Primary Account Number using Luhn formula (ISO/IEC 7812)."""
    clean = re.sub(r"\\D", "", pan or "")
    if len(clean) < 12:
        return False
    digits = [int(d) for d in clean]
    checksum = 0
    reverse_digits = digits[::-1]
    for i, d in enumerate(reverse_digits):
        if i % 2 == 1:
            doubled = d * 2
            checksum += doubled - 9 if doubled > 9 else doubled
        else:
            checksum += d
    return checksum % 10 == 0


def calculate_luhn_check_digit(partial_pan: str) -> str:
    """Calculate the 1-digit Luhn check digit for a partial PAN."""
    clean = re.sub(r"\\D", "", partial_pan)
    digits = [int(d) for d in clean]
    checksum = 0
    # The check digit will be at an even position from right when appended
    for i, d in enumerate(digits[::-1]):
        if i % 2 == 0:
            doubled = d * 2
            checksum += doubled - 9 if doubled > 9 else doubled
        else:
            checksum += d
    remainder = checksum % 10
    return str((10 - remainder) % 10)


def generate_luhn_pan(bin_prefix: str = "456789", length: int = 16) -> str:
    """Generate a valid synthetic PAN under a given BIN prefix matching Luhn check digit."""
    clean_bin = re.sub(r"\\D", "", bin_prefix)
    random_digits_needed = length - len(clean_bin) - 1
    if random_digits_needed < 1:
        raise ValueError(f"BIN prefix length ({len(clean_bin)}) exceeds or equals target PAN length ({length})")
    
    middle = "".join(str(random.randint(0, 9)) for _ in range(random_digits_needed))
    partial = f"{clean_bin}{middle}"
    check_digit = calculate_luhn_check_digit(partial)
    full_pan = f"{partial}{check_digit}"
    assert validate_luhn(full_pan)
    return full_pan


def calculate_visa_pvv_detailed(pan: str, pin: str, pvki: str = "1", pvk_id: str = "PVK_VISA_01") -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Calculate Visa PVV with step-by-step intermediate cryptographic visibility."""
    pvk_hex = SoftHsmCryptoCore.INTERNAL_CLEAR_KEYS.get(pvk_id, "5566778899AABBCC5566778899AABBCC")
    pan11 = pan[-12:-1]  # Rightmost 11 digits excluding Luhn check digit
    tsp = f"{pan11}{pvki[0]}{pin[:4]}"
    cipher = SoftHsmCryptoCore.des3_ecb_hex(tsp, pvk_hex, decrypt=False)
    
    digits_found = [ch for ch in cipher if ch.isdigit()]
    decimalized_alphas = [str(int(ch, 16) - 10) for ch in cipher if ch in "ABCDEF"]
    combined = "".join(digits_found + decimalized_alphas)
    pvv = combined[:4]
    
    return {
        "pan": pan,
        "pin": pin,
        "pvki": pvki,
        "pvk_id": pvk_id,
        "pvk_kcv": SoftHsmCryptoCore.calculate_kcv(pvk_hex),
        "tsp_constructed": tsp,
        "3des_cipher_hex": cipher,
        "decimalized_sequence": combined,
        "calculated_pvv": pvv,
    }


def calculate_ibm_offset_detailed(pan: str, pin: str, pvk_id: str = "PVK_VISA_01") -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Calculate IBM 3624 PIN Offset with step-by-step intermediate visibility."""
    pvk_hex = SoftHsmCryptoCore.INTERNAL_CLEAR_KEYS.get(pvk_id, "5566778899AABBCC5566778899AABBCC")
    dec_table = "0123456789012345"
    val_data = pan[-16:].zfill(16)
    enc = SoftHsmCryptoCore.des3_ecb_hex(val_data, pvk_hex, decrypt=False)
    natural_pin = "".join(dec_table[int(enc[i], 16)] for i in range(len(pin)))
    offset = "".join(str((int(pin[i]) - int(natural_pin[i]) + 10) % 10) for i in range(len(pin)))
    
    return {
        "pan": pan,
        "pin": pin,
        "pvk_id": pvk_id,
        "validation_data": val_data,
        "encrypted_validation_data": enc,
        "natural_pin": natural_pin,
        "calculated_offset": offset[:4],
    }


def calculate_cvv_detailed(pan: str, expiry_yy_mm: str, service_code: str = "101", cvk_id: str = "CVK_MAIN_01") -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Calculate CVV1 / CVV2 / iCVV with intermediate DES blocks."""
    cvk_hex = SoftHsmCryptoCore.INTERNAL_CLEAR_KEYS.get(cvk_id, "5566778899AABBCC5566778899AABBCC")
    calculated_cvv = SoftHsmCryptoCore.calculate_cvv(pan, expiry_yy_mm, service_code, cvk_hex)
    return {
        "pan": pan,
        "expiry_yy_mm": expiry_yy_mm,
        "service_code": service_code,
        "cvk_id": cvk_id,
        "cvk_kcv": SoftHsmCryptoCore.calculate_kcv(cvk_hex),
        "calculated_cvv": calculated_cvv,
    }


def pack_pin_block_detailed(pin: str, pan: str, format_name: str = "ISO_0", awk_id: str = "AWK_ATM_01") -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Pack clear PIN into ISO Format 0, 1, or 3 PIN block and encrypt under AWK."""
    awk_hex = SoftHsmCryptoCore.INTERNAL_CLEAR_KEYS.get(awk_id, "1A2B3C4D5E6F70811A2B3C4D5E6F7081")
    
    if format_name.upper() == "ISO_0":
        pin_part = f"0{len(pin)}{pin}".ljust(16, "F")
        pan12 = pan[-13:-1].zfill(12)
        pan_part = f"0000{pan12}"
        clear_block = SoftHsmCryptoCore.xor_hex(pin_part, pan_part)
    elif format_name.upper() == "ISO_1":
        # Format 1: 1 + L + PIN + Random Pad
        rand_pad = "".join(f"{random.randint(0, 15):X}" for _ in range(14 - len(pin)))
        clear_block = f"1{len(pin)}{pin}{rand_pad}"
    elif format_name.upper() == "ISO_3":
        # Format 3: 3 + L + PIN + Random (F-pad) XOR PAN
        rand_pad = "".join(f"{random.choice('0123456789ABCDEF')}" for _ in range(14 - len(pin)))
        pin_part = f"3{len(pin)}{pin}{rand_pad}"
        pan12 = pan[-13:-1].zfill(12)
        pan_part = f"0000{pan12}"
        clear_block = SoftHsmCryptoCore.xor_hex(pin_part, pan_part)
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported PIN block format: {format_name}")

    encrypted_block = SoftHsmCryptoCore.des3_ecb_hex(clear_block, awk_hex, decrypt=False)
    
    return {
        "format": format_name.upper(),
        "pin": pin,
        "pan": pan,
        "awk_id": awk_id,
        "awk_kcv": SoftHsmCryptoCore.calculate_kcv(awk_hex),
        "clear_pin_block": clear_block,
        "encrypted_pin_block": encrypted_block,
    }
'''

    }
  };

  const handleCalculatePvv = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch('/crypto/calculate-pvv', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ pan: pvvPan, pin: pvvPin, pvki: '1', pvk_id: 'PVK_VISA_01' }),
      });
      setPvvResult(res);
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleCalculateCvv = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch('/crypto/calculate-cvv', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ pan: cvvPan, expiry_yy_mm: cvvExp, service_code: cvvServiceCode }),
      });
      setCvvResult(res);
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handlePackPinBlock = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch('/crypto/pack-pin-block', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ pan: blockPan, pin: blockPin, format: blockFormat, awk_id: 'AWK_ATM_01' }),
      });
      setBlockResult(res);
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err.message);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold">PIN, PVV & Card Generation Lab</h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
            Interactive Soft-HSM personalization bench: Luhn test card generation, Visa PVV, IBM 3624 offset, CVV, and ISO PIN blocks
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="text-xs font-mono px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-500 border border-emerald-500/20 font-bold">
            HSM: Thales payShield 10K (Raw Mode)
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {msg && (
        <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-400 text-xs font-mono">
          {msg}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tabs */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 pb-2">
        {[
          ['GEN', '1. Luhn Synthetic Card Generator', CreditCard],
          ['PVV', '2. Visa PVV & IBM 3624 Offset', ShieldCheck],
          ['CVV', '3. CVV1 / CVV2 / iCVV Derivation', KeyRound],
          ['BLOCK', '4. ISO PIN Block Packer', Lock],
        ].map(([k, label, Icon]: any) => (
          <button
            key={k}
            onClick={() => setTab(k)}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-bold transition ${
              tab === k
                ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-sm'
                : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800'
            }`}
          >
            <Icon size={15} />
            <span>{label}</span>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* TAB 1: CARD GENERATOR */}
      {tab === 'GEN' && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
          <div className="lg:col-span-6 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4">
            <h2 className="text-sm font-bold">Synthetic Test Card Personalizer</h2>
            <div className="space-y-3 text-xs font-mono">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">Select Bank BIN Range</label>
                <select
                  value={selectedBin}
                  onChange={(e) => setSelectedBin(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-3 py-2"
                >
                  {bins.map((b) => (
                    <option key={b.id} value={b.bin_prefix}>
                      {b.bin_prefix} — {b.card_product} ({b.institution_code})
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">Cardholder Name</label>
                <input
                  value={cardholderName}
                  onChange={(e) => setCardholderName(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-3 py-2"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">Card Type</label>
                  <select
                    value={cardType}
                    onChange={(e) => setCardType(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-3 py-2"
                  >
                    <option value="DEBIT">DEBIT</option>
                    <option value="CREDIT">CREDIT</option>
                    <option value="PREPAID">PREPAID</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">Initial PIN (Packs PVV)</label>
                  <input
                    value={initialPin}
                    onChange={(e) => setInitialPin(e.target.value)}
                    maxLength={4}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-3 py-2"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={handleGenerateCard}
              className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-semibold py-2.5 rounded-lg text-xs"
            >
              <Sparkles size={15} /> Generate Luhn-Valid Card & Seed Database
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="lg:col-span-6 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4">
            <h2 className="text-sm font-bold">Personalization Output</h2>
            {generatedCard ? (
              <div className="space-y-3 text-xs font-mono">
                <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-950 to-slate-900 border border-emerald-800/40 text-emerald-200 space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[11px] text-emerald-400">
                    <span>{generatedCard.institution_code} SWITCH</span>
                    <span>{generatedCard.card_product}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-lg font-bold tracking-wider text-white py-1">
                    {generatedCard.test_pan_reference}
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[11px]">
                    <div>EXP: {String(generatedCard.expiry_month).padStart(2, '0')}/{generatedCard.expiry_year}</div>
                    <div>CVV: {generatedCard.cvv}</div>
                    <div>PIN: {initialPin}</div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-1">
                  <div><span className="text-slate-400">Luhn Valid:</span> <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">YES (Mod-10 Verified)</span></div>
                  <div><span className="text-slate-400">Visa PVV:</span> <span className="text-amber-400 font-bold">{generatedCard.pvv}</span> (PVKI: 1)</div>
                  <div><span className="text-slate-400">Linked Account:</span> {generatedCard.linked_account_number}</div>
                  <div><span className="text-slate-400">EMV AID:</span> A0000000031010 (MK_AC_EMV01)</div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="text-slate-400 text-xs font-mono py-16 text-center">
                Configure BIN range and click Generate to issue a live synthetic card with verified PVV and CVV.
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TAB 2: PVV & OFFSET */}
      {tab === 'PVV' && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
          <div className="lg:col-span-6 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4">
            <h2 className="text-sm font-bold">Visa PVV & IBM 3624 Calculator</h2>
            <div className="space-y-3 text-xs font-mono">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">Card PAN</label>
                <input
                  value={pvvPan}

                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">Clear PIN (4 Digits)</label>
                <input
                  value={pvvPin}
                  onChange={(e) => setPvvPin(e.target.value)}
                  maxLength={4}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-3 py-2"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={handleCalculatePvv}
              className="bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-semibold px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs"

              Calculate Visa PVV ➔
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="lg:col-span-6 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4">
            <h2 className="text-sm font-bold">Calculation Breakdown</h2>
            {pvvResult ? (
              <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 text-xs font-mono space-y-2">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-emerald-400 font-bold border-b border-slate-800 pb-2">
                  <span>Visa PVV Result:</span>

                <div><span className="text-slate-400">Constructed TSP (16 Digits):</span> {pvvResult.tsp_constructed}</div>
                <div><span className="text-slate-400">3DES Ciphertext:</span> {pvvResult.3des_cipher_hex}</div>
                <div><span className="text-slate-400">Decimalized Sequence:</span> {pvvResult.decimalized_sequence}</div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="text-slate-400 text-xs font-mono py-12 text-center">
                Enter PAN and PIN to inspect intermediate 3DES and decimalization steps.
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TAB 3: CVV */}
      {tab === 'CVV' && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
          <div className="lg:col-span-6 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4">
            <h2 className="text-sm font-bold">CVV1 / CVV2 / iCVV Derivation</h2>
            <div className="space-y-3 text-xs font-mono">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">Card PAN</label>
                <input
                  value={cvvPan}
                  onChange={(e) => setCvvPan(e.target.value)}
