                />
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">Expiry (YYMM)</label>
                  <input
                    value={cvvExp}
                    onChange={(e) => setCvvExp(e.target.value)}
                    maxLength={4}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-3 py-2"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">Service Code</label>
                  <input
                    value={cvvServiceCode}
                    onChange={(e) => setCvvServiceCode(e.target.value)}
                    maxLength={3}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-3 py-2"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={handleCalculateCvv}
              className="bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-semibold px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs"
            >
              Derive CVV ➔
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="lg:col-span-6 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4">
            <h2 className="text-sm font-bold">CVV Derivation Breakdown</h2>
            {cvvResult ? (
              <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 text-xs font-mono space-y-2">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-emerald-400 font-bold border-b border-slate-800 pb-2">
                  <span>Derived CVV:</span>
                  <span className="text-base text-amber-400 font-bold">{cvvResult.calculated_cvv}</span>
                </div>
                <div><span className="text-slate-400">CVK Reference:</span> {cvvResult.cvk_id} (KCV: {cvvResult.cvk_kcv})</div>
                <div><span className="text-slate-400">Combined Block (32 hex):</span> {cvvResult.pan}{cvvResult.expiry_yy_mm}{cvvResult.service_code}0000000000000</div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="text-slate-400 text-xs font-mono py-12 text-center">
                Enter PAN, Expiry, and Service Code to compute 3-digit CVV.
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TAB 4: PIN BLOCK */}
      {tab === 'BLOCK' && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
          <div className="lg:col-span-6 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4">
            <h2 className="text-sm font-bold">ISO 9564 PIN Block Packer (AWK Encryption)</h2>
            <div className="space-y-3 text-xs font-mono">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">Card PAN</label>
                <input
                  value={blockPan}
                  onChange={(e) => setBlockPan(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-3 py-2"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">Clear PIN</label>
                  <input
                    value={blockPin}
                    onChange={(e) => setBlockPin(e.target.value)}
                    maxLength={12}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-3 py-2"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">ISO Format</label>
                  <select
                    value={blockFormat}
                    onChange={(e) => setBlockFormat(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-3 py-2"
                  >
                    <option value="ISO_0">ISO Format 0 (Standard ANSI X9.8)</option>
                    <option value="ISO_1">ISO Format 1 (No PAN XOR)</option>
                    <option value="ISO_3">ISO Format 3</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={handlePackPinBlock}
              className="bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-semibold px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs"
            >
              Pack & Encrypt PIN Block ➔
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="lg:col-span-6 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4">
            <h2 className="text-sm font-bold">Packed PIN Block Output</h2>
            {blockResult ? (
              <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 text-xs font-mono space-y-2">
                <div><span className="text-slate-400">Clear Block:</span> <span className="text-sky-300 font-bold">{blockResult.clear_pin_block}</span></div>
                <div><span className="text-slate-400">Encrypted Under AWK:</span> <span className="text-amber-400 font-bold">{blockResult.encrypted_pin_block}</span></div>
                <div><span className="text-slate-400">AWK Reference:</span> {blockResult.awk_id} (KCV: {blockResult.awk_kcv})</div>
                <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-800 text-[11px] text-slate-400">
                  Ready to paste directly into TIC DE52 or ISO 8583 Field 52.
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="text-slate-400 text-xs font-mono py-12 text-center">
                Configure clear PIN and PAN to generate raw ISO-0/1/3 encrypted block.
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
'''

TEST_STEP06_CODE = '''"""
test_step06_card_crypto.py — Tests for Step 6 Luhn Generation, Visa PVV, CVV, and PIN Change
"""

import os
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

os.environ["DATABASE_URL"] = "sqlite:///:memory:"

from app.database import Base, SessionLocal, engine
from app.main import app
from app.models import Card, PinProfile
from app.card_crypto_service import (
    calculate_cvv_detailed,
    calculate_luhn_check_digit,
    calculate_visa_pvv_detailed,
    generate_luhn_pan,
    pack_pin_block_detailed,
    validate_luhn,
)
from app.seed_data import seed_initial_data
from app.security import create_access_token
from app.config import settings


@pytest.fixture()
def db_session():
    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    session = SessionLocal()
    seed_initial_data(session)
    yield session
    session.close()
    Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)


@pytest.fixture()
def client(db_session):
    with TestClient(app) as c:
        token = create_access_token(subject=settings.ADMIN_USERNAME)
        c.headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}
        yield c


def test_luhn_generation_and_validation():
    pan = generate_luhn_pan("456789", 16)
    assert pan.startswith("456789")
    assert len(pan) == 16
    assert validate_luhn(pan) is True
    # Invalidate check digit
    bad_pan = pan[:-1] + str((int(pan[-1]) + 1) % 10)
    assert validate_luhn(bad_pan) is False


def test_visa_pvv_calculation():
    # Test known vector
    res = calculate_visa_pvv_detailed("4567890123450001", "1234", "1", "PVK_VISA_01")
    assert len(res["calculated_pvv"]) == 4
    assert res["calculated_pvv"].isdigit()


def test_cvv_derivation():
    res = calculate_cvv_detailed("4567890123450001", "2812", "101")
    assert len(res["calculated_cvv"]) == 3
    assert res["calculated_cvv"].isdigit()


def test_iso0_pin_block_packing():
    res = pack_pin_block_detailed("1234", "4567890123450001", "ISO_0")
    assert len(res["encrypted_pin_block"]) == 16
    assert len(res["clear_pin_block"]) == 16


def test_card_pin_change_endpoint(client, db_session):
    card = db_session.query(Card).first()
    pin_prof_before = card.pin_profile.pin_offset_reference

    # Change PIN to 4321
    res = client.post(f"/api/cards/{card.id}/pin", json={"new_pin": "4321"})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    data = res.json()
    assert data["status"] == "updated"
    assert data["new_pvv"] != pin_prof_before

    db_session.refresh(card.pin_profile)
    assert card.pin_profile.pin_offset_reference == data["new_pvv"]
    assert card.pin_profile.retry_counter == 0
'''


def main() -> int:
    args = parse_installer_args("Step 06: PIN, PVV and Card Generation Lab")
    session = PatcherSession(
        step_id="step06",
        title="Implement PIN, PVV, CVV, ISO PIN Block, and Synthetic Card Personalization Lab",
        dry_run=args.dry_run,
    )

    # 1. Write backend/app/card_crypto_service.py
    session.write_file("backend/app/card_crypto_service.py", CARD_CRYPTO_SERVICE_CODE)

    # 2. Patch backend/app/schemas.py to add card crypto schemas
    session.patch_file(
        "backend/app/schemas.py",
        [
            {
                "marker": "step06:schemas_card_crypto",
                "action": "append",
                "text": (
                    "\n# ==============================================================================\n"
                    "# STEP 6 SCHEMAS: PIN, PVV, CVV & SYNTHETIC CARD GENERATION\n"
                    "# ==============================================================================\n\n"
                    "class CardPinChangeRequest(BaseModel):\n"
                    "    new_pin: str = Field(..., min_length=4, max_length=12, description='New clear PIN (4 to 12 digits)')\n\n\n"
                    "class CardGenerateRequest(BaseModel):\n"
                    "    bin_prefix: str = '456789'\n"
                    "    cardholder_name: str = 'SYNTHETIC CARDHOLDER'\n"
                    "    card_type: str = 'DEBIT'\n"
                    "    card_product: str = 'VISA_DEBIT_CLASSIC'\n"
                    "    initial_pin: str = '1234'\n"
                    "    linked_account_id: Optional[str] = None\n\n\n"
                    "class PvvCalculateRequest(BaseModel):\n"
                    "    pan: str\n"
                    "    pin: str\n"
                    "    pvki: str = '1'\n"
                    "    pvk_id: str = 'PVK_VISA_01'\n\n\n"
                    "class CvvCalculateRequest(BaseModel):\n"
                    "    pan: str\n"
                    "    expiry_yy_mm: str = '2812'\n"
                    "    service_code: str = '101'\n"
                    "    cvk_id: str = 'CVK_MAIN_01'\n\n\n"
                    "class PinBlockPackRequest(BaseModel):\n"
                    "    pan: str\n"
                    "    pin: str\n"
                    "    format: str = 'ISO_0'\n"
                    "    awk_id: str = 'AWK_ATM_01'\n"
                ),
            }
        ],
    )

    # 3. Patch backend/app/api_routes.py to add crypto calculation and PIN change endpoints
    session.patch_file(
        "backend/app/api_routes.py",
        [
            {
                "marker": "step06:api_routes_crypto_imports",
                "action": "insert_after",
                "anchor": "from app.schemas import (",
                "text": (
                    "    CardGenerateRequest,\n"
                    "    CardPinChangeRequest,\n"
                    "    CvvCalculateRequest,\n"
                    "    PinBlockPackRequest,\n"
                    "    PvvCalculateRequest,"
                ),
            },
            {
                "marker": "step06:api_routes_crypto_service_import",
                "action": "insert_after",
                "anchor": "from app.audit_service import record_audit, serialize_entity",
                "text": (
                    "from app.card_crypto_service import (\n"
                    "    calculate_cvv_detailed,\n"
                    "    calculate_ibm_offset_detailed,\n"
                    "    calculate_visa_pvv_detailed,\n"
                    "    generate_luhn_pan,\n"
                    "    pack_pin_block_detailed,\n"
                    ")"
                ),
            },
            {
                "marker": "step06:crypto_calculation_endpoints",
                "action": "insert_before",
                "anchor": "# ==============================================================================\n# 3. TRANSACTION CODES, HOST CONFIGURATION & RESPONSE CODES",
                "text": (
                    "# --- CARD ISSUING & CRYPTO LAB ENDPOINTS (STEP 6) ---\n\n"
                    "@router.post('/cards/{card_id}/pin')\n"
                    "def change_card_pin(card_id: str, payload: CardPinChangeRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user)):\n"
                    "    card = db.query(Card).filter(Card.id == card_id).first()\n"
                    "    if not card:\n"
                    "        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail='Card not found')\n"
                    "    pin_prof = db.query(PinProfile).filter(PinProfile.card_id == card.id).first()\n"
                    "    if not pin_prof:\n"
                    "        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail='PIN profile not found for card')\n\n"
                    "    before = serialize_entity(pin_prof)\n"
                    "    pvk_id = pin_prof.pvk_key_reference or 'PVK_VISA_01'\n"
                    "    if pin_prof.pin_verification_method == 'IBM_3624':\n"
                    "        calc = calculate_ibm_offset_detailed(card.test_pan_reference, payload.new_pin, pvk_id)\n"
                    "        new_ref = calc['calculated_offset']\n"
                    "    else:\n"
                    "        calc = calculate_visa_pvv_detailed(card.test_pan_reference, payload.new_pin, pin_prof.pvki, pvk_id)\n"
                    "        new_ref = calc['calculated_pvv']\n\n"
                    "    pin_prof.pin_offset_reference = new_ref\n"
                    "    pin_prof.retry_counter = 0\n"
                    "    pin_prof.pin_changed_at = utc_now()\n"
                    "    after = serialize_entity(pin_prof)\n"
                    "    record_audit(db, 'PIN_PROFILE', pin_prof.id, 'PIN_CHANGE', performed_by=current_user, before_state=before, after_state=after,\n"
                    "                 change_summary=f'Changed PIN and recalculated PVV/Offset for card {card.masked_pan}')\n"
                    "    db.commit()\n"
                    "    return {'status': 'updated', 'card_id': card.id, 'new_pvv': new_ref, 'method': pin_prof.pin_verification_method}\n\n\n"
                    "@router.post('/cards/generate-test-card')\n"
                    "def generate_test_card_endpoint(payload: CardGenerateRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user)):\n"
                    "    bin_match = db.query(BinRange).filter(BinRange.bin_prefix == payload.bin_prefix).first()\n"
                    "    if not bin_match:\n"
                    "        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f'BIN range {payload.bin_prefix} not found in database')\n\n"
                    "    # Generate Luhn PAN\n"
                    "    pan = generate_luhn_pan(payload.bin_prefix, bin_match.pan_length)\n"
                    "    # Resolve customer & account\n"
                    "    inst_id = bin_match.institution_id\n"
                    "    cust = db.query(Customer).filter(Customer.institution_id == inst_id).first()\n"
                    "    if not cust:\n"
                    "        cust = db.query(Customer).first()\n"
                    "    acct = db.query(Account).filter(Account.customer_id == cust.id).first() if cust else None\n"
                    "    if not acct:\n"
                    "        acct = db.query(Account).first()\n\n"
                    "    # Calculate PVV and CVV\n"
                    "    pvv_calc = calculate_visa_pvv_detailed(pan, payload.initial_pin, '1', 'PVK_VISA_01')\n"
                    "    cvv_calc = calculate_cvv_detailed(pan, '2812', '101', 'CVK_MAIN_01')\n\n"
                    "    card = Card(\n"
                    "        customer_id=cust.id,\n"
                    "        card_number_token=tokenize_pan(pan),\n"
                    "        test_pan_reference=pan,\n"
                    "        masked_pan=mask_pan(pan),\n"
                    "        cardholder_name=payload.cardholder_name.upper(),\n"
                    "        expiry_month=12,\n"
                    "        expiry_year=2028,\n"
                    "        card_type=payload.card_type,\n"
                    "        card_product=payload.card_product or bin_match.card_product,\n"
                    "        card_status='ACTIVE',\n"
                    "        linked_account_id=acct.id if acct else None,\n"
                    "        institution_id=inst_id,\n"
                    "    )\n"
                    "    db.add(card)\n"
                    "    db.flush()\n"
                    "    if acct:\n"
                    "        db.add(CardAccount(card_id=card.id, account_id=acct.id, account_role='PRIMARY', priority=1, status='ACTIVE'))\n"
                    "    db.add(CardLimit(card_id=card.id))\n"
                    "    db.add(PinProfile(card_id=card.id, pin_verification_method='VISA_PVV', pvk_key_reference='PVK_VISA_01', pin_offset_reference=pvv_calc['calculated_pvv'], pvki='1', cvv_reference=cvv_calc['calculated_cvv']))\n"
                    "    db.add(EmvProfile(card_id=card.id))\n"
                    "    record_audit(db, 'CARD', card.id, 'GENERATE_TEST_CARD', performed_by=current_user, after_state=serialize_entity(card),\n"
                    "                 change_summary=f'Generated Luhn test card {card.masked_pan} under BIN {payload.bin_prefix}')\n"
                    "    db.commit()\n"
                    "    return {\n"
                    "        'id': card.id,\n"
                    "        'test_pan_reference': card.test_pan_reference,\n"
                    "        'masked_pan': card.masked_pan,\n"
                    "        'cardholder_name': card.cardholder_name,\n"
                    "        'expiry_month': card.expiry_month,\n"
                    "        'expiry_year': card.expiry_year,\n"
                    "        'pvv': pvv_calc['calculated_pvv'],\n"
                    "        'cvv': cvv_calc['calculated_cvv'],\n"
                    "        'card_product': card.card_product,\n"
                    "        'institution_code': bin_match.institution.institution_code if bin_match.institution else 'ITCL',\n"
                    "        'linked_account_number': acct.account_number if acct else 'NONE',\n"
                    "    }\n\n\n"
                    "@router.post('/crypto/calculate-pvv')\n"
                    "def api_calculate_pvv(payload: PvvCalculateRequest, _: str = Depends(get_current_user)):\n"
                    "    return calculate_visa_pvv_detailed(payload.pan, payload.pin, payload.pvki, payload.pvk_id)\n\n\n"
                    "@router.post('/crypto/calculate-cvv')\n"
                    "def api_calculate_cvv(payload: CvvCalculateRequest, _: str = Depends(get_current_user)):\n"
                    "    return calculate_cvv_detailed(payload.pan, payload.expiry_yy_mm, payload.service_code, payload.cvk_id)\n\n\n"

                    "def api_pack_pin_block(payload: PinBlockPackRequest, _: str = Depends(get_current_user)):\n"
                    "    return pack_pin_block_detailed(payload.pin, payload.pan, payload.format, payload.awk_id)\n\n"
                ),
            },
        ],
    )

"""
INSTALLER: tools/install_step07.py
STEP 7 — Complete Operation and Cryptographic Log Portal (Single Unified Installer)
Adds:
  1. ApiAuditLog & CryptoEvent ORM models in backend/app/models.py
  2. Contextvars correlation tracing middleware in backend/app/context_trace.py
  3. Granular 6-step PIN/PVV instrumentation in backend/app/hsm_adapter.py
  4. Unified timeline API endpoints in backend/app/api_routes.py
  5. UnifiedLogPortalPage.tsx in frontend/src/pages/
  6. Route registration in App.tsx and Layout.tsx
  7. Automated Pytest test suite in backend/tests/test_step07_log_portal.py
"""

from pathlib import Path
import sys

BASE_DIR = Path(r"E:\HOST_VSCODE\host-simulator").resolve()
sys.path.insert(0, str(BASE_DIR))

CONTEXT_TRACE_CODE = '''"""
context_trace.py — Request-Scoped Correlation and Cryptographic Event Tracing
Uses contextvars to trace end-to-end execution across API routes and HSM cryptographic steps.
"""

from contextvars import ContextVar
import json
import time
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
import uuid
from starlette.middleware.base import BaseHTTPMiddleware
from starlette.requests import Request
from starlette.responses import Response

# Request-scoped correlation ID
current_correlation_id: ContextVar[str] = ContextVar("current_correlation_id", default="")
# Request-scoped crypto event collector
current_crypto_trace: ContextVar[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = ContextVar("current_crypto_trace", default=[])


def get_correlation_id() -> str:
    cid = current_correlation_id.get()
    if not cid:
        cid = f"CORR-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12].upper()}"
        current_correlation_id.set(cid)
    return cid


def record_crypto_step(
    operation_type: str,
    step_number: int,
    step_name: str,
    key_id: Optional[str] = None,
    key_kcv: Optional[str] = None,
    raw_input: Optional[str] = None,
    raw_output: Optional[str] = None,
    expected_output: Optional[str] = None,
    status: str = "COMPLETED",
    details: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    duration_ms: int = 1,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Record an individual cryptographic transformation step into the current request trace."""
    event = {
        "correlation_id": get_correlation_id(),
        "operation_type": operation_type,
        "step_number": step_number,
        "step_name": step_name,
        "key_id": key_id,
        "key_kcv": key_kcv,
        "raw_input": raw_input,
        "raw_output": raw_output,
        "expected_output": expected_output,
        "status": status,
        "details": details or {},
        "duration_ms": max(1, duration_ms),
    }
    trace = current_crypto_trace.get()
    trace.append(event)
    return event


class CorrelationTraceMiddleware(BaseHTTPMiddleware):
    async def dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next):
        # 1. Establish or extract correlation ID
        corr_id = request.headers.get("X-Correlation-ID") or f"CORR-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12].upper()}"
        token_corr = current_correlation_id.set(corr_id)
        token_trace = current_crypto_trace.set([])

        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        
        # Read body safely for API auditing (skip websockets)
        req_body = None
        if request.url.path.startswith("/api") and not request.url.path.startswith("/api/ws"):
            try:
                body_bytes = await request.body()
                if body_bytes:
                    try:
                        req_body = json.loads(body_bytes.decode("utf-8"))
                    except Exception:
                        req_body = {"raw": body_bytes.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")}
            except Exception:
                pass

        try:
            response: Response = await call_next(request)
        except Exception:
            current_correlation_id.reset(token_corr)
            current_crypto_trace.reset(token_trace)
            raise

        dur_ms = max(1, int((time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000))
        response.headers["X-Correlation-ID"] = corr_id

        # 2. Persist ApiAuditLog and CryptoEvents asynchronously or at end of request
        if request.url.path.startswith("/api") and not request.url.path.startswith("/api/ws"):
            try:
                from app.database import SessionLocal
                from app.models import ApiAuditLog, CryptoEvent
                
                db = SessionLocal()
                try:
                    audit = ApiAuditLog(
                        correlation_id=corr_id,
                        http_method=request.method,
                        path=request.url.path,
                        status_code=response.status_code,
                        client_ip=request.client.host if request.client else "127.0.0.1",
                        user_agent=request.headers.get("User-Agent", "Unknown"),
                        duration_ms=dur_ms,
                        request_headers=dict(request.headers),
                        request_body=req_body,
                        response_body={"status": response.status_code},
                    )
                    db.add(audit)
                    
                    # Flush crypto trace events collected during this request
                    trace_events = current_crypto_trace.get()
                    for ev in trace_events:
                        db.add(CryptoEvent(**ev))
                    
                    db.commit()
                except Exception:
                    db.rollback()
                finally:
                    db.close()
            except Exception:
                pass

        current_correlation_id.reset(token_corr)
        current_crypto_trace.reset(token_trace)
        return response
'''

                  <td className="py-2.5 font-bold">#{ev.step_number} {ev.step_name}</td>
                  <td className="py-2.5">{ev.operation_type}</td>
                  <td className="py-2.5 text-amber-400">{ev.key_id} ({ev.key_kcv})</td>
                  <td className="py-2.5 break-all max-w-xs">{ev.raw_input || 'N/A'}</td>
                  <td className="py-2.5 break-all max-w-xs font-bold text-emerald-400">{ev.raw_output || 'N/A'}</td>
                  <td className="py-2.5">
                    <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-500">
                      {ev.status}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TAB 3: API AUDIT LOG */}
      {tab === 'API' && (
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 overflow-x-auto">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-bold mb-3">HTTP API Dispatch Logs (X-Correlation-ID Tracked)</h2>
          <div className="space-y-2 text-xs font-mono">
            {logs.filter(l => l.category === 'API').map((apiLog, idx) => (
              <div key={idx} className="p-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 flex justify-between items-center">
                <div>
                  <span className="font-bold text-sky-400">{apiLog.title}</span>
                  <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">Correlation: {apiLog.correlation_id}</div>
                </div>
                <div className="text-right">
                  <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">{apiLog.status}</span>
                  <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">{apiLog.duration_ms} ms</div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
'''

"""
INSTALLER: tools/install_step08.py
STEP 8 — Authorizer Rules Engine (Single Unified Installer)
Adds:
  1. Safe whitelist AST expression evaluator in backend/app/rules_evaluator.py
  2. AuthorizerRule ORM model in backend/app/models.py
  3. Pydantic v2 schemas in backend/app/schemas.py
  4. Integration before HSM verification in backend/app/host_engine.py
  5. CRUD & dry-run test endpoints in backend/app/api_routes.py
  6. frontend/src/pages/AuthorizerRulesPage.tsx
  7. Route registration in App.tsx and Layout.tsx
  8. Automated Pytest test suite in backend/tests/test_step08_authorizer_rules.py

from pathlib import Path
import sys

BASE_DIR = Path(r"E:\HOST_VSCODE\host-simulator").resolve()
sys.path.insert(0, str(BASE_DIR))

from tools.patcher import PatcherSession, parse_installer_args

RULES_EVALUATOR_CODE = '''"""
rules_evaluator.py — Whitelist AST Expression Evaluator & Context Builder
Executes custom authorizer rule expressions safely without using eval() or exec().
"""

import ast
from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional


class SafeEvalError(Exception):
    """Raised when an expression contains forbidden nodes or syntax errors."""


class SafeAstEvaluator:
    ALLOWED_OPERATORS = {
        ast.Eq: lambda a, b: a == b,
        ast.NotEq: lambda a, b: a != b,
        ast.Lt: lambda a, b: a < b,
        ast.LtE: lambda a, b: a <= b,
        ast.Gt: lambda a, b: a > b,
        ast.GtE: lambda a, b: a >= b,
        ast.In: lambda a, b: a in b,
        ast.NotIn: lambda a, b: a not in b,
        ast.And: lambda a, b: a and b,
        ast.Or: lambda a, b: a or b,
        ast.Not: lambda a: not a,
    }

    @classmethod
    def evaluate(cls, expression: str, context: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
        clean_expr = expression.strip()
        if not clean_expr:
            return False
        try:
            tree = ast.parse(clean_expr, mode="eval")
            return bool(cls._eval_node(tree.body, context))
        except Exception as exc:
            raise SafeEvalError(f"Rule evaluation error in '{clean_expr}': {exc}")

    @classmethod
    def _eval_node(cls, node: ast.AST, context: Dict[str, Any]) -> Any:
        if isinstance(node, ast.Constant):
            return node.value

        if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
            key = node.id
            if key == "true":
                return True
            if key == "false":
                return False
            if key == "null" or key == "none":
                return None
            if key in context:
                return context[key]
            raise SafeEvalError(f"Undefined variable in rule context: '{key}'")

        if isinstance(node, ast.Attribute):
            val = cls._eval_node(node.value, context)
            attr = node.attr
            if isinstance(val, dict):
                return val.get(attr)
            if hasattr(val, attr):
                return getattr(val, attr)
            raise SafeEvalError(f"Cannot resolve attribute '{attr}' on {type(val)}")

        if isinstance(node, (ast.List, ast.Tuple)):
            return [cls._eval_node(elt, context) for elt in node.elts]

        if isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp):
            op_type = type(node.op)
            if op_type in cls.ALLOWED_OPERATORS:
                operand = cls._eval_node(node.operand, context)
                return cls.ALLOWED_OPERATORS[op_type](operand)
            raise SafeEvalError(f"Forbidden unary operator: {op_type}")

        if isinstance(node, ast.BoolOp):
            if isinstance(node.op, ast.And):
                for val_node in node.values:
                    if not cls._eval_node(val_node, context):
                        return False
                return True
            if isinstance(node.op, ast.Or):
                for val_node in node.values:
                    if cls._eval_node(val_node, context):
                        return True
                return False
            raise SafeEvalError(f"Forbidden boolean operator: {type(node.op)}")

        if isinstance(node, ast.Compare):
            left = cls._eval_node(node.left, context)
            for op, comparator_node in zip(node.ops, node.comparators):
                op_type = type(op)
                right = cls._eval_node(comparator_node, context)
                if op_type not in cls.ALLOWED_OPERATORS:
                    raise SafeEvalError(f"Forbidden comparison operator: {op_type}")
                # Numeric type coercion for comparisons
                if isinstance(left, (int, float, Decimal)) and isinstance(right, (int, float, Decimal)):
                    left_cmp = float(left)
                    right_cmp = float(right)
                else:
                    left_cmp = left
                    right_cmp = right

                if not cls.ALLOWED_OPERATORS[op_type](left_cmp, right_cmp):
                    return False
                left = right
            return True

        raise SafeEvalError(f"Forbidden syntax node: {type(node).__name__}")


def build_rule_context(
    mti: str,
    fields: Dict[str, str],
    tx_code: str,
    tx_amount: Decimal,
    card: Any = None,
    customer: Any = None,
    account: Any = None,
    issuer_inst: Any = None,
    acquirer_inst: Any = None,
    ps_code: str = "ITCL",
    card_limit: Any = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Constructs a normalized dictionary containing all transaction parameters for rule evaluation."""
    pan = fields.get("2", "")
    bin_prefix = pan[:6] if len(pan) >= 6 else ""

    inst_code = ""
    inst_name = ""
    if issuer_inst:
        inst_code = issuer_inst.institution_code
        inst_name = issuer_inst.name
    elif card and hasattr(card, "institution") and card.institution:
        inst_code = card.institution.institution_code
        inst_name = card.institution.name

    acq_code = acquirer_inst.institution_code if acquirer_inst else ""
    hour = int(fields.get("12", "120000")[:2]) if len(fields.get("12", "")) >= 2 else 12

    return {
        "trancode": str(tx_code),
        "tran_code": str(tx_code),
        "mti": str(mti),
        "amount": float(tx_amount),
        "currency": fields.get("49", "BDT"),
        "pan": pan,
        "bin": bin_prefix,
        "mcc": fields.get("18", "5411"),
        "terminal_id": fields.get("41", ""),
        "merchant_id": fields.get("32", ""),
        "institution": {
            "code": inst_code,
            "name": inst_name,
        },
        "acquirer_bank": acq_code,
        "issuer_bank": inst_code,
        "ps_name": ps_code,
        "channel": fields.get("25", "00"),
        "hour": hour,
        "card_status": card.card_status if card else "ACTIVE",
        "account_balance": float(account.available_balance) if account else 0.0,
        "daily_used": float(card_limit.daily_used) if card_limit else 0.0,
        "is_foreign": fields.get("19", "050") != "050",
    }
'''

TEST_STEP08_CODE = '''"""
test_step08_authorizer_rules.py — Tests for Step 8 Safe AST Rules Engine
"""

import os
import pytest
from decimal import Decimal
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

os.environ["DATABASE_URL"] = "sqlite:///:memory:"

from app.database import Base, SessionLocal, engine
from app.main import app
from app.models import AuthorizerRule, Card, Transaction
from app.rules_evaluator import SafeAstEvaluator, SafeEvalError, build_rule_context
from app.host_engine import HostTransactionProcessor
from app.seed_data import seed_initial_data
from app.security import create_access_token
from app.config import settings


@pytest.fixture()
def db_session():
    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    session = SessionLocal()
    seed_initial_data(session)
    yield session
    session.close()
    Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)


@pytest.fixture()
def client(db_session):
    with TestClient(app) as c:
        token = create_access_token(subject=settings.ADMIN_USERNAME)
        c.headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}
        yield c


def test_safe_ast_evaluator_valid_expressions():
    ctx = {
        "trancode": "10",
        "amount": 25000.0,
        "institution": {"code": "IFIC", "name": "IFIC Bank"},
        "card_status": "ACTIVE",
        "bin": "456789"
    }

    # Match test
    assert SafeAstEvaluator.evaluate('trancode == "10" and amount > 20000', ctx) is True
    assert SafeAstEvaluator.evaluate('institution.code == "IFIC"', ctx) is True
    assert SafeAstEvaluator.evaluate('bin in ["456789", "512345"]', ctx) is True

    # No match test
    assert SafeAstEvaluator.evaluate('amount > 50000', ctx) is False
    assert SafeAstEvaluator.evaluate('card_status != "ACTIVE"', ctx) is False


def test_safe_ast_evaluator_rejects_unsafe_operations():
    ctx = {"amount": 100}
    with pytest.raises(SafeEvalError):
        # Forbidden function calls
        SafeAstEvaluator.evaluate('__import__("os").system("echo 1")', ctx)

    with pytest.raises(SafeEvalError):
        # Forbidden attribute execution
        SafeAstEvaluator.evaluate('amount.__class__.__mro__', ctx)


def test_authorizer_rule_declines_transaction_in_host_engine(db_session):
    # Create a rule rejecting transactions with amount > 10,000 with RC 61
    rule = AuthorizerRule(
        rule_code="TEST_MAX_10K",
        name="Decline over 10K",
        priority=10,
        expression="amount > 10000",
        action="DECLINE",
        response_code="61",
        message="Transaction exceeds custom authorizer rule threshold",
        enabled=True,
    )
    db_session.add(rule)
    db_session.commit()

    proc = HostTransactionProcessor(db_session)
    res = proc.process_transaction({
        "transaction_code": "10",
        "mti": "0200",
        "test_clear_pin_helper": "1234",
        "fields": {
            "2": "4567890123450001",
            "3": "0100000",
            "4": "000001500000",  # 15,000 BDT > 10,000 threshold
            "11": "700001",
            "37": "000099700001",
            "41": "ATM01",
            "49": "BDT",
        },
    })
    assert res["response_code"] == "61"
    assert res["authorization_status"] == "DECLINED"

    db_session.refresh(rule)
    assert rule.hit_count >= 1
'''

  4. SessionStorage persistence & auto-restore in frontend/src/pages/SimulatorAndJournal.tsx
  5. Automated Pytest test suite in backend/tests/test_step09_simulator_improvements.py

from pathlib import Path

BASE_DIR = Path(r"E:\HOST_VSCODE\host-simulator").resolve()

ISO_STANDARD_CODEC_CODE = '''"""
iso_standard_codec.py — Standard ISO 8583:1987 Message Codec
Supports ASCII bitmap, Hex bitmap, primary/secondary bitmaps, LLVAR/LLLVAR, and packing/unpacking.
"""

import re
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

# Standard ISO 8583:1987 field definitions
# Format: field_num: (name, data_type, length_type, fixed_length)
ISO8583_FIELDS: Dict[int, Tuple[str, str, str, Optional[int]]] = {
    2:   ("Primary Account Number (PAN)",        "N",   "LLVAR",  19),
    3:   ("Processing Code",                     "N",   "FIXED",  6),
    4:   ("Amount, Transaction",                 "N",   "FIXED",  12),
    7:   ("Transmission Date & Time",            "N",   "FIXED",  10),
    11:  ("System Trace Audit Number (STAN)",    "N",   "FIXED",  6),
    12:  ("Time, Local Transaction",             "N",   "FIXED",  6),
    13:  ("Date, Local Transaction",             "N",   "FIXED",  4),
    14:  ("Date, Expiration",                    "N",   "FIXED",  4),
    18:  ("Merchant Category Code (MCC)",        "N",   "FIXED",  4),
    22:  ("Point of Service Entry Mode",         "N",   "FIXED",  3),
    25:  ("Point of Service Condition Code",     "N",   "FIXED",  2),
    32:  ("Acquiring Institution ID",            "N",   "LLVAR",  11),
    35:  ("Track 2 Data",                        "ANS", "LLVAR",  37),
    37:  ("Retrieval Reference Number (RRN)",    "ANS", "FIXED",  12),
    38:  ("Authorization Identification Response","ANS","FIXED",  6),
    39:  ("Response Code",                       "ANS", "FIXED",  2),
    41:  ("Card Acceptor Terminal ID",           "ANS", "FIXED",  8),
    42:  ("Card Acceptor Identification Code",   "ANS", "FIXED",  15),
    43:  ("Card Acceptor Name/Location",         "ANS", "FIXED",  40),
    48:  ("Private Additional Data",             "ANS", "LLLVAR", 999),
    49:  ("Currency Code, Transaction",          "N",   "FIXED",  3),
    52:  ("Personal Identification Number Data", "HEX", "FIXED",  16),
    55:  ("ICC Related Data (EMV DE55)",         "HEX", "LLLVAR", 999),
    62:  ("Private Data, Custom",                "ANS", "LLLVAR", 999),
    64:  ("Primary MAC",                         "HEX", "FIXED",  16),
    70:  ("Network Management Information Code", "N",   "FIXED",  3),
    90:  ("Original Data Elements",              "N",   "FIXED",  42),
    102: ("Account Identification 1",            "ANS", "LLVAR",  28),
    103: ("Account Identification 2",            "ANS", "LLVAR",  28),
    128: ("Secondary MAC",                       "HEX", "FIXED",  16),
}


def decode_iso8583_1987(raw_msg: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Decodes a standard ISO 8583:1987 message with 16-hex or 32-hex bitmap.
    Returns parsed fields, MTI, warnings, and format metadata.
    """
    clean = raw_msg.strip().replace(" ", "").replace("\\n", "").replace("\\r", "")
    if len(clean) < 20:
        return {"valid": False, "error": "Message is too short for ISO 8583:1987", "format": "UNKNOWN"}

    mti = clean[:4]
    if not mti.isdigit():
        return {"valid": False, "error": f"Invalid ISO MTI: '{mti}'", "format": "UNKNOWN"}

    pos = 4
    # Read primary bitmap (16 hex chars = 64 bits)
    primary_hex = clean[pos : pos + 16]
    pos += 16

    try:
        bits = bin(int(primary_hex, 16))[2:].zfill(64)
    except Exception as exc:
        return {"valid": False, "error": f"Invalid primary bitmap hex: {exc}", "format": "ISO8583_1987"}

    has_secondary = bits[0] == "1"
    secondary_hex = None
    if has_secondary:
        secondary_hex = clean[pos : pos + 16]
        pos += 16
        sec_bits = bin(int(secondary_hex, 16))[2:].zfill(64)
        full_bits = bits + sec_bits
    else:
        full_bits = bits

    present_fields = [i + 1 for i, b in enumerate(full_bits) if b == "1" and i != 0]

    raw_fields: Dict[str, str] = {}
    detailed_fields: Dict[str, Any] = {}
    warnings: List[str] = []

    for fnum in present_fields:
        if fnum not in ISO8583_FIELDS:
            warnings.append(f"Field DE{fnum} present in bitmap but not defined in standard 1987 dictionary")
            break

        name, dtype, ltype, flen = ISO8583_FIELDS[fnum]
        try:
            if ltype == "FIXED":
                val = clean[pos : pos + flen]
                pos += flen
            elif ltype == "LLVAR":
                plen = int(clean[pos : pos + 2])
                pos += 2
                val = clean[pos : pos + plen]
                pos += plen
            elif ltype == "LLLVAR":
                plen = int(clean[pos : pos + 3])
                pos += 3
                val = clean[pos : pos + plen]
                pos += plen
            else:
                warnings.append(f"Unhandled length type {ltype} for DE{fnum}")
                break

            raw_fields[str(fnum)] = val
            detailed_fields[f"DE{fnum} {name}"] = val
        except Exception as exc:
            warnings.append(f"Error parsing field DE{fnum}: {exc}")
            break

    # Determine matched transaction code from DE3
    proc_code = raw_fields.get("3", "000000")
    tc_derived = proc_code[:2] if len(proc_code) >= 2 else "10"

    return {
        "valid": True,
        "format": "ISO8583_1987",
        "mti": mti,
        "bitmap": {
            "primary_hex": primary_hex,
            "secondary_hex": secondary_hex,
            "fields_present": present_fields,
        },
        "raw_fields": raw_fields,
        "detailed_fields": detailed_fields,
        "derived_transaction_code": tc_derived,
        "warnings": warnings,
    }


def build_iso8583_1987(mti: str, fields: Dict[int, str]) -> str:
    """Builds a standard ISO 8583:1987 message with hex bitmap."""
    clean_fields = {int(k): str(v) for k, v in fields.items() if v is not None and str(v) != ""}
    present_fnums = sorted(f for f in clean_fields.keys() if f != 1)
    needs_secondary = any(f > 64 for f in present_fnums)

    bits = ["0"] * (128 if needs_secondary else 64)
    if needs_secondary:
        bits[0] = "1"
    for f in present_fnums:
        if 1 <= f <= len(bits):
            bits[f - 1] = "1"

    bitmap_hex = "".join(f"{int(''.join(bits[i:i+4]), 2):X}" for i in range(0, len(bits), 4))
    body_parts = []

    for fnum in present_fnums:
        if fnum not in ISO8583_FIELDS:
            continue
        _, dtype, ltype, flen = ISO8583_FIELDS[fnum]
        val = clean_fields[fnum]

        if ltype == "FIXED" and flen is not None:
            if dtype == "N":
                val = val.zfill(flen)[:flen]
            else:
                val = val.ljust(flen)[:flen]
            body_parts.append(val)
        elif ltype == "LLVAR":
            body_parts.append(f"{len(val):02d}{val}")
        elif ltype == "LLLVAR":
            body_parts.append(f"{len(val):03d}{val}")

    return f"{mti}{bitmap_hex}{''.join(body_parts)}"
'''

def test_standard_iso8583_pack_and_unpack():
    fields = {
        2: "4567890123450001",
        3: "010000",
        4: "000000100000",
        11: "123456",
        37: "000020526991",
        41: "ATM00001",
        49: "050"
    }
    raw = build_iso8583_1987("0200", fields)
    assert raw.startswith("0200")
    
    decoded = decode_iso8583_1987(raw)
    assert decoded["valid"] is True
    assert decoded["format"] == "ISO8583_1987"
    assert decoded["mti"] == "0200"
    assert decoded["raw_fields"]["2"] == "4567890123450001"
    assert decoded["raw_fields"]["11"] == "123456"
    assert decoded["derived_transaction_code"] == "01"


def test_parse_raw_endpoint_detects_tic_v2164e(client):
    # TIC message starts with A4M
    tic_raw, _ = build_tic_message("0200", {2: "4567890123450001", 3: "0100000", 4: "000000100000", 11: "998877", 49: "BDT"})
    res = client.post("/api/simulator/parse-raw", json={"raw_message": tic_raw})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    data = res.json()
    assert data["format"] == "TIC_V2164E"
    assert data["mti"] == "0200"
    assert data["fields"]["11"] == "998877"


def test_parse_raw_endpoint_detects_standard_iso8583(client):
    # Standard ISO message starts with 0200 + hex bitmap
    iso_raw = build_iso8583_1987("0200", {2: "4567890123450002", 3: "010000", 4: "000000250000", 11: "334455"})

    data = res.json()
    assert data["format"] == "ISO8583_1987"
    assert data["mti"] == "0200"
    assert data["fields"]["2"] == "4567890123450002"
    assert data["fields"]["11"] == "334455"
'''

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
INSTALLER: tools/install_step10.py
STEP 10 — HSM Key Management & Split-Component Ceremony (Single Unified Installer)
Adds:
  1. backend/app/key_ceremony_service.py (Parity, Component Assembly, KCV, ZMK Import/Export)
  2. Database columns clear_key_hex and parent_key_id in HsmKeyReference
  3. Pydantic schemas in backend/app/schemas.py
  4. Strict dynamic key resolution in backend/app/hsm_adapter.py
  5. REST endpoints in backend/app/api_routes.py
  6. frontend/src/pages/KeyCeremonyWorkbenchPage.tsx
  7. Route registration in App.tsx and Layout.tsx
  8. Automated Pytest test suite in backend/tests/test_step10_hsm_keys.py
"""

from pathlib import Path
import sys

BASE_DIR = Path(r"E:\HOST_VSCODE\host-simulator").resolve()
sys.path.insert(0, str(BASE_DIR))

from tools.patcher import PatcherSession, parse_installer_args

KEY_CEREMONY_SERVICE_CODE = '''"""
key_ceremony_service.py — Split-Component Key Ceremony & Key Exchange Service
Implements DES odd-parity adjustment, 2/3 component XOR assembly, KCV calculation,
and key translation under Zone Master Keys (ZMK).
"""

import re
import secrets
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
from app.hsm_adapter import SoftHsmCryptoCore


def enforce_des_odd_parity(hex_key: str) -> str:
    """Adjusts the least significant bit (LSB) of each byte so that it has odd parity."""
    raw = bytes.fromhex(hex_key.replace(" ", "").upper())
    adjusted = bytearray()
    for b in raw:
        # Count bits in the top 7 bits
        bits_count = bin(b & 0xFE).count("1")
        # If even, set LSB to 1; if odd, set LSB to 0
        lsb = 1 if (bits_count % 2 == 0) else 0
        adjusted.append((b & 0xFE) | lsb)
    return adjusted.hex().upper()


def validate_des_parity(hex_key: str) -> bool:
    """Validates that every byte in the key has odd parity."""
    raw = bytes.fromhex(hex_key.replace(" ", "").upper())
    for b in raw:
        if bin(b).count("1") % 2 == 0:
            return False
    return True


def generate_random_des_key(length_bits: int = 128) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Generates a cryptographically secure random 2-Key (128-bit) or 3-Key (192-bit) 3DES key with odd parity."""
    num_bytes = 16 if length_bits == 128 else 24
    rand_bytes = secrets.token_bytes(num_bytes)
    adjusted_hex = enforce_des_odd_parity(rand_bytes.hex().upper())
    kcv = SoftHsmCryptoCore.calculate_kcv(adjusted_hex)
    return {
        "key_hex": adjusted_hex,
        "length_bits": length_bits,
        "kcv": kcv,
        "odd_parity": True,
    }


def split_key_into_components(key_hex: str, num_components: int = 3) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Splits a key into 2 or 3 random components that XOR back to the original key."""
    clean_key = key_hex.replace(" ", "").upper()
    num_bytes = len(clean_key) // 2
    components = []

    running_xor = bytes.fromhex(clean_key)
    for _ in range(num_components - 1):
        rand_comp = secrets.token_bytes(num_bytes)
        rand_hex = enforce_des_odd_parity(rand_comp.hex().upper())
        components.append({
            "component_number": len(components) + 1,
            "hex": rand_hex,
            "kcv": SoftHsmCryptoCore.calculate_kcv(rand_hex),
        })
        running_xor = bytes(a ^ b for a, b in zip(running_xor, bytes.fromhex(rand_hex)))

    # Final component is the remaining XOR
    final_hex = enforce_des_odd_parity(running_xor.hex().upper())
    components.append({
        "component_number": len(components) + 1,
        "hex": final_hex,
        "kcv": SoftHsmCryptoCore.calculate_kcv(final_hex),
    })

    return {
        "original_key_kcv": SoftHsmCryptoCore.calculate_kcv(clean_key),
        "num_components": num_components,
        "components": components,
    }


def assemble_components(components_hex: List[str]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Assembles 2 or 3 clear components via XOR into the final operational key."""
    if len(components_hex) < 2:
        raise ValueError("Key assembly requires at least 2 components")

    clean_comps = [c.replace(" ", "").upper() for c in components_hex]
    key_len = len(clean_comps[0])
    for c in clean_comps:
        if len(c) != key_len:
            raise ValueError("All components must have identical length (32 or 48 hex chars)")

    running_bytes = bytes.fromhex(clean_comps[0])
    for c in clean_comps[1:]:
        comp_bytes = bytes.fromhex(c)
        running_bytes = bytes(a ^ b for a, b in zip(running_bytes, comp_bytes))

    assembled_hex = enforce_des_odd_parity(running_bytes.hex().upper())
    kcv = SoftHsmCryptoCore.calculate_kcv(assembled_hex)

    return {
        "assembled_key_hex": assembled_hex,
        "length_bits": len(assembled_hex) * 4,
        "kcv": kcv,
        "odd_parity": True,
        "components_count": len(components_hex),
        "component_kcvs": [SoftHsmCryptoCore.calculate_kcv(c) for c in clean_comps],
    }


def import_key_under_zmk(encrypted_key_hex: str, zmk_hex: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Decrypts a working key received under a ZMK and computes its clear KCV."""
    clean_enc = encrypted_key_hex.replace(" ", "").upper()
    clean_zmk = zmk_hex.replace(" ", "").upper()
    clear_key = SoftHsmCryptoCore.des3_ecb_hex(clean_enc, clean_zmk, decrypt=True)
    clear_key_parity = enforce_des_odd_parity(clear_key)
    kcv = SoftHsmCryptoCore.calculate_kcv(clear_key_parity)
    return {
        "clear_key_hex": clear_key_parity,
        "kcv": kcv,
        "zmk_kcv": SoftHsmCryptoCore.calculate_kcv(clean_zmk),
    }


def export_key_under_zmk(clear_key_hex: str, zmk_hex: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Encrypts a working key under a ZMK for secure export/exchange."""
    clean_key = clear_key_hex.replace(" ", "").upper()
    clean_zmk = zmk_hex.replace(" ", "").upper()
    encrypted_key = SoftHsmCryptoCore.des3_ecb_hex(clean_key, clean_zmk, decrypt=False)
    kcv = SoftHsmCryptoCore.calculate_kcv(clean_key)
    return {
        "encrypted_key_hex": encrypted_key,
        "key_kcv": kcv,
        "zmk_kcv": SoftHsmCryptoCore.calculate_kcv(clean_zmk),
    }
'''

TEST_STEP10_CODE = '''"""
test_step10_hsm_keys.py — Tests for Step 10 HSM Key Management & Key Ceremony
"""

import os
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

os.environ["DATABASE_URL"] = "sqlite:///:memory:"

from app.database import Base, SessionLocal, engine
from app.main import app
from app.models import HsmKeyReference
from app.key_ceremony_service import (
    assemble_components,
    enforce_des_odd_parity,
    export_key_under_zmk,
    generate_random_des_key,
    import_key_under_zmk,
    split_key_into_components,
    validate_des_parity,
)
from app.seed_data import seed_initial_data
from app.security import create_access_token
from app.config import settings


@pytest.fixture()
def db_session():
    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    session = SessionLocal()
    seed_initial_data(session)
    yield session
    session.close()
    Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)


@pytest.fixture()
def client(db_session):
    with TestClient(app) as c:
        token = create_access_token(subject=settings.ADMIN_USERNAME)
        c.headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}
        yield c


def test_odd_parity_enforcement_and_validation():
    # Known key
    raw_key = "0123456789ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF"
    parity_key = enforce_des_odd_parity(raw_key)
    assert validate_des_parity(parity_key) is True


def test_split_and_assemble_three_components():
    rand = generate_random_des_key(128)
    orig_key = rand["key_hex"]
    orig_kcv = rand["kcv"]

    # Split into 3 parts
    split = split_key_into_components(orig_key, 3)
    assert len(split["components"]) == 3

    # Assemble back
    comps = [c["hex"] for c in split["components"]]
    assembled = assemble_components(comps)
    assert assembled["kcv"] == orig_kcv


def test_assemble_and_register_endpoint(client, db_session):
    payload = {
        "key_identifier": "AWK_TEST_CEREMONY_01",
        "key_type": "AWK",
        "components": [
            "11111111111111111111111111111111",
            "22222222222222222222222222222222"
        ]
    }
    res = client.post("/api/hsm/ceremony/assemble-components", json=payload)
    assert res.status_code == 200
    data = res.json()
    assert data["key_identifier"] == "AWK_TEST_CEREMONY_01"
    assert len(data["kvc"]) == 6

    # Verify key was persisted into the database with its clear hex
    key_db = db_session.query(HsmKeyReference).filter(HsmKeyReference.key_identifier == "AWK_TEST_CEREMONY_01").first()
    assert key_db is not None
    assert key_db.clear_key_hex is not None


def test_export_and_import_under_zmk():
    zmk = "0123456789ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF"
    working_key = "1A2B3C4D5E6F70811A2B3C4D5E6F7081"

    exported = export_key_under_zmk(working_key, zmk)
    assert len(exported["encrypted_key_hex"]) == 32

    imported = import_key_under_zmk(exported["encrypted_key_hex"], zmk)
    assert imported["kcv"] == exported["key_kcv"]
'''


def main() -> int:
    args = parse_installer_args("Step 10: HSM Key Management & Split-Component Ceremony")
    session = PatcherSession(
        step_id="step10",
        title="Implement Split-Component Key Ceremony, Parity Enforcement, and ZMK Key Exchange",
        dry_run=args.dry_run,
    )

    # 1. Write backend/app/key_ceremony_service.py
    session.write_file("backend/app/key_ceremony_service.py", KEY_CEREMONY_SERVICE_CODE)

    # 2. Patch backend/app/models.py to add clear_key_hex and parent_key_id to HsmKeyReference
    session.patch_file(
        "backend/app/models.py",
        [
            {
                "marker": "step10:hsm_key_ceremony_columns",
                "action": "insert_after",
                "anchor": "    key_status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(20), nullable=False, default=\"ACTIVE\")",
                "text": (
                    "    clear_key_hex: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(64))\n"
                    "    parent_key_id: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(36), ForeignKey('hsm_key_references.id'), index=True)\n"
                    "    parent_key: Mapped[Optional['HsmKeyReference']] = relationship('HsmKeyReference', remote_side=[id])"
                ),
            }
        ],
    )

    # 3. Patch backend/app/schemas.py to add ceremony schemas
    session.patch_file(
        "backend/app/schemas.py",
        [
            {
                "marker": "step10:schemas_key_ceremony",
                "action": "append",
                "text": (
                    "\n# ==============================================================================\n"
                    "# STEP 10 SCHEMAS: HSM KEY CEREMONY & EXCHANGE\n"
                    "# ==============================================================================\n\n"
                    "class RandomKeyGenerateRequest(BaseModel):\n"
                    "    length_bits: int = 128\n\n\n"
                    "class KeyAssemblyRequest(BaseModel):\n"
                    "    key_identifier: str = Field(..., min_length=3, max_length=100)\n"
                    "    key_type: str = 'AWK'\n"
                    "    key_name: Optional[str] = None\n"
                    "    institution_id: Optional[str] = None\n"
                    "    components: List[str] = Field(..., min_length=2, max_length=3)\n\n\n"
                    "class KeyExportUnderZmkRequest(BaseModel):\n"
                    "    key_identifier: str\n"
                    "    zmk_identifier: str = 'ZMK_MAIN'\n\n\n"
                    "class KeyImportUnderZmkRequest(BaseModel):\n"
                    "    key_identifier: str\n"
                    "    key_type: str = 'AWK'\n"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
INSTALLER: tools/install_step11.py
STEP 11 — Routing and Network Simulation (Single Unified Installer)
Adds:
  1. backend/app/network_adapter.py (Enterprise Network Routing & Simulated Switch)
  2. Columns simulation_mode, simulated_response_code, simulated_delay_ms in network_profiles
  3. Pydantic schemas in backend/app/schemas.py
  4. Outbound Off-Us routing & PIN translation integration in backend/app/host_engine.py
  5. REST endpoints in backend/app/api_routes.py
  6. frontend/src/pages/NetworkRoutingPage.tsx
  7. Route registration in App.tsx and Layout.tsx
  8. Automated Pytest test suite in backend/tests/test_step11_routing.py
"""

from pathlib import Path
import sys

BASE_DIR = Path(r"E:\HOST_VSCODE\host-simulator").resolve()
sys.path.insert(0, str(BASE_DIR))

from tools.patcher import PatcherSession, parse_installer_args

NETWORK_ADAPTER_CODE = '''"""
network_adapter.py — Enterprise Switch Routing Engine & Simulated Card Schemes
Handles On-Us vs Off-Us resolution, cross-zone PIN translation (AWK -> IWK),
outbound simulated switch adapters (Visa/Mastercard/NPSB), and timeout reversal handling.
"""

import time
import uuid
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from app.hsm_adapter import HSMAdapter, SoftHsmCryptoCore
from app.models import BinRange, NetworkProfile, ProcessingSystem, Transaction


class NetworkAdapter:
    """Base interface for payment network connectivity."""

    def __init__(self, db: Session, network_name: str):
        self.db = db
        self.network_name = network_name
        self.hsm = HSMAdapter(db)

    def route_transaction(self, request_payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        raise NotImplementedError


class SimulatedNetworkAdapter(NetworkAdapter):
    """
    Simulates external card payment switches (VisaNet, Mastercard Banknet, NPSB).
    Translates PIN blocks across cryptographic zones (AWK -> IWK) and handles
    simulation behaviors: Always Approve, Decline with configured RC, Timeout, and Unavailable.
    """

    def route_transaction(self, request_payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        # 1. Resolve network profile configuration from database
        profile = (
            self.db.query(NetworkProfile)
            .filter(NetworkProfile.network_name == self.network_name)
            .first()
        )
        sim_mode = getattr(profile, "simulation_mode", "ALWAYS_APPROVE") if profile else "ALWAYS_APPROVE"
        sim_rc = getattr(profile, "simulated_response_code", "00") if profile else "00"
        sim_delay = getattr(profile, "simulated_delay_ms", 0) if profile else 0

        if sim_delay > 0:
            time.sleep(min(sim_delay, 500) / 1000.0)

        pan = request_payload.get("pan", "")
        fields = request_payload.get("fields", {})
        pin_block = fields.get("52")

        # 2. Zone PIN Translation: Translate from AWK (acquirer zone) to IWK (switch zone)
        translated_pin_block = None
        if pin_block:
            trans_res = self.hsm.translate_pin_block(
                pan=pan,
                encrypted_pin_block=pin_block,
                awk_id="AWK_ATM_01",
                iwk_id="IWK_SW_01",
            )
            translated_pin_block = trans_res.get("sanitized_resp", {}).get("destination_pin_block") or "F" * 16

        # 3. Simulate Network Outcome
        if sim_mode == "TIMEOUT":
            return {
                "network_status": "TIMEOUT",
                "response_code": "91",
                "response_message": f"{self.network_name} switch timeout (RC 91). Automatic reversal required.",
                "requires_reversal": True,
                "translated_pin_block": translated_pin_block,
                "authorization_code": "000000",
            }
        elif sim_mode == "UNAVAILABLE":
            return {
                "network_status": "UNAVAILABLE",
                "response_code": "91",
                "response_message": f"{self.network_name} switch link disconnected or inoperative (RC 91)",
                "requires_reversal": False,
                "translated_pin_block": translated_pin_block,
                "authorization_code": "000000",
            }
        elif sim_mode == "DECLINE_WITH_RC":
            return {
                "network_status": "DECLINED",
                "response_code": sim_rc,
                "response_message": f"Declined by external network {self.network_name} (RC {sim_rc})",
                "requires_reversal": False,
                "translated_pin_block": translated_pin_block,
                "authorization_code": "000000",
            }

        # Default: ALWAYS_APPROVE
        return {
            "network_status": "APPROVED",
            "response_code": "00",
            "response_message": f"Approved by external network {self.network_name}",
            "requires_reversal": False,
            "translated_pin_block": translated_pin_block,
            "authorization_code": uuid.uuid4().hex[:6].upper(),
        }


def resolve_transaction_routing(db: Session, pan: str, acquirer_id: str = "123456") -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Determines On-Us vs Off-Us status and selects the destination processing system or network adapter.
    """
    clean_pan = "".join(ch for ch in pan if ch.isdigit())
    bin_prefix = clean_pan[:6] if len(clean_pan) >= 6 else ""

    bin_match = db.query(BinRange).filter(BinRange.bin_prefix == bin_prefix).first()
    if not bin_match:
        # Default to On-Us ITCL internal switch if unknown
        return {
            "is_on_us": True,
            "routing_target": "INTERNAL_ITCL",
            "scheme": "ITCL",
            "destination_network": None,
            "bin_prefix": bin_prefix,
        }

    is_on_us = bin_match.is_on_us
    scheme = bin_match.scheme.upper()

    dest_network = None
    if not is_on_us:
        if "VISA" in scheme:
            dest_network = "VISA_SCHEME"
        elif "MASTER" in scheme:
            dest_network = "MASTERCARD_SCHEME"
        elif "NPSB" in scheme:
            dest_network = "NPSB_NATIONAL_SWITCH"
        else:
            dest_network = "INTERNAL_SIMULATOR_TIC"

    return {
        "is_on_us": is_on_us,
        "routing_target": "ON_US_HOST" if is_on_us else "EXTERNAL_NETWORK",
        "scheme": scheme,
        "destination_network": dest_network,
        "bin_prefix": bin_prefix,
        "institution_id": bin_match.institution_id,
        "card_product": bin_match.card_product,
    }
'''

              </div>
              <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold ${
                p.simulation_mode === 'ALWAYS_APPROVE' ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400' :
                p.simulation_mode === 'TIMEOUT' ? 'bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400' : 'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-400'
              }`}>
                {p.simulation_mode}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-3 text-xs font-mono">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">Simulation Mode</label>
                <select
                  value={p.simulation_mode}
                  onChange={(e) => handleUpdateMode(p, e.target.value, p.simulated_response_code, p.simulated_delay_ms)}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5"
                >
                  <option value="ALWAYS_APPROVE">ALWAYS_APPROVE (RC 00)</option>
                  <option value="DECLINE_WITH_RC">DECLINE_WITH_RC</option>
                  <option value="TIMEOUT">TIMEOUT (RC 91 + Auto-Reversal)</option>
                  <option value="UNAVAILABLE">UNAVAILABLE (RC 91 Link Inoperative)</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              {p.simulation_mode === 'DECLINE_WITH_RC' && (
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">Simulated Decline Response Code</label>
                  <select
                    value={p.simulated_response_code}
                    onChange={(e) => handleUpdateMode(p, p.simulation_mode, e.target.value, p.simulated_delay_ms)}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5"
                  >
                    <option value="51">51 — Insufficient Funds</option>
                    <option value="05">05 — Do Not Honor</option>
                    <option value="54">54 — Expired Card</option>
                    <option value="55">55 — Incorrect PIN</option>
                    <option value="61">61 — Exceeds Limit</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              )}

              <div>
                <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">Simulated Network Latency (ms)</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  value={p.simulated_delay_ms}
                  onChange={(e) => handleUpdateMode(p, p.simulation_mode, p.simulated_response_code, parseInt(e.target.value) || 0)}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Interactive PAN Routing Inspector */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4">
        <h2 className="text-sm font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
          <Play size={15} className="text-emerald-500" /> Interactive BIN Routing & Outbound Dispatch Test
        </h2>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <input
            value={testPan}
            onChange={(e) => setTestPan(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Enter synthetic PAN (e.g. 456789... or 512345...)"
            className="flex-1 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs font-mono"
          />
          <button
            onClick={handleTestRoute}
            className="bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold"
          >
            Resolve Route & Dispatch ➔
          </button>
        </div>

        {testResult && (
          <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 text-xs font-mono space-y-2">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-800 pb-2">
              <span className="font-bold text-emerald-400">Routing Target: {testResult.routing.routing_target}</span>
              <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold ${testResult.routing.is_on_us ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400' : 'bg-sky-500/10 text-sky-400'}`}>
                {testResult.routing.is_on_us ? 'ON-US (Internal ITCL)' : 'OFF-US (External Scheme)'}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div><span className="text-slate-400">Card Scheme:</span> {testResult.routing.scheme}</div>
            <div><span className="text-slate-400">Destination Adapter:</span> {testResult.routing.destination_network || 'None (Internal Host)'}</div>
            {testResult.outbound_response && (
              <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-800">
                <div className="text-[11px] text-amber-400 font-bold mb-1">Simulated Network Response:</div>

                <div>Message: {testResult.outbound_response.response_message}</div>

};

  2. SettlementBatch, SettlementEntry, SettlementPosition ORM models in backend/app/models.py

  5. Settlement REST endpoints in backend/app/api_routes.py
  6. frontend/src/pages/ClearingAndSettlementPage.tsx
  7. Route registration in App.tsx and Layout.tsx
  8. Automated Pytest test suite in backend/tests/test_step12_settlement.py

import sys

SETTLEMENT_SERVICE_CODE = '''"""
settlement_service.py — Clearing, Daily Settlement and Multilateral Reconciliation Engine
Implements authorization holds, 0220 advices, daily cutover batches, interchange fee calculation,
net settlement position resolution, and mismatch audits.
"""

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
import uuid
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
from sqlalchemy import func
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from app.models import (
    Account,
    AccountLedger,
    Institution,
    ProcessingSystem,
    SettlementBatch,
    SettlementEntry,
    SettlementPosition,
    Transaction,
)


def calculate_fees(amount: Decimal, transaction_code: str, scheme: str = "ITCL") -> Dict[str, Decimal]:
    """
    Calculates interchange fee and processing switch fee based on transaction type.
    """
    if amount <= Decimal("0.00"):
        return {"interchange_fee": Decimal("0.00"), "scheme_fee": Decimal("0.00")}

    # Default ATM Cash Withdrawal: Fixed fee
    if transaction_code in ("10", "010"):
        interchange = Decimal("15.00")  # 15 BDT interchange
        scheme_fee = Decimal("2.50")    # 2.5 BDT switch fee
    elif transaction_code in ("40", "110"):
        # POS / E-Commerce Purchase: 1.5% interchange + 0.15% scheme
        interchange = (amount * Decimal("0.015")).quantize(Decimal("0.01"))
        scheme_fee = (amount * Decimal("0.0015")).quantize(Decimal("0.01"))
    else:
        interchange = Decimal("5.00")
        scheme_fee = Decimal("1.00")

    return {
        "interchange_fee": interchange,
        "scheme_fee": scheme_fee,
    }


def execute_daily_cutover(
    db: Session,
    ps_code: str = "ITCL",
    operator: str = "admin",
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Executes daily cutover: closes the current batch, computes interchange and scheme fees,
    generates settlement entries, and derives multilateral net positions per institution.
    """
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    batch_num = f"SETL-{ps_code}-{now.strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S')}"

    # 1. Resolve Processing System
    ps = db.query(ProcessingSystem).filter(ProcessingSystem.ps_code == ps_code.upper()).first()
    ps_id = ps.id if ps else None

    # 2. Identify all approved financial transactions not yet in a closed settlement batch
    settled_tx_ids = db.query(SettlementEntry.transaction_id)
    unsettled_txs = (
        db.query(Transaction)
        .filter(
            Transaction.authorization_status == "APPROVED",
            Transaction.mti.in_(["0200", "0210", "0220"]),
            ~Transaction.id.in_(settled_tx_ids),
        )
        .all()
    )

    batch = SettlementBatch(
        batch_number=batch_num,
        processing_system_id=ps_id,
        ps_code=ps_code.upper(),
        cutover_time=now,
        status="CLOSED",
        total_transactions=len(unsettled_txs),
        total_amount=Decimal("0.00"),
        total_fees=Decimal("0.00"),
        mismatch_count=0,
    )
    db.add(batch)
    db.flush()

    tot_amt = Decimal("0.00")
    tot_fees = Decimal("0.00")
    mismatches = 0

    # Institution position aggregators: inst_id -> {debit_vol, credit_vol, debit_cnt, credit_cnt, fee_net}
    positions: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}

    def _ensure_inst(inst_id: str):
        if inst_id not in positions:
            positions[inst_id] = {
                "debit_volume": Decimal("0.00"),
                "credit_volume": Decimal("0.00"),
                "debit_count": 0,
                "credit_count": 0,
                "net_fee": Decimal("0.00"),
            }

    for tx in unsettled_txs:
        fees = calculate_fees(tx.transaction_amount, tx.transaction_code or "10", ps_code)
        ic_fee = fees["interchange_fee"]
        sch_fee = fees["scheme_fee"]
        total_fee = ic_fee + sch_fee
        net_amt = tx.transaction_amount - total_fee

        tot_amt += tx.transaction_amount
        tot_fees += total_fee

        entry = SettlementEntry(
            batch_id=batch.id,
            transaction_id=tx.id,
            issuer_institution_id=tx.issuer_institution_id,
            acquirer_institution_id=tx.acquirer_institution_id,
            mti=tx.mti,
            transaction_amount=tx.transaction_amount,
            interchange_fee=ic_fee,
            scheme_fee=sch_fee,
            net_amount=net_amt,
            settlement_status="SETTLED",
        )
        db.add(entry)

        # Multi-lateral position tracking
        if tx.issuer_institution_id:
            _ensure_inst(tx.issuer_institution_id)
            # Issuer owes the settlement switch for customer withdrawals
            positions[tx.issuer_institution_id]["debit_volume"] += tx.transaction_amount
            positions[tx.issuer_institution_id]["debit_count"] += 1
            # Issuer receives interchange fee
            positions[tx.issuer_institution_id]["net_fee"] += ic_fee

        if tx.acquirer_institution_id:
            _ensure_inst(tx.acquirer_institution_id)
            # Acquirer is credited with the cash dispensed
            positions[tx.acquirer_institution_id]["credit_volume"] += tx.transaction_amount
            positions[tx.acquirer_institution_id]["credit_count"] += 1
            # Acquirer pays interchange fee and switch fee
            positions[tx.acquirer_institution_id]["net_fee"] -= total_fee

    batch.total_amount = tot_amt
    batch.total_fees = tot_fees

    # 3. Create SettlementPosition records per institution
    for inst_id, pos in positions.items():
        net_settlement = pos["credit_volume"] - pos["debit_volume"] + pos["net_fee"]
        db.add(
            SettlementPosition(
                batch_id=batch.id,
                institution_id=inst_id,
                net_settlement_amount=net_settlement,
                debit_count=pos["debit_count"],
                credit_count=pos["credit_count"],
                debit_volume=pos["debit_volume"],
                credit_volume=pos["credit_volume"],
                net_fee_amount=pos["net_fee"],
                settlement_status="SETTLED",
            )
        )

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(batch)

    return {
        "batch_id": batch.id,
        "batch_number": batch.batch_number,
        "ps_code": batch.ps_code,
        "cutover_time": batch.cutover_time.isoformat(),
        "total_transactions": batch.total_transactions,
        "total_amount": float(batch.total_amount),
        "total_fees": float(batch.total_fees),
        "status": batch.status,
        "institutions_settled": len(positions),
    }


def get_reconciliation_summary(db: Session) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Audits open holds, cleared totals, and flags any mismatch discrepancies."""
    total_approved = db.query(func.count(Transaction.id)).filter(Transaction.authorization_status == "APPROVED").scalar() or 0
    total_reversed = db.query(func.count(Transaction.id)).filter(Transaction.transaction_status == "REVERSED").scalar() or 0
    total_settled = db.query(func.count(SettlementEntry.id)).scalar() or 0
    pending_settlement = max(0, total_approved - total_settled)

    batches = db.query(SettlementBatch).order_by(SettlementBatch.cutover_time.desc()).limit(10).all()

    return {
        "total_approved_transactions": total_approved,
        "total_reversed_transactions": total_reversed,
        "total_settled_transactions": total_settled,
        "pending_clearing_transactions": pending_settlement,
        "reconciliation_status": "BALANCED" if pending_settlement == 0 else "PENDING_BATCH_CUTOVER",
        "recent_batches": [
            {
                "id": b.id,
                "batch_number": b.batch_number,
                "ps_code": b.ps_code,
                "cutover_time": b.cutover_time.isoformat(),
                "total_transactions": b.total_transactions,
                "total_amount": float(b.total_amount),
                "total_fees": float(b.total_fees),
                "status": b.status,
            }
            for b in batches
        ],
    }
'''

              <div className="text-slate-400 pt-1 border-t border-slate-800">
                Transactions generated across multiple banks. Now click "Execute Daily Settlement Cutover" above to clear them.
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

};
